民數記 26:61 拿答、亞比戶、在耶和華面前獻凡火的時候、就死了。

Numbers 26:62 And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
民數記 26:62 利未人中、凡一個月以外被數的男丁、共有二萬三千．他們本來沒有數在以色列人中．因爲在以色列人中沒有分給他們產業。

Numbers 26:63 These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
民數記 26:63 這些就是被摩西和祭司以利亞撒所數的、他們在摩押平原、與耶利哥相對的約但河邊、數點以色列人。

Numbers 26:64 But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
民數記 26:64 但被數的人中、沒有一個是摩西和祭司亞倫、從前在西乃的曠野所數的以色列人．

Numbers 26:65 For the L ORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
民數記 26:65 因爲耶和華論到他們說、他們必要死在曠野、所以除了耶孚尼的兒子迦勒、和嫩的兒子約書亞以外、連一個人也沒有存留。

Numbers 27:1 T hen came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
民數記 27:1 屬約瑟的兒子瑪拿西的各族、有瑪拿西的玄孫、瑪吉的曾孫、基列的孫子、希弗的兒子西羅非哈的女兒、名叫瑪拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。他們前來、

Numbers 27:2 And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
民數記 27:2 站在會幕門口、在摩西和祭司以利亞撒、並衆首領、與全會衆面前、說、

Numbers 27:3 Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the L ORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
民數記 27:3 我們的父親死在曠野、他不與可拉同黨聚集攻擊耶和華、是在自己罪中死的、他也沒有兒子。

Numbers 27:4 Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
民數記 27:4 爲甚麼因我們的父親沒有兒子、就把他的名從他族中除掉呢．求你們在我們父親的弟兄中分給我們產業。

Numbers 27:5 And Moses brought their cause before the L ORD.
民數記 27:5 於是摩西將他們的案件、呈到耶和華面前。

Numbers 27:6 And the L ORD spake unto Moses, saying,
民數記 27:6 耶和華曉諭摩西說、

Numbers 27:7 The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
民數記 27:7 西羅非哈的女兒說的有理。你定要在他們父親的弟兄中、把地分給他們爲業．要將他們父親的產業歸給他們。

Numbers 27:8 And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
民數記 27:8 你也要曉諭以色列人說、人若死了沒有兒子、就要把他的產業歸給他的女兒。

Numbers 27:9 And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
民數記 27:9 他若沒有女兒、就要把他的產業給他的弟兄。

Numbers 27:10 And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
民數記 27:10 他若沒有弟兄、就要把他的產業給他父親的弟兄。

Numbers 27:11 And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the L ORD commanded Moses.
民數記 27:11 他父親若沒有弟兄、就要把他的產業給他族中最近的親屬、他便要得爲業．這要作以色列人的律例、典章、是照耶和華吩咐摩西的。

Numbers 27:12 And the L ORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
民數記 27:12 耶和華對摩西說、你上這亞巴琳山、觀看我所賜給以色列人的地。

Numbers 27:13 And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
民數記 27:13 看了以後、你也必歸到你列祖那裏、像你哥哥亞倫一樣．

Numbers 27:14 For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
民數記 27:14 因爲你們在尋的曠野、當會衆爭鬧的時候、違背了我的命、沒有在湧水之地會衆眼前尊我爲聖。（這水、就是尋的曠野加低斯米利巴水。）

Numbers 27:15 And Moses spake unto the L ORD, saying,
民數記 27:15 摩西對耶和華說、

Numbers 27:16 Let the L ORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
民數記 27:16 願耶和華萬人之靈的 神、立一個人治理會衆。

Numbers 27:17 Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the L ORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
民數記 27:17 可以在他們面前出入、也可以引導他們、免得耶和華的會衆如同沒有牧人的羊羣一般。

Numbers 27:18 And the L ORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
民數記 27:18 耶和華對摩西說、嫩的兒子約書亞、是心中有聖靈的、你將他領來按手在他頭上．

Numbers 27:19 And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
民數記 27:19 使他站在祭司以利亞撒、和全會衆面前、囑咐他。

Numbers 27:20 And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
民數記 27:20 又將你的尊榮給他幾分、使以色列全會衆都聽從他。

Numbers 27:21 And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the L ORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
民數記 27:21 他要站在祭司以利亞撒面前、以利亞撒要憑烏陵的判斷、在耶和華面前爲他求問．他和以色列全會衆都要遵以利亞撒的命出入。

Numbers 27:22 And Moses did as the L ORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
民數記 27:22 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的、將約書亞領來、使他站在祭司以利亞撒和全會衆面前、

Numbers 27:23 And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the L ORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
民數記 27:23 按手在他頭上、囑咐他、是照耶和華藉摩西所說的話。

Numbers 28:1 A nd the L ORD spake unto Moses, saying,
民數記 28:1 耶和華曉諭摩西說、

Numbers 28:2 Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
民數記 28:2 你要吩咐以色列人說、獻給我的供物、就是獻給我作馨香火祭的食物、你們要按日期獻給我。

Numbers 28:3 And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the L ORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
民數記 28:3 又要對他們說、你們要獻給耶和華的火祭、就是沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔、每日兩隻、作爲常獻的燔祭。

Numbers 28:4 The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
民數記 28:4 早晨要獻一隻、黃昏的時候要獻一隻。

Numbers 28:5 And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
民數記 28:5 又用細麵伊法十分之一、並搗成的油一欣四分之一、調和作爲素祭。

Numbers 28:6 It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the L ORD.
民數記 28:6 這是西乃山所命定爲常獻的燔祭、是獻給耶和華爲馨香的火祭。

Numbers 28:7 And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the L ORD for a drink offering.
民數記 28:7 爲這一隻羊羔要同獻奠祭的酒、一欣四分之一．在聖所中、你要將醇酒奉給耶和華爲奠祭。

Numbers 28:8 And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the L ORD.
民數記 28:8 晚上、你要獻那一隻羊羔、必照早晨的素祭、和同獻的奠祭獻上、作爲馨香的火祭、獻給耶和華。

Numbers 28:9 And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
民數記 28:9 當安息日、要獻兩隻沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔、並用調油的細麵伊法十分之二爲素祭、又將同獻的奠祭獻上。

Numbers 28:10 This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 28:10 這是每安息日獻的燔祭、那常獻的燔祭、和同獻的奠祭在外。

Numbers 28:11 And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the L ORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
民數記 28:11 每月朔、你們要將兩隻公牛犢、一隻公綿羊、七隻沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔、獻給耶和華爲燔祭。

Numbers 28:12 And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
民數記 28:12 每隻公牛、要用調油的細麵伊法十分之三、作爲素祭、那隻公羊也用調油的細麵伊法十分之二、作爲素祭。

Numbers 28:13 And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the L ORD.
民數記 28:13 每隻羊羔要用調油的細麵伊法十分之一、作爲素祭、和馨香的燔祭．是獻給耶和華的火祭。

Numbers 28:14 And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
民數記 28:14 一隻公牛要奠酒半欣、一隻公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一、一隻羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一．這是每月的燔祭、一年之中要月月如此。

Numbers 28:15 And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the L ORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 28:15 又要將一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭、獻給耶和華．要獻在常獻的燔祭、和同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 28:16 And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the L ORD.
民數記 28:16 正月十四日、是耶和華的逾越節。

Numbers 28:17 And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
民數記 28:17 這月十五日是節期、要喫無酵餅七日。

Numbers 28:18 In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
民數記 28:18 第一日當有聖會、甚麼勞碌的工都不可作。

Numbers 28:19 But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the L ORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
民數記 28:19 當將公牛犢兩隻、公綿羊一隻、一歲的公羊羔七隻、都要沒有殘疾的、用火獻給耶和華爲燔祭。

Numbers 28:20 And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
民數記 28:20 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵、爲一隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三．爲一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二。

Numbers 28:21 A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
民數記 28:21 爲那七隻羊羔、每隻要獻伊法十分之一．

Numbers 28:22 And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
民數記 28:22 並獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭、爲你們贖罪。

Numbers 28:23 Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
民數記 28:23 你們獻這些、要在早晨常獻的燔祭以外。

Numbers 28:24 After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the L ORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 28:24 一連七日、每日要照這例、把馨香火祭的食物獻給耶和華、是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 28:25 And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
民數記 28:25 第七日當有聖會、甚麼勞碌的工都不可作。

Numbers 28:26 Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the L ORD, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
民數記 28:26 七七節莊稼初熟、你們獻新素祭給耶和華的日子、當有聖會、甚麼勞碌的工都不可作。

Numbers 28:27 But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the L ORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
民數記 28:27 只要將公牛犢兩隻、公綿羊一隻、一歲的公羊羔七隻、作爲馨香的燔祭、獻給耶和華。

Numbers 28:28 And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
民數記 28:28 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵、爲每隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三．爲一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二．

Numbers 28:29 A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
民數記 28:29 爲那七隻羊羔、每隻要獻伊法十分之一．

Numbers 28:30 And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
民數記 28:30 並獻一隻公山羊爲你們贖罪。

Numbers 28:31 Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
民數記 28:31 這些、你們要獻在常獻的燔祭、和同獻的素祭、並同獻的奠祭以外、都要沒有殘疾的。

Numbers 29:1 A nd in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
民數記 29:1 七月初一日、你們當有聖會、甚麼勞碌的工都不可作、是你們當守爲吹角的日子。

Numbers 29:2 And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the L ORD; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
民數記 29:2 你們要將公牛犢一隻、公綿羊一隻、沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔七隻、作爲馨香的燔祭、獻給耶和華。

Numbers 29:3 And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,
民數記 29:3 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵、爲一隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三．爲一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二、

Numbers 29:4 And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
民數記 29:4 爲那七隻羊羔、每隻要獻伊法十分之一。

Numbers 29:5 And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
民數記 29:5 又獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭、爲你們贖罪。

Numbers 29:6 Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the L ORD.
民數記 29:6 這些是在月朔的燔祭、和同獻的素祭、並常獻的燔祭、與同獻的素祭、以及照例同獻的奠祭以外．都作爲馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。

Numbers 29:7 And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:
民數記 29:7 七月初十日、你們當有聖會、要刻苦己心、甚麼工都不可作。

Numbers 29:8 But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the L ORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
民數記 29:8 只要將公牛犢一隻、公綿羊一隻、一歲的公羊羔七隻、都要沒有殘疾的、作爲馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。

Numbers 29:9 And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,
民數記 29:9 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵、爲一隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三、爲一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二．

Numbers 29:10 A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
民數記 29:10 爲那七隻羊羔每隻要獻伊法十分之一。

Numbers 29:11 One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
民數記 29:11 又獻一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭、這是在贖罪祭、和常獻的燔祭、與同獻的素祭、並同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 29:12 And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the L ORD seven days:
民數記 29:12 七月十五日、你們當有聖會、甚麼勞碌的工都不可作、要向耶和華守節七日。

Numbers 29:13 And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the L ORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
民數記 29:13 又要將公牛犢十三隻、公綿羊兩隻、一歲的公羊羔十四隻、都要沒有殘疾的、用火獻給耶和華爲馨香的燔祭。

Numbers 29:14 And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
民數記 29:14 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵、爲那十三隻公牛每隻要獻伊法十分之三．爲那兩隻公羊、每隻要獻伊法十分之二．

Numbers 29:15 And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
民數記 29:15 爲那十四隻羊羔、每隻要獻伊法十分之一．

Numbers 29:16 And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 29:16 並獻一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭．這是在常獻的燔祭、和同獻的素祭、並同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 29:17 And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
民數記 29:17 第二日要獻公牛犢十二隻、公綿羊兩隻、沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔十四隻。

Numbers 29:18 And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
民數記 29:18 並爲公牛、公羊、和羊羔、按數照例、獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。

Numbers 29:19 And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
民數記 29:19 又要獻一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭．這是在常獻的燔祭、和同獻的素祭、並同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 29:20 And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
民數記 29:20 第三日要獻公牛十一隻、公羊兩隻、沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔十四隻。

Numbers 29:21 And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
民數記 29:21 並爲公牛、公羊、和羊羔、按數照例獻同獻的素祭、和同獻的奠祭。

Numbers 29:22 And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 29:22 又要獻一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 29:23 And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
民數記 29:23 第四日要獻公牛十隻、公羊兩隻、沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻．

Numbers 29:24 Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
民數記 29:24 並爲公牛、公羊、和羊羔、按數照例、獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。

Numbers 29:25 And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 29:25 又要獻一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭．這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭、並同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 29:26 And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
民數記 29:26 第五日要獻公牛九隻、公羊兩隻、沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔十四隻。

Numbers 29:27 And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
民數記 29:27 並爲公牛、公羊、和羊羔、按數照例獻同獻的素祭、和同獻的奠祭。

Numbers 29:28 And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 29:28 又要獻一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭．這是在常獻的燔祭、和同獻的素祭、並同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 29:29 And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
民數記 29:29 第六日要獻公牛八隻、公羊兩隻、沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔十四隻．

Numbers 29:30 And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
民數記 29:30 並爲公牛、公羊、和羊羔、按數照例獻同獻的素祭、和同獻的奠祭。

Numbers 29:31 And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 29:31 又要獻一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭．這是在常獻的燔祭、和同獻的素祭、並同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 29:32 And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
民數記 29:32 第七日要獻公牛七隻、公羊兩隻、沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔十四隻．

Numbers 29:33 And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
民數記 29:33 並爲公牛、公羊、和羊羔、按數照例獻同獻的素祭、和同獻的奠祭。

Numbers 29:34 And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 29:34 又要獻一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭．這是在常獻的燔祭、和同獻的素祭、並同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 29:35 On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:
民數記 29:35 第八日你們當有嚴肅會、甚麼勞碌的工都不可作。

Numbers 29:36 But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the L ORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
民數記 29:36 只要將公牛一隻、公羊一隻、沒有殘疾一歲的公羊羔七隻、作火祭、獻給耶和華爲馨香的燔祭．

Numbers 29:37 Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
民數記 29:37 並爲公牛、公羊、和羊羔、按數照例獻同獻的素祭、和同獻的奠祭。

Numbers 29:38 And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
民數記 29:38 又要獻一隻公山羊爲贖罪祭．這是在常獻的燔祭、和同獻的素祭並、同獻的奠祭以外。

Numbers 29:39 These things ye shall do unto the L ORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
民數記 29:39 這些祭要在你們的節期獻給耶和華、都在所許的願、並甘心所獻的以外、作爲你們的燔祭、素祭、奠祭、和平安祭。

Numbers 29:40 And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the L ORD commanded Moses.
民數記 29:40 於是、摩西照耶和華所吩咐他的一切話、告訴以色列人。

Numbers 30:1 A nd Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the L ORD hath commanded.
民數記 30:1 摩西曉諭以色列各支派的首領、說、耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣。

Numbers 30:2 If a man vow a vow unto the L ORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
民數記 30:2 人若向耶和華許願、或起誓、要約束自己、就不可食言、必要按口中所出的一切話行。

Numbers 30:3 If a woman also vow a vow unto the L ORD, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
民數記 30:3 女子年幼還在父家的時候、若向耶和華許願要約束自己．

Numbers 30:4 And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
民數記 30:4 他父親也聽見他所許的願、並約束自己的話、卻向他默默不言、他所許的願、並約束自己的話、就都要爲定。

Numbers 30:5 But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the L ORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
民數記 30:5 但他父親聽見的日子、若不應承、他所許的願、和約束自己的話、就都不得爲定．耶和華也必赦免他、因爲他父親不應承。

Numbers 30:6 And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
民數記 30:6 他若出了嫁、有願在身、或是口中出了約束自己的冒失話．

Numbers 30:7 And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it:
民數記 30:7 他丈夫聽見的日子、卻向他默默不言、他所許的願、並約束自己的話、就都要爲定。

Numbers 30:8 But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the L ORD shall forgive her.
民數記 30:8 但他丈夫聽見的日子、若不應承、就算廢了他所許的願和他出口約束自己的冒失話、耶和華也必赦免他。

Numbers 30:9 But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
民數記 30:9 寡婦、或是被休的婦人所許的願、就是他約束自己的話、都要爲定。

Numbers 30:10 And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
民數記 30:10 他若在丈夫家裏許了願或起了誓、約束自己．

Numbers 30:11 And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
民數記 30:11 丈夫聽見卻向他默默不言、也沒有不應承、他所許的願、並約束自己的話、就都要爲定。

Numbers 30:12 But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the L ORD shall forgive her.
民數記 30:12 丈夫聽見的日子、若把這兩樣全廢了、婦人口中所許的願、或是約束自己的話、就都不得爲定、因他丈夫已經把這兩樣廢了．耶和華也必赦免他。

Numbers 30:13 Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
民數記 30:13 凡他所許的願、和刻苦約束自己所起的誓、他丈夫可以堅定、也可以廢去。

Numbers 30:14 But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
民數記 30:14 倘若他丈夫天天向他默默不言、就算是堅定他所許的願、和約束自己的話、因丈夫聽見的日子向他默默不言、就使這兩樣堅定。

Numbers 30:15 But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
民數記 30:15 但他丈夫聽見以後、若使這兩樣全廢了、就要擔當婦人的罪孽。

Numbers 30:16 These are the statutes, which the L ORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
民數記 30:16 這是丈夫待妻子、父親待女兒、女兒年幼還在父家、耶和華所吩咐摩西的律例。

Numbers 31:1 A nd the L ORD spake unto Moses, saying,
民數記 31:1 耶和華吩咐摩西說、

Numbers 31:2 Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
民數記 31:2 你要在米甸人身上報以色列人的仇、後來要歸到你列祖那裏。

Numbers 31:3 And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the L ORD of Midian.
民數記 31:3 摩西吩咐百姓說、要從你們中間叫人帶兵器出去攻擊米甸、好在米甸人身上爲耶和華報仇。

Numbers 31:4 Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
民數記 31:4 從以色列衆支派中每支派要打發一千人去打仗。

Numbers 31:5 So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
民數記 31:5 於是從以色列千萬人中、每支派交出一千人、共一萬二千人、帶着兵器豫備打仗。

Numbers 31:6 And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
民數記 31:6 摩西就打發每支派的一千人去打仗、並打發祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈同去、非尼哈手裏拿着聖所的器皿、和吹大聲的號筒。

Numbers 31:7 And they warred against the Midianites, as the L ORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
民數記 31:7 他們就照耶和華所吩咐摩西的、與米甸人打仗、殺了所有的男丁。

Numbers 31:8 And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
民數記 31:8 在所殺的人中、殺了米甸的五王、就是以未、利金、蘇珥、戶珥、利巴、又用刀殺了比珥的兒子巴蘭。

Numbers 31:9 And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
民數記 31:9 以色列人擄了米甸人的婦女孩子、並將他們的牲畜、羊羣、和所有的財物都奪了來、當作擄物。

Numbers 31:10 And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
民數記 31:10 又用火焚燒他們所住的城邑、和所有的營寨．

Numbers 31:11 And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
民數記 31:11 把一切所奪的、所擄的、連人帶牲畜都帶了去．

Numbers 31:12 And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
民數記 31:12 將所擄的人、所奪的牲畜、財物、都帶到摩押平原、在約但河邊與耶利哥相對的營盤、交給摩西、和祭司以利亞撒、並以色列的會衆。

Numbers 31:13 And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
民數記 31:13 摩西和祭司以利亞撒、並會衆一切的首領、都出到營外迎接他們。

Numbers 31:14 And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
民數記 31:14 摩西向打仗回來的軍長、就是千夫長、百夫長、發怒。

Numbers 31:15 And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
民數記 31:15 對他們說、你們要存留這一切婦女的活命麼．

Numbers 31:16 Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the L ORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the L ORD.
民數記 31:16 這些婦女、因巴蘭的計謀、叫以色列人在毘珥的事上得罪耶和華、以致耶和華的會衆遭遇瘟疫。

Numbers 31:17 Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
民數記 31:17 所以你們要把一切的男孩、和所有已嫁的女子、都殺了。

Numbers 31:18 But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
民數記 31:18 但女孩子中、凡沒有出嫁的、你們都可以存留他的活命。

Numbers 31:19 And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
民數記 31:19 你們要在營外駐紮七日、凡殺了人的、和一切摸了被殺的、並你們所擄來的人口、第三日、第七日、都要潔淨自己。

Numbers 31:20 And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
民數記 31:20 也要因一切的衣服、皮物、山羊毛織的物、和各樣的木器、潔淨自己。

Numbers 31:21 And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the L ORD commanded Moses;
民數記 31:21 祭司以利亞撒、對打仗回來的兵丁說、耶和華所吩咐摩西律法中的條例、乃是這樣．

Numbers 31:22 Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
民數記 31:22 金、銀、銅、鐵、錫、鉛、

Numbers 31:23 Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
民數記 31:23 凡能見火的、你們要叫他經火、就爲潔淨、然而還要用除汚穢的水潔淨他、凡不能見火的、你們要叫他過水。

Numbers 31:24 And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
民數記 31:24 第七日、你們要洗衣服、就爲潔淨、然後可以進營。

Numbers 31:25 And the L ORD spake unto Moses, saying,
民數記 31:25 耶和華曉諭摩西說、

Numbers 31:26 Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
民數記 31:26 你和祭司以利亞撒、並會衆的各族長、要計算所擄來的人口和牲畜的總數。

Numbers 31:27 And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
民數記 31:27 把所擄來的、分作兩半、一半歸與出去打仗的精兵、一半歸與全會衆。

Numbers 31:28 And levy a tribute unto the L ORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
民數記 31:28 又要從出去打仗所得的人口、牛、驢、羊羣中、每五百取一、作爲貢物奉給耶和華。

Numbers 31:29 Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the L ORD.
民數記 31:29 從他們一半之中、要取出來交給祭司以利亞撒、作爲耶和華的舉祭。

Numbers 31:30 And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the L ORD.
民數記 31:30 從以色列人的一半之中、就是從人口、牛、驢、羊羣、各樣牲畜中、每五十取一、交給看守耶和華帳幕的利未人。

Numbers 31:31 And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the L ORD commanded Moses.
民數記 31:31 於是摩西和祭司以利亞撒、照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。

Numbers 31:32 And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
民數記 31:32 除了兵丁所奪的財物以外、所擄來的、羊六十七萬五千隻．

Numbers 31:33 And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
民數記 31:33 牛七萬二千隻．

Numbers 31:34 And threescore and one thousand asses,
民數記 31:34 驢六萬一千匹．

Numbers 31:35 And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
民數記 31:35 女人共三萬二千口．都是沒有出嫁的。

Numbers 31:36 And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
民數記 31:36 出去打仗之人的分、就是他們所得的那一半、共計羊三十三萬七千五百隻。

Numbers 31:37 And the L ORD 's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
民數記 31:37 從其中歸耶和華爲貢物的、有六百七十五隻．

Numbers 31:38 And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the L ORD 's tribute was threescore and twelve.
民數記 31:38 牛三萬六千隻．從其中歸耶和華爲貢物的、有七十二隻．

Numbers 31:39 And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the L ORD 's tribute was threescore and one.
民數記 31:39 驢三萬零五百匹、從其中歸耶和華爲貢物的、有六十一匹．

Numbers 31:40 And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the L ORD 's tribute was thirty and two persons.
民數記 31:40 人一萬六千口、從其中歸耶和華的、有三十二口。

Numbers 31:41 And Moses gave the tribute, which was the L ORD 's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the L ORD commanded Moses.
民數記 31:41 摩西把貢物、就是歸與耶和華的舉祭、交給祭司以利亞撒、是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

Numbers 31:42 And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
民數記 31:42 以色列人所得的那一半、就是摩西從打仗的人取來分給他們的。

Numbers 31:43 (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
民數記 31:43 （會衆的那一半、有羊三十三萬七千五百隻．

Numbers 31:44 And thirty and six thousand beeves,
民數記 31:44 牛三萬六千隻．

Numbers 31:45 And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
民數記 31:45 驢三萬零五百匹．

Numbers 31:46 And sixteen thousand persons;)
民數記 31:46 人一萬六千口。）

Numbers 31:47 Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the L ORD; as the L ORD commanded Moses.
民數記 31:47 無論是人口、是牲畜、摩西每五十取一、交給看守耶和華帳幕的利未人、是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

Numbers 31:48 And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
民數記 31:48 帶領千軍的各軍長、就是千夫長、百夫長、都近前來見摩西、

Numbers 31:49 And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
民數記 31:49 對他說、僕人權下的兵、已經計算總數、並不短少一人。

Numbers 31:50 We have therefore brought an oblation for the L ORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the L ORD.
民數記 31:50 如今我們將各人所得的金器、就是脚鍊子、鐲子、打印的戒指、耳環、手釧、都送來爲耶和華的供物、好在耶和華面前、爲我們的生命贖罪。

Numbers 31:51 And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
民數記 31:51 摩西和祭司以利亞撒、就收了他們的金子、都是打成的器皿。

Numbers 31:52 And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the L ORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
民數記 31:52 千夫長、百夫長、所獻給耶和華爲舉祭的金子、共有一萬六千七百五十舍客勒。

Numbers 31:53 (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
民數記 31:53 各兵丁都爲自己奪了財物。

Numbers 31:54 And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the L ORD.
民數記 31:54 摩西和祭司以利亞撒、收了千夫長、百夫長的金子、就帶進會幕、在耶和華面前作爲以色列人的記念。

Numbers 32:1 N ow the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
民數記 32:1 流便子孫、和迦得子孫的牲畜、極其衆多．他們看見雅謝地和基列地是可牧放牲畜之地、

Numbers 32:2 The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
民數記 32:2 就來見摩西和祭司以利亞撒、並會衆的首領、說、

Numbers 32:3 Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
民數記 32:3 亞大錄、底本、雅謝、寧拉、希實本、以利亞利、示班、尼波、比穩、

Numbers 32:4 Even the country which the L ORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
民數記 32:4 就是耶和華在以色列會衆前面所攻取之地、是可牧放牲畜之地、你僕人也有牲畜。

Numbers 32:5 Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
民數記 32:5 又說、我們若在你眼前蒙恩、求你把這地給我們爲業、不要領我們過約但河。

Numbers 32:6 And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
民數記 32:6 摩西對迦得子孫和流便子孫說、難道你們的弟兄去打仗、你們竟坐在這裏麼。

Numbers 32:7 And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the L ORD hath given them?
民數記 32:7 你們爲何使以色列人灰心喪膽、不過去進入耶和華所賜給他們的那地呢。

Numbers 32:8 Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
民數記 32:8 我先前從加低斯巴尼亞打發你們先祖去窺探那地、他們也是這樣行。

Numbers 32:9 For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the L ORD had given them.
民數記 32:9 他們上以實各谷、去窺探那地回來的時候、使以色列人灰心喪膽、不進入耶和華所賜給他們的地。

Numbers 32:10 And the L ORD 's anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
民數記 32:10 當日耶和華的怒氣發作、就起誓說、

Numbers 32:11 Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
民數記 32:11 凡從埃及上來二十歲以外的人、斷不得看見我對亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許之地、因爲他們沒有專心跟從我。

Numbers 32:12 Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the L ORD.
民數記 32:12 惟有基尼洗族耶孚尼的兒子迦勒、和嫩的兒子約書亞、可以看見、因爲他們專心跟從我。

Numbers 32:13 And the L ORD 's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the L ORD, was consumed.
民數記 32:13 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作、使他們在曠野飄流四十年、等到在耶和華眼前行惡的那一、代人都消滅了。

Numbers 32:14 And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the L ORD toward Israel.
民數記 32:14 誰知、你們起來接續先祖、增添罪人的數目、使耶和華向以色列大發烈怒。

Numbers 32:15 For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
民數記 32:15 你們若退後不跟從他、他還要把以色列人撇在曠野、便是你們使這衆民滅亡。

Numbers 32:16 And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
民數記 32:16 兩支派的人挨近摩西說、我們要在這裏爲牲畜壘圈、爲婦人孩子造城。

Numbers 32:17 But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
民數記 32:17 我們自己要帶兵器、行在以色列人的前頭、好把他們領到他們的地方、但我們的婦人孩子、因這地居民的緣故、要住在堅固的城內。

Numbers 32:18 We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
民數記 32:18 我們不回家、直等到以色列人各承受自己的產業。

Numbers 32:19 For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
民數記 32:19 我們不和他們在約但河那邊一帶之地同受產業、因爲我們的產業是坐落在約但河東邊這裏。

Numbers 32:20 And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the L ORD to war,
民數記 32:20 摩西對他們說、你們若這樣行、在耶和華面前帶着兵器出去打仗．

Numbers 32:21 And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the L ORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
民數記 32:21 所有帶兵器的人都要在耶和華面前過約但河、等他趕出他的仇敵、

Numbers 32:22 And the land be subdued before the L ORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the L ORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the L ORD.
民數記 32:22 那地被耶和華制伏了、然後你們可以回來、向耶和華和以色列纔爲無罪、這地也必在耶和華面前歸你們爲業。

Numbers 32:23 But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the L ORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
民數記 32:23 倘若你們不這樣行、就得罪耶和華、要知道你們的罪必追上你們。

Numbers 32:24 Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
民數記 32:24 如今你們口中所出的、只管去行、爲你們的婦人孩子造城、爲你們的羊羣壘圈。

Numbers 32:25 And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
民數記 32:25 迦得子孫和流便子孫對摩西說、僕人要照我主所吩咐的去行。

Numbers 32:26 Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
民數記 32:26 我們的妻子、孩子、羊羣、和所有的牲畜、都要留在基列的各城。

Numbers 32:27 But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord saith.
民數記 32:27 但你的僕人、凡帶兵器的、都要照我主所說的話、在耶和華面前過去打仗。

Numbers 32:28 So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
民數記 32:28 於是摩西爲他們囑咐祭司以利亞撒、和嫩的兒子約書亞、並以色列衆支派的族長、

Numbers 32:29 And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the L ORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
民數記 32:29 說、迦得子孫和流便子孫、凡帶兵器在耶和華面前去打仗的、若與你們一同過約但河、那地被你們制伏了、你們就要把基列地給他們爲業。

Numbers 32:30 But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
民數記 32:30 倘若他們不帶兵器和你們一同過去、就要在迦南地你們中間得產業。

Numbers 32:31 And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the L ORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
民數記 32:31 迦得子孫、和流便子孫回答說、耶和華怎樣吩咐僕人、僕人就怎樣行。

Numbers 32:32 We will pass over armed before the L ORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be our's.
民數記 32:32 我們要帶兵器、在耶和華面前過去進入迦南地、只是約但河這邊、我們所得爲業之地、仍歸我們。

Numbers 32:33 And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
民數記 32:33 摩西將亞摩利王西宏的國、和巴珊王噩的國、連那地和周圍的城邑、都給了迦得子孫和流便子孫、並約瑟的兒子瑪拿西半個支派。

Numbers 32:34 And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
民數記 32:34 迦得子孫建造底本、亞他錄、亞羅珥、

Numbers 32:35 And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
民數記 32:35 亞他錄、朔反、雅謝、約比哈、

Numbers 32:36 And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
民數記 32:36 伯寧拉、伯哈蘭、都是堅固城．他們又壘羊圈。

Numbers 32:37 And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
民數記 32:37 流便子孫建造希實本、以利亞利、基列亭、

Numbers 32:38 And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
民數記 32:38 尼波、巴力免、西比瑪（尼波、巴力免、名字是改了的）、又給他們所建造的城另起別名。

Numbers 32:39 And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
民數記 32:39 瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉、他的子孫往基列去、佔了那地、趕出那裏的亞摩利人。

Numbers 32:40 And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
民數記 32:40 摩西將基列賜給瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉、他子孫就住在那裏。

Numbers 32:41 And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
民數記 32:41 瑪拿西的子孫睚珥、去佔了基列的村莊、就稱這些村莊、爲哈倭特睚珥。

Numbers 32:42 And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
民數記 32:42 挪巴去佔了基納和基納的鄉村、就按自己的名稱基納爲挪巴。

Numbers 33:1 T hese are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
民數記 33:1 以色列人按着軍隊、在摩西、亞倫的手下出埃及地所行的路程、記在下面。

Numbers 33:2 And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the L ORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
民數記 33:2 摩西遵着耶和華的吩咐記載他們所行的路程、其路程乃是這樣．

Numbers 33:3 And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
民數記 33:3 正月十五日、就是逾越節的次日、以色列人從蘭塞起行、在一切埃及人眼前、昂然無懼的出去。

Numbers 33:4 For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the L ORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the L ORD executed judgments.
民數記 33:4 那時、埃及人正葬埋他們的長子、就是耶和華在他們中間所擊殺的．耶和華也敗壞他們的神。

Numbers 33:5 And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
民數記 33:5 以色列人從蘭塞起行、安營在疎割。

Numbers 33:6 And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
民數記 33:6 從疎割起行、安營在曠野邊的以倘。

Numbers 33:7 And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
民數記 33:7 從以倘起行、轉到比哈希錄、是在巴力洗分對面、就在密奪安營。

Numbers 33:8 And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
民數記 33:8 從比哈希錄對面起行、經過海中到了書珥曠野．又在伊坦的曠野走了三天的路程、就安營在瑪拉。

Numbers 33:9 And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
民數記 33:9 從瑪拉起行、來到以琳、以琳有十二股水泉、七十棵棕樹、就在那裏安營。

Numbers 33:10 And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
民數記 33:10 從以琳起行、安營在紅海邊。

Numbers 33:11 And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
民數記 33:11 從紅海邊起行、安營在汛的曠野。

Numbers 33:12 And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
民數記 33:12 從汛的曠野起行、安營在脫加。

Numbers 33:13 And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
民數記 33:13 從脫加起行、安營在亞錄。

Numbers 33:14 And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
民數記 33:14 從亞錄起行、安營在利非訂、在那裏百姓沒有水喝。

Numbers 33:15 And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
民數記 33:15 從利非訂起行、安營在西乃的曠野。

Numbers 33:16 And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
民數記 33:16 從西乃的曠野起行、安營在基博羅哈他瓦。

Numbers 33:17 And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
民數記 33:17 從基博羅哈他瓦起行、安營在哈洗錄。

Numbers 33:18 And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
民數記 33:18 從哈洗錄起行、安營在利提瑪。

Numbers 33:19 And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
民數記 33:19 從利提瑪起行、安營在臨門帕烈。

Numbers 33:20 And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
民數記 33:20 從臨門帕烈起行、安營在立拿。

Numbers 33:21 And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
民數記 33:21 從立拿起行、安營在勒撒。

Numbers 33:22 And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
民數記 33:22 從勒撒起行、安營在基希拉他。

Numbers 33:23 And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
民數記 33:23 從基希拉他起行、安營在沙斐山。

Numbers 33:24 And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
民數記 33:24 從沙斐山起行、安營在哈拉大。

Numbers 33:25 And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
民數記 33:25 從哈拉大起行、安營在瑪吉希錄。

Numbers 33:26 And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
民數記 33:26 從瑪吉希錄起行、安營在他哈。

Numbers 33:27 And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
民數記 33:27 從他哈起行、安營在他拉。

Numbers 33:28 And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
民數記 33:28 從他拉起行、安營在密加。

Numbers 33:29 And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
民數記 33:29 從密加起行、安營在哈摩拿。

Numbers 33:30 And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
民數記 33:30 從哈摩拿起行、安營在摩西錄。

Numbers 33:31 And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
民數記 33:31 從摩西錄起行、安營在比尼亞干。

Numbers 33:32 And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
民數記 33:32 從比尼亞干起行、安營在曷哈及甲。

Numbers 33:33 And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
民數記 33:33 從曷哈及甲起行、安營在約巴他。

Numbers 33:34 And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
民數記 33:34 從約巴他起行、安營在阿博拿。

Numbers 33:35 And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
民數記 33:35 從阿博拿起行、安營在以旬迦別。

Numbers 33:36 And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
民數記 33:36 從以旬迦別起行、安營在尋的曠野、就是加低斯．

Numbers 33:37 And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
民數記 33:37 從加低斯起行、安營在何珥山、以東地的邊界。

Numbers 33:38 And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the L ORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
民數記 33:38 以色列人出了埃及地後四十年、五月初一日、祭司亞倫遵着耶和華的吩咐、上何珥山就死在那裏。

Numbers 33:39 And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
民數記 33:39 亞倫死在何珥山的時候、年一百二十三歲。

Numbers 33:40 And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
民數記 33:40 住在迦南南地的迦南人亞拉得王、聽說以色列人來了。

Numbers 33:41 And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
民數記 33:41 以色列人從何珥山起行、安營在撒摩拿。

Numbers 33:42 And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
民數記 33:42 從撒摩拿起行、安營在普嫩。

Numbers 33:43 And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
民數記 33:43 從普嫩起行、安營在阿伯。

Numbers 33:44 And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.
民數記 33:44 從阿伯起行、安營在以耶亞巴琳、摩押的邊界。

Numbers 33:45 And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.
民數記 33:45 從以耶亞巴琳起行、安營在底本迦得。

Numbers 33:46 And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
民數記 33:46 從底本迦得起行、安營在亞門低比拉太音。

Numbers 33:47 And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
民數記 33:47 從亞門低比拉太音起行、安營在尼波對面的亞巴琳山裏。

Numbers 33:48 And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
民數記 33:48 從亞巴琳山起行、安營在摩押平原、約但河邊耶利哥對面。

Numbers 33:49 And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.
民數記 33:49 他們在摩押平原沿約但河邊安營、從伯耶施末直到亞伯什亭。

Numbers 33:50 And the L ORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
民數記 33:50 耶和華在摩押平原約但河邊、耶利哥對面曉諭摩西說、

Numbers 33:51 Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
民數記 33:51 你吩咐以色列人說、你們過約但河進迦南地的時候、

Numbers 33:52 Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
民數記 33:52 就要從你們面前趕出那裏所有的居民、毀滅他們一切鏨成的石像、和他們一切鑄成的偶像、又拆毀他們一切的邱壇。

Numbers 33:53 And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
民數記 33:53 你們要奪那地住在其中、因我把那地賜給你們爲業。

Numbers 33:54 And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
民數記 33:54 你們要按家室拈鬮、承受那地、人多的、要把產業多分給他們、人少的、要把產業少分給他們、拈出何地給何人、就要歸何人、你們要按宗族的支派承受。

Numbers 33:55 But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
民數記 33:55 倘若你們不趕出那地的居民、所容留的居民、就必作你們眼中的刺、肋下的荊棘、也必在你們所住的地上擾害你們。

Numbers 33:56 Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
民數記 33:56 而且我素常有意怎樣待他們、也必照樣待你們。

Numbers 34:1 A nd the L ORD spake unto Moses, saying,
民數記 34:1 耶和華曉諭摩西說、

Numbers 34:2 Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
民數記 34:2 你吩咐以色列人說、你們到了迦南地、就是歸你們爲業的迦南四境之地。

Numbers 34:3 Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
民數記 34:3 南角要從尋的曠野、貼着以東的邊界、南界要從鹽海東頭起、

Numbers 34:4 And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
民數記 34:4 繞到亞克拉濱坡的南邊、接連到尋、直通到加低斯巴尼亞的南邊、又通到哈薩亞達、接連到押們。

Numbers 34:5 And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
民數記 34:5 從押們轉到埃及小河、直通到海爲止。

Numbers 34:6 And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
民數記 34:6 西邊要以大海爲界．這就是你們的西界。

Numbers 34:7 And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
民數記 34:7 北界要從大海起、畫到何珥山．

Numbers 34:8 From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
民數記 34:8 從何珥山畫到哈馬口、通到西達達．

Numbers 34:9 And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
民數記 34:9 又通到西斐崙、直到哈薩以難．這要作你們的北界。

Numbers 34:10 And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
民數記 34:10 你們要從哈薩以難畫到示番爲東界。

Numbers 34:11 And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
民數記 34:11 這界要從示番下到亞延東邊的利比拉、又要達到基尼烈湖的東邊。

Numbers 34:12 And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
民數記 34:12 這界要下到約但河、通到鹽海爲止、這四圍的邊界以內、要作你們的地。

Numbers 34:13 And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the L ORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
民數記 34:13 摩西吩咐以色列人說、這地就是耶和華吩咐拈鬮給九個半支派承受爲業的．

Numbers 34:14 For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
民數記 34:14 因爲流便支派、和迦得支派、按着宗族受了產業、瑪拿西半個支派也受了產業。

Numbers 34:15 The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
民數記 34:15 這兩個半支派已經在耶利哥對面、約但河東向日出之地受了產業。

Numbers 34:16 And the L ORD spake unto Moses, saying,
民數記 34:16 耶和華曉諭摩西說、

Numbers 34:17 These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
民數記 34:17 要給你們分地爲業之人的名字、是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞。

Numbers 34:18 And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
民數記 34:18 又要從每支派中、選一個首領幫助他們。

Numbers 34:19 And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
民數記 34:19 這些人的名字猶大支派、有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。

Numbers 34:20 And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
民數記 34:20 西緬支派、有亞米忽的兒子示母利。

Numbers 34:21 Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
民數記 34:21 便雅憫支派、有基斯倫的兒子以利達。

Numbers 34:22 And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
民數記 34:22 但支派、有一個首領、約利的兒子布基。

Numbers 34:23 The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
民數記 34:23 約瑟的子孫瑪拿西支派、有一個首領、以弗的兒子漢聶。

Numbers 34:24 And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
民數記 34:24 以法蓮支派、有一個首領、拾弗但的兒子基母利。

Numbers 34:25 And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
民數記 34:25 西布倫支派、有一個首領、帕納的兒子以利撒番。

Numbers 34:26 And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
民數記 34:26 以薩迦支派、有一個首領、阿散的兒子帕鐵。

Numbers 34:27 And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
民數記 34:27 亞設支派、有一個首領、示羅米的兒子亞希忽。

Numbers 34:28 And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
民數記 34:28 拿弗他利支派、有一個首領、亞米忽的兒子比大黑。

Numbers 34:29 These are they whom the L ORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
民數記 34:29 這些人、就是耶和華所吩咐、在迦南地把產業分給以色列人的。

Numbers 35:1 A nd the L ORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
民數記 35:1 耶和華在摩押平原、約但河邊、耶利哥對面、曉諭摩西說、

Numbers 35:2 Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
民數記 35:2 你吩咐以色列人、要從所得爲業的地中、把些城給利未人居住．也要把這城四圍的郊野給利未人。

Numbers 35:3 And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
民數記 35:3 這城邑要歸他們居住、城邑的郊野、可以牧養他們的牛羊、和各樣的牲畜、又可以安置他們的財物。

Numbers 35:4 And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
民數記 35:4 你們給利未人的郊野、要從城根起、四圍往外量一千肘。

Numbers 35:5 And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
民數記 35:5 另外東量二千肘、南量二千肘、西量二千肘、北量二千肘爲邊界、城在當中．這要歸他們作城邑的郊野。

Numbers 35:6 And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
民數記 35:6 你們給利未人的城邑、其中當有六座逃城、使誤殺人的可以逃到那裏．此外還要給他們四十二座城。

Numbers 35:7 So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
民數記 35:7 你們要給利未人的城、共有四十八座、連城帶郊野都要給他們。

Numbers 35:8 And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
民數記 35:8 以色列人所得的地業、從中要把些城邑給利未人、人多的就多給、人少的就少給、各支派要按所承受爲業之地把城邑給利未人。

Numbers 35:9 And the L ORD spake unto Moses, saying,
民數記 35:9 耶和華曉諭摩西說、

Numbers 35:10 Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
民數記 35:10 你吩咐以色列人說、你們過約但河、進了迦南地、

Numbers 35:11 Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
民數記 35:11 就要分出幾座城、爲你們作逃城、使誤殺人的可以逃到那裏。

Numbers 35:12 And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
民數記 35:12 這些城、可以作逃避報仇人的城、使誤殺人的不至於死、等他站在會衆面前聽審判。

Numbers 35:13 And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
民數記 35:13 你們所分出來的城、要作六座逃城。

Numbers 35:14 Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
民數記 35:14 在約但河東要分出三座城、在迦南地也要分出三座城、都作逃城。

Numbers 35:15 These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
民數記 35:15 這六座城要給以色列人、和他們中間的外人、並寄居的、作爲逃城、使誤殺人的都可以逃到那裏。

Numbers 35:16 And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
民數記 35:16 倘若人用鐵器打人、以致打死、他就是故殺人的、故殺人的必被治死。

Numbers 35:17 And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
民數記 35:17 若用可以打死人的石頭打死了人、他就是故殺人的、故殺人的必被治死。

Numbers 35:18 Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
民數記 35:18 若用可以打死人的木器打死了人、他就是故殺人的、故殺人的必被治死。

Numbers 35:19 The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
民數記 35:19 報血仇的、必親自殺那故殺人的、一遇見就殺他。

Numbers 35:20 But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
民數記 35:20 人若因怨恨把人推倒、或是埋伏往人身上扔物、以致於死、

Numbers 35:21 Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
民數記 35:21 或是因仇恨用手打人、以致於死、那打人的、必被治死。他是故殺人的、報血仇的一遇見就殺他。

Numbers 35:22 But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
民數記 35:22 倘若人沒有仇恨、忽然將人推倒、或是沒有埋伏、把物扔在人身上、

Numbers 35:23 Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
民數記 35:23 或是沒有看見的時候用可以打死人的石頭、扔在人身上、以致於死、本來與他無仇、也無意害他、

Numbers 35:24 Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
民數記 35:24 會衆就要照典章、在打死人的、和報血仇的中間審判。

Numbers 35:25 And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
民數記 35:25 會衆要救這誤殺人的脫離報血仇人的手、也要使他歸入逃城．他要住在其中、直等到受聖膏的大祭司死了。

Numbers 35:26 But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
民數記 35:26 但誤殺人的、無論甚麼時候、若出了逃城的境外．

Numbers 35:27 And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
民數記 35:27 報血仇的在逃城境外遇見他、將他殺了、報血仇的就沒有流血之罪．

Numbers 35:28 Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
民數記 35:28 因爲誤殺人的該住在逃城裏、等到大祭司死了、大祭司死了以後、誤殺人的纔可以回到他所得爲業之地。

Numbers 35:29 So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
民數記 35:29 這在你們一切的住處、要作你們世世代代的律例、典章。

Numbers 35:30 Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
民數記 35:30 無論誰故殺人、要憑幾個見證人的口、把那故殺人的殺了、只是不可憑一個見證的口叫人死。

Numbers 35:31 Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
民數記 35:31 故殺人犯死罪的、你們不可收贖價代替他的命他必被治死。

Numbers 35:32 And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
民數記 35:32 那逃到逃城的人、你們不可爲他收贖價、使他在大祭司未死以先、再來住在本地。

Numbers 35:33 So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
民數記 35:33 這樣、你們就不汚穢所住之地、因爲血是汚穢地的、若有在地上流人血的、非流那殺人者的血、那地就不得潔淨。

Numbers 35:34 Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the L ORD dwell among the children of Israel.
民數記 35:34 你們不可玷汚所住之地、就是我住在其中之地因爲我耶和華住在以色列人中間。

Numbers 36:1 A nd the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
民數記 36:1 約瑟的後裔、瑪拿西的孫子、瑪吉的兒子基列、他子孫中的諸族長來到摩西、和作首領的以色列人族長面前、

Numbers 36:2 And they said, The L ORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the L ORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
民數記 36:2 說、耶和華曾吩咐我主、拈鬮分地給以色列人爲業、我主也受了耶和華的吩咐、將我們兄弟西羅非哈的產業分給他的衆女兒。

Numbers 36:3 And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
民數記 36:3 他們若嫁以色列別支派的人、就必將我們祖宗所遺留的產業、加在他們丈夫支派的產業中．這樣、我們拈鬮所得的產業就要減少了。

Numbers 36:4 And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
民數記 36:4 到了以色列人的禧年、這女兒的產業就必加在他們丈夫支派的產業上．這樣、我們祖宗支派的產業就減少了。

Numbers 36:5 And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the L ORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
民數記 36:5 摩西照耶和華的話、吩咐以色列人說、約瑟支派的人說得有理。

Numbers 36:6 This is the thing which the L ORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
民數記 36:6 論到西羅非哈的衆女兒、耶和華這樣吩咐說．他們可以隨意嫁人、只是要嫁同宗支派的人。

Numbers 36:7 So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
民數記 36:7 這樣、以色列人的產業就不從這支派歸到那支派．因爲以色列人要各守各祖宗支派的產業。

Numbers 36:8 And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
民數記 36:8 凡在以色列支派中得了產業的女子、必作同宗支派人的妻、好叫以色列人、各自承受他祖宗的產業。

Numbers 36:9 Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
民數記 36:9 這樣、他們的產業就不從這支派歸到那支派、因爲以色列支派的人、要各守各的產業。

Numbers 36:10 Even as the L ORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
民數記 36:10 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西、西羅非哈的衆女兒就怎樣行。

Numbers 36:11 For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
民數記 36:11 西羅非哈的女兒瑪拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿都嫁了他們伯叔的兒子。

Numbers 36:12 And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
民數記 36:12 他們嫁入約瑟兒子、瑪拿西子孫的族中、他們的產業仍留在同宗支派中。

Numbers 36:13 These are the commandments and the judgments, which the L ORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
民數記 36:13 這是耶和華在摩押平原、約但河邊、耶利哥對面、藉着摩西所吩咐以色列人的命令、典章。 申命記]] 1925

## Deuteronomy / 申命記

Deuteronomy 1:1 T hese be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
申命記 1:1 以下所記的、是摩西在約但河東的曠野、疎弗對面的亞拉巴、就是巴蘭、陀弗、拉班、哈洗錄、底撒哈中間、向以色列衆人所說的話。

Deuteronomy 1:2 (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)
申命記 1:2 從何烈山經過西珥山、到加低斯巴尼亞、有十一天的路程。

Deuteronomy 1:3 And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the L ORD had given him in commandment unto them;
申命記 1:3 出埃及第四十年十一月初一日、摩西照耶和華藉着他所吩咐以色列人的話、都曉諭他們。

Deuteronomy 1:4 After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
申命記 1:4 那時、他已經擊殺了住希實本的亞摩利王西宏、和住以得來亞斯他錄的巴珊王噩。

Deuteronomy 1:5 On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
申命記 1:5 摩西在約但河東的摩押地、講律法說、

Deuteronomy 1:6 The L ORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
申命記 1:6 耶和華我們的 神在何烈山曉諭我們說、你們在這山上住的日子彀了．

Deuteronomy 1:7 Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
申命記 1:7 要起行轉到亞摩利人的山地、和靠近這山地的各處、就是亞拉巴、山地、高原、南地、沿海一帶迦南人的地、並利巴嫩山又到伯拉大河．

Deuteronomy 1:8 Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the L ORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
申命記 1:8 如今我將這地擺在你們面前、你們要進去得這地、就是耶和華向你們列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各、起誓應許賜給他們和他們後裔爲業之地。

Deuteronomy 1:9 And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
申命記 1:9 那時我對你們說、管理你們的重任、我獨自擔當不起。

Deuteronomy 1:10 The L ORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
申命記 1:10 耶和華你們的 神使你們多起來、看哪、你們今日像天上的星那樣多。

Deuteronomy 1:11 (The L ORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
申命記 1:11 惟願耶和華你們列祖的 神、使你們比如今更多千倍、照他所應許你們的話、賜福與你們。

Deuteronomy 1:12 How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
申命記 1:12 但你們的麻煩、和管理你們的重任、並你們的爭訟、我獨自一人怎能擔當得起呢。

Deuteronomy 1:13 Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
申命記 1:13 你們要按着各支派、選舉有智慧、有見識、爲衆人所認識的、我立他們爲你們的首領。

Deuteronomy 1:14 And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
申命記 1:14 你們回答我說、照你所說的行了爲妙。

Deuteronomy 1:15 So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
申命記 1:15 我便將你們各支派的首領、有智慧爲衆人所認識的、照你們的支派、立他們爲官長、千夫長、百夫長、五十夫長、十夫長、管理你們。

Deuteronomy 1:16 And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
申命記 1:16 當時、我囑咐你們的審判官說、你們聽訟、無論是弟兄彼此爭訟、是與同居的外人爭訟、都要按公義判斷。

Deuteronomy 1:17 Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
申命記 1:17 審判的時候、不可看人的外貌、聽訟不可分貴賤、不可懼怕人、因爲審判是屬乎 神的．若有難斷的案件、可以呈到我這裏、我就判斷。

Deuteronomy 1:18 And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
申命記 1:18 那時、我將你們所當行的事、都吩咐你們了。

Deuteronomy 1:19 And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the L ORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
申命記 1:19 我們照着耶和華我們 神所吩咐的、從何烈山起行、經過你們所看見那大而可怕的曠野、往亞摩利人的山地去、到了加低斯巴尼亞。

Deuteronomy 1:20 And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the L ORD our God doth give unto us.
申命記 1:20 我對你們說、你們已經到了耶和華我們 神所賜給我們的亞摩利人之山地。

Deuteronomy 1:21 Behold, the L ORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the L ORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
申命記 1:21 看哪、耶和華你的 神已將那地擺在你面前、你要照耶和華你列祖的 神所說的上去得那地爲業．不要懼怕、也不要驚惶。

Deuteronomy 1:22 And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
申命記 1:22 你們都就近我來說、我們要先打發人去、爲我們窺探那地、將我們上去該走何道、必進何城、都回報我們。

Deuteronomy 1:23 And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
申命記 1:23 這話我以爲美、就從你們中間選了十二個人、每支派一人。

Deuteronomy 1:24 And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
申命記 1:24 於是他們起身上山地去、到以實各谷、窺探那地。

Deuteronomy 1:25 And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the L ORD our God doth give us.
申命記 1:25 他們手裏拿着那地的果子下來、到我們那裏、回報說、耶和華我們的 神所賜給我們的是美地。

Deuteronomy 1:26 Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the L ORD your God:
申命記 1:26 你們卻不肯上去、竟違背了耶和華你們 神的命令．

Deuteronomy 1:27 And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the L ORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
申命記 1:27 在帳棚內發怨言、說、耶和華因爲恨我們、所以將我們從埃及地領出來、要交在亞摩利人手中、除滅我們。

Deuteronomy 1:28 Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
申命記 1:28 我們上那裏去呢．我們的弟兄使我們的心消化、說、那地的民比我們又大又高、城邑又廣大又堅固、高得頂天、並且我們在那裏看見亞衲族的人。

Deuteronomy 1:29 Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
申命記 1:29 我就對你們說、不要驚恐、也不要怕他們。

Deuteronomy 1:30 The L ORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
申命記 1:30 在你們前面行的耶和華你們的 神、必爲你們爭戰、正如他在埃及和曠野、在你們眼前所行的一樣．

Deuteronomy 1:31 And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the L ORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
申命記 1:31 你們在曠野所行的路上、也曾見耶和華你們的 神、撫養你們、如同人撫養兒子一般、直等你們來到這地方。

Deuteronomy 1:32 Yet in this thing ye did not believe the L ORD your God,
申命記 1:32 你們在這事上卻不信耶和華你們的 神。

Deuteronomy 1:33 Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
申命記 1:33 他在路上、在你們前面行、爲你們找安營的地方、夜間在火柱裏、日間在雲柱裏、指示你們所當行的路。

Deuteronomy 1:34 And the L ORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
申命記 1:34 耶和華聽見你們這話、就發怒起誓說、

Deuteronomy 1:35 Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers.
申命記 1:35 這惡世代的人、連一個也不得見我起誓應許賜給你們列祖的美地．

Deuteronomy 1:36 Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the L ORD.
申命記 1:36 惟有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒、必得看見、並且我要將他所踏過的地賜給他、和他的子孫、因爲他專心跟從我。

Deuteronomy 1:37 Also the L ORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
申命記 1:37 耶和華爲你的緣故、也向我發怒、說、你必不得進入那地。

Deuteronomy 1:38 But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
申命記 1:38 伺候你嫩的兒子約書亞、他必得進入那地、你要勉勵他、因爲他要使以色列人承受那地爲業。

Deuteronomy 1:39 Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
申命記 1:39 並且你們的婦人孩子、就是你們所說必被擄掠的、和今日不知善惡的兒女、必進入那地、我要將那地賜給他們、他們必得爲業。

Deuteronomy 1:40 But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
申命記 1:40 至於你們、要轉回、從紅海的路往曠野去。

Deuteronomy 1:41 Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the L ORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the L ORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
申命記 1:41 那時、你們回答我說、我們得罪了耶和華、情願照耶和華我們 神一切所吩咐的、上去爭戰、於是你們各人帶着兵器、爭先上山地去了。

Deuteronomy 1:42 And the L ORD said unto me, Say unto them. Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
申命記 1:42 耶和華吩咐我說、你對他們說、不要上去、也不要爭戰、因我不在你們中間、恐怕你們被仇敵殺敗了。

Deuteronomy 1:43 So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the L ORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
申命記 1:43 我就告訴了你們、你們卻不聽從、竟違背耶和華的命令、擅自上山地去了。

Deuteronomy 1:44 And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
申命記 1:44 住那山地的亞摩利人、就出來攻擊你們、追趕你們如蜂擁一般、在西珥殺退你們、直到何珥瑪。

Deuteronomy 1:45 And ye returned and wept before the L ORD; but the L ORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
申命記 1:45 你們便回來、在耶和華面前哭號、耶和華卻不聽你們的聲音、也不向你們側耳。

Deuteronomy 1:46 So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
申命記 1:46 於是你們在加低斯住了許多日子。

Deuteronomy 2:1 T hen we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the L ORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
申命記 2:1 此後、我們轉回、從紅海的路往曠野去、是照耶和華所吩咐我的．我們在西珥山繞行了許多日子。

Deuteronomy 2:2 And the L ORD spake unto me, saying,
申命記 2:2 耶和華對我說、

Deuteronomy 2:3 Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
申命記 2:3 你們繞行這山的日子彀了、要轉向北去。

Deuteronomy 2:4 And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
申命記 2:4 你吩咐百姓說、你們弟兄以掃的子孫、住在西珥、你們要經過他們的境界．他們必懼怕你們、所以你們要分外謹愼。

Deuteronomy 2:5 Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
申命記 2:5 不可與他們爭戰、他們的地、連脚掌可踏之處、我都不給你們、因我已將西珥山賜給以掃爲業。

Deuteronomy 2:6 Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
申命記 2:6 你們要用錢向他們買糧喫、也要用錢向他們買水喝。

Deuteronomy 2:7 For the L ORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the L ORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
申命記 2:7 因爲耶和華你的 神、在你手裏所辦的一切事上、已賜福與你．你走這大曠野他都知道了．這四十年、耶和華你的 神常與你同在、故此你一無所缺。

Deuteronomy 2:8 And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
申命記 2:8 於是我們離了我們弟兄以掃子孫所住的西珥、從亞拉巴的路、經過以拉他、以旬迦別、轉向摩押曠野的路去。

Deuteronomy 2:9 And the L ORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
申命記 2:9 耶和華吩咐我說、不可擾害摩押人、也不可與他們爭戰．他們的地我不賜給你爲業、因我已將亞珥賜給羅得的子孫爲業。

Deuteronomy 2:10 The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
申命記 2:10 （先前、有以米人住在那裏、民數衆多、身體高大、像亞衲人一樣。

Deuteronomy 2:11 Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
申命記 2:11 這以米人像亞衲人、也算爲利乏音人、摩押人稱他們爲以米人。

Deuteronomy 2:12 The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the L ORD gave unto them.
申命記 2:12 先前、何利人也住在西珥、但以掃的子孫將他們除滅、得了他們的地、接着居住、就如以色列在耶和華賜給他爲業之地所行的一樣。）

Deuteronomy 2:13 Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
申命記 2:13 現在起來過撒烈溪．於是我們過了撒烈溪。

Deuteronomy 2:14 And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the L ORD sware unto them.
申命記 2:14 自從離開加低斯巴尼亞、到過了撒烈溪的時候、共有三十八年、等那世代的兵丁、都從營中滅盡、正如耶和華向他們所起的誓。

Deuteronomy 2:15 For indeed the hand of the L ORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
申命記 2:15 耶和華的手也攻擊他們、將他們從營中除滅、直到滅盡。

Deuteronomy 2:16 So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
申命記 2:16 兵丁從民中都滅盡死亡以後、

Deuteronomy 2:17 That the L ORD spake unto me, saying,
申命記 2:17 耶和華吩咐我說、

Deuteronomy 2:18 Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
申命記 2:18 你今天要從摩押的境界亞珥經過、

Deuteronomy 2:19 And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
申命記 2:19 走近亞捫人之地、不可擾害他們、也不可與他們爭戰、亞捫人的地我不賜給你們爲業、因我已將那地賜給羅得的子孫爲業。

Deuteronomy 2:20 (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
申命記 2:20 （那地也算爲利乏音人之地、先前、利乏音人住在那裏、亞捫人稱他們爲散送冥。

Deuteronomy 2:21 A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the L ORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
申命記 2:21 那民衆多身體高大、像亞衲人一樣、但耶和華從亞捫人面前除滅他們、亞捫人就得了他們的地、接着居住．

Deuteronomy 2:22 As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
申命記 2:22 正如耶和華從前爲住西珥的以掃子孫、將何利人從他們面前除滅．他們得了何利人的地、接着居住一樣、直到今日。

Deuteronomy 2:23 And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
申命記 2:23 從迦斐託出來的迦斐託人、將先前住在鄉村直到迦薩的亞衞人除滅、接着居住。）

Deuteronomy 2:24 Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
申命記 2:24 你們起來前往、過亞嫩谷、我已將亞摩利人希實本王西宏、和他的地、交在你手中、你要與他爭戰得他的地爲業。

Deuteronomy 2:25 This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
申命記 2:25 從今日起我要使天下萬民、聽見你的名聲都驚恐、懼怕、且因你發顫傷慟。

Deuteronomy 2:26 And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying, Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
申命記 2:26 我從基底莫的曠野、差遣使者去見希實本王西宏、用和睦的話說、

Deuteronomy 2:27 Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
申命記 2:27 求你容我從你的地經過、只走大道、不偏左右。

Deuteronomy 2:28 Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
申命記 2:28 你可以賣糧給我喫、也可以賣水給我喝、只要容我步行過去．

Deuteronomy 2:29 (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the L ORD our God giveth us.
申命記 2:29 就如住西珥的以掃子孫、和住亞珥的摩押人待我一樣、等我過了約但河、好進入耶和華我們 神所賜給我們的地。

Deuteronomy 2:30 But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the L ORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
申命記 2:30 但希實本王西宏、不容我們從他那裏經過、因爲耶和華你的 神使他心中剛硬、性情頑梗、爲要將他交在你手中、像今日一樣。

Deuteronomy 2:31 And the L ORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
申命記 2:31 耶和華對我說、從此起首、我要將西宏和他的地、交給你、你要得他的地爲業。

Deuteronomy 2:32 Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
申命記 2:32 那時西宏和他的衆民、出來攻擊我們、在雅雜與我們交戰。

Deuteronomy 2:33 And the L ORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
申命記 2:33 耶和華我們的 神、將他交給我們、我們就把他和他的兒子、並他的衆民都擊殺了。

Deuteronomy 2:34 And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
申命記 2:34 我們奪了他的一切城邑、將有人煙的各城、連女人帶孩子、盡都毀滅、沒有留下一個。
