Job 6:22 Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
約伯記 6:22 我豈說、請你們供給我．從你們的財物中、送禮物給我。

Job 6:23 Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
約伯記 6:23 豈說、拯救我脫離敵人的手麼．救贖我脫離強暴人的手麼。

Job 6:24 Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
約伯記 6:24 請你們教導我、我便不作聲．使我明白在何事上有錯。

Job 6:25 How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?
約伯記 6:25 正直的言語、力量何其大．但你們責備、是責備甚麼呢。

Job 6:26 Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
約伯記 6:26 絕望人的講論、旣然如風、你們還想要駁正言語麼。

Job 6:27 Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.
約伯記 6:27 你們想爲孤兒拈鬮、以朋友當貨物。

Job 6:28 Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.
約伯記 6:28 現在請你們看看我、我決不當面說謊。

Job 6:29 Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.
約伯記 6:29 請你們轉意、不要不公．請再轉意、我的事有理。

Job 6:30 Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
約伯記 6:30 我的舌上、豈有不義麼．我的口裏、豈不辨奸惡麼。

Job 7:1 Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?
約伯記 7:1 人在世上豈無爭戰麼．他的日子不像雇工人的日子麼。

Job 7:2 As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
約伯記 7:2 像奴僕切慕黑影、像雇工人盼望工價、

Job 7:3 So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
約伯記 7:3 我也照樣、經過困苦的日月、夜間的疲乏爲我而定。

Job 7:4 When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
約伯記 7:4 我躺臥的時候、便說、我何時起來、黑夜就過去呢．我盡是反來覆去、直到天亮。

Job 7:5 My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
約伯記 7:5 我的肉體以蟲子和塵土爲衣．我的皮膚纔收了口、又重新破裂。

Job 7:6 My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
約伯記 7:6 我的日子比梭更快、都消耗在無指望之中。

Job 7:7 O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.
約伯記 7:7 求你想念、我的生命不過是一口氣．我的眼睛必不再見福樂。

Job 7:8 The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.
約伯記 7:8 觀看我的人、他的眼必不再見我．你的眼目要看我、我卻不在了。

Job 7:9 As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
約伯記 7:9 雲彩消散而過、照樣、人下陰間也不再上來。

Job 7:10 He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
約伯記 7:10 他不再回自己的家、故土也不再認識他。

Job 7:11 Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
約伯記 7:11 我不禁止我口．我靈愁苦、要發出言語．我心苦惱、要吐露哀情。

Job 7:12 Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
約伯記 7:12 我對 神說、我豈是洋海、豈是大魚、你竟防守我呢。

Job 9:11 Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

Job 9:13 If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.

Job 9:18 He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

Job 9:19 If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

Job 9:20 If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
約伯記 9:20 我雖有義、自己的口要定我爲有罪．我雖完全、我口必顯我爲彎曲。

Job 9:21 Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

Job 9:22 This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

Job 9:27 If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

Job 9:35 Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
約伯記 9:35 我就說話、也不懼怕他．現在我卻不是那樣。

Job 10:1 My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

Job 10:3 Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

約伯記 10:12 你將生命和慈愛賜給我、你也眷顧保全我的心靈。

Job 10:15 If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
約伯記 10:15 我若行惡、便有了禍．我若爲義、也不敢抬頭、正是滿心羞愧、眼見我的苦情。

Job 10:16 For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

Job 10:17 Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.

Job 10:19 I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

Job 10:22 A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
約伯記 10:22 那地甚是幽暗、是死蔭混沌之地．那裏的光好像幽暗。

Job 11:3 Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

Job 11:8 It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?

Job 11:10 If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
約伯記 11:10 他若經過、將人拘禁、招人受審、誰能阻擋他呢。

Job 11:11 For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?
約伯記 11:11 他本知道虛妄的人．人的罪孽、他雖不留意、還是無所不見。

Job 11:12 For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.
約伯記 11:12 空虛的人、卻毫無知識、人生在世好像野驢的駒子。

Job 11:13 If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;
約伯記 11:13 你若將心安正、又向主舉手．

Job 11:14 If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
約伯記 11:14 你手裏若有罪孽、就當遠遠的除掉、也不容非義住在你帳棚之中。

Job 11:15 For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
約伯記 11:15 那時、你必仰起臉來、毫無斑點．你也必堅固、無所懼怕。

Job 11:16 Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:

Job 11:17 And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
約伯記 11:17 你在世的日子、要比正午更明．雖有黑暗、仍像早晨。

Job 11:18 And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

Job 11:19 Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

Job 11:20 But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
約伯記 11:20 但惡人的眼目必要失明、他們無路可逃．他們的指望就是氣絕。

Job 12:1 And Job answered and said,
約伯記 12:1 約伯回答說、

約伯記 12:2 你們眞是子民哪、你們死亡、智慧也就滅沒了。

Job 12:3 But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
約伯記 12:3 但我也有聰明、與你們一樣．並非不及你們．你們所說的、誰不知道呢。

Job 12:4 I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
約伯記 12:4 我這求告 神、蒙他應允的人、竟成了朋友所譏笑的．公義完全人、竟受了人的譏笑。

Job 12:5 He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
約伯記 12:5 安逸的人心裏藐視災禍．這災禍常常等待滑脚的人。

Job 12:6 The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
約伯記 12:6 強盜的帳棚興旺、惹 神的人穩固． 神多將財物送到他們手中。

Job 12:7 But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
約伯記 12:7 你且問走獸、走獸必指教你．又問空中的飛鳥、飛鳥必告訴你．

Job 12:8 Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
約伯記 12:8 或與地說話、地必指教你．海中的魚、也必向你說明。

Job 12:9 Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
約伯記 12:9 看這一切、誰不知道是耶和華的手作成的呢。

Job 12:10 In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
約伯記 12:10 凡活物的生命、和人類的氣息、都在他手中。

Job 12:11 Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
約伯記 12:11 耳朶豈不試驗言語、正如上膛嘗食物麼。

Job 12:12 With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
約伯記 12:12 年老的有智慧、壽高的有知識。

Job 12:13 With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
約伯記 12:13 在 神有智慧和能力．他有謀畧和知識。

Job 12:14 Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
約伯記 12:14 他拆毀的、就不能再建造．他捆住人、便不得開釋。

Job 12:15 Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
約伯記 12:15 他把水留住、水便枯乾．他再發出水來、水就翻地。

Job 12:16 With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
約伯記 12:16 在他有能力和智慧、被誘惑的、與誘惑人的、都是屬他。

Job 12:17 He leadeth counsellers away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
約伯記 12:17 他把謀士剝衣擄去、又使審判官變成愚人。

Job 12:18 He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
約伯記 12:18 他放鬆君王的綁、又用帶子捆他們的腰。

Job 12:19 He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
約伯記 12:19 他把祭司剝衣擄去、又使有能的人傾敗．

Job 12:20 He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
約伯記 12:20 他廢去忠信人的講論、又奪去老人的聰明。

Job 12:21 He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
約伯記 12:21 他使君王蒙羞被辱、放鬆有力之人的腰帶。

Job 12:22 He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
約伯記 12:22 他將深奧的事從黑暗中彰顯、使死蔭顯爲光明。

Job 12:23 He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
約伯記 12:23 他使邦國興旺而又毀滅．他使邦國開廣而又擄去。

Job 12:24 He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
約伯記 12:24 他將地上民中首領的聰明奪去、使他們在荒廢無路之地漂流。

Job 12:25 They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
約伯記 12:25 他們無光、在黑暗中摸索、又使他們東倒西歪、像醉酒的人一樣。

Job 13:1 Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
約伯記 13:1 這一切我眼都見過、我耳都聽過、而且明白。

Job 13:2 What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
約伯記 13:2 你們所知道的、我也知道．並非不及你們。

Job 13:3 Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
約伯記 13:3 我眞要對全能者說話、我願與 神理論。

Job 13:4 But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
約伯記 13:4 你們是編造謊言的、都是無用的醫生。

Job 13:5 O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
約伯記 13:5 惟願你們全然不作聲．這就算爲你們的智慧。

Job 13:6 Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
約伯記 13:6 請你們聽我的辯論、留心聽我口中的分訴。

Job 13:7 Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
約伯記 13:7 你們要爲 神說不義的話麼、爲他說詭詐的言語麼。

Job 13:8 Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
約伯記 13:8 你們要爲 神徇情麼、要爲他爭論麼。

Job 13:9 Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
約伯記 13:9 他查出你們來、這豈是好麼．人欺哄人、你們也要照樣欺哄他麼。

Job 13:10 He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
約伯記 13:10 你們若暗中徇情、他必要責備你們。

Job 13:11 Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
約伯記 13:11 他的尊榮、豈不叫你們懼怕麼．他的驚嚇、豈不臨到你們麼。

Job 13:12 Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
約伯記 13:12 你們以爲可記念的箴言、是爐灰的箴言．你們以爲可靠的堅壘是淤泥的堅壘。

Job 13:13 Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
約伯記 13:13 你們不要作聲、任憑我罷、讓我說話．無論如何我都承當。

Job 13:14 Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
約伯記 13:14 我何必把我的肉挂在牙上、將我的命放在手中。

Job 13:15 Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
約伯記 13:15 他必殺我．我雖無指望、然而我在他面前還要辯明我所行的。

Job 13:16 He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
約伯記 13:16 這要成爲我的拯救、因爲不虔誠的人不得到他面前。

Job 13:17 Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
約伯記 13:17 你們要細聽我的言語、使我所辯論的、入你們的耳中。

Job 13:18 Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
約伯記 13:18 我已陳明我的案、知道自己有義。

Job 13:19 Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
約伯記 13:19 有誰與我爭論、我就情願緘默不言、氣絕而亡。

Job 13:20 Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
約伯記 13:20 惟有兩件、不要向我施行、我就不躱開你的面．

Job 13:21 Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
約伯記 13:21 就是把你的手縮回、遠離我身．又不使你的驚惶威嚇我。

Job 13:22 Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
約伯記 13:22 這樣、你呼叫、我就回答．或是讓我說話、你回答我。

Job 13:23 How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
約伯記 13:23 我的罪孽和罪過有多少呢．求你叫我知道我的過犯與罪愆。

Job 13:24 Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
約伯記 13:24 你爲何掩面、拿我當仇敵呢。

Job 13:25 Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
約伯記 13:25 你要驚動被風吹的葉子麼．要追趕枯乾的碎稭麼．

Job 13:26 For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
約伯記 13:26 你按罪狀刑罰我、又使我擔當幼年的罪孽．

Job 13:27 Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
約伯記 13:27 也把我的脚上了木狗、並窺察我一切的道路、爲我的脚掌畫定界限。

Job 13:28 And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
約伯記 13:28 我已經像滅絕的爛物、像蟲蛀的衣裳。

Job 14:1 Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
約伯記 14:1 人爲婦人所生、日子短少、多有患難．

Job 14:2 He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
約伯記 14:2 出來如花、又被割下．飛去如影、不能存留。

Job 14:3 And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
約伯記 14:3 這樣的人你豈睜眼看他麼．又叫我來受審麼。

Job 14:4 Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
約伯記 14:4 誰能使潔淨之物出於汚穢之中呢．無論誰也不能。

Job 14:5 Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
約伯記 14:5 人的日子旣然限定、他的月數在你那裏、你也派定他的界限、使他不能越過、

Job 14:6 Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
約伯記 14:6 便求你轉眼不看他、使他得歇息、直等他像雇工人完畢他的日子。

Job 14:7 For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
約伯記 14:7 樹若被砍下、還可指望發芽、嫩枝生長不息、

Job 14:8 Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
約伯記 14:8 其根雖然衰老在地裏、榦也死在土中．

Job 14:9 Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
約伯記 14:9 及至得了水氣、還要發芽、又長枝條、像新栽的樹一樣。

Job 14:10 But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
約伯記 14:10 但人死亡而消滅．他氣絕、竟在何處呢。

Job 14:11 As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
約伯記 14:11 海中的水絕盡、江河消散乾涸．

Job 14:12 So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
約伯記 14:12 人也是如此、躺下不再起來、等到天沒有了、仍不得復醒、也不得從睡中喚醒。

Job 14:13 O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
約伯記 14:13 惟願你把我藏在陰間．存於隱密處、等你的忿怒過去、願你爲我定了日期、記念我。

Job 14:14 If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
約伯記 14:14 人若死了、豈能再活呢。我只要在我一切爭戰的日子、等我被釋放的時候來到。

Job 14:15 Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
約伯記 14:15 你呼叫、我便回答．你手所作的、你必羨慕。

Job 14:16 For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
約伯記 14:16 但如今你數點我的脚步、豈不窺察我的罪過麼。

Job 14:17 My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
約伯記 14:17 我的過犯被你封在囊中、也縫嚴了我的罪孽。

Job 14:18 And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
約伯記 14:18 山崩變爲無有．磐石挪開原處。

Job 14:19 The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
約伯記 14:19 水流消磨石頭．所流溢的、洗去地上的塵土．你也照樣滅絕人的指望。

Job 14:20 Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
約伯記 14:20 你攻擊人常常得勝、使他去世、你改變他的容貌、叫他往而不回。

Job 14:21 His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
約伯記 14:21 他兒子得尊榮他也不知道．降爲卑他也不覺得。

Job 14:22 But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
約伯記 14:22 但知身上疼痛、心中悲哀。

Job 15:1 Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
約伯記 15:1 提幔人以利法回答說、

Job 15:2 Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
約伯記 15:2 智慧人豈可用虛空的知識回答、用東風充滿肚腹呢。

Job 15:3 Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
約伯記 15:3 他豈可用無益的話、和無濟於事的言語理論呢。

Job 15:4 Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
約伯記 15:4 你是廢棄敬畏的意、在 神面前阻止敬虔的心。

Job 15:5 For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
約伯記 15:5 你的罪孽指教你的口、你選用詭詐人的舌頭。

Job 15:6 Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
約伯記 15:6 你自己的口定你有罪、並非是我．你自己的嘴見證你的不是。

Job 15:7 Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
約伯記 15:7 你豈是頭一個被生的人麼．你受造在諸山之先麼。

Job 15:8 Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
約伯記 15:8 你曾聽見 神的密旨麼．你還將智慧獨自得盡麼。

Job 15:9 What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
約伯記 15:9 你知道甚麼、是我們不知道的呢．你明白甚麼、是我們不明白的呢。

Job 15:10 With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
約伯記 15:10 我們這裏有白髮的、和年紀老邁的、比你父親還老。

Job 15:11 Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
約伯記 15:11 神用溫和的話安慰你、你以爲太小麼。

Job 15:12 Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
約伯記 15:12 你的心爲何將你逼去．你的眼爲何冒出火星、

Job 15:13 That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
約伯記 15:13 使你的靈反對 神、也任你的口發這言語。

Job 15:14 What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
約伯記 15:14 人是甚麼、竟算爲潔淨呢．婦人所生的是甚麼、竟算爲義呢。

Job 15:15 Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
約伯記 15:15 神不信靠他的衆聖者、在他眼前天也不潔淨．

Job 15:16 How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
約伯記 15:16 何况那汚穢可憎、喝罪孽如水的世人呢。

Job 15:17 I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
約伯記 15:17 我指示你、你要聽．我要述說所看見的、

Job 15:18 Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
約伯記 15:18 就是智慧人、從列祖所受、傳說而不隱瞞的。

Job 15:19 Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
約伯記 15:19 （這地惟獨賜給他們、並沒有外人從他們中間經過．）

Job 15:20 The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
約伯記 15:20 惡人一生之日、劬勞痛苦、強暴人一生的年數、也是如此。

Job 15:21 A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
約伯記 15:21 驚嚇的聲音常在他耳中．在平安時搶奪的必臨到他那裏。

Job 15:22 He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
約伯記 15:22 他不信自己能從黑暗中轉回．他被刀劍等候。

Job 15:23 He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
約伯記 15:23 他漂流在外求食、說、那裏有食物呢．他知道黑暗的日子在他手邊豫備好了。

Job 15:24 Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
約伯記 15:24 急難困苦叫他害怕、而且勝了他、好像君王豫備上陣一樣。

Job 15:25 For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
約伯記 15:25 他伸手攻擊 神、以驕傲攻擊全能者、

Job 15:26 He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
約伯記 15:26 挺着頸項、用盾牌的厚凸面、向全能者直闖、

Job 15:27 Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
約伯記 15:27 是因他的臉蒙上脂油、腰積成肥肉。

Job 15:28 And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
約伯記 15:28 他曾住在荒涼城邑、無人居住將成亂堆的房屋。

Job 15:29 He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
約伯記 15:29 他不得富足、財物不得常存、產業在地上也不加增。

Job 15:30 He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
約伯記 15:30 他不得出離黑暗．火燄要將他的枝子燒乾、因 神口中的氣、他要滅亡．

Job 15:31 Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
約伯記 15:31 他不用倚靠虛假、欺哄自己．因虛假必成爲他的報應。

Job 15:32 It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
約伯記 15:32 他的日期未到之先這事必成就、他的枝子不得青綠。

Job 15:33 He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
約伯記 15:33 他必像葡萄樹的葡萄、未熟而落、又像橄欖樹的花、一開而謝。

Job 15:34 For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
約伯記 15:34 原來不敬虔之輩、必無生育、受賄賂之人的帳棚、必被火燒．

Job 15:35 They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
約伯記 15:35 他們所懷的是毒害、所生的是罪孽、心裏所豫備的是詭詐。

Job 16:1 Then Job answered and said,
約伯記 16:1 約伯回答說、

Job 16:2 I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
約伯記 16:2 這樣的話我聽了許多．你們安慰人、反叫人愁煩。

Job 16:3 Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
約伯記 16:3 虛空的言語有窮盡麼．有甚麼話惹動你回答呢。

Job 16:4 I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
約伯記 16:4 我也能說你們那樣的話．你們若處在我的境遇、我也會聯絡言語攻擊你們、又能向你們搖頭。

Job 16:5 But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
約伯記 16:5 但我必用口堅固你們、用嘴消解你們的憂愁。

Job 16:6 Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
約伯記 16:6 我雖說話、憂愁仍不得消解．我雖停住不說、憂愁就離開我麼。

Job 16:7 But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
約伯記 16:7 但現在 神使我困倦．使親友遠離我。

Job 16:8 And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
約伯記 16:8 又抓住我、作見證攻擊我．我身體的枯瘦也當面見證我的不是。

Job 16:9 He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
約伯記 16:9 主發怒撕裂我、逼迫我、向我切齒．我的敵人怒目看我。

Job 16:10 They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
約伯記 16:10 他們向我開口、打我的臉羞辱我、聚會攻擊我。

Job 16:11 God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
約伯記 16:11 神把我交給不敬虔的人、把我扔到惡人的手中。

Job 16:12 I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
約伯記 16:12 我素來安逸、他折斷我、掐住我的頸項、把我摔碎、又立我爲他的箭靶子。

Job 16:13 His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
約伯記 16:13 他的弓箭手四面圍繞我．他破裂我的肺腑、並不留情．把我的膽傾倒在地上．

Job 16:14 He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
約伯記 16:14 將我破裂又破裂．如同勇士向我直闖。

Job 16:15 I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
約伯記 16:15 我縫麻布在我皮膚上、把我的角放在塵土中。

Job 16:16 My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
約伯記 16:16 我的臉、因哭泣發紫、在我的眼皮上有死蔭。

Job 16:17 Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
約伯記 16:17 我的手中、卻無強暴、我的祈禱、也是清潔。

Job 16:18 O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
約伯記 16:18 地阿、不要遮蓋我的血、不要阻擋我的哀求。

Job 16:19 Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
約伯記 16:19 現今、在天有我的見證、在上有我的中保。

Job 16:20 My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.
約伯記 16:20 我的朋友譏誚我．我卻向 神眼淚汪汪．

Job 16:21 O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!
約伯記 16:21 願人得與 神辯白、如同人與朋友辯白一樣。

Job 16:22 When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
約伯記 16:22 因爲再過幾年、我必走那往而不返之路。

Job 17:1 My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
約伯記 17:1 我的心靈消耗、我的日子滅盡、墳墓爲我豫備好了。

Job 17:2 Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
約伯記 17:2 眞有戲笑我的在我這裏、我眼常見他們惹動我。

Job 17:3 Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
約伯記 17:3 願主拿憑據給我、自己爲我作保．在你以外誰肯與我擊掌呢。

Job 17:4 For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
約伯記 17:4 因你使他們心不明理．所以你必不高舉他們。

Job 17:5 He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
約伯記 17:5 控告他的朋友、以朋友爲可搶奪的、連他兒女的眼睛、也要失明。

Job 17:6 He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
約伯記 17:6 神使我作了民中的笑談．他們也吐唾沫在我臉上。

Job 17:7 Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
約伯記 17:7 我的眼睛因憂愁昏花、我的百體好像影兒。

Job 17:8 Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
約伯記 17:8 正直人、因此必驚奇、無辜的人、要興起攻擊不敬虔之輩。

Job 17:9 The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
約伯記 17:9 然而義人要持守所行的道、手潔的人要力上加力。

Job 17:10 But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
約伯記 17:10 至於你們衆人、可以再來辯論罷．你們中間、我找不着一個智慧人。

Job 17:11 My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
約伯記 17:11 我的日子已經過了、我的謀算、我心所想望的、已經斷絕。

Job 17:12 They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
約伯記 17:12 他們以黑夜爲白晝．說、亮光近乎黑暗。

Job 17:13 If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
約伯記 17:13 我若盼望陰間爲我的房屋．若下榻在黑暗中．

Job 17:14 I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
約伯記 17:14 若對朽壞說、你是我的父．對蟲說、你是我的母親姐妹．

Job 17:15 And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
約伯記 17:15 這樣、我的指望在哪裏呢．我所指望的、誰能看見呢。

Job 17:16 They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
約伯記 17:16 等到安息在塵土中、這指望必下到陰間的門閂那裏了。

Job 18:1 Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
約伯記 18:1 書亞人比勒達回答說、

Job 18:2 How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
約伯記 18:2 你尋索言語要到幾時呢．你可以揣摩思想、然後我們就說話。

Job 18:3 Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
約伯記 18:3 我們爲何算爲畜生、在你眼中看作汚穢呢。

Job 18:4 He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
約伯記 18:4 你這惱怒將自己撕裂的、難道大地爲你見棄、磐石挪開原處麼。

Job 18:5 Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
約伯記 18:5 惡人的亮光、必要熄滅、他的火燄、必不照耀。

Job 18:6 The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
約伯記 18:6 他帳棚中的亮光、要變爲黑暗．他以上的燈、也必熄滅。

Job 18:7 The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
約伯記 18:7 他堅強的脚步、必見狹窄、自己的計謀、必將他絆倒。

Job 18:8 For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
約伯記 18:8 因爲他被自己的脚陷入網中、走在纏人的網羅上。

Job 18:9 The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
約伯記 18:9 圈套必抓住他的脚跟、機關必擒獲他。

Job 18:10 The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
約伯記 18:10 活扣爲他藏在土內、羈絆爲他藏在路上。

Job 18:11 Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
約伯記 18:11 四面的驚嚇要使他害怕、並且追趕他的脚跟。

Job 18:12 His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
約伯記 18:12 他的力量必因飢餓衰敗、禍患要在他旁邊等候。

Job 18:13 It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
約伯記 18:13 他本身的肢體要被吞喫、死亡的長子要吞喫他的肢體。

Job 18:14 His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
約伯記 18:14 他要從所倚靠的帳棚被拔出來、帶到驚嚇的王那裏。

Job 18:15 It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
約伯記 18:15 不屬他的必住在他的帳棚裏．硫磺必撒在他所住之處。

Job 18:16 His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
約伯記 18:16 下邊、他的根本要枯乾．上邊、他的枝子要剪除。

Job 18:17 His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
約伯記 18:17 他的記念、在地上必然滅亡、他的名字、在街上也不存留。

Job 18:18 He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
約伯記 18:18 他必從光明中被攆到黑暗裏、必被趕出世界。

Job 18:19 He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
約伯記 18:19 在本民中必無子無孫、在寄居之地、也無一人存留。

Job 18:20 They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
約伯記 18:20 以後來的、要驚奇他的日子、好像以前去的、受了驚駭。

Job 18:21 Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
約伯記 18:21 不義之人的住處、總是這樣、此乃不認識 神之人的地步。

Job 19:1 Then Job answered and said,
約伯記 19:1 約伯回答說、

Job 19:2 How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
約伯記 19:2 你們攪擾我的心、用言語壓碎我、要到幾時呢。

Job 19:3 These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
約伯記 19:3 你們這十次羞辱我．你們苦待我也不以爲恥。

Job 19:4 And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
約伯記 19:4 果眞我有錯、這錯乃是在我。

Job 19:5 If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
約伯記 19:5 你們果然要向我誇大、以我的羞辱爲證指責我．

Job 19:6 Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
約伯記 19:6 就該知道是 神傾覆我、用網羅圍繞我。

Job 19:7 Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
約伯記 19:7 我因委曲呼叫、卻不蒙應允．我呼求、卻不得公斷。

Job 19:8 He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
約伯記 19:8 神用籬笆攔住我的道路、使我不得經過．又使我的路徑黑暗。

Job 19:9 He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
約伯記 19:9 他剝去我的榮光、摘去我頭上的冠冕。

Job 19:10 He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
約伯記 19:10 他在四圍攻擊我、我便歸於死亡．將我的指望如樹拔出來．

Job 19:11 He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
約伯記 19:11 他的忿怒向我發作、以我爲敵人。

Job 19:12 His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
約伯記 19:12 他的軍旅一齊上來、修築戰路攻擊我、在我帳棚的四圍安營。

Job 19:13 He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
約伯記 19:13 他把我的弟兄隔在遠處、使我所認識的全然與我生疎。

Job 19:14 My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
約伯記 19:14 我的親戚、與我斷絕、我的密友、都忘記我。

Job 19:15 They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
約伯記 19:15 在我家寄居的、和我的使女、都以我爲外人．我在他們眼中看爲外邦人。

Job 19:16 I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
約伯記 19:16 我呼喚僕人、雖用口求他、他還是不回答。

Job 19:17 My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.
約伯記 19:17 我口的氣味、我妻子厭惡、我的懇求、我同胞也憎嫌。

Job 19:18 Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
約伯記 19:18 連小孩子也藐視我．我若起來、他們都嘲笑我。

Job 19:19 All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
約伯記 19:19 我的密友都憎惡我、我平日所愛的人向我翻臉。

Job 19:20 My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
約伯記 19:20 我的皮肉緊貼骨頭、我只剩牙皮逃脫了。

Job 19:21 Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
約伯記 19:21 我朋友阿、可憐我、可憐我、因爲 神的手攻擊我。

Job 19:22 Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
約伯記 19:22 你們爲甚麼彷彿 神逼迫我、喫我的肉還以爲不足呢。

Job 19:23 Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
約伯記 19:23 惟願我的言語、現在寫上、都記錄在書上．

Job 19:24 That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
約伯記 19:24 用鐵筆鐫刻、用鉛灌在磐石上、直存到永遠。

Job 19:25 For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
約伯記 19:25 我知道我的救贖主活着、末了必站立在地上．

Job 19:26 And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
約伯記 19:26 我這皮肉滅絕之後、我必在肉體之外得見 神。

Job 19:27 Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
約伯記 19:27 我自己要見他、親眼要看他、並不像外人．我的心腸在我裏面消滅了。

Job 19:28 But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
約伯記 19:28 你們若說、我們逼迫他、要何等的重呢、惹事的根乃在乎他。

Job 19:29 Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
約伯記 19:29 你們就當懼怕刀劍．因爲忿怒惹動刀劍的刑罰、使你們知道有報應。

Job 20:1 Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
約伯記 20:1 拿瑪人瑣法回答說、

Job 20:2 Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
約伯記 20:2 我心中急躁、所以我的思念叫我回答。

Job 20:3 I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
約伯記 20:3 我已聽見那羞辱我責備我的話．我的悟性叫我回答。

Job 20:4 Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
約伯記 20:4 你豈不知亙古以來、自從人生在地、

Job 20:5 That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
約伯記 20:5 惡人誇勝是暫時的、不敬虔人的喜樂不過轉眼之間麼。

Job 20:6 Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
約伯記 20:6 他的尊榮雖達到天上、頭雖頂到雲中．

Job 20:7 Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
約伯記 20:7 他終必滅亡、像自己的糞一樣．素來見他的人要說、他在哪裏呢。

Job 20:8 He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
約伯記 20:8 他必飛去如夢、不再尋見．速被趕去如夜間的異象。

Job 20:9 The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
約伯記 20:9 親眼見過他的、必不再見他．他的本處、也再見不着他。

Job 20:10 His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
約伯記 20:10 他的兒女要求窮人的恩、他的手要賠還不義之財。

Job 20:11 His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
約伯記 20:11 他的骨頭雖然有青年之力、卻要和他一同躺臥在塵土中。

Job 20:12 Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
約伯記 20:12 他口內雖以惡爲甘甜、藏在舌頭底下、

Job 20:13 Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
約伯記 20:13 愛戀不捨、含在口中．

Job 20:14 Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
約伯記 20:14 他的食物在肚裏、卻要化爲酸、在他裏面成爲虺蛇的惡毒。

Job 20:15 He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
約伯記 20:15 他吞了財寶、還要吐出． 神要從他腹中掏出來。

Job 20:16 He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
約伯記 20:16 他必吸飲虺蛇的毒氣．蝮蛇的舌頭也必殺他。

Job 20:17 He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
約伯記 20:17 流奶與蜜之河、他不得再見。

Job 20:18 That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
約伯記 20:18 他勞碌得來的要賠還、不得享用．不能照所得的財貨歡樂。

Job 20:19 Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
約伯記 20:19 他欺壓窮人、且又離棄．強取非自己所蓋的房屋。

Job 20:20 Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
約伯記 20:20 他因貪而無厭、所喜悅的連一樣也不能保守。

Job 20:21 There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
約伯記 20:21 其餘的、沒有一樣他不吞滅．所以他的福樂不能長久。

Job 20:22 In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
約伯記 20:22 他在滿足有餘的時候、必到狹窄的地步．凡受苦楚的人、都必加手在他身上。

Job 20:23 When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
約伯記 20:23 他正要充滿肚腹的時候、 神必將猛烈的忿怒降在他身上、正在他喫飯的時候、要將這忿怒像雨降在他身上。

Job 20:24 He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
約伯記 20:24 他要躱避鐵器、銅弓的箭要將他射透。

Job 20:25 It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
約伯記 20:25 他把箭一抽、就從他身上出來．發光的箭頭、從他膽中出來．有驚惶臨在他身上。

Job 20:26 All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
約伯記 20:26 他的財寶歸於黑暗．人所不吹的火、要把他燒滅、要把他帳棚中所剩下的燒燬。

Job 20:27 The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
約伯記 20:27 天要顯明他的罪孽、地要興起攻擊他。

Job 20:28 The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
約伯記 20:28 他的家產必然過去． 神發怒的日子、他的貨物都要消滅。

Job 20:29 This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
約伯記 20:29 這是惡人從 神所得的分、是 神爲他所定的產業。

Job 21:1 But Job answered and said,
約伯記 21:1 約伯回答說、

Job 21:2 Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
約伯記 21:2 你們要細聽我的言語、就算是你們安慰我。

Job 21:3 Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
約伯記 21:3 請寬容我、我又要說話．說了以後、任憑你們嗤笑罷。

Job 21:4 As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
約伯記 21:4 我豈是向人訴寃、爲何不焦急呢。

Job 21:5 Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
約伯記 21:5 你們要看着我而驚奇、用手摀口。

Job 21:6 Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
約伯記 21:6 我每逢思想、心就驚惶、渾身戰兢。

Job 21:7 Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
約伯記 21:7 惡人爲何存活、享大壽數、勢力強盛呢。

Job 21:8 Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
約伯記 21:8 他們眼見兒孫、和他們一同堅立。

Job 21:9 Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
約伯記 21:9 他們的家宅平安無懼、 神的杖也不加在他們身上。

Job 21:10 Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
約伯記 21:10 他們的公牛孳生而不斷絕．母牛下犢而不掉胎。

Job 21:11 They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
約伯記 21:11 他們打發小孩子出去、多如羊羣．他們的兒女踊躍跳舞。

Job 21:12 They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
約伯記 21:12 他們隨着琴鼓歌唱、又因簫聲歡喜。

Job 21:13 They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
約伯記 21:13 他們度日諸事亨通、轉眼下入陰間。

Job 21:14 Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
約伯記 21:14 他們對 神說、離開我們罷．我們不願曉得你的道。

Job 21:15 What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
約伯記 21:15 全能者是誰、我們何必事奉他呢．求告他有甚麼益處呢。

Job 21:16 Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
約伯記 21:16 看哪、他們亨通不在乎自己．惡人所謀定的離我好遠。

Job 21:17 How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
約伯記 21:17 惡人的燈何嘗熄滅．患難何嘗臨到他們呢． 神何嘗發怒、向他們分散災禍呢。

Job 21:18 They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
約伯記 21:18 他們何嘗像風前的碎稭、如暴風颳去的糠粃呢。

Job 21:19 God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
約伯記 21:19 你們說、 神爲惡人的兒女積蓄罪孽。我說、不如本人受報、好使他親自知道。

Job 21:20 His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
約伯記 21:20 願他親眼看見自己敗亡、親自飲全能者的忿怒。

Job 21:21 For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
約伯記 21:21 他的歲月旣盡、他還顧他本家麼。

Job 21:22 Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
約伯記 21:22 神旣審判那在高位的、誰能將知識教訓他呢。

Job 21:23 One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
約伯記 21:23 有人至死身體強壯、盡得平靖安逸．

Job 21:24 His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
約伯記 21:24 他的奶桶充滿、他的骨髓滋潤。

Job 21:25 And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
約伯記 21:25 有人至死心中痛苦、終身未嘗福樂的滋味。

Job 21:26 They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
約伯記 21:26 他們一樣躺臥在塵土中、都被蟲子遮蓋。

Job 21:27 Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
約伯記 21:27 我知道你們的意思、並誣害我的計謀。

Job 21:28 For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
約伯記 21:28 你們說、霸者的房屋在那裏．惡人住過的帳棚在那裏。

Job 21:29 Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
約伯記 21:29 你們豈沒有詢問過路的人麼．不知道他們所引的證據麼。

Job 21:30 That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
約伯記 21:30 就是惡人在禍患的日子得存留、在發怒的日子得逃脫。

Job 21:31 Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?
約伯記 21:31 他所行的、有誰當面給他說明．他所作的、有誰報應他呢。

Job 21:32 Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
約伯記 21:32 然而他要被抬到塋地、並有人看守墳墓。

Job 21:33 The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
約伯記 21:33 他要以谷中的土塊爲甘甜、在他以先去的無數、在他以後去的更多。

Job 21:34 How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
約伯記 21:34 你們對答的話中旣都錯謬、怎麼徒然安慰我呢。

Job 22:1 Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
約伯記 22:1 提幔人以利法回答說、

Job 22:2 Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
約伯記 22:2 人豈能使 神有益呢．智慧人但能有益於己。

Job 22:3 Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
約伯記 22:3 你爲人公義、豈叫全能者喜悅呢．你行爲完全、豈能使他得利呢。

Job 22:4 Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
約伯記 22:4 豈是因你敬畏他、就責備你、審判你麼。

Job 22:5 Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
約伯記 22:5 你的罪惡豈不是大麼．你的罪孽也沒有窮盡。

Job 22:6 For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
約伯記 22:6 因你無故強取弟兄的物爲當頭、剝去貧寒人的衣服。

Job 22:7 Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
約伯記 22:7 困乏的人你沒有給他水喝．飢餓的人、你沒有給他食物。

Job 22:8 But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
約伯記 22:8 有能力的人、就得地土．尊貴的人、也住在其中。

Job 22:9 Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
約伯記 22:9 你打發寡婦空手回去、折斷孤兒的膀臂。

Job 22:10 Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
約伯記 22:10 因此、有網羅環繞你、有恐懼忽然使你驚惶．

Job 22:11 Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
約伯記 22:11 或有黑暗蒙蔽你、並有洪水淹沒你。

Job 22:12 Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
約伯記 22:12 神豈不是在高天麼．你看星宿何其高呢。

Job 22:13 And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
約伯記 22:13 你說、 神知道甚麼．他豈能看透幽暗施行審判呢。

Job 22:14 Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
約伯記 22:14 密雲將他遮蓋、使他不能看見．他周遊穹蒼。

Job 22:15 Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
約伯記 22:15 你要依從上古的道麼．這道是惡人所行的．

Job 22:16 Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
約伯記 22:16 他們未到死期、忽然除滅．根基毀壞、好像被江河沖去．

Job 22:17 Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
約伯記 22:17 他們向 神說、離開我們罷．又說、全能者能把我們怎麼樣呢。

Job 22:18 Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
約伯記 22:18 那知 神以美物充滿他們的房屋．但惡人所謀定的離我好遠。

Job 22:19 The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
約伯記 22:19 義人看見他們的結局就歡喜、無辜的人嗤笑他們、

Job 22:20 Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
約伯記 22:20 說、那起來攻擊我們的、果然被剪除、其餘的都被火燒滅。

Job 22:21 Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
約伯記 22:21 你要認識 神、就得平安．福氣也必臨到你。

Job 22:22 Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
約伯記 22:22 你當領受他口中的教訓、將他的言語存在心裏。

Job 22:23 If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
約伯記 22:23 你若歸向全能者、從你帳棚中遠除不義、就必得建立。

Job 22:24 Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
約伯記 22:24 要將你的珍寶丟在塵土裏、將俄斐的黃金丟在溪河石頭之間．

Job 22:25 Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
約伯記 22:25 全能者就必爲你的珍寶、作你的寶銀。

Job 22:26 For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
約伯記 22:26 你就要以全能者爲喜樂、向 神仰起臉來。

Job 22:27 Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
約伯記 22:27 你要禱告他、他就聽你．你也要還你的願。

Job 22:28 Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
約伯記 22:28 你定意要作何事、必然給你成就．亮光也必照耀你的路。

Job 22:29 When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
約伯記 22:29 人使你降卑、你仍可說、必得高升．謙卑的人 神必然拯救。

Job 22:30 He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
約伯記 22:30 人非無辜、 神且要搭救他．他因你手中清潔、必蒙拯救。

Job 23:1 Then Job answered and said,
約伯記 23:1 約伯回答說、

Job 23:2 Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
約伯記 23:2 如今我的哀告還算爲悖逆．我的責罰比我的唉哼還重。

Job 23:3 Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
約伯記 23:3 惟願我能知道在那裏可以尋見 神、能到他的臺前．

Job 23:4 I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
約伯記 23:4 我就在他面前將我的案件陳明、滿口辯白。

Job 23:5 I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
約伯記 23:5 我必知道他回答我的言語、明白他向我所說的話。

Job 23:6 Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
約伯記 23:6 他豈用大能與我爭辯麼．必不這樣．他必理會我。

Job 23:7 There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
約伯記 23:7 在他那裏正直人可以與他辯論．這樣、我必永遠脫離那審判我的。

Job 23:8 Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
約伯記 23:8 只是我往前行、他不在那裏．往後退、也不能見他。

Job 23:9 On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
約伯記 23:9 他在左邊行事、我卻不能看見．在右邊隱藏、我也不能見他。

Job 23:10 But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
約伯記 23:10 然而他知道我所行的路、他試煉我之後、我必如精金。

Job 23:11 My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
約伯記 23:11 我脚追隨他的步履．我謹守他的道、並不偏離。

Job 23:12 Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
約伯記 23:12 他嘴唇的命令、我未曾背棄．我看重他口中的言語、過於我需用的飲食。

Job 23:13 But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
約伯記 23:13 只是他心志已定、誰能使他轉意呢．他心裏所願的、就行出來。

Job 23:14 For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
約伯記 23:14 他向我所定的、就必作成．這類的事他還有許多。

Job 23:15 Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
約伯記 23:15 所以我在他面前驚惶、我思念這事、便懼怕他。

Job 23:16 For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
約伯記 23:16 神使我喪膽、全能者使我驚惶。

Job 23:17 Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
約伯記 23:17 我的恐懼、不是因爲黑暗、也不是因爲幽暗蒙蔽我的臉。

Job 24:1 Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
約伯記 24:1 全能者旣定期罰惡、爲何不使認識他的人看見那日子呢。

Job 24:2 Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
約伯記 24:2 有人挪移地界、搶奪羣畜而牧養。

Job 24:3 They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
約伯記 24:3 他們拉去孤兒的驢、強取寡婦的牛爲當頭。

Job 24:4 They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
約伯記 24:4 他們使窮人離開正道．世上的貧民盡都隱藏。

Job 24:5 Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
約伯記 24:5 這些貧窮人、如同野驢出到曠野、殷勤尋找食物．他們靠着野地給兒女餬口．

Job 24:6 They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
約伯記 24:6 收割別人田間的禾稼．摘取惡人餘剩的葡萄．

Job 24:7 They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
約伯記 24:7 終夜赤身無衣、天氣寒冷毫無遮蓋．

Job 24:8 They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
約伯記 24:8 在山上被大雨淋濕．因沒有避身之處就挨近磐石。

Job 24:9 They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
約伯記 24:9 又有人從母懷中搶奪孤兒、強取窮人的衣服爲當頭．

Job 24:10 They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
約伯記 24:10 使人赤身無衣、到處流行．且因飢餓扛抬禾捆。

Job 24:11 Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
約伯記 24:11 在那些人的圍牆內造油、醡酒、自己還口渴。

Job 24:12 Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.
約伯記 24:12 在多民的城內有人唉哼、受傷的人哀號． 神卻不理會那惡人的愚妄。

Job 24:13 They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
約伯記 24:13 又有人背棄光明、不認識光明的道、不住在光明的路上。

Job 24:14 The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
約伯記 24:14 殺人的黎明起來、殺害困苦窮乏人．夜間又作盜賊。

Job 24:15 The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.
約伯記 24:15 姦夫等候黃昏、說、必無眼能見我、就把臉蒙蔽。

Job 24:16 In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
約伯記 24:16 盜賊黑夜挖窟窿、白日躱藏、並不認識光明。

Job 24:17 For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
約伯記 24:17 他們看早晨如幽暗．因爲他們曉得幽暗的驚駭。

Job 24:18 He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
約伯記 24:18 這些惡人猶如浮萍快快飄去．他們所得的分在世上被咒詛．他們不得再走葡萄園的路。

Job 24:19 Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.
約伯記 24:19 乾旱炎熱消沒雪水．陰間也如此消沒犯罪之輩。

Job 24:20 The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
約伯記 24:20 懷他的母要忘記他．蟲子要喫他、覺得甘甜．他不再被人記念．不義的人必如樹折斷。

Job 24:21 He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
約伯記 24:21 他惡待不懷孕不生養的婦人、不善待寡婦。

Job 24:22 He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
約伯記 24:22 然而 神用能力保全有勢力的人．那性命難保的人仍然興起。

Job 24:23 Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
約伯記 24:23 神使他們安穩、他們就有所倚靠． 神的眼目也看顧他們的道路。

Job 24:24 They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
約伯記 24:24 他們被高舉不過片時、就沒有了．他們降爲卑、被除滅、與衆人一樣．又如穀穗被割。

Job 24:25 And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
約伯記 24:25 若不是這樣、誰能證實我是說謊的、將我的言語駁爲虛空呢。

Job 25:1 Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
約伯記 25:1 書亞人比勒達回答說、

Job 25:2 Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
約伯記 25:2 神有治理之權、有威嚴可畏．他在高處施行和平。

Job 25:3 Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
約伯記 25:3 他的諸軍、豈能數算．他的光亮一發、誰不蒙照呢。

Job 25:4 How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
約伯記 25:4 這樣在 神面前、人怎能稱義．婦人所生的、怎能潔淨。

Job 25:5 Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
約伯記 25:5 在 神眼前、月亮也無光亮、星宿也不清潔．

Job 25:6 How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
約伯記 25:6 何况如蟲的人、如蛆的世人呢。

Job 26:1 But Job answered and said,
約伯記 26:1 約伯回答說、

Job 26:2 How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
約伯記 26:2 無能的人、蒙你何等的幫助．膀臂無力的人、蒙你何等的拯救。

Job 26:3 How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
約伯記 26:3 無智慧的人、蒙你何等的指教．你向他多顯大知識。

Job 26:4 To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
約伯記 26:4 你向誰發出言語來．誰的靈從你而出。

Job 26:5 Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
約伯記 26:5 在大水和水族以下的陰魂戰兢。

Job 26:6 Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
約伯記 26:6 在 神面前陰間顯露、滅亡也不得遮掩。

Job 26:7 He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
約伯記 26:7 神將北極鋪在空中、將大地懸在虛空．

Job 26:8 He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
約伯記 26:8 將水包在密雲中、雲卻不破裂。

Job 26:9 He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.
約伯記 26:9 遮蔽他的寶座、將雲鋪在其上．

Job 26:10 He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
約伯記 26:10 在水面的周圍畫出界限、直到光明黑暗的交界。

Job 26:11 The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
約伯記 26:11 天的柱子因他的斥責震動驚奇。

Job 26:12 He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
約伯記 26:12 他以能力攪動大海、他藉知識打傷拉哈伯．

Job 26:13 By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
約伯記 26:13 藉他的靈使天有妝飾．他的手刺殺快蛇。

Job 26:14 Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
約伯記 26:14 看哪、這不過是 神工作的些微．我們所聽於他的是何等細微的聲音．他大能的雷聲誰能明透呢。

Job 27:1 Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
約伯記 27:1 約伯接着說、

Job 27:2 As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;
約伯記 27:2 神奪去我的理、全能者使我心中愁苦．我指着永生的 神起誓、

Job 27:3 All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;
約伯記 27:3 （我的生命尚在我裏面、 神所賜呼吸之氣仍在我的鼻孔內）

Job 27:4 My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
約伯記 27:4 我的嘴決不說非義之言、我的舌也不說詭詐之語。

Job 27:5 God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
約伯記 27:5 我斷不以你們爲是．我至死必不以自己爲不正。

Job 27:6 My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
約伯記 27:6 我持定我的義、必不放鬆．在世的日子我心必不責備我。

Job 27:7 Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
約伯記 27:7 願我的仇敵如惡人一樣、願那起來攻擊我的、如不義之人一般。

Job 27:8 For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
約伯記 27:8 不敬虔的人、雖然得利、 神奪取其命的時候、還有甚麼指望呢。

Job 27:9 Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
約伯記 27:9 患難臨到他、 神豈能聽他的呼求。

Job 27:10 Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
約伯記 27:10 他豈以全能者爲樂、隨時求告 神呢。

Job 27:11 I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
約伯記 27:11 神的作爲、我要指教你們、全能者所行的、我也不隱瞞。

Job 27:12 Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
約伯記 27:12 你們自己也都見過．爲何全然變爲虛妄呢。

Job 27:13 This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
約伯記 27:13 神爲惡人所定的分、強暴人從全能者所得的報、乃是這樣．

Job 27:14 If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
約伯記 27:14 倘或他的兒女增多、還是被刀所殺．他的子孫必不得飽食。

Job 27:15 Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
約伯記 27:15 他所遺留的人、必死而埋葬．他的寡婦也不哀哭。

Job 27:16 Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
約伯記 27:16 他雖積蓄銀子如塵沙、豫備衣服如泥土．

Job 27:17 He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
約伯記 27:17 他只管豫備、義人卻要穿上．他的銀子、無辜的人要分取。

Job 27:18 He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.
約伯記 27:18 他建造房屋如蟲作窩、又如守望者所搭的棚。

Job 27:19 The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.
約伯記 27:19 他雖富足躺臥、卻不得收殮．轉眼之間就不在了。

Job 27:20 Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
約伯記 27:20 驚恐如波濤、將他追上．暴風在夜間、將他颳去。

Job 27:21 The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
約伯記 27:21 東風把他飄去、又颳他離開本處。

Job 27:22 For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
約伯記 27:22 神要向他射箭、並不留情．他恨不得逃脫 神的手。

Job 27:23 Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
約伯記 27:23 人要向他拍掌、並要發叱聲、使他離開本處。

Job 28:1 Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
約伯記 28:1 銀子有礦、煉金有方。

Job 28:2 Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
約伯記 28:2 鐵從地裏挖出、銅從石中鎔化。

Job 28:3 He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
約伯記 28:3 人爲黑暗定界限、查究幽暗陰翳的石頭、直到極處．

Job 28:4 The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
約伯記 28:4 在無人居住之處刨開礦穴、過路的人也想不到他們．又與人遠離、懸在空中搖來搖去。

Job 28:5 As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
約伯記 28:5 至於地、能出糧食．地內好像被火翻起來。

Job 28:6 The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
約伯記 28:6 地中的石頭有藍寶石、並有金沙。

Job 28:7 There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:
約伯記 28:7 礦中的路鷙鳥不得知道、鷹眼也未見過．

Job 28:8 The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
約伯記 28:8 狂傲的野獸未曾行過．猛烈的獅子也未曾經過。

Job 28:9 He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
約伯記 28:9 人伸手鑿開堅石、傾倒山根。

Job 28:10 He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
約伯記 28:10 在磐石中鑿出水道．親眼看見各樣寶物。

Job 28:11 He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
約伯記 28:11 他封閉水不得滴流．使隱藏的物顯露出來。

Job 28:12 But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
約伯記 28:12 然而智慧有何處可尋．聰明之處在哪裏呢。

Job 28:13 Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
約伯記 28:13 智慧的價值無人能知、在活人之地也無處可尋。

Job 28:14 The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.
約伯記 28:14 深淵說、不在我內．滄海說、不在我中。

Job 28:15 It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
約伯記 28:15 智慧非用黃金可得、也不能平白銀爲他的價值。

Job 28:16 It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
約伯記 28:16 俄斐金、和貴重的紅瑪瑙、並藍寶石、不足與較量。

Job 28:17 The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
約伯記 28:17 黃金、和玻璃、不足與比較、精金的器皿、不足與兌換。

Job 28:18 No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
約伯記 28:18 珊瑚、水晶、都不足論、智慧的價值勝過珍珠。

Job 28:19 The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
約伯記 28:19 古實的紅璧璽、不足與比較。精金、也不足與較量。

Job 28:20 Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
約伯記 28:20 智慧從何處來呢．聰明之處在哪裏呢。

Job 28:21 Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
約伯記 28:21 是向一切有生命的眼目隱藏、向空中的飛鳥掩蔽。

Job 28:22 Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
約伯記 28:22 滅沒和死亡說、我們風聞其名。

Job 28:23 God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
約伯記 28:23 神明白智慧的道路、曉得智慧的所在。

Job 28:24 For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;
約伯記 28:24 因他鑒察直到地極、徧觀普天之下．

Job 28:25 To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
約伯記 28:25 要爲風定輕重．又度量諸水。

Job 28:26 When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
約伯記 28:26 他爲雨露定命令、爲雷電定道路。

Job 28:27 Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
約伯記 28:27 那時他看見智慧、而且述說．他堅定、並且查究。

Job 28:28 And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the LORD, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
約伯記 28:28 他對人說、敬畏主就是智慧、遠離惡便是聰明。

Job 29:1 Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
約伯記 29:1 約伯又接着說、

Job 29:2 Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;
約伯記 29:2 惟願我的景况如從前的月分、如 神保守我的日子。

Job 29:3 When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;
約伯記 29:3 那時他的燈照在我頭上．我藉他的光行過黑暗。

Job 29:4 As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
約伯記 29:4 我願如壯年的時候。那時我在帳棚中． 神待我有密友之情．

Job 29:5 When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
約伯記 29:5 全能者仍與我同在、我的兒女都環繞我．

Job 29:6 When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
約伯記 29:6 奶多可洗我的脚、磐石爲我出油成河。

Job 29:7 When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
約伯記 29:7 我出到城門、在街上設立座位、

Job 29:8 The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
約伯記 29:8 少年人見我而迴避、老年人也起身站立．

Job 29:9 The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
約伯記 29:9 王子都停止說話、用手摀口．

Job 29:10 The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
約伯記 29:10 首領靜默無聲、舌頭貼住上膛。

Job 29:11 When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:
約伯記 29:11 耳朶聽我的、就稱我有福．眼睛看我的、便稱讚我．

Job 29:12 Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
約伯記 29:12 因我拯救哀求的困苦人、和無人幫助的孤兒。

Job 29:13 The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.
約伯記 29:13 將要滅亡的爲我祝福。我也使寡婦心中歡樂。

Job 29:14 I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
約伯記 29:14 我以公義爲衣服、以公平爲外袍和冠冕。

Job 29:15 I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
約伯記 29:15 我爲瞎子的眼、瘸子的脚。

Job 29:16 I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
約伯記 29:16 我爲窮乏人的父．素不認識的人我查明他的案件。

Job 29:17 And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
約伯記 29:17 我打破不義之人的牙牀、從他牙齒中奪了所搶的。

Job 29:18 Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
約伯記 29:18 我便說、我必死在家中、必增添我的日子、多如塵沙．

Job 29:19 My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
約伯記 29:19 我的根長到水邊、露水終夜霑在我的枝上．

Job 29:20 My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
約伯記 29:20 我的榮耀在身上增新、我的弓在手中日強。

Job 29:21 Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
約伯記 29:21 人聽見我而仰望、靜默等候我的指教。

Job 29:22 After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
約伯記 29:22 我說話之後、他們就不再說．我的言語像雨露滴在他們身上。

Job 29:23 And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
約伯記 29:23 他們仰望我如仰望雨．又張開口如切慕春雨。

Job 29:24 If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
約伯記 29:24 他們不敢自信、我就向他們含笑．他們不使我臉上的光改變。

Job 29:25 I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
約伯記 29:25 我爲他們選擇道路、又坐首位．我如君王在軍隊中居住．又如弔喪的安慰傷心的人。

Job 30:1 But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
約伯記 30:1 但如今比我年少的人戲笑我．其人之父、我曾藐視、不肯安在看守我羊羣的狗中。

Job 30:2 Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
約伯記 30:2 他們壯年的氣力旣已衰敗、其手之力與我何益呢。

Job 30:3 For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
約伯記 30:3 他們因窮乏飢餓、身體枯瘦、在荒廢淒涼的幽暗中、齦乾燥之地．

Job 30:4 Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
約伯記 30:4 在草叢之中採鹹草、羅騰的根爲他們的食物。

Job 30:5 They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
約伯記 30:5 他們從人中被趕出、人追喊他們如賊一般、

Job 30:6 To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
約伯記 30:6 以致他們住在荒谷之間、在地洞和巖穴中．

Job 30:7 Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
約伯記 30:7 在草叢中叫喚、在荊棘下聚集。

Job 30:8 They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
約伯記 30:8 這都是愚頑下賤人的兒女．他們被鞭打、趕出境外。

Job 30:9 And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
約伯記 30:9 現在這些人以我爲歌曲、以我爲笑談。

Job 30:10 They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
約伯記 30:10 他們厭惡我、躱在旁邊站着、不住的吐唾沫在我臉上。

Job 30:11 Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
約伯記 30:11 鬆開他們的繩索苦待我、在我面前脫去轡頭。

Job 30:12 Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
約伯記 30:12 這等下流人在我右邊起來、推開我的脚、築成戰路來攻擊我。

Job 30:13 They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
約伯記 30:13 這些無人幫助的、毀壞我的道、加增我的災。

Job 30:14 They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
約伯記 30:14 他們來如同闖進大破口．在毀壞之間、輥在我身上。

Job 30:15 Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
約伯記 30:15 驚恐臨到我、驅逐我的尊榮如風．我的福祿如雲過去。

Job 30:16 And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
約伯記 30:16 現在我心極其悲傷．困苦的日子將我抓住。

Job 30:17 My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
約伯記 30:17 夜間我裏面的骨頭刺我、疼痛不止、好像齦我。

Job 30:18 By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
約伯記 30:18 因 神的大力、我的外衣汚穢不堪．又如裏衣的領子將我纏住。

Job 30:19 He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
約伯記 30:19 神把我扔在淤泥中、我就像塵土和爐灰一般。

Job 30:20 I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.
約伯記 30:20 主阿、我呼求你、你不應允我．我站起來、你就定睛看我。

Job 30:21 Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
約伯記 30:21 你向我變心、待我殘忍．又用大能追逼我．

Job 30:22 Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
約伯記 30:22 把我提在風中、使我駕風而行．又使我消滅在烈風中。

Job 30:23 For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
約伯記 30:23 我知道要使我臨到死地、到那爲衆生所定的陰宅。

Job 30:24 Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
約伯記 30:24 然而人仆倒、豈不伸手．遇災難、豈不求救呢。

Job 30:25 Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
約伯記 30:25 人遭難、我豈不爲他哭泣呢．人窮乏、我豈不爲他憂愁呢。

Job 30:26 When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
約伯記 30:26 我仰望得好處、災禍就到了．我等待光明、黑暗便來了。

Job 30:27 My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
約伯記 30:27 我心裏煩擾不安、困苦的日子臨到我身。

Job 30:28 I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
約伯記 30:28 我沒有日光就哀哭行去．我在會中站着求救。

Job 30:29 I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
約伯記 30:29 我與野狗爲弟兄、與鴕鳥爲同伴。

Job 30:30 My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
約伯記 30:30 我的皮膚黑而脫落．我的骨頭因熱燒焦。

Job 30:31 My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
約伯記 30:31 所以我的琴音變爲悲音、我的簫聲變爲哭聲。

Job 31:1 I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
約伯記 31:1 我與眼睛立約、怎能戀戀瞻望處女呢。

Job 31:2 For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
約伯記 31:2 從至上的 神所得之分、從至高全能者所得之業、是甚麼呢。

Job 31:3 Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
約伯記 31:3 豈不是禍患臨到不義的、災害臨到作孽的呢。

Job 31:4 Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
約伯記 31:4 神豈不是察看我的道路、數點我的脚步呢。

Job 31:5 If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
約伯記 31:5 我若與虛謊同行、脚若追隨詭詐．

Job 31:6 Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.
約伯記 31:6 我若被公道的天平稱度、使 神可以知道我的純正．

Job 31:7 If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
約伯記 31:7 我的脚步若偏離正路、我的心若隨着我的眼目、若有玷汚粘在我手上．

Job 31:8 Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
約伯記 31:8 就願我所種的、有別人喫．我田所產的、被拔出來。

Job 31:9 If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;
約伯記 31:9 我若受迷惑、向婦人起淫念、在鄰舍的門外蹲伏．

Job 31:10 Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
約伯記 31:10 就願我的妻子給別人推磨、別人也與他同室。

Job 31:11 For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
約伯記 31:11 因爲這是大罪、是審判官當罰的罪孽。

Job 31:12 For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
約伯記 31:12 這本是火焚燒、直到毀滅、必拔除我所有的家產。

Job 31:13 If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
約伯記 31:13 我的僕婢與我爭辯的時候、我若藐視不聽他們的情節．

Job 31:14 What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
約伯記 31:14 神興起、我怎樣行呢．他察問、我怎樣回答呢。

Job 31:15 Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
約伯記 31:15 造我在腹中的、不也是造他麼．將他與我摶在腹中的、豈不是一位麼。

Job 31:16 If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
約伯記 31:16 我若不容貧寒人得其所願、或叫寡婦眼中失望、

Job 31:17 Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
約伯記 31:17 或獨自喫我一點食物、孤兒沒有與我同喫．

Job 31:18 (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)
約伯記 31:18 （從幼年時孤兒與我同長、好像父子一樣．我從出母腹就扶助寡婦．）

Job 31:19 If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
約伯記 31:19 我若見人因無衣死亡、或見窮乏人身無遮蓋．

Job 31:20 If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
約伯記 31:20 我若不使他因我羊的毛得暖、爲我祝福．

Job 31:21 If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
約伯記 31:21 我若在城門口見有幫助我的、舉手攻擊孤兒．

Job 31:22 Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
約伯記 31:22 情願我的肩頭從缺盆骨脫落、我的膀臂從羊矢骨折斷。

Job 31:23 For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
約伯記 31:23 因 神降的災禍、使我恐懼、因他的威嚴、我不能妄爲。

Job 31:24 If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
約伯記 31:24 我若以黃金爲指望、對精金說、你是我的倚靠．

Job 31:25 If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
約伯記 31:25 我若因財物豐裕、因我手多得貲財而歡喜．

Job 31:26 If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
約伯記 31:26 我若見太陽發光、明月行在空中、

Job 31:27 And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
約伯記 31:27 心就暗暗被引誘、口便親手．

Job 31:28 This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
約伯記 31:28 這也是審判官當罰的罪孽、又是我背棄在上的 神。

Job 31:29 If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
約伯記 31:29 我若見恨我的遭報就歡喜、見他遭災便高興．

Job 31:30 Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
約伯記 31:30 （我沒有容口犯罪、咒詛他的生命）

Job 31:31 If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
約伯記 31:31 若我帳棚的人未嘗說、誰不以主人的食物喫飽呢．

Job 31:32 The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
約伯記 31:32 （從來我沒有容客旅在街上住宿、卻開門迎接行路的人．）

Job 31:33 If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
約伯記 31:33 我若像亞當遮掩我的過犯、將罪孽藏在懷中、

Job 31:34 Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
約伯記 31:34 因懼怕大衆、又因宗族藐視我使我驚恐、以致閉口無言、杜門不出．

Job 31:35 Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
約伯記 31:35 惟願有一位肯聽我、（看哪、在這裏有我所畫的押、願全能者回答我）

Job 31:36 Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
約伯記 31:36 願那敵我者所寫的狀詞在我這裏我必帶在肩上、又綁在頭上爲冠冕．

Job 31:37 I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
約伯記 31:37 我必向他述說我脚步的數目、必如君王進到他面前。

Job 31:38 If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
約伯記 31:38 我若奪取田地、這地向我喊寃、犂溝一同哭泣．

Job 31:39 If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
約伯記 31:39 我若喫地的出產不給價值、或叫原主喪命．

Job 31:40 Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
約伯記 31:40 願這地長蒺藜代替麥子、長惡草代替大麥．約伯的話說完了。

Job 32:1 So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
約伯記 32:1 於是這三個人、因約伯自以爲義、就不再回答他。

Job 32:2 Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
約伯記 32:2 那時有布西人、蘭族巴拉迦的兒子以利戶、向約伯發怒、因約伯自以爲義、不以 神爲義。

Job 32:3 Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
約伯記 32:3 他又向約伯的三個朋友發怒、因爲他們想不出回答的話來、仍以約伯爲有罪。

Job 32:4 Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
約伯記 32:4 以利戶要與約伯說話、就等候他們、因爲他們比自己年老。

Job 32:5 When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
約伯記 32:5 以利戶見這三個人口中無話回答、就怒氣發作。

Job 32:6 And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
約伯記 32:6 布西人巴拉迦的兒子以利戶回答說、我年輕、你們老邁、因此我退讓、不敢向你們陳說我的意見。

Job 32:7 I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
約伯記 32:7 我說、年老的當先說話、壽高的當以智慧教訓人。

Job 32:8 But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
約伯記 32:8 但在人裏面有靈、全能者的氣使人有聰明。

Job 32:9 Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
約伯記 32:9 尊貴的不都有智慧、壽高的不都能明白公平。

Job 32:10 Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
約伯記 32:10 因此我說、你們要聽我言、我也要陳說我的意見。

Job 32:11 Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
約伯記 32:11 你們查究所要說的話．那時我等候你們的話側耳聽你們的辯論、

Job 32:12 Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
約伯記 32:12 留心聽你們．誰知你們中間無一人折服約伯、駁倒他的話。

Job 32:13 Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
約伯記 32:13 你們切不可說、我們尋得智慧． 神能勝他、人卻不能。

Job 32:14 Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
約伯記 32:14 約伯沒有向我爭辯、我也不用你們的話回答他。

Job 32:15 They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
約伯記 32:15 他們驚奇不再回答、一言不發。

Job 32:16 When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
約伯記 32:16 我豈因他們不說話、站住不再回答、仍舊等候呢。

Job 32:17 I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
約伯記 32:17 我也要回答我的一分話、陳說我的意見。

Job 32:18 For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
約伯記 32:18 因爲我的言語滿懷、我裏面的靈激動我。

Job 32:19 Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
約伯記 32:19 我的胸懷如盛酒之囊、沒有出氣之縫、又如新皮袋快要破裂。

Job 32:20 I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
約伯記 32:20 我要說話、使我舒暢．我要開口回答。

Job 32:21 Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
約伯記 32:21 我必不看人的情面、也不奉承人。

Job 32:22 For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
約伯記 32:22 我不曉得奉承、若奉承、造我的主必快快除滅我。

Job 33:1 Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
約伯記 33:1 約伯阿、請聽我的話、留心聽我一切的言語。

Job 33:2 Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
約伯記 33:2 我現在開口、用舌發言。

Job 33:3 My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
約伯記 33:3 我的言語、要發明心中所存的正直．我所知道的、我嘴唇要誠實的說出。

Job 33:4 The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
約伯記 33:4 神的靈造我、全能者的氣使我得生。

Job 33:5 If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
約伯記 33:5 你若回答我、就站起來、在我面前陳明。

Job 33:6 Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
約伯記 33:6 我在 神面前與你一樣、也是用土造成。

Job 33:7 Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
約伯記 33:7 我不用威嚴驚嚇你、也不用勢力重壓你。

Job 33:8 Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,
約伯記 33:8 你所說的我聽見了、也聽見你的言語、說、

Job 33:9 I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
約伯記 33:9 我是清潔無過的．我是無辜的、在我裏面也沒有罪孽。

Job 33:10 Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
約伯記 33:10 神找機會攻擊我、以我爲仇敵、

Job 33:11 He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
約伯記 33:11 把我的脚上了木狗、窺察我一切的道路。

Job 33:12 Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
約伯記 33:12 我要回答你說、你這話無理．因 神比世人更大。

Job 33:13 Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.
約伯記 33:13 你爲何與他爭論呢、因他的事都不對人解說。

Job 33:14 For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
約伯記 33:14 神說、一次、兩次、世人卻不理會。

Job 33:15 In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
約伯記 33:15 人躺在牀上沉睡的時候 神就用夢、和夜間的異象、

Job 33:16 Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
約伯記 33:16 開通他們的耳朶、將當受的教訓印在他們心上、

Job 33:17 That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
約伯記 33:17 好叫人不從自己的謀算、不行驕傲的事．

Job 33:18 He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
約伯記 33:18 攔阻人不陷於坑裏、不死在刀下。

Job 33:19 He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
約伯記 33:19 人在牀上被懲治、骨頭中不住的疼痛．

Job 33:20 So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
約伯記 33:20 以致他的口厭棄食物、心厭惡美味。

Job 33:21 His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
約伯記 33:21 他的肉消瘦、不得再見、先前不見的骨頭、都凸出來。

Job 33:22 Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
約伯記 33:22 他的靈魂臨近深坑、他的生命近於滅命的。

Job 33:23 If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
約伯記 33:23 一千天使中、若有一個作傳話的、與 神同在、指示人所當行的事．

Job 33:24 Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
約伯記 33:24 神就給他開恩、說、救贖他免得下坑．我已經得了贖價。

Job 33:25 His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:
約伯記 33:25 他的肉要比孩童的肉更嫩．他就反老還童。

Job 33:26 He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
約伯記 33:26 他禱告 神、 神就喜悅他、使他歡呼朝見 神的面． 神又看他爲義。

Job 33:27 He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
約伯記 33:27 他在人前歌唱說、我犯了罪、顚倒是非、這竟與我無益。

Job 33:28 He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
約伯記 33:28 神救贖我的靈魂免入深坑．我的生命也必見光。

Job 33:29 Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
約伯記 33:29 神兩次、三次、向人行這一切的事．

Job 33:30 To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
約伯記 33:30 爲要從深坑救回人的靈魂、使他被光照耀與活人一樣。

Job 33:31 Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
約伯記 33:31 約伯阿、你當側耳聽我的話．不要作聲、等我講說。

Job 33:32 If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
約伯記 33:32 你若有話說、就可以回答我．你只管說、因我願以你爲是。

Job 33:33 If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
約伯記 33:33 若不然、你就聽我說、你不要作聲、我便將智慧教訓你。

Job 34:1 Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
約伯記 34:1 以利戶又說、

Job 34:2 Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
約伯記 34:2 你們智慧人、要聽我的話．有知識的人、要留心聽我說。

Job 34:3 For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
約伯記 34:3 因爲耳朶試驗話語、好像上膛嘗食物。

Job 34:4 Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
約伯記 34:4 我們當選擇何爲是、彼此知道何爲善。

Job 34:5 For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
約伯記 34:5 約伯曾說、我是公義、 神奪去我的理．

Job 34:6 Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
約伯記 34:6 我雖有理、還算爲說謊言的．我雖無過、受的傷還不能醫治。

Job 34:7 What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?
約伯記 34:7 誰像約伯、喝譏誚如同喝水呢。

Job 34:8 Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.
約伯記 34:8 他與作孽的結伴、和惡人同行。

Job 34:9 For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.
約伯記 34:9 他說、人以 神爲樂、總是無益。

Job 34:10 Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
約伯記 34:10 所以你們明理的人要聽我的話． 神斷不至行惡、全能者斷不至作孽。

Job 34:11 For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
約伯記 34:11 他必按人所作的報應人、使各人照所行的得報。

Job 34:12 Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
約伯記 34:12 神必不作惡、全能者也不偏離公平。

Job 34:13 Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
約伯記 34:13 誰派他治理地、安定全世界呢。

Job 34:14 If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
約伯記 34:14 他若專心爲己、將靈和氣收歸自己．

Job 34:15 All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
約伯記 34:15 凡有血氣的就必一同死亡、世人必仍歸塵土。

Job 34:16 If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
約伯記 34:16 你若明理、就當聽我的話、留心聽我言語的聲音。

Job 34:17 Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
約伯記 34:17 難道恨惡公平的、可以掌權麼．那有公義的、有大能的、豈可定他有罪麼。

Job 34:18 Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?
約伯記 34:18 他對君王說、你是鄙陋的、對貴臣說、你是邪惡的。

Job 34:19 How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
約伯記 34:19 他待王子不徇情面、也不看重富足的過於貧窮的．因爲都是他手所造。

Job 34:20 In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
約伯記 34:20 在轉眼之間、半夜之中、他們就死亡．百姓被震動而去世、有權力的被奪去非借人手。
