Proverbs 7:23 Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
箴言 7:23 直等箭穿他的肝、如同雀鳥急入網羅、卻不知是自喪己命。

Proverbs 7:24 Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
箴言 7:24 衆子阿、現在要聽從我、留心聽我口中的話。

Proverbs 7:25 Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
箴言 7:25 你的心、不可偏向淫婦的道．不要入他的迷途。

Proverbs 7:26 For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
箴言 7:26 因爲被他傷害仆倒的不少．被他殺戮的而且甚多。

Proverbs 7:27 Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
箴言 7:27 他的家是在陰間之路、下到死亡之宮。

Proverbs 8:1 Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
箴言 8:1 智慧豈不呼叫、聰明豈不發聲。

Proverbs 8:2 She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
箴言 8:2 他在道旁高處的頂上、在十字路口站立．

Proverbs 8:3 She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
箴言 8:3 在城門旁、在城門口、在城門洞、大聲說、

Proverbs 8:4 Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
箴言 8:4 衆人哪、我呼叫你們．我向世人發聲。

Proverbs 8:5 O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
箴言 8:5 說、愚蒙人哪、你們要會悟靈明．愚昧人哪、你們當心裏明白。

Proverbs 8:6 Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
箴言 8:6 你們當聽、因我要說極美的話．我張嘴要論正直的事。

Proverbs 8:7 For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
箴言 8:7 我的口要發出眞理．我的嘴憎惡邪惡。

Proverbs 8:8 All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
箴言 8:8 我口中的言語、都是公義、並無彎曲乖僻。

Proverbs 8:9 They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
箴言 8:9 有聰明的以爲明顯、得知識的以爲正直．

Proverbs 8:10 Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
箴言 8:10 你們當受我的教訓、不受白銀．寧得知識、勝過黃金。

Proverbs 8:11 For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
箴言 8:11 因爲智慧比珍珠更美．一切可喜愛的、都不足與比較。

Proverbs 8:12 I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
箴言 8:12 我智慧以靈明爲居所、又尋得知識和謀畧。

Proverbs 8:13 The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
箴言 8:13 敬畏耶和華、在乎恨惡邪惡．那驕傲、狂妄、並惡道、以及乖謬的口、都爲我所恨惡。

Proverbs 8:14 Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
箴言 8:14 我有謀畧、和眞知識．我乃聰明．我有能力。

Proverbs 8:15 By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
箴言 8:15 帝王藉我坐國位．君王藉我定公平。

Proverbs 8:16 By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
箴言 8:16 王子和首領、世上一切的審判官、都是藉我掌權。

Proverbs 8:17 I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
箴言 8:17 愛我的、我也愛他．懇切尋求我的、必尋得見。

Proverbs 8:18 Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
箴言 8:18 豐富尊榮在我．恆久的財並公義也在我。

Proverbs 8:19 My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
箴言 8:19 我的果實勝過黃金．強如精金．我的出產超乎高銀。

Proverbs 8:20 I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
箴言 8:20 我在公義的道上走、在公平的路中行．

Proverbs 8:21 That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
箴言 8:21 使愛我的承受貨財、並充滿他們的府庫。

Proverbs 8:22 The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
箴言 8:22 在耶和華造化的起頭、在太初創造萬物之先、就有了我。

Proverbs 8:23 I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
箴言 8:23 從亙古、從太初、未有世界以前、我已被立。

Proverbs 8:24 When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
箴言 8:24 沒有深淵、沒有大水的泉源、我已生出。

Proverbs 8:25 Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
箴言 8:25 大山未曾奠定、小山未有之先、我已生出。

Proverbs 8:26 While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
箴言 8:26 耶和華還沒有創造大地、和田野、並世上的土質、我已生出。

Proverbs 8:27 When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
箴言 8:27 他立高天、我在那裏．他在淵面的周圍、畫出圓圈、

Proverbs 8:28 When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
箴言 8:28 上使穹蒼堅硬、下使淵源穩固、

Proverbs 8:29 When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
箴言 8:29 爲滄海定出界限、使水不越過他的命令、立定大地的根基．

Proverbs 8:30 Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
箴言 8:30 那時、我在他那裏爲工師、日日爲他所喜愛、常常在他面前踴躍、

Proverbs 8:31 Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
箴言 8:31 踴躍在他爲人豫備可住之地、也喜悅住在世人之間。

Proverbs 8:32 Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
箴言 8:32 衆子阿、現在要聽從我．因爲謹守我道的、便爲有福。

Proverbs 8:33 Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
箴言 8:33 要聽教訓、就得智慧、不可棄絕。

Proverbs 8:34 Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
箴言 8:34 聽從我、日日在我門口仰望、在我門框旁邊等候的、那人便爲有福。

Proverbs 8:35 For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
箴言 8:35 因爲尋得我的、就尋得生命、也必蒙耶和華的恩惠。

Proverbs 8:36 But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
箴言 8:36 得罪我的、卻害了自己的性命．恨惡我的、都喜愛死亡。

Proverbs 9:1 Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
箴言 9:1 智慧建造房屋、鑿成七根柱子、

Proverbs 9:2 She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
箴言 9:2 宰殺牲畜、調和旨酒、設擺筵席．

Proverbs 9:3 She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
箴言 9:3 打發使女出去、自己在城中至高處呼叫、

Proverbs 9:4 Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
箴言 9:4 說、誰是愚蒙人、可以轉到這裏來．又對那無知的人說、

Proverbs 9:5 Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
箴言 9:5 你們來、喫我的餅、喝我調和的酒。

Proverbs 9:6 Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
箴言 9:6 你們愚蒙人、要捨棄愚蒙、就得存活．並要走光明的道。

Proverbs 9:7 He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
箴言 9:7 指斥褻慢人的、必受辱罵．責備惡人的、必被玷汚。

Proverbs 9:8 Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
箴言 9:8 不要責備褻慢人、恐怕他恨你．要責備智慧人、他必愛你。

Proverbs 9:9 Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
箴言 9:9 教導智慧人、他就越發有智慧．指示義人、他就增長學問。

Proverbs 9:10 The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
箴言 9:10 敬畏耶和華、是智慧的開端．認識至聖者、便是聰明。

Proverbs 9:11 For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
箴言 9:11 你藉着我、日子必增多、年歲也必加添。

Proverbs 9:12 If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
箴言 9:12 你若有智慧、是與自己有益．你若褻慢、就必獨自擔當。

Proverbs 9:13 A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
箴言 9:13 愚昧的婦人喧嚷．他是愚蒙、一無所知。

Proverbs 9:14 For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
箴言 9:14 他坐在自己的家門口、坐在城中高處的座位上、

Proverbs 9:15 To call passengers who go right on their ways:
箴言 9:15 呼叫過路的、就是直行其道的人、

Proverbs 9:16 Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
箴言 9:16 說、誰是愚蒙人、可以轉到這裏來．又對那無知的人說、

Proverbs 9:17 Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
箴言 9:17 偷來的水是甜的、暗喫的餅是好的。

Proverbs 9:18 But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
箴言 9:18 人卻不知有陰魂在他那裏．他的客在陰間的深處。

Proverbs 10:1 The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
箴言 10:1 所羅門的箴言。智慧之子、使父親歡樂．愚昧之子、叫母親擔憂。

Proverbs 10:2 Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
箴言 10:2 不義之財、毫無益處．惟有公義、能救人脫離死亡。

Proverbs 10:3 The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
箴言 10:3 耶和華不使義人受飢餓．惡人所欲的他必推開。

Proverbs 10:4 He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
箴言 10:4 手懶的、要受貧窮．手勤的、卻要富足。

Proverbs 10:5 He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
箴言 10:5 夏天聚斂的、是智慧之子．收割時沉睡的、是貽羞之子。

Proverbs 10:6 Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
箴言 10:6 福祉臨到義人的頭．強暴蒙蔽惡人的口。

Proverbs 10:7 The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
箴言 10:7 義人的記念被稱讚．惡人的名字必朽爛。

Proverbs 10:8 The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
箴言 10:8 心中智慧的、必受命令．口裏愚妄的、必致傾倒。

Proverbs 10:9 He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
箴言 10:9 行正直路的、步步安穩．走彎曲道的、必致敗露。

Proverbs 10:10 He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
箴言 10:10 以眼傳神的、使人憂患．口裏愚妄的、必致傾倒。

Proverbs 10:11 The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
箴言 10:11 義人的口是生命的泉源．強暴蒙蔽惡人的口。

Proverbs 10:12 Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
箴言 10:12 恨、能挑啟爭端．愛、能遮掩一切過錯。

Proverbs 10:13 In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
箴言 10:13 明哲人嘴裏有智慧．無知人背上受刑杖。

Proverbs 10:14 Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
箴言 10:14 智慧人積存知識．愚妄人的口速致敗壞。

Proverbs 10:15 The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
箴言 10:15 富戶的財物、是他的堅城．窮人的貧乏、是他的敗壞。

Proverbs 10:16 The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
箴言 10:16 義人的勤勞致生．惡人的進項致死。

Proverbs 10:17 He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
箴言 10:17 謹守訓誨的、乃在生命的道上．違棄責備的、便失迷了路。

Proverbs 10:18 He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
箴言 10:18 隱藏怨恨的、有說謊的嘴．口出讒謗的、是愚妄的人。

Proverbs 10:19 In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
箴言 10:19 多言多語難免有過．禁止嘴唇是有智慧。

Proverbs 10:20 The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
箴言 10:20 義人的舌、乃似高銀．惡人的心所值無幾。

Proverbs 10:21 The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
箴言 10:21 義人的口教養多人．愚昧人因無知而死亡。

Proverbs 10:22 The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
箴言 10:22 耶和華所賜的福、使人富足、並不加上憂慮。

Proverbs 10:23 It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
箴言 10:23 愚妄人以行惡爲戲耍．明哲人卻以智慧爲樂。

Proverbs 10:24 The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
箴言 10:24 惡人所怕的必臨到他．義人所願的必蒙應允。

Proverbs 10:25 As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
箴言 10:25 暴風一過、惡人歸於無有．義人的根基卻是永久。

Proverbs 10:26 As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
箴言 10:26 懶惰人叫差他的人、如醋倒牙、如煙薰目。

Proverbs 10:27 The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
箴言 10:27 敬畏耶和華、使人日子加多．但惡人的年歲必被減少。

Proverbs 10:28 The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
箴言 10:28 義人的盼望、必得喜樂．惡人的指望、必至滅沒。

Proverbs 10:29 The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
箴言 10:29 耶和華的道、是正直人的保障．卻成了作孽人的敗壞。

Proverbs 10:30 The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
箴言 10:30 義人永不挪移．惡人不得住在地上。

Proverbs 10:31 The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
箴言 10:31 義人的口、滋生智慧．乖謬的舌、必被割斷。

Proverbs 10:32 The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
箴言 10:32 義人的嘴、能令人喜悅．惡人的口、說乖謬的話。

Proverbs 11:1 A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
箴言 11:1 詭詐的天平、爲耶和華所憎惡．公平的法碼、爲他所喜悅。

Proverbs 11:2 When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
箴言 11:2 驕傲來、羞恥也來．謙遜人卻有智慧。

Proverbs 11:3 The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
箴言 11:3 正直人的純正、必引導自己．奸詐人的乖僻、必毀滅自己。

Proverbs 11:4 Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
箴言 11:4 發怒的日子、貲財無益．惟有公義能救人脫離死亡。

Proverbs 11:5 The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
箴言 11:5 完全人的義、必指引他的路．但惡人必因自己的惡跌倒。

Proverbs 11:6 The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
箴言 11:6 正直人的義、必拯救自己．奸詐人必陷在自己的罪孽中。

Proverbs 11:7 When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
箴言 11:7 惡人一死、他的指望必滅絕．罪人的盼望、也必滅沒。

Proverbs 11:8 The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
箴言 11:8 義人得脫離患難、有惡人來代替他。

Proverbs 11:9 An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
箴言 11:9 不虔敬的人用口敗壞鄰舍．義人卻因知識得救。

Proverbs 11:10 When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
箴言 11:10 義人享福、合城喜樂．惡人滅亡、人都歡呼。

Proverbs 11:11 By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
箴言 11:11 城因正直人祝福便高舉．卻因邪惡人的口就傾覆。

Proverbs 11:12 He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
箴言 11:12 藐視鄰舍的、毫無智慧．明哲人卻靜默不言。

Proverbs 11:13 A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
箴言 11:13 往來傳舌的、洩漏密事．心中誠實的、遮隱事情。

Proverbs 11:14 Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellers there is safety.
箴言 11:14 無智謀、民就敗落．謀士多、人便安居。

Proverbs 11:15 He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
箴言 11:15 爲外人作保的、必受虧損．恨惡擊掌的、卻得安穩。

Proverbs 11:16 A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
箴言 11:16 恩德的婦女得尊榮．強暴的男子得貲財。

Proverbs 11:17 The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
箴言 11:17 仁慈的人、善待自己．殘忍的人、擾害己身。

Proverbs 11:18 The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
箴言 11:18 惡人經營、得虛浮的工價．撒義種的、得實在的果效。

Proverbs 11:19 As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
箴言 11:19 恆心爲義的、必得生命．追求邪惡的、必致死亡。

Proverbs 11:20 They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
箴言 11:20 心中乖僻的、爲耶和華所憎惡．行事完全的、爲他所喜悅。

Proverbs 11:21 Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
箴言 11:21 惡人雖然連手、必不免受罰．義人的後裔必得拯救。

Proverbs 11:22 As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
箴言 11:22 婦女美貌而無見識、如同金環帶在豬鼻上。

Proverbs 11:23 The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
箴言 11:23 義人的心願、盡得好處．惡人的指望、致干忿怒。

Proverbs 11:24 There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
箴言 11:24 有施散的、卻更增添．有吝惜過度的、反致窮乏。

Proverbs 11:25 The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
箴言 11:25 好施捨的、必得豐裕．滋潤人的、必得滋潤。

Proverbs 11:26 He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
箴言 11:26 屯糧不賣的、民必咒詛他．情願出賣的、人必爲他祝福。

Proverbs 11:27 He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
箴言 11:27 懇切求善的、就求得恩惠．惟獨求惡的、惡必臨到他身。

Proverbs 11:28 He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
箴言 11:28 倚仗自己財物的、必跌倒．義人必發旺如青葉。

Proverbs 11:29 He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
箴言 11:29 擾害己家的、必承受清風．愚昧人必作慧心人的僕人。

Proverbs 11:30 The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
箴言 11:30 義人所結的果子、就是生命樹．有智慧的必能得人。

Proverbs 11:31 Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
箴言 11:31 看哪、義人在世尚且受報、何况惡人和罪人呢。

Proverbs 12:1 Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
箴言 12:1 喜愛管教的、就是喜愛知識．恨惡責備的、卻是畜類。

Proverbs 12:2 A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
箴言 12:2 善人必蒙耶和華的恩惠．設詭計的人、耶和華必定他的罪。

Proverbs 12:3 A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
箴言 12:3 人靠惡行不能堅立．義人的根必不動搖。

Proverbs 12:4 A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
箴言 12:4 才德的婦人、是丈夫的冠冕．貽羞的婦人、如同朽爛在他丈夫的骨中。

Proverbs 12:5 The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
箴言 12:5 義人的思念是公平．惡人的計謀是詭詐。

Proverbs 12:6 The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
箴言 12:6 惡人的言論、是埋伏流人的血．正直人的口、必拯救人。

Proverbs 12:7 The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
箴言 12:7 惡人傾覆、歸於無有．義人的家、必站得住。

Proverbs 12:8 A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
箴言 12:8 人必按自己的智慧被稱讚．心中乖謬的、必被藐視。

Proverbs 12:9 He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
箴言 12:9 被人輕賤、卻有僕人、強如自尊、缺少食物。

Proverbs 12:10 A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
箴言 12:10 義人顧惜他牲畜的命．惡人的憐憫、也是殘忍。

Proverbs 12:11 He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
箴言 12:11 耕種自己田地的、必得飽食．追隨虛浮的、卻是無知。

Proverbs 12:12 The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
箴言 12:12 惡人想得壞人的網羅．義人的根、得以結實。

Proverbs 12:13 The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
箴言 12:13 惡人嘴中的過錯、是自己的網羅．但義人必脫離患難。

Proverbs 12:14 A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
箴言 12:14 人因口所結的果子、必飽得美福．人手所作的、必爲自己的報應。

Proverbs 12:15 The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
箴言 12:15 愚妄人所行的、在自己眼中看爲正直．惟智慧人、肯聽人的勸教。

Proverbs 12:16 A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
箴言 12:16 愚妄人的惱怒、立時顯露．通達人能忍辱藏羞。

Proverbs 12:17 He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
箴言 12:17 說出眞話的、顯明公義．作假見證的、顯出詭詐。

Proverbs 12:18 There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
箴言 12:18 說話浮躁的、如刀刺人．智慧人的舌頭、卻爲醫人的良藥。

Proverbs 12:19 The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
箴言 12:19 口吐眞言、永遠堅立．舌說謊話、只存片時。

Proverbs 12:20 Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellers of peace is joy.
箴言 12:20 圖謀惡事的、心存詭詐．勸人和睦的、便得喜樂。

Proverbs 12:21 There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
箴言 12:21 義人不遭災害．惡人滿受禍患。

Proverbs 12:22 Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
箴言 12:22 說謊言的嘴、爲耶和華所憎惡．行事誠實的、爲他所喜悅。

Proverbs 12:23 A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
箴言 12:23 通達人隱藏知識．愚昧人的心、彰顯愚昧。

Proverbs 12:24 The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
箴言 12:24 殷勤人的手必掌權．懶惰的人必服苦。

Proverbs 12:25 Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
箴言 12:25 人心憂慮、屈而不伸．一句良言、使心歡樂。

Proverbs 12:26 The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
箴言 12:26 義人引導他的鄰舍．惡人的道、叫人失迷。

Proverbs 12:27 The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
箴言 12:27 懶惰的人、不烤打獵所得的．殷勤的人、卻得寶貴的財物。

Proverbs 12:28 In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
箴言 12:28 在公義的道上有生命．其路之中、並無死亡。

Proverbs 13:1 A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
箴言 13:1 智慧子聽父親的教訓．褻慢人不聽責備。

Proverbs 13:2 A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
箴言 13:2 人因口所結的果子、必享美福．奸詐人必遭強暴。

Proverbs 13:3 He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
箴言 13:3 謹守口的、得保生命．大張嘴的、必致敗亡。

Proverbs 13:4 The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
箴言 13:4 懶惰人羨慕、卻無所得．殷勤人必得豐裕。

Proverbs 13:5 A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
箴言 13:5 義人恨惡謊言．惡人有臭名、且致慚愧。

Proverbs 13:6 Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
箴言 13:6 行爲正直的、有公義保守．犯罪的被邪惡傾覆。

Proverbs 13:7 There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
箴言 13:7 假作富足的、卻一無所有．裝作窮乏的、卻廣有財物。

Proverbs 13:8 The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
箴言 13:8 人的貲財是他生命的贖價．窮乏人卻聽不見威嚇的話。

Proverbs 13:9 The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
箴言 13:9 義人的光明亮．惡人的燈要熄滅。

Proverbs 13:10 Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
箴言 13:10 驕傲只啟爭競．聽勸言的、卻有智慧。

Proverbs 13:11 Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
箴言 13:11 不勞而得之財、必然消耗．勤勞積蓄的、必見加增。

Proverbs 13:12 Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
箴言 13:12 所盼望的遲延未得、令人心憂．所願意的臨到、卻是生命樹。

Proverbs 13:13 Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
箴言 13:13 藐視訓言的、自取滅亡．敬畏誡命的、必得善報。

Proverbs 13:14 The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
箴言 13:14 智慧人的法則、是生命的泉源、可以使人離開死亡的網羅。

Proverbs 13:15 Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
箴言 13:15 美好的聰明、使人蒙恩．奸詐人的道路、崎嶇難行。

Proverbs 13:16 Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
箴言 13:16 凡通達人都憑知識行事．愚昧人張揚自己的愚昧。

Proverbs 13:17 A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
箴言 13:17 奸惡的使者、必陷在禍患裏．忠信的使臣、乃醫人的良藥。

Proverbs 13:18 Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
箴言 13:18 棄絕管教的、必致貧受辱．領受責備的、必得尊榮。

Proverbs 13:19 The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
箴言 13:19 所欲的成就、心覺甘甜．遠離惡事、爲愚昧人所憎惡。

Proverbs 13:20 He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
箴言 13:20 與智慧人同行的、必得智慧．和愚昧人作伴的、必受虧損。

Proverbs 13:21 Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
箴言 13:21 禍患追趕罪人．義人必得善報。

Proverbs 13:22 A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
箴言 13:22 善人給子孫遺留產業．罪人爲義人積存貲財。

Proverbs 13:23 Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
箴言 13:23 窮人耕種多得糧食、但因不義有消滅的。

Proverbs 13:24 He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
箴言 13:24 不忍用杖打兒子的、是恨惡他．疼愛兒子的、隨時管教。

Proverbs 13:25 The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
箴言 13:25 義人喫得飽足．惡人肚腹缺糧。

Proverbs 14:1 Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
箴言 14:1 智慧婦人、建立家室．愚妄婦人、親手拆毀。

Proverbs 14:2 He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
箴言 14:2 行動正直的、敬畏耶和華．行事乖僻的、卻藐視他。

Proverbs 14:3 In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
箴言 14:3 愚妄人口中驕傲、如杖責打己身．智慧人的嘴、必保守自己。

Proverbs 14:4 Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
箴言 14:4 家裏無牛、槽頭乾淨．土產加多、乃憑牛力。

Proverbs 14:5 A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
箴言 14:5 誠實見證人、不說謊話．假見證人、吐出謊言。

Proverbs 14:6 A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
箴言 14:6 褻慢人尋智慧、卻尋不着．聰明人易得知識。

Proverbs 14:7 Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
箴言 14:7 到愚昧人面前、不見他嘴中有知識。

Proverbs 14:8 The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
箴言 14:8 通達人的智慧、在乎明白己道．愚昧人的愚妄、乃是詭詐．

Proverbs 14:9 Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
箴言 14:9 愚妄人犯罪、以爲戲耍．正直人互相喜悅。

Proverbs 14:10 The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
箴言 14:10 心中的苦楚、自己知道．心裏的喜樂、外人無干。

Proverbs 14:11 The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
箴言 14:11 奸惡人的房屋必傾倒．正直人的帳棚必興盛。

Proverbs 14:12 There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
箴言 14:12 有一條路人以爲正．至終成爲死亡之路。

Proverbs 14:13 Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
箴言 14:13 人在喜笑中、心也憂愁．快樂至極、就生愁苦。

Proverbs 14:14 The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
箴言 14:14 心中背道的、必滿得自己的結果．善人必從自己的行爲、得以知足。

Proverbs 14:15 The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
箴言 14:15 愚蒙人是話都信．通達人步步謹愼。

Proverbs 14:16 A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
箴言 14:16 智慧人懼怕、就遠離惡事．愚妄人卻狂傲自恃。

Proverbs 14:17 He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
箴言 14:17 輕易發怒的、行事愚妄．設立詭計的、被人恨惡。

Proverbs 14:18 The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
箴言 14:18 愚蒙人得愚昧爲產業．通達人得知識爲冠冕。

Proverbs 14:19 The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
箴言 14:19 壞人俯伏在善人面前．惡人俯伏在義人門口。

Proverbs 14:20 The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
箴言 14:20 貧窮人連鄰舍也恨他．富足人朋友最多。

Proverbs 14:21 He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
箴言 14:21 藐視鄰舍的、這人有罪．憐憫貧窮的、這人有福。

Proverbs 14:22 Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
箴言 14:22 謀惡的豈非走入迷途麼．謀善的必得慈愛和誠實。

Proverbs 14:23 In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
箴言 14:23 諸般勤勞、都有益處．嘴上多言、乃致窮乏。

Proverbs 14:24 The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
箴言 14:24 智慧人的財、爲自己的冠冕．愚妄人的愚昧、終是愚昧。

Proverbs 14:25 A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
箴言 14:25 作眞見證的、救人性命．吐出謊言的、施行詭詐。

Proverbs 14:26 In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
箴言 14:26 敬畏耶和華的、大有倚靠．他的兒女、也有避難所。

Proverbs 14:27 The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
箴言 14:27 敬畏耶和華、就是生命的泉源、可以使人離開死亡的網羅。

Proverbs 14:28 In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
箴言 14:28 帝王榮耀在乎民多．君王衰敗在乎民少。

Proverbs 14:29 He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
箴言 14:29 不輕易發怒的、大有聰明．性情暴躁的、大顯愚妄。

Proverbs 14:30 A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
箴言 14:30 心中安靜、是肉體的生命．嫉妒是骨中的朽爛。

Proverbs 14:31 He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
箴言 14:31 欺壓貧寒的、是辱沒造他的主．憐憫窮乏的、乃是尊敬主。

Proverbs 14:32 The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
箴言 14:32 惡人在所行的惡上、必被推倒．義人臨死、有所投靠。

Proverbs 14:33 Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
箴言 14:33 智慧存在聰明人心中．愚昧人心裏所存的、顯而易見。

Proverbs 14:34 Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
箴言 14:34 公義使邦國高舉．罪惡是人民的羞辱。

Proverbs 14:35 The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
箴言 14:35 智慧的臣子、蒙王恩惠．貽羞的僕人、遭其震怒。

Proverbs 15:1 A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
箴言 15:1 回答柔和、使怒消退．言語暴戾、觸動怒氣。

Proverbs 15:2 The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
箴言 15:2 智慧人的舌、善發知識．愚昧人的口、吐出愚昧。

Proverbs 15:3 The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
箴言 15:3 耶和華的眼目、無處不在．惡人善人、他都鑒察。

Proverbs 15:4 A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
箴言 15:4 溫良的舌、是生命樹．乖謬的嘴、使人心碎。

Proverbs 15:5 A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
箴言 15:5 愚妄人藐視父親的管教．領受責備的、得着見識。

Proverbs 15:6 In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
箴言 15:6 義人家中、多有財寶．惡人得利、反受擾害。

Proverbs 15:7 The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
箴言 15:7 智慧人的嘴、播揚知識．愚昧人的心、並不如此。

Proverbs 15:8 The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
箴言 15:8 惡人獻祭、爲耶和華所憎惡．正直人祈禱、爲他所喜悅。

Proverbs 15:9 The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
箴言 15:9 惡人的道路、爲耶和華所憎惡．追求公義的、爲他所喜愛。

Proverbs 15:10 Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
箴言 15:10 捨棄正路的、必受嚴刑．恨惡責備的、必致死亡。

Proverbs 15:11 Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
箴言 15:11 陰間和滅亡、尚在耶和華眼前、何况世人的心呢。

Proverbs 15:12 A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
箴言 15:12 褻慢人不愛受責備．他也不就近智慧人。

Proverbs 15:13 A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
箴言 15:13 心中喜樂、面帶笑容．心裏憂愁、靈被損傷。

Proverbs 15:14 The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
箴言 15:14 聰明人心求知識．愚昧人口喫愚昧。

Proverbs 15:15 All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
箴言 15:15 困苦人的日子、都是愁苦．心中歡暢的、常享豐筵。

Proverbs 15:16 Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
箴言 15:16 少有財寶、敬畏耶和華、強如多有財寶、煩亂不安。

Proverbs 15:17 Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
箴言 15:17 喫素菜、彼此相愛、強如喫肥牛、彼此相恨。

Proverbs 15:18 A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
箴言 15:18 暴怒的人、挑啟爭端．忍怒的人、止息分爭。

Proverbs 15:19 The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
箴言 15:19 懶惰人的道、像荊棘的籬笆．正直人的路、是平坦的大道。

Proverbs 15:20 A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
箴言 15:20 智慧子使父親喜樂．愚昧人藐視母親。

Proverbs 15:21 Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
箴言 15:21 無知的人、以愚妄爲樂．聰明的人、按正直而行。

Proverbs 15:22 Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellers they are established.
箴言 15:22 不先商議、所謀無效．謀士衆多、所謀乃成。

Proverbs 15:23 A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
箴言 15:23 口善應對、自覺喜樂．話合其時、何等美好。

Proverbs 15:24 The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
箴言 15:24 智慧人從生命的道上升、使他遠離在下的陰間。

Proverbs 15:25 The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
箴言 15:25 耶和華必拆毀驕傲人的家．卻要立定寡婦的地界。

Proverbs 15:26 The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
箴言 15:26 惡謀爲耶和華所憎惡．良言乃爲純淨。

Proverbs 15:27 He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
箴言 15:27 貪戀財利的、擾害己家．恨惡賄賂的、必得存活。

Proverbs 15:28 The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
箴言 15:28 義人的心、思量如何回答．惡人的口、吐出惡言。

Proverbs 15:29 The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
箴言 15:29 耶和華遠離惡人．卻聽義人的禱告。

Proverbs 15:30 The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
箴言 15:30 眼有光使心喜樂．好信息使骨滋潤。

Proverbs 15:31 The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
箴言 15:31 聽從生命責備的、必常在智慧人中。

Proverbs 15:32 He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
箴言 15:32 棄絕管教的、輕看自己的生命．聽從責備的、卻得智慧。

Proverbs 15:33 The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
箴言 15:33 敬畏耶和華、是智慧的訓誨．尊榮以前、必有謙卑。

Proverbs 16:1 The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
箴言 16:1 心中的謀算在乎人．舌頭的應對、由於耶和華。

Proverbs 16:2 All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
箴言 16:2 人一切所行的、在自己眼中看爲清潔．惟有耶和華衡量人心。

Proverbs 16:3 Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
箴言 16:3 你所作的、要交託耶和華、你所謀的、就必成立。

Proverbs 16:4 The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
箴言 16:4 耶和華所造的、各適其用．就是惡人、也爲禍患的日子所造。

Proverbs 16:5 Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
箴言 16:5 凡心裏驕傲的、爲耶和華所憎惡．雖然連手、他必不免受罰。

Proverbs 16:6 By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
箴言 16:6 因憐憫誠實、罪孽得贖．敬畏耶和華的、遠離惡事。

Proverbs 16:7 When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
箴言 16:7 人所行的若蒙耶和華喜悅、耶和華也使他的仇敵與他和好。

Proverbs 16:8 Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
箴言 16:8 多有財利、行事不義、不如少有財利、行事公義。

Proverbs 16:9 A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
箴言 16:9 人心籌算自己的道路．惟耶和華指引他的脚步。

Proverbs 16:10 A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
箴言 16:10 王的嘴中有神語．審判之時、他的口、必不差錯。

Proverbs 16:11 A just weight and balance are the LORD's: all the weights of the bag are his work.
箴言 16:11 公道的天平和秤、都屬耶和華．囊中一切法碼、都爲他所定。

Proverbs 16:12 It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
箴言 16:12 作惡爲王所憎惡．因國位是靠公義堅立。

Proverbs 16:13 Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
箴言 16:13 公義的嘴、爲王所喜悅．說正直話的、爲王所喜愛。

Proverbs 16:14 The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
箴言 16:14 王的震怒、如殺人的使者．但智慧人能止息王怒。

Proverbs 16:15 In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
箴言 16:15 王的臉光、使人有生命．王的恩典、好像春雲時雨。

Proverbs 16:16 How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
箴言 16:16 得智慧勝似得金子．選聰明強如選銀子。

Proverbs 16:17 The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
箴言 16:17 正直人的道、是遠離惡事．謹守己路的、是保全性命。

Proverbs 16:18 Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
箴言 16:18 驕傲在敗壞以先．狂心在跌倒之前。

Proverbs 16:19 Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
箴言 16:19 心裏謙卑與窮乏人來往、強如將擄物與驕傲人同分。

Proverbs 16:20 He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
箴言 16:20 謹守訓言的、必得好處．倚靠耶和華的、便爲有福。

Proverbs 16:21 The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
箴言 16:21 心中有智慧、必稱爲通達人．嘴中的甜言、加增人的學問。

Proverbs 16:22 Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
箴言 16:22 人有智慧就有生命的泉源．愚昧人必被愚昧懲治。

Proverbs 16:23 The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
箴言 16:23 智慧人的心、教訓他的口、又使他的嘴、增長學問。

Proverbs 16:24 Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
箴言 16:24 良言如同蜂房、使心覺甘甜、使骨得醫治。

Proverbs 16:25 There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
箴言 16:25 有一條路、人以爲正、至終成爲死亡之路。

Proverbs 16:26 He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
箴言 16:26 勞力人的胃口、使他勞力、因爲他的口腹催逼他。

Proverbs 16:27 An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
箴言 16:27 匪徒圖謀奸惡、嘴上彷彿有燒焦的火。

Proverbs 16:28 A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
箴言 16:28 乖僻人播散分爭．傳舌的離間密友。

Proverbs 16:29 A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
箴言 16:29 強暴人誘惑鄰舍、領他走不善之道。

Proverbs 16:30 He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
箴言 16:30 眼目緊合的、圖謀乖僻、嘴唇緊閉的、成就邪惡。

Proverbs 16:31 The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
箴言 16:31 白髮是榮耀的冠冕．在公義的道上、必能得着。

Proverbs 16:32 He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
箴言 16:32 不輕易發怒的、勝過勇士．治服己心的、強如取城。

Proverbs 16:33 The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
箴言 16:33 籤放在懷裏．定事由耶和華。

Proverbs 17:1 Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
箴言 17:1 設筵滿屋、大家相爭、不如有塊乾餅、大家相安。

Proverbs 17:2 A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
箴言 17:2 僕人辦事聰明、必管轄貽羞之子、又在衆子中、同分產業。

Proverbs 17:3 The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
箴言 17:3 鼎爲煉銀、爐爲煉金．惟有耶和華熬煉人心。

Proverbs 17:4 A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
箴言 17:4 行惡的留心聽奸詐之言．說謊的側耳聽邪惡之語。

Proverbs 17:5 Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
箴言 17:5 戲笑窮人的、是辱沒造他的主．幸災樂禍的、必不免受罰。

Proverbs 17:6 Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
箴言 17:6 子孫爲老人的冠冕．父親是兒女的榮耀。

Proverbs 17:7 Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
箴言 17:7 愚頑人說美言本不相宜、何况君王說謊話呢。

Proverbs 17:8 A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
箴言 17:8 賄賂在餽送的人眼中、看爲寶玉、隨處運動、都得順利。

Proverbs 17:9 He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
箴言 17:9 遮掩人過的、尋求人愛．屢次挑錯的、離間密友。

Proverbs 17:10 A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
箴言 17:10 一句責備話、深入聰明人的心、強如責打愚昧人一百下。

Proverbs 17:11 An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
箴言 17:11 惡人只尋背叛、所以必有嚴厲的使者、奉差攻擊他。

Proverbs 17:12 Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
箴言 17:12 寧可遇見丟崽子的母熊、不可遇見正行愚妄的愚昧人。

Proverbs 17:13 Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
箴言 17:13 以惡報善的、禍患必不離他的家。

Proverbs 17:14 The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
箴言 17:14 分爭的起頭、如水放開．所以在爭鬧之先、必當止息爭競。

Proverbs 17:15 He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.
箴言 17:15 定惡人爲義的、定義人爲惡的、這都爲耶和華所憎惡。

Proverbs 17:16 Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
箴言 17:16 愚昧人旣無聰明、爲何手拿價銀買智慧呢。

Proverbs 17:17 A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
箴言 17:17 朋友乃時常親愛．弟兄爲患難而生。

Proverbs 17:18 A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
箴言 17:18 在鄰舍面前擊掌作保、乃是無知的人。

Proverbs 17:19 He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
箴言 17:19 喜愛爭競的、是喜愛過犯．高立家門的、乃自取敗壞。

Proverbs 17:20 He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
箴言 17:20 心存邪僻的、尋不着好處．舌弄是非的、陷在禍患中。

Proverbs 17:21 He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
箴言 17:21 生愚昧子的、必自愁苦．愚頑人的父、毫無喜樂。

Proverbs 17:22 A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
箴言 17:22 喜樂的心、乃是良藥．憂傷的靈、使骨枯乾。

Proverbs 17:23 A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
箴言 17:23 惡人暗中受賄賂、爲要顚倒判斷。

Proverbs 17:24 Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
箴言 17:24 明哲人眼前有智慧．愚昧人眼望地極。

Proverbs 17:25 A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
箴言 17:25 愚昧子使父親愁煩、使母親憂苦。

Proverbs 17:26 Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
箴言 17:26 刑罰義人爲不善．責打君子爲不義。

Proverbs 17:27 He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
箴言 17:27 寡少言語的有知識．性情溫良的有聰明。

Proverbs 17:28 Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
箴言 17:28 愚昧人若靜默不言、也可算爲智慧．閉口不說、也可算爲聰明。

Proverbs 18:1 Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
箴言 18:1 與衆寡合的、獨自尋求心願、並惱恨一切眞智慧。

Proverbs 18:2 A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
箴言 18:2 愚昧人不喜愛明哲、只喜愛顯露心意。

Proverbs 18:3 When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
箴言 18:3 惡人來、藐視隨來．羞恥到、辱罵同到。

Proverbs 18:4 The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
箴言 18:4 人口中的言語、如同深水．智慧的泉源、好像湧流的河水。

Proverbs 18:5 It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
箴言 18:5 瞻徇惡人的情面、偏斷義人的案件、都爲不善。

Proverbs 18:6 A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
箴言 18:6 愚昧人張嘴啟爭端、開口招鞭打。

Proverbs 18:7 A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
箴言 18:7 愚昧人的口、自取敗壞．他的嘴、是他生命的網羅。

Proverbs 18:8 The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
箴言 18:8 傳舌人的言語、如同美食、深入人的心腹。

Proverbs 18:9 He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
箴言 18:9 作工懈怠的、與浪費人爲弟兄。

Proverbs 18:10 The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
箴言 18:10 耶和華的名、是堅固臺．義人奔入、便得安穩。

Proverbs 18:11 The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
箴言 18:11 富足人的財物、是他的堅城、在他心想、猶如高牆。

Proverbs 18:12 Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
箴言 18:12 敗壞之先、人心驕傲．尊榮以前、必有謙卑。

Proverbs 18:13 He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
箴言 18:13 未曾聽完先回答的、便是他的愚昧、和羞辱。

Proverbs 18:14 The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
箴言 18:14 人有疾病、心能忍耐．心靈憂傷、誰能承當呢。

Proverbs 18:15 The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
箴言 18:15 聰明人的心得知識．智慧人的耳求知識。

Proverbs 18:16 A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
箴言 18:16 人的禮物、爲他開路、引他到高位的人面前。

Proverbs 18:17 He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
箴言 18:17 先訴情由的、似乎有理．但鄰舍來到、就察出實情。

Proverbs 18:18 The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
箴言 18:18 掣籤能止息爭競、也能解散強勝的人。

Proverbs 18:19 A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
箴言 18:19 弟兄結怨、勸他和好、比取堅固城還難．這樣的爭競、如同堅寨的門閂。

Proverbs 18:20 A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
箴言 18:20 人口中所結的果子、必充滿肚腹．他嘴所出的、必使他飽足。

Proverbs 18:21 Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
箴言 18:21 生死在舌頭的權下、喜愛他的、必喫他所結的果子。

Proverbs 18:22 Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
箴言 18:22 得着賢妻的、是得着好處、也是蒙了耶和華的恩惠。

Proverbs 18:23 The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
箴言 18:23 貧窮人說哀求的話．富足人用威嚇的話回答。

Proverbs 18:24 A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
箴言 18:24 濫交朋友的、自取敗壞．但有一朋友、比弟兄更親密。

Proverbs 19:1 Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
箴言 19:1 行爲純正的貧窮人、勝過乖謬愚妄的富足人。

Proverbs 19:2 Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
箴言 19:2 心無知識的、乃爲不善．脚步急快的、難免犯罪。

Proverbs 19:3 The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
箴言 19:3 人的愚昧、傾敗他的道．他的心也抱怨耶和華。

Proverbs 19:4 Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
箴言 19:4 財物使朋友增多．但窮人朋友遠離。

Proverbs 19:5 A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
箴言 19:5 作假見證的、必不免受罰．吐出謊言的、終不能逃脫。

Proverbs 19:6 Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
箴言 19:6 好施散的、有多人求他的恩情．愛送禮的、人都爲他的朋友。

Proverbs 19:7 All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
箴言 19:7 貧窮人弟兄都恨他．何况他的朋友、更遠離他．他用言語追隨、他們卻走了。

Proverbs 19:8 He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
箴言 19:8 得着智慧的、愛惜生命、保守聰明的、必得好處。

Proverbs 19:9 A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
箴言 19:9 作假見證的、不免受罰．吐出謊言的、也必滅亡。

Proverbs 19:10 Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
箴言 19:10 愚昧人宴樂度日、是不合宜的．何况僕人管轄王子呢。

Proverbs 19:11 The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
箴言 19:11 人有見識、就不輕易發怒．寬恕人的過失、便是自己的榮耀。

Proverbs 19:12 The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
箴言 19:12 王的忿怒、好像獅子吼叫．他的恩典、卻如草上的甘露。

Proverbs 19:13 A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
箴言 19:13 愚昧的兒子、是父親的禍患．妻子的爭吵、如雨連連滴漏。

Proverbs 19:14 House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
箴言 19:14 房屋錢財、是祖宗所遺留的．惟有賢慧的妻、是耶和華所賜的。

Proverbs 19:15 Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
箴言 19:15 懶惰使人沉睡．懈怠的人、必受飢餓。

Proverbs 19:16 He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
箴言 19:16 謹守誡命的、保全生命．輕忽己路的、必致死亡。

Proverbs 19:17 He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
箴言 19:17 憐憫貧窮的、就是借給耶和華．他的善行、耶和華必償還。

Proverbs 19:18 Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
箴言 19:18 趁有指望、管教你的兒子．你的心不可任他死亡。

Proverbs 19:19 A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
箴言 19:19 暴怒的人、必受刑罰．你若救他、必須再救。

Proverbs 19:20 Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in the latter end.
箴言 19:20 你要聽勸教、受訓誨、使你終久有智慧。

Proverbs 19:21 There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
箴言 19:21 人心多有計謀．惟有耶和華的籌算、纔能立定。

Proverbs 19:22 The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
箴言 19:22 施行仁慈的、令人愛慕．窮人強如說謊言的。

Proverbs 19:23 The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
箴言 19:23 敬畏耶和華的、得着生命．他必恆久知足、不遭禍患。

Proverbs 19:24 A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
箴言 19:24 懶惰人放手在盤子裏．就是向口撤回、他也不肯。

Proverbs 19:25 Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
箴言 19:25 鞭打褻慢人、愚蒙人必長見識．責備明哲人、他就明白知識。

Proverbs 19:26 He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
箴言 19:26 虐待父親、攆出母親的、是貽羞致辱之子。

Proverbs 19:27 Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
箴言 19:27 我兒、不可聽了教訓、而又偏離知識的言語。

Proverbs 19:28 An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
箴言 19:28 匪徒作見證戲笑公平．惡人的口吞下罪孽。

Proverbs 19:29 Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
箴言 19:29 刑罰是爲褻慢人豫備的．鞭打是爲愚昧人的背豫備的。

Proverbs 20:1 Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
箴言 20:1 酒能使人褻慢、濃酒使人喧嚷．凡因酒錯誤的、就無智慧。

Proverbs 20:2 The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
箴言 20:2 王的威嚇如同獅子吼叫．惹動他怒的、是自害己命。

Proverbs 20:3 It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
箴言 20:3 遠離分爭是人的尊榮．愚妄人都愛爭鬧。

Proverbs 20:4 The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
箴言 20:4 懶惰人因冬寒不肯耕種．到收割的時候、他必討飯、而無所得。

Proverbs 20:5 Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
箴言 20:5 人心懷藏謀畧、好像深水．惟明哲人、纔能汲引出來。

Proverbs 20:6 Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
箴言 20:6 人多述說自己的仁慈．但忠信人誰能遇着呢。

Proverbs 20:7 The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
箴言 20:7 行爲純正的義人、他的子孫、是有福的。

Proverbs 20:8 A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
箴言 20:8 王坐在審判的位上、以眼目驅散諸惡。

Proverbs 20:9 Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
箴言 20:9 誰能說、我潔淨了我的心．我脫淨了我的罪。

Proverbs 20:10 Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.
箴言 20:10 兩樣的法碼、兩樣的升斗、都爲耶和華所憎惡。

Proverbs 20:11 Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
箴言 20:11 孩童的動作、是清潔、是正直、都顯明他的本性。

Proverbs 20:12 The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
箴言 20:12 能聽的耳、能看的眼、都是耶和華所造的。

Proverbs 20:13 Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
箴言 20:13 不要貪睡、免致貧窮．眼要睜開、你就喫飽。

Proverbs 20:14 It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
箴言 20:14 買物的說、不好、不好．及至買去、他便自誇。

Proverbs 20:15 There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
箴言 20:15 有金子和許多珍珠．惟有知識的嘴、乃爲貴重的珍寶。

Proverbs 20:16 Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
箴言 20:16 誰爲生人作保、就拿誰的衣服．誰爲外人作保、誰就要承當。

Proverbs 20:17 Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
箴言 20:17 以虛謊而得的食物、人覺甘甜．但後來他的口、必充滿塵沙。

Proverbs 20:18 Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
箴言 20:18 計謀都憑籌算立定．打仗要憑智謀。

Proverbs 20:19 He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
箴言 20:19 往來傳舌的、洩漏密事．大張嘴的不可與他結交。

Proverbs 20:20 Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
箴言 20:20 咒罵父母的、他的燈必滅、變爲漆黑的黑暗。

Proverbs 20:21 An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
箴言 20:21 起初速得的產業、終久卻不爲福。

Proverbs 20:22 Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
箴言 20:22 你不要說、我要以惡報惡．要等候耶和華、他必拯救你。

Proverbs 20:23 Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance is not good.
箴言 20:23 兩樣的法碼、爲耶和華所憎惡．詭詐的天平、也爲不善。

Proverbs 20:24 Man's goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
箴言 20:24 人的脚步爲耶和華所定．人豈能明白自己的路呢。

Proverbs 20:25 It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
箴言 20:25 人冒失說、這是聖物、許願之後纔查問、就是自陷網羅。

Proverbs 20:26 A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
箴言 20:26 智慧的王、簸散惡人、用碌碡輥軋他們。

Proverbs 20:27 The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
箴言 20:27 人的靈是耶和華的燈、鑒察人的心腹。

Proverbs 20:28 Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
箴言 20:28 王因仁慈和誠實、得以保全他的國位、也因仁慈立穩。

Proverbs 20:29 The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
箴言 20:29 強壯乃少年人的榮耀．白髮爲老年人的尊榮。

Proverbs 20:30 The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
箴言 20:30 鞭傷除淨人的罪惡．責打能入人的心腹。

Proverbs 21:1 The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
箴言 21:1 王的心在耶和華手中、好像隴溝的水、隨意流轉。

Proverbs 21:2 Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
箴言 21:2 人所行的、在自己眼中都看爲正．惟有耶和華衡量人心。

Proverbs 21:3 To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
箴言 21:3 行仁義公平、比獻祭更蒙耶和華悅納。

Proverbs 21:4 An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
箴言 21:4 惡人發達、眼高心傲、這乃是罪．

Proverbs 21:5 The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
箴言 21:5 殷勤籌畫的、足致豐裕．行事急躁的、都必缺乏。

Proverbs 21:6 The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
箴言 21:6 用詭詐之舌求財的、就是自己取死．所得之財、乃是吹來吹去的浮雲。

Proverbs 21:7 The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
箴言 21:7 惡人的強暴必將自己掃除．因他們不肯按公平行事。

Proverbs 21:8 The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
箴言 21:8 負罪之人的路甚是彎曲．至於清潔的人、他所行的乃是正直。

Proverbs 21:9 It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
箴言 21:9 寧可住在房頂的角上、不在寬闊的房屋、與爭吵的婦人同住。

Proverbs 21:10 The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
箴言 21:10 惡人的心、樂人受禍．他眼並不憐恤鄰舍。

Proverbs 21:11 When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
箴言 21:11 褻慢的人受刑罰、愚蒙的人就得智慧．智慧人受訓誨、便得知識。

Proverbs 21:12 The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
箴言 21:12 義人思想惡人的家、知道惡人傾倒、必至滅亡。

Proverbs 21:13 Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
箴言 21:13 塞耳不聽窮人哀求的、他將來呼籲也不蒙應允。

Proverbs 21:14 A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
箴言 21:14 暗中送的禮物、挽回怒氣．懷中搋的賄賂、止息暴怒。

Proverbs 21:15 It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
箴言 21:15 秉公行義、使義人喜樂、使作孽的人敗壞。

Proverbs 21:16 The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
箴言 21:16 迷離通達道路的、必住在陰魂的會中。

Proverbs 21:17 He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
箴言 21:17 愛宴樂的、必致窮乏．好酒愛膏油的、必不富足。

Proverbs 21:18 The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
箴言 21:18 惡人作了義人的贖價．奸詐人代替正直人。

Proverbs 21:19 It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
箴言 21:19 寧可住在曠野、不與爭吵使氣的婦人同住。

Proverbs 21:20 There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
箴言 21:20 智慧人家中積蓄寶物膏油．愚昧人隨得來隨吞下。

Proverbs 21:21 He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
箴言 21:21 追求公義仁慈的、就尋得生命、公義、和尊榮。

Proverbs 21:22 A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
箴言 21:22 智慧人爬上勇士的城牆、傾覆他所倚靠的堅壘。

Proverbs 21:23 Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
箴言 21:23 謹守口與舌的、就保守自己免受災難。

Proverbs 21:24 Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
箴言 21:24 心驕氣傲的人、名叫褻慢．他行事狂妄、都出於驕傲。

Proverbs 21:25 The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
箴言 21:25 懶惰人的心願、將他殺害、因爲他手不肯作工。

Proverbs 21:26 He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
箴言 21:26 有終日貪得無饜的．義人施捨而不吝惜。

Proverbs 21:27 The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
箴言 21:27 惡人的祭物是可憎的、何况他存惡意來獻呢。

Proverbs 21:28 A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
箴言 21:28 作假見證的必滅亡．惟有聽眞情而言的、其言長存。

Proverbs 21:29 A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
箴言 21:29 惡人臉無羞恥．正直人行事堅定。

Proverbs 21:30 There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
箴言 21:30 沒有人能以智慧、聰明、謀畧、敵擋耶和華。

Proverbs 21:31 The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
箴言 21:31 馬是爲打仗之日豫備的．得勝乃在乎耶和華。

Proverbs 22:1 A Good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
箴言 22:1 美名勝過大財．恩寵強如金銀。

Proverbs 22:2 The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.
箴言 22:2 富戶窮人、在世相遇、都爲耶和華所造。

Proverbs 22:3 A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
箴言 22:3 通達人見禍藏躱．愚蒙人前往受害。

Proverbs 22:4 By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, honour, and life.
箴言 22:4 敬畏耶和華心存謙卑、就得富有、尊榮、生命爲賞賜。

Proverbs 22:5 Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
箴言 22:5 乖僻人的路上、有荊棘和網羅．保守自己生命的、必要遠離。

Proverbs 22:6 Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
箴言 22:6 教養孩童、使他走當行的道、就是到老他也不偏離。

Proverbs 22:7 The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
箴言 22:7 富戶管轄窮人．欠債的是債主的僕人。

Proverbs 22:8 He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
箴言 22:8 撒罪孽的、必收災禍．他逞怒的杖、也必廢掉。

Proverbs 22:9 He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
箴言 22:9 眼目慈善的、就必蒙福．因他將食物分給窮人。

Proverbs 22:10 Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
箴言 22:10 趕出褻慢人、爭端就消除、分爭和羞辱、也必止息。

Proverbs 22:11 He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
箴言 22:11 喜愛清心的人、因他嘴上的恩言、王必與他爲友。

Proverbs 22:12 The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
箴言 22:12 耶和華的眼目、眷顧聰明人．卻傾敗奸詐人的言語。

Proverbs 22:13 The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
箴言 22:13 懶惰人說、外頭有獅子、我在街上、就必被殺。

Proverbs 22:14 The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
箴言 22:14 淫婦的口爲深坑、耶和華所憎惡的、必陷在其中。

Proverbs 22:15 Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
箴言 22:15 愚蒙迷住孩童的心、用管教的杖可以遠遠趕除。

Proverbs 22:16 He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
箴言 22:16 欺壓貧窮爲要利己的、並送禮與富戶的、都必缺乏。

Proverbs 22:17 Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
箴言 22:17 你須側耳聽受智慧人的言語、留心領會我的知識．

Proverbs 22:18 For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
箴言 22:18 你若心中存記、嘴上咬定、這便爲美。

Proverbs 22:19 That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
箴言 22:19 我今日以此特特指教你、爲要使你倚靠耶和華。

Proverbs 22:20 Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
箴言 22:20 謀畧和知識的美事、我豈沒有寫給你麼．

Proverbs 22:21 That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
箴言 22:21 要使你知道眞言的實理、你好將眞言回覆那打發你來的人。

Proverbs 22:22 Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
箴言 22:22 貧窮人、你不可因他貧窮就搶奪他的物．也不可在城門口欺壓困苦人．

Proverbs 22:23 For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
箴言 22:23 因耶和華必爲他辨屈．搶奪他的、耶和華必奪取那人的命。

Proverbs 22:24 Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
箴言 22:24 好生氣的人、不可與他結交．暴怒的人、不可與他來往．

Proverbs 22:25 Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
箴言 22:25 恐怕你效法他的行爲、自己就陷在網羅裏。

Proverbs 22:26 Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
箴言 22:26 不要與人擊掌、不要爲欠債的作保。

Proverbs 22:27 If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
箴言 22:27 你若沒有甚麼償還、何必使人奪去你睡臥的牀呢。

Proverbs 22:28 Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
箴言 22:28 你先祖所立的地界、你不可挪移。

Proverbs 22:29 Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
箴言 22:29 你看見辦事殷勤的人麼、他必站在君王面前．必不站在下賤人面前。

Proverbs 23:1 When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
箴言 23:1 你若與官長坐席、要留意在你面前的是誰。

Proverbs 23:2 And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
箴言 23:2 你若是貪食的、就當拿刀放在喉嚨上。

Proverbs 23:3 Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
箴言 23:3 不可貪戀他的美食、因爲是哄人的食物。

Proverbs 23:4 Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
箴言 23:4 不要勞碌求富、休仗自己的聰明。

Proverbs 23:5 Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
箴言 23:5 你豈要定睛在虛無的錢財上麼．因錢財必長翅膀、如鷹向天飛去。

Proverbs 23:6 Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
箴言 23:6 不要喫惡眼人的飯、也不要貪他的美味．

Proverbs 23:7 For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
箴言 23:7 因爲他心怎樣思量、他爲人就是怎樣．他雖對你說、請喫、請喝、他的心卻與你相背。

Proverbs 23:8 The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
箴言 23:8 你所喫的那點食物、必吐出來．你所說的甘美言語、也必落空。

Proverbs 23:9 Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
箴言 23:9 你不要說話給愚昧人聽．因他必藐視你智慧的言語。

Proverbs 23:10 Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
箴言 23:10 不可挪移古時的地界．也不可侵入孤兒的田地。

Proverbs 23:11 For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
箴言 23:11 因他們的救贖主、大有能力．他必向你爲他們辨屈。

Proverbs 23:12 Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
箴言 23:12 你要留心領受訓誨。側耳聽從知識的言語。

Proverbs 23:13 Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
箴言 23:13 不可不管教孩童、你用杖打他、他必不至於死。

Proverbs 23:14 Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
箴言 23:14 你要用杖打他、就可以救他的靈魂免下陰間。

Proverbs 23:15 My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
箴言 23:15 我兒、你心若存智慧、我的心也甚歡喜。

Proverbs 23:16 Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
箴言 23:16 你的嘴若說正直話、我的心腸也必快樂。

Proverbs 23:17 Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
箴言 23:17 你心中不要嫉妒罪人．只要終日敬畏耶和華。

Proverbs 23:18 For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
箴言 23:18 因爲至終必有善報．你的指望也不至斷絕。

Proverbs 23:19 Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
箴言 23:19 我兒、你當聽、當存智慧、好在正道上引導你的心。

Proverbs 23:20 Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
箴言 23:20 好飲酒的、好喫肉的、不要與他們來往。

Proverbs 23:21 For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
箴言 23:21 因爲好酒貪食的、必致貧窮．好睡覺的、必穿破爛衣服。

Proverbs 23:22 Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
箴言 23:22 你要聽從生你的父親．你母親老了、也不可藐視他。

Proverbs 23:23 Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
箴言 23:23 你當買眞理．就是智慧、訓誨、和聰明、也都不可賣。

Proverbs 23:24 The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
箴言 23:24 義人的父親、必大得快樂．人生智慧的兒子、必因他歡喜。

Proverbs 23:25 Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
箴言 23:25 你要使父母歡喜．使生你的快樂。

Proverbs 23:26 My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
箴言 23:26 我兒、要將你的心歸我．你的眼目、也要喜悅我的道路。

Proverbs 23:27 For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
箴言 23:27 妓女是深坑．外女是窄阱．

Proverbs 23:28 She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
箴言 23:28 他埋伏好像強盜、他使人中多有奸詐的。

Proverbs 23:29 Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
箴言 23:29 誰有禍患、誰有憂愁、誰有爭鬬、誰有哀歎、誰無故受傷、誰眼目紅赤、

Proverbs 23:30 They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
箴言 23:30 就是那流連飲酒、常去尋找調和酒的人。

Proverbs 23:32 At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
箴言 23:32 酒發紅、在杯中閃爍、你不可觀看、雖然下咽舒暢、終久是咬你如蛇、刺你如毒蛇。

Proverbs 23:33 Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
箴言 23:33 你眼必看見異怪的事。你心必發出乖謬的話．

Proverbs 23:34 Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
箴言 23:34 你必像躺在海中、或像臥在桅杆上．

Proverbs 23:35 They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
箴言 23:35 你必說、人打我我卻未受傷、人鞭打我我竟不覺得、我幾時清醒、我仍去尋酒。

Proverbs 24:1 Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
箴言 24:1 你不要嫉妒惡人、也不要起意與他們相處．

Proverbs 24:2 For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
箴言 24:2 因爲他們的心、圖謀強暴．他們的口、談論奸惡。

Proverbs 24:3 Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
箴言 24:3 房屋因智慧建造、又因聰明立穩．

Proverbs 24:4 And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
箴言 24:4 其中因知識充滿各樣美好寶貴的財物。

Proverbs 24:5 A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
箴言 24:5 智慧人大有能力．有知識的人、力上加力。

Proverbs 24:6 For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellers there is safety.
箴言 24:6 你去打仗、要憑智謀．謀士衆多、人便得勝。

Proverbs 24:7 Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
箴言 24:7 智慧極高、非愚昧人所能及、所以在城門內、不敢開口。

Proverbs 24:8 He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
箴言 24:8 設計作惡的、必稱爲奸人。

Proverbs 24:9 The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
箴言 24:9 愚妄人的思念、乃是罪惡．褻慢者爲人所憎惡。

Proverbs 24:10 If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
箴言 24:10 你在患難之日若膽怯、你的力量就微小。

Proverbs 24:11 If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
箴言 24:11 人被拉到死地、你要解救．人將被殺、你須攔阻。

Proverbs 24:12 If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
箴言 24:12 你若說、這事我未曾知道．那衡量人心的、豈不明白麼．保守你命的豈不知道麼．他豈不按各人所行、的報應各人麼。

Proverbs 24:13 My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
箴言 24:13 我兒、你要喫蜜、因爲是好的．喫蜂房下滴的蜜、便覺甘甜。

Proverbs 24:14 So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
箴言 24:14 你心得了智慧、也必覺得如此．你若找着、至終必有善報．你的指望、也不至斷絕。

Proverbs 24:15 Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
箴言 24:15 你這惡人、不要埋伏攻擊義人的家．不要毀壞他安居之所。

Proverbs 24:16 For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
箴言 24:16 因爲義人雖七次跌倒、仍必興起．惡人卻被禍患傾倒。

Proverbs 24:17 Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
箴言 24:17 你仇敵跌倒、你不要歡喜．他傾倒、你心不要快樂。

Proverbs 24:18 Lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
箴言 24:18 恐怕耶和華看見就不喜悅、將怒氣從仇敵身上轉過來。

Proverbs 24:19 Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
箴言 24:19 不要爲作惡的心懷不平．也不要嫉妒惡人．

Proverbs 24:20 For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
箴言 24:20 因爲惡人終不得善報．惡人的燈、也必熄滅。

Proverbs 24:21 My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
箴言 24:21 我兒、你要敬畏耶和華與君王．不要與反覆無常的人結交．

Proverbs 24:22 For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
箴言 24:22 因爲他們的災難、必忽然而起．耶和華與君王所施行的毀滅、誰能知道呢。

Proverbs 24:23 These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
箴言 24:23 以下也是智慧人的箴言。審判時看人情面、是不好的。

Proverbs 24:24 He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
箴言 24:24 對惡人說、你是義人的、這人萬民必咒詛、列邦必憎惡。

Proverbs 24:25 But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
箴言 24:25 責備惡人的、必得喜悅．美好的福、也必臨到他。

Proverbs 24:26 Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
箴言 24:26 應對正直的、猶如與人親嘴。

Proverbs 24:27 Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
箴言 24:27 你要在外頭豫備工料、在田間辦理整齊、然後建造房屋。

Proverbs 24:28 Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
箴言 24:28 不可無故作見證、陷害鄰舍．也不可用嘴欺騙人。

Proverbs 24:29 Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
箴言 24:29 不可說、人怎樣待我、我也怎樣待他、我必照他所行的報復他。

Proverbs 24:30 I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
箴言 24:30 我經過懶惰人的田地、無知人的葡萄園．

Proverbs 24:31 And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
箴言 24:31 荊棘長滿了地皮、刺草遮蓋了田面、石牆也坍塌了．

Proverbs 24:32 Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
箴言 24:32 我看見就留心思想、我看着就領了訓誨。

Proverbs 24:33 Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
箴言 24:33 再睡片時、打盹片時、抱着手躺臥片時、

Proverbs 24:34 So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
箴言 24:34 你的貧窮、就必如強盜速來、你的缺乏、彷彿拿兵器的人來到。

Proverbs 25:1 These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
箴言 25:1 以下也是所羅門的箴言．是猶大王希西家的人所謄錄的。

Proverbs 25:2 It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
箴言 25:2 將事隱祕、乃 神的榮耀．將事察清、乃君王的榮耀。

Proverbs 25:3 The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
箴言 25:3 天之高、地之厚、君王之心也測不透。

Proverbs 25:4 Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
箴言 25:4 除去銀子的渣滓、就有銀子出來、銀匠能以作器皿。

Proverbs 25:5 Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
箴言 25:5 除去王面前的惡人、國位就靠公義堅立。

Proverbs 25:6 Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
箴言 25:6 不要在王面前妄自尊大．不要在大人的位上站立。

Proverbs 25:7 For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.
箴言 25:7 寧可有人說請你上來、強如在你覲見的王子面前、叫你退下。

Proverbs 25:8 Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
箴言 25:8 不要冒失出去與人爭競、免得至終被他羞辱、你就不知道怎樣行了。

Proverbs 25:9 Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
箴言 25:9 你與鄰舍爭訟、要與他一人辯論．不可洩漏人的密事．

Proverbs 25:10 Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.
箴言 25:10 恐怕聽見的人罵你、你的臭名就難以脫離。

Proverbs 25:11 A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
箴言 25:11 一句話說得合宜、就如金㰋果在銀網子裏。

Proverbs 25:12 As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
箴言 25:12 智慧人的勸戒、在順從的人耳中、好像金耳環、和精金的妝飾。

Proverbs 25:13 As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
箴言 25:13 忠信的使者、叫差他的人心裏舒暢、就如在收割時、有冰雪的涼氣。

Proverbs 25:14 Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
箴言 25:14 空誇贈送禮物的、好像無雨的風雲。

Proverbs 25:15 By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
箴言 25:15 恆常忍耐、可以勸動君王．柔和的舌頭、能折斷骨頭。

Proverbs 25:16 Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
箴言 25:16 你得了蜜麼、只可喫彀而已．恐怕你過飽就嘔吐出來。

Proverbs 25:17 Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour's house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
箴言 25:17 你的脚要少進鄰舍的家、恐怕他厭煩你、恨惡你。

Proverbs 25:18 A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
箴言 25:18 作假見證陷害鄰舍的、就是大槌、是利刀、是快箭。

Proverbs 25:19 Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
箴言 25:19 患難時倚靠不忠誠的人、好像破壞的牙、錯骨縫的脚。

Proverbs 25:20 As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
箴言 25:20 對傷心的人唱歌、就如冷天脫衣服、又如鹼上倒醋。

Proverbs 25:21 If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
箴言 25:21 你的仇敵、若餓了就給他飯喫．若渴了就給他水喝。

Proverbs 25:22 For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.
箴言 25:22 因爲你這樣行、就是把炭火堆在他的頭上．耶和華也必賞賜你。

Proverbs 25:23 The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
箴言 25:23 北風生雨、讒謗人的舌頭也生怒容。

Proverbs 25:24 It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
箴言 25:24 寧可住在房頂的角上、不在寬闊的房屋與爭吵的婦人同住。

Proverbs 25:25 As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
箴言 25:25 有好消息從遠方來、就如拿涼水給口渴的人喝。

Proverbs 25:26 A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
箴言 25:26 義人在惡人面前退縮、好像「逿」字「走」代「辵」旁渾之泉、弄濁之井。

Proverbs 25:27 It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
箴言 25:27 喫蜜過多是不好的．考究自己的榮耀、也是可厭的。

Proverbs 25:28 He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
箴言 25:28 人不制伏自己的心、好像毀壞的城邑沒有牆垣。

Proverbs 26:1 As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
箴言 26:1 夏天落雪、收割時下雨、都不相宜．愚昧人得尊榮、也是如此。

Proverbs 26:2 As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
箴言 26:2 麻雀往來、燕子翻飛、這樣、無故的咒詛、也必不臨到。

Proverbs 26:3 A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.
箴言 26:3 鞭子是爲打馬．轡頭是爲勒驢．刑杖是爲打愚昧人的背。

Proverbs 26:4 Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
箴言 26:4 不要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他、恐怕你與他一樣。

Proverbs 26:5 Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
箴言 26:5 要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他、免得他自以爲有智慧。

Proverbs 26:6 He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
箴言 26:6 藉愚昧人手寄信的、是砍斷自己的脚、自受損害。

Proverbs 26:7 The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
箴言 26:7 瘸子的脚、空存無用．箴言在愚昧人的口中也是如此。

Proverbs 26:8 As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.
箴言 26:8 將尊榮給愚昧人的、好像人把石子包在機弦裏。

Proverbs 26:9 As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
箴言 26:9 箴言在愚昧人的口中、好像荊棘刺入醉漢的手。

Proverbs 26:10 The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
箴言 26:10 雇愚昧人的、與雇過路人的、就像射傷衆人的弓箭手。

Proverbs 26:11 As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
箴言 26:11 愚昧人行愚妄事、行了又行、就如狗轉過來喫他所吐的。

Proverbs 26:12 Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
箴言 26:12 你見自以爲有智慧的人麼．愚昧人比他更有指望。

Proverbs 26:13 The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
箴言 26:13 懶惰人說、道上有猛獅、街上有壯獅。

Proverbs 26:14 As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.
箴言 26:14 門在樞紐轉動、懶惰人在牀上也是如此。

Proverbs 26:15 The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
箴言 26:15 懶惰人放手在盤子裏、就是向口撤回、也以爲勞乏。

Proverbs 26:16 The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
箴言 26:16 懶惰人看自己、比七個善於應對的人更有智慧。

Proverbs 26:17 He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
箴言 26:17 過路被事激動、管理不干己的爭競、好像人揪住狗耳。

Proverbs 26:19 So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
箴言 26:19 人欺凌鄰舍、卻說、我豈不是戲耍麼。他就像瘋狂的人拋擲火把、利箭、與殺人的兵器。

Proverbs 26:20 Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
箴言 26:20 火缺了柴、就必熄滅．無人傳舌、爭競便止息。

Proverbs 26:21 As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
箴言 26:21 好爭競的人煽惑爭端、就如餘火加炭、火上加柴一樣。

Proverbs 26:22 The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
箴言 26:22 傳舌人的言語、如同美食、深入人的心腹。

Proverbs 26:23 Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
箴言 26:23 火熱的嘴、奸惡的心、好像銀渣包的瓦器。

Proverbs 26:24 He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
箴言 26:24 怨恨人的用嘴粉飾、心裏卻藏着詭詐．

Proverbs 26:25 When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
箴言 26:25 他用甜言蜜語、你不可信他、因爲他心中有七樣可憎惡的．

Proverbs 26:26 Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
箴言 26:26 他雖用詭詐遮掩自己的怨恨、他的邪惡必在會中顯露。

Proverbs 26:27 Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
箴言 26:27 挖陷坑的、自己必掉在其中．輥石頭的、石頭必反輥在他身上。

Proverbs 26:28 A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
箴言 26:28 虛謊的舌、恨他所壓傷的人．諂媚的口、敗壞人的事。

Proverbs 27:1 Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
箴言 27:1 不要爲明日自誇、因爲一日要生何事、你尚且不能知道。

Proverbs 27:2 Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
箴言 27:2 要別人誇獎你、不可用口自誇．等外人稱讚你、不可用嘴自稱。

Proverbs 27:3 A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.
箴言 27:3 石頭重、沙土沉、愚妄人的惱怒、比這兩樣更重。

Proverbs 27:4 Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
箴言 27:4 忿怒爲殘忍、怒氣爲狂瀾、惟有嫉妒、誰能敵得住呢。

Proverbs 27:5 Open rebuke is better than secret love.
箴言 27:5 當面的責備、強如背地的愛情。

Proverbs 27:6 Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
箴言 27:6 朋友加的傷痕出於忠誠．仇敵連連親嘴、卻是多餘。

Proverbs 27:7 The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
箴言 27:7 人喫飽了、厭惡蜂房的蜜．人飢餓了、一切苦物都覺甘甜。

Proverbs 27:8 As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
箴言 27:8 人離本處飄流、好像雀鳥離窩遊飛。

Proverbs 27:9 Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
箴言 27:9 膏油與香料、使人心喜悅．朋友誠實的勸教、也是如此甘美。

Proverbs 27:10 Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
箴言 27:10 你的朋友、和父親的朋友、你都不可離棄．你遭難的日子、不要上弟兄的家去．相近的鄰舍、強如遠方的弟兄。

Proverbs 27:11 My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
箴言 27:11 我兒、你要作智慧人、好叫我的心歡喜、使我可以回答那譏誚我的人。

Proverbs 27:12 A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
箴言 27:12 通達人見禍藏躱．愚蒙人前往受害。

Proverbs 27:13 Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
箴言 27:13 誰爲生人作保、就拿誰的衣服．誰爲外女作保、誰就承當。

Proverbs 27:14 He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
箴言 27:14 清晨起來、大聲給朋友祝福的、就算是咒詛他。

Proverbs 27:15 A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
箴言 27:15 大雨之日連連滴漏、和爭吵的婦人一樣．

Proverbs 27:16 Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
箴言 27:16 想攔阻他的、便是攔阻風、也是右手抓油。

Proverbs 27:17 Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
箴言 27:17 鐵磨鐵、磨出刃來．朋友相感、也是如此。

Proverbs 27:18 Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
箴言 27:18 看守無花果樹的、必喫樹上的果子．敬奉主人的、必得尊榮。

Proverbs 27:19 As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
箴言 27:19 水中照臉、彼此相符．人與人、心也相對。

Proverbs 27:20 Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
箴言 27:20 陰間和滅亡、永不滿足．人的眼目、也是如此。
