Proverbs 27:21 As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
箴言 27:21 鼎爲煉銀、爐爲煉金、人的稱讚也試煉人。

Proverbs 27:22 Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
箴言 27:22 你雖用杵、將愚妄人與打碎的麥子一同搗在臼中、他的愚妄還是離不了他。

Proverbs 27:23 Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
箴言 27:23 你要詳細知道你羊羣的景况．留心料理你的牛羣。

Proverbs 27:24 For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?
箴言 27:24 因爲貲財不能永有．冠冕豈能存到萬代。

Proverbs 27:25 The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
箴言 27:25 乾草割去、嫩草發現、山上的菜蔬、也被收斂。

Proverbs 27:26 The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
箴言 27:26 羊羔之毛、是爲你作衣服．山羊是爲作田地的價值．

Proverbs 27:27 And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
箴言 27:27 並有母山羊奶彀你喫、也彀你的家眷喫、且彀養你的婢女。

Proverbs 28:1 The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
箴言 28:1 惡人雖無人追趕也逃跑、義人卻膽壯像獅子。

Proverbs 28:2 For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
箴言 28:2 邦國因有罪過、君王就多更換．因有聰明知識的人、國必長存。

Proverbs 28:3 A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
箴言 28:3 窮人欺壓貧民、好像暴雨沖沒糧食。

Proverbs 28:4 They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
箴言 28:4 違棄律法的、誇獎惡人．遵守律法的、卻與惡人相爭。

Proverbs 28:5 Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
箴言 28:5 壞人不明白公義．惟有尋求耶和華的無不明白。

Proverbs 28:6 Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
箴言 28:6 行爲純正的窮乏人、勝過行事乖僻的富足人。

Proverbs 28:7 Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
箴言 28:7 謹守律法的是智慧之子．與貪食人作伴的、卻羞辱其父。

Proverbs 28:8 He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
箴言 28:8 人以厚利加增財物、是給那憐憫窮人者積蓄的。

Proverbs 28:9 He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
箴言 28:9 轉耳不聽律法的、他的祈禱也爲可憎。

Proverbs 28:10 Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
箴言 28:10 誘惑正直人行惡道的、必掉在自己的坑裏．惟有完全人、必承受福分。

Proverbs 28:11 The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
箴言 28:11 富足人自以爲有智慧．但聰明的貧窮人、能將他查透。

Proverbs 28:12 When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
箴言 28:12 義人得志有大榮耀．惡人興起人就躱藏。

Proverbs 28:13 He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
箴言 28:13 遮掩自己罪過的、必不亨通．承認離棄罪過的、必蒙憐恤。

Proverbs 28:14 Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
箴言 28:14 常存敬畏的、便爲有福．心存剛硬的、必陷在禍患裏。

Proverbs 28:15 As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
箴言 28:15 暴虐的君王轄制貧民．好像吼叫的獅子、覓食的熊。

Proverbs 28:16 The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
箴言 28:16 無知的君多行暴虐．以貪財爲可恨的、必年長日久。

Proverbs 28:17 A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
箴言 28:17 背負流人血之罪的、必往坑裏奔跑、誰也不可攔阻他。

Proverbs 28:18 Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
箴言 28:18 行動正直的、必蒙拯救．行事彎曲的、立時跌倒。

Proverbs 28:19 He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
箴言 28:19 耕種自己田地的、必得飽食．追隨虛浮的、足受窮乏。

Proverbs 28:20 A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
箴言 28:20 誠實人必多得福、想要急速發財的、不免受罰。

Proverbs 28:21 To have respect of persons is not good: for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
箴言 28:21 看人的情面、乃爲不好．人因一塊餅枉法、也爲不好。

Proverbs 28:22 He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
箴言 28:22 人有惡眼想要急速發財、卻不知窮乏必臨到他身。

Proverbs 28:23 He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
箴言 28:23 責備人的、後來蒙人喜悅、多於那用舌頭諂媚人的。

Proverbs 28:24 Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
箴言 28:24 偷竊父母的、說、這不是罪．此人就是與強盜同類。

Proverbs 28:25 He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
箴言 28:25 心中貪婪的、挑起爭端．倚靠耶和華的、必得豐裕。

Proverbs 28:26 He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
箴言 28:26 心中自是的、便是愚昧人．憑智慧行事的、必蒙拯救。

Proverbs 28:27 He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
箴言 28:27 賙濟貧窮的、不致缺乏．佯爲不見的、必多受咒詛。

Proverbs 28:28 When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
箴言 28:28 惡人興起、人就躱藏．惡人敗亡、義人增多。

Proverbs 29:1 He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
箴言 29:1 人屢次受責罰、仍然硬着頸項．他必頃刻敗壞、無法可治。

Proverbs 29:2 When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
箴言 29:2 義人增多、民就喜樂．惡人掌權、民就歎息。

Proverbs 29:3 Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
箴言 29:3 愛慕智慧的、使父親喜樂．與妓女結交的、卻浪費錢財。

Proverbs 29:4 The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
箴言 29:4 王藉公平、使國堅定．索要賄賂、使國傾敗。

Proverbs 29:5 A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
箴言 29:5 諂媚鄰舍的、就是設網羅絆他的脚。

Proverbs 29:6 In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
箴言 29:6 惡人犯罪、自陷網羅．惟獨義人歡呼喜樂。

Proverbs 29:7 The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
箴言 29:7 義人知道查明窮人的案．惡人沒有聰明、就不得而知。

Proverbs 29:8 Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
箴言 29:8 褻慢人煽惑通城．智慧人止息衆怒。

Proverbs 29:9 If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
箴言 29:9 智慧人與愚妄人相爭、或怒、或笑、總不能使他止息。

Proverbs 29:10 The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
箴言 29:10 好流人血的、恨惡完全人、索取正直人的性命。

Proverbs 29:11 A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
箴言 29:11 愚妄人怒氣全發．智慧人忍氣含怒。

Proverbs 29:12 If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
箴言 29:12 君王若聽謊言、他一切臣僕都是奸惡。

Proverbs 29:13 The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.
箴言 29:13 貧窮人、強暴人、在世相遇、他們的眼目、都蒙耶和華光照。

Proverbs 29:14 The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
箴言 29:14 君王憑誠實判斷窮人．他的國位、必永遠堅立。

Proverbs 29:15 The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
箴言 29:15 杖打和責備、能加增智慧．放縱的兒子、使母親羞愧。

Proverbs 29:16 When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
箴言 29:16 惡人加多、過犯也加多．義人必看見他們跌倒。

Proverbs 29:17 Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
箴言 29:17 管教你的兒子、他就使你得安息、也必使你心裏喜樂。

Proverbs 29:18 Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
箴言 29:18 沒有異象、民就放肆．惟遵守律法的、便爲有福。

Proverbs 29:19 A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
箴言 29:19 只用言語、僕人不肯受管教、他雖然明白、也不留意。

Proverbs 29:20 Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
箴言 29:20 你見言語急躁的人麼．愚昧人比他更有指望。

Proverbs 29:21 He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
箴言 29:21 人將僕人從小嬌養、這僕人終久必成了他的兒子。

Proverbs 29:22 An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
箴言 29:22 好氣的人挑啟爭端．暴怒的人、多多犯罪。

Proverbs 29:23 A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
箴言 29:23 人的高傲必使他卑下．心裏謙遜的、必得尊榮。

Proverbs 29:24 Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
箴言 29:24 人與盜賊分贓、是恨惡自己的性命．他聽見叫人發誓的聲音、卻不言語。

Proverbs 29:25 The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
箴言 29:25 懼怕人的、陷入網羅．惟有倚靠耶和華的、必得安穩。

Proverbs 29:26 Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the LORD.
箴言 29:26 求王恩的人多．定人事乃在耶和華。

Proverbs 29:27 An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
箴言 29:27 爲非作歹的、被義人憎嫌．行事正直的、被惡人憎惡。

Proverbs 30:1 The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
箴言 30:1 雅基的兒子亞古珥的言語就是眞言。這人對以鐵和烏甲說、

Proverbs 30:2 Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
箴言 30:2 我比衆人更蠢笨、也沒有人的聰明。

Proverbs 30:3 I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
箴言 30:3 我沒有學好智慧．也不認識至聖者。

Proverbs 30:4 Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?
箴言 30:4 誰昇天又降下來．誰聚風在掌握中．誰包水在衣服裏．誰立定地的四極．他名叫甚麼．他兒子名叫甚麼．你知道麼。

Proverbs 30:5 Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
箴言 30:5 神的言語、句句都是煉淨的、投靠他的、他便作他們的盾牌。

Proverbs 30:6 Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
箴言 30:6 他的言語、你不可加添、恐怕他責備你、你就顯爲說謊言的。

Proverbs 30:7 Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
箴言 30:7 我求你兩件事、在我未死之先、不要不賜給我．

Proverbs 30:8 Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
箴言 30:8 求你使虛假和謊言遠離我．使我也不貧窮、也不富足賜給我需用的飲食．

Proverbs 30:9 Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
箴言 30:9 恐怕我飽足不認你、說、耶和華是誰呢．又恐怕我貧窮就偷竊、以致褻瀆我 神的名。

Proverbs 30:10 Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
箴言 30:10 你不要向主人讒謗僕人、恐怕他咒詛你、你便算爲有罪。

Proverbs 30:11 There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
箴言 30:11 有一宗人、咒詛父親、不給母親祝福。

Proverbs 30:12 There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
箴言 30:12 有一宗人、自以爲清潔、卻沒有洗去自己的汚穢。

Proverbs 30:13 There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
箴言 30:13 有一宗人、眼目何其高傲、眼皮也是高舉。

Proverbs 30:14 There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
箴言 30:14 有一宗人、牙如劍、齒如刀、要吞滅地上的困苦人、和世間的窮乏人。

Proverbs 30:15 The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
箴言 30:15 螞蟥有兩個女兒、常說、給呀給呀．有三樣不知足的、連不說彀的共有四樣．

Proverbs 30:16 The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
箴言 30:16 就是陰間和石胎、浸水不足的地、並火。

Proverbs 30:17 The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
箴言 30:17 戲笑父親、藐視而不聽從母親的、他的眼睛、必爲谷中的烏鴉啄出來、爲鷹雛所喫。

Proverbs 30:18 There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
箴言 30:18 我所測不透的奇妙有三樣、連我所不知道的共有四樣．

Proverbs 30:19 The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
箴言 30:19 就是鷹在空中飛的道、蛇在磐石上爬的道、船在海中行的道、男與女交合的道．

Proverbs 30:20 Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
箴言 30:20 淫婦的道、也是這樣、他喫了把嘴一擦、就說、我沒有行惡。

Proverbs 30:21 For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
箴言 30:21 使地震動的有三樣、連地擔不起的共有四樣．

Proverbs 30:22 For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
箴言 30:22 就是僕人作王．愚頑人喫飽．

Proverbs 30:23 For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
箴言 30:23 醜惡的女子出嫁．婢女接續主母。

Proverbs 30:24 There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
箴言 30:24 地上有四樣小物、卻甚聰明．

Proverbs 30:25 The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
箴言 30:25 螞蟻是無力之類、卻在夏天豫備糧食．

Proverbs 30:26 The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
箴言 30:26 沙番是輭弱之類、卻在磐石中造房。

Proverbs 30:27 The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
箴言 30:27 蝗蟲沒有君王、卻分隊而出．

Proverbs 30:28 The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.
箴言 30:28 守宮用爪抓牆、卻住在王宮。

Proverbs 30:29 There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
箴言 30:29 步行威武的有三樣、連行走威武的共有四樣．

Proverbs 30:30 A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
箴言 30:30 就是獅子乃百獸中最爲猛烈、無所躱避的．

Proverbs 30:31 A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
箴言 30:31 獵狗、公山羊、和無人能敵的君王。

Proverbs 30:32 If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
箴言 30:32 你若行事愚頑、自高自傲、或是懷了惡念、就當用手摀口。

Proverbs 30:33 Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
箴言 30:33 搖牛奶必成奶油．扭鼻子必出血．照樣、激動怒氣必起爭端。

Proverbs 31:1 The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
箴言 31:1 利慕伊勒王的言語、是他母親教訓他的眞言。

Proverbs 31:2 What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
箴言 31:2 我的兒阿、我腹中生的兒阿、我許願得的兒阿、我當怎樣教訓你呢．

Proverbs 31:3 Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
箴言 31:3 不要將你的精力給婦女、也不要有敗壞君王的行爲。

Proverbs 31:4 It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
箴言 31:4 利慕伊勒阿、君王喝酒、君王喝酒不相宜．王子說、濃酒在那裏也不相宜．

Proverbs 31:5 Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
箴言 31:5 恐怕喝了就忘記律例、顚倒一切困苦人的是非．

Proverbs 31:6 Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
箴言 31:6 可以把濃酒給將亡的人喝．把清酒給苦心的人喝．

Proverbs 31:7 Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
箴言 31:7 讓他喝了、就忘記他的貧窮、不再記念他的苦楚。

Proverbs 31:8 Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
箴言 31:8 你當爲啞吧開口．爲一切孤獨的伸寃。

Proverbs 31:9 Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
箴言 31:9 你當開口按公義判斷、爲困苦和窮乏的辨屈。

Proverbs 31:10 Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
箴言 31:10 才德的婦人誰能得着呢．他的價值遠勝過珍珠．

Proverbs 31:11 The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
箴言 31:11 他丈夫心裏倚靠他、必不缺少利益．

Proverbs 31:12 She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
箴言 31:12 他一生使丈夫有益無損．

Proverbs 31:13 She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
箴言 31:13 他尋找羊羢和麻、甘心用手作工．

Proverbs 31:14 She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
箴言 31:14 他好像商船從遠方運糧來．

Proverbs 31:15 She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
箴言 31:15 未到黎明他就起來、把食物分給家中的人．將當作的工分派婢女。

Proverbs 31:16 She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
箴言 31:16 他想得田地、就買來．用手所得之利、栽種葡萄園．

Proverbs 31:17 She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
箴言 31:17 他以能力束腰、使膀臂有力．

Proverbs 31:18 She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
箴言 31:18 他覺得所經營的有利他的燈終夜不滅。

Proverbs 31:19 She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
箴言 31:19 他手拿撚線竿．手把紡線車．

Proverbs 31:20 She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
箴言 31:20 他張手賙濟困苦人．伸手幫補窮乏人。

Proverbs 31:21 She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
箴言 31:21 他不因下雪爲家裏的人擔心、因爲全家都穿着朱紅衣服．

Proverbs 31:22 She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
箴言 31:22 他爲自己製作繡花毯子．他的衣服、是細麻和紫色布作的。

Proverbs 31:23 Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
箴言 31:23 他丈夫在城門口與本地的長老同坐、爲衆人所認識。

Proverbs 31:24 She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
箴言 31:24 他作細麻布衣裳出賣．又將腰帶賣與商家。

Proverbs 31:25 Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
箴言 31:25 能力和威儀、是他的衣服．他想到日後的景况就喜笑。

Proverbs 31:26 She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
箴言 31:26 他開口就發智慧．他舌上有仁慈的法則．

Proverbs 31:27 She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
箴言 31:27 他觀察家務、並不喫閒飯。

Proverbs 31:28 Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
箴言 31:28 他的兒女起來稱他有福．他的丈夫也稱讚他、

Proverbs 31:29 Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
箴言 31:29 說、才德的女子很多、惟獨你超過一切。

Proverbs 31:30 Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
箴言 31:30 豔麗是虛假的．美容是虛浮的．惟敬畏耶和華的婦女、必得稱讚。

Proverbs 31:31 Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
箴言 31:31 願他享受操作所得的．願他的工作、在城門口榮耀他。 傳道書]] 1925

## Ecclesiastes / 傳道書

Ecclesiastes 1:1 The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king of Jerusalem.
傳道書 1:1 在耶路撒冷作王、大衞的兒子、傳道者的言語。

Ecclesiastes 1:2 Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
傳道書 1:2 傳道者說、虛空的虛空、虛空的虛空．凡事都是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 1:3 What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?
傳道書 1:3 人一切的勞碌、就是他在日光之下的勞碌、有甚麼益處呢。

Ecclesiastes 1:4 One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.
傳道書 1:4 一代過去、一代又來．地卻永遠長存。

Ecclesiastes 1:5 The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
傳道書 1:5 日頭出來、日頭落下、急歸所出之地。

Ecclesiastes 1:6 The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.
傳道書 1:6 風往南颳、又向北轉、不住的旋轉、而且返回轉行原道。

Ecclesiastes 1:7 All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
傳道書 1:7 江河都往海裏流、海卻不滿．江河從何處流、仍歸還何處．

Ecclesiastes 1:8 All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
傳道書 1:8 萬事令人厭煩人不能說盡．眼看、看不飽、耳聽、聽不足。

Ecclesiastes 1:9 The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
傳道書 1:9 已有的事、後必再有．已行的事、後必再行．日光之下並無新事。

Ecclesiastes 1:10 Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.
傳道書 1:10 豈有一件事人能指着說、這是新的．那知、在我們以前的世代、早已有了。

Ecclesiastes 1:11 There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
傳道書 1:11 已過的世代、無人記念、將來的世代、後來的人也不記念。

Ecclesiastes 1:12 I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
傳道書 1:12 我傳道者在耶路撒冷作過以色列的王。

Ecclesiastes 1:13 And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
傳道書 1:13 我專心用智慧尋求查究天下所作的一切事、乃知 神叫世人所經練的、是極重的勞苦。

Ecclesiastes 1:14 I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
傳道書 1:14 我見日光之下所作的一切事、都是虛空、都是捕風。

Ecclesiastes 1:15 That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
傳道書 1:15 彎曲的不能變直．缺少的不能足數。

Ecclesiastes 1:16 I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
傳道書 1:16 我心裏議論、說、我得了大智慧、勝過我以前在耶路撒冷的衆人．而且我心中多經歷智慧、和知識的事。

Ecclesiastes 1:17 And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
傳道書 1:17 我又專心察明智慧、狂妄、和愚昧．乃知這也是捕風。

Ecclesiastes 1:18 For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
傳道書 1:18 因爲多有智慧、就多有愁煩．加增知識的、就加增憂傷。

Ecclesiastes 2:1 I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.
傳道書 2:1 我心裏說、來罷、我以喜樂試試你、你好享福．誰知、這也是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 2:2 I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
傳道書 2:2 我指嬉笑說、這是狂妄．論喜樂說、有何功效呢。

Ecclesiastes 2:3 I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
傳道書 2:3 我心裏察究、如何用酒使我肉體舒暢、我心卻仍以智慧引導我．又如何持住愚昧、等我看明世人、在天下一生當行何事爲美。

Ecclesiastes 2:4 I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:
傳道書 2:4 我爲自己動大工程、建造房屋、栽種葡萄園、

Ecclesiastes 2:5 I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
傳道書 2:5 修造園囿、在其中栽種各樣果木樹、

Ecclesiastes 2:6 I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
傳道書 2:6 挖造水池、用以澆灌嫩小的樹木．

Ecclesiastes 2:7 I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
傳道書 2:7 我買了僕婢、也有生在家中的僕婢．又有許多牛羣羊羣、勝過以前在耶路撒冷衆人所有的．

Ecclesiastes 2:8 I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
傳道書 2:8 我又爲自己積蓄金銀、和君王的財寶、並各省的財寶．又得唱歌的男女、和世人所喜愛的物、並許多的妃嬪。

Ecclesiastes 2:9 So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
傳道書 2:9 這樣、我就日見昌盛、勝過以前在耶路撒冷的衆人．我的智慧仍然存留。

Ecclesiastes 2:10 And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
傳道書 2:10 凡我眼所求的、我沒有留下不給他的．我心所樂的、我沒有禁止不享受的．因我的心爲我一切所勞碌的快樂．這就是我從勞碌中所得的分。

Ecclesiastes 2:11 Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.
傳道書 2:11 後來我察看我手所經營的一切事、和我勞碌所成的功．誰知都是虛空、都是捕風、在日光之下毫無益處。

Ecclesiastes 2:12 And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.
傳道書 2:12 我轉念觀看智慧、狂妄、和愚昧．在王以後而來的人、還能作甚麼呢．也不過行早先所行的就是了。

Ecclesiastes 2:13 Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
傳道書 2:13 我便看出智慧勝過愚昧、如同光明勝過黑暗。

Ecclesiastes 2:14 The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
傳道書 2:14 智慧人的眼目光明、、愚昧人在黑暗裏行．我卻看明有一件事、這兩等人都必遇見。

Ecclesiastes 2:15 Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
傳道書 2:15 我就心裏說、愚昧人所遇見的、我也必遇見．我爲何更有智慧呢．我心裏說、這也是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 2:16 For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
傳道書 2:16 智慧人、和愚昧人一樣、永遠無人記念．因爲日後都被忘記．可歎智慧人死亡、與愚昧人無異。

Ecclesiastes 2:17 Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
傳道書 2:17 我所以恨惡生命、因爲在日光之下所行的事我都以爲煩惱．都是虛空、都是捕風。

Ecclesiastes 2:18 Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
傳道書 2:18 我恨惡一切的勞碌、就是我在日光之下的勞碌、因爲我得來的必留給我以後的人。

Ecclesiastes 2:19 And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
傳道書 2:19 那人是智慧、是愚昧、誰能知道．他竟要管理我勞碌所得的、就是我在日光之下用智慧所得的．這也是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 2:20 Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.
傳道書 2:20 故此、我轉想我在日光之下所勞碌的一切工作、心便絕望。

Ecclesiastes 2:21 For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
傳道書 2:21 因爲有人用智慧知識靈巧所勞碌得來的、卻要留給未曾勞碌的人爲分．這也是虛空、也是大患。

Ecclesiastes 2:22 For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?
傳道書 2:22 人在日光之下勞碌累心、在他一切的勞碌上得着甚麼呢。

Ecclesiastes 2:23 For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
傳道書 2:23 因爲他日日憂慮他的勞苦成爲愁煩．連夜間心也不安．這也是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 2:24 There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
傳道書 2:24 人莫強如喫喝、且在勞碌中享福．我看這也是出於 神的手。

Ecclesiastes 2:25 For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?
傳道書 2:25 論到喫用、享福、誰能勝過我呢。

Ecclesiastes 2:26 For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
傳道書 2:26 神喜悅誰、就給誰智慧、知識、和喜樂．惟有罪人、 神使他勞苦、叫他將所收聚的、所堆積的、歸給 神所喜悅的人．這也是虛空、也是捕風。

Ecclesiastes 3:1 To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
傳道書 3:1 凡事都有定期、天下萬務都有定時．

Ecclesiastes 3:2 A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
傳道書 3:2 生有時、死有時．栽種有時、拔出所栽種的、也有時．

Ecclesiastes 3:3 A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
傳道書 3:3 殺戮有時、醫治有時．拆毀有時、建造有時．

Ecclesiastes 3:4 A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
傳道書 3:4 哭有時、笑有時．哀慟有時、跳舞有時．

Ecclesiastes 3:5 A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
傳道書 3:5 拋擲石頭有時、堆聚石頭有時．懷抱有時、不懷抱有時．

Ecclesiastes 3:6 A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
傳道書 3:6 尋找有時、失落有時．保守有時、捨棄有時．

Ecclesiastes 3:7 A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
傳道書 3:7 撕裂有時、縫補有時．靜默有時、言語有時．

Ecclesiastes 3:8 A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
傳道書 3:8 喜愛有時、恨惡有時．爭戰有時、和好有時。

Ecclesiastes 3:9 What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
傳道書 3:9 這樣看來、作事的人在他的勞碌上有甚麼益處呢。

Ecclesiastes 3:10 I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
傳道書 3:10 我見 神叫世人勞苦、使他們在其中受經練。

Ecclesiastes 3:11 He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
傳道書 3:11 神造萬物、各按其時成爲美好．又將永生安置在世人心裏．然而 神從始至終的作爲、人不能參透。

Ecclesiastes 3:12 I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
傳道書 3:12 我知道世人、莫強如終身喜樂行善。

Ecclesiastes 3:13 And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
傳道書 3:13 並且人人喫喝、在他一切勞碌中享福．這也是 神的恩賜。

Ecclesiastes 3:14 I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.
傳道書 3:14 我知道 神一切所作的、都必永存、無所增添、無所減少． 神這樣行、是要人在他面前存敬畏的心。

Ecclesiastes 3:15 That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.
傳道書 3:15 現今的事早先就有了．將來的事早已也有了．並且 神使已過的事重新再來．

Ecclesiastes 3:16 And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.
傳道書 3:16 我又見日光之下、在審判之處有奸惡．在公義之處也有奸惡。

Ecclesiastes 3:17 I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
傳道書 3:17 我心裏說、 神必審判義人和惡人．因爲在那裏、各樣事務、一切工作、都有定時。

Ecclesiastes 3:18 I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.
傳道書 3:18 我心裏說、這乃爲世人的緣故、是 神要試驗他們、使他們覺得自己不過像獸一樣。

Ecclesiastes 3:19 For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
傳道書 3:19 因爲世人遭遇的、獸也遭遇．所遭遇的都是一樣．這個怎樣死、那個也怎樣死、氣息都是一樣．人不能強於獸．都是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 3:20 All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
傳道書 3:20 都歸一處．都是出於塵土、也都歸於塵土。

Ecclesiastes 3:21 Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
傳道書 3:21 誰知道人的靈是往上昇、獸的魂是下入地呢。

Ecclesiastes 3:22 Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
傳道書 3:22 故此、我見人、莫強如在他經營的事上喜樂．因爲這是他的分．他身後的事、誰能使他回來得見呢。

Ecclesiastes 4:1 So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
傳道書 4:1 我又轉念、見日光之下所行的一切欺壓．看哪、受欺壓的流淚、且無人安慰．欺壓他們的有勢力、也無人安慰他們。

Ecclesiastes 4:2 Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
傳道書 4:2 因此我讚歎那早已死的死人、勝過那還活着的活人．

Ecclesiastes 4:3 Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
傳道書 4:3 並且我以爲那未曾生的、就是未見過日光之下惡事的、比這兩等人更強。

Ecclesiastes 4:4 Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
傳道書 4:4 我又見人爲一切的勞碌、和各樣靈巧的工作、就被鄰舍嫉妒．這也是虛空、也是捕風。

Ecclesiastes 4:5 The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
傳道書 4:5 愚昧人抱着手、喫自己的肉。

Ecclesiastes 4:6 Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
傳道書 4:6 滿了一把、得享安靜、強如滿了兩把、勞碌捕風。

Ecclesiastes 4:7 Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
傳道書 4:7 我又轉念、見日光之下有一件虛空的事。

Ecclesiastes 4:8 There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
傳道書 4:8 有人孤單無二、無子無兄、竟勞碌不息、眼目也不以錢財爲足．他說我勞勞碌碌、刻苦自己、不享福樂、到底是爲誰呢．這也是虛空、是極重的勞苦。

Ecclesiastes 4:9 Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
傳道書 4:9 兩個人總比一個人好、因爲二人勞碌同得美好的果效。

Ecclesiastes 4:10 For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
傳道書 4:10 若是跌倒、這人可以扶起他的同伴．若是孤身跌倒、沒有別人扶起他來、這人就有禍了。

Ecclesiastes 4:11 Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
傳道書 4:11 再者、二人同睡、就都煖和．一人獨睡、怎能煖和呢。

Ecclesiastes 4:12 And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
傳道書 4:12 有人攻勝孤身一人、若有二人便能敵擋他．三股合成的繩子、不容易折斷。

Ecclesiastes 4:13 Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
傳道書 4:13 貧窮而有智慧的少年人、勝過年老不肯納諫的愚昧王。

Ecclesiastes 4:14 For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
傳道書 4:14 這人是從監牢中出來作王．在他國中、生來原是貧窮的。

Ecclesiastes 4:15 I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
傳道書 4:15 我見日光之下一切行動的活人、都隨從那第二位、就是起來代替老王的少年人。

Ecclesiastes 4:16 There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
傳道書 4:16 他所治理的衆人、就是他的百姓、多得無數．在他後來的人、尚且不喜悅他．這眞是虛空、也是捕風。

Ecclesiastes 5:1 Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
傳道書 5:1 你到 神的殿、要謹愼脚步．因爲近前聽、勝過愚昧人獻祭、、他們本不知道所作的是惡。

Ecclesiastes 5:2 Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
傳道書 5:2 你在 神面前不可冒失開口、也不可心急發言．因爲 神在天上、你在地下、所以你的言語要寡少。

Ecclesiastes 5:3 For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool's voice is known by multitude of words.
傳道書 5:3 事務多、就令人作夢、言語多、就顯出愚昧。

Ecclesiastes 5:4 When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.
傳道書 5:4 你向 神許願、償還不可遲延．因他不喜悅愚昧人．所以你許的願應當償還。

Ecclesiastes 5:5 Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
傳道書 5:5 你許願不還、不如不許。

Ecclesiastes 5:6 Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?
傳道書 5:6 不可任你的口使肉體犯罪．也不可在祭司面前說是錯許了．爲何使 神因你的聲音發怒、敗壞你手所作的呢。

Ecclesiastes 5:7 For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.
傳道書 5:7 多夢和多言、其中多有虛幻．你只要敬畏 神。

Ecclesiastes 5:8 If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.
傳道書 5:8 你若在一省之中見窮人受欺壓、並奪去公義公平的事、不要因此詫異．因有一位高過居高位的鑒察．在他們以上還有更高的。

Ecclesiastes 5:9 Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.
傳道書 5:9 况且地的益處歸衆人．就是君王也受田地的供應。

Ecclesiastes 5:10 He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.
傳道書 5:10 貪愛銀子的、不因得銀子知足．貪愛豐富的、也不因得利益知足．這也是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 5:11 When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?
傳道書 5:11 貨物增添、喫的人也增添．物主得甚麼益處呢、不過眼看而已。

Ecclesiastes 5:12 The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
傳道書 5:12 勞碌的人、不拘喫多喫少、睡得香甜．富足人的豐滿、卻不容他睡覺。

Ecclesiastes 5:13 There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
傳道書 5:13 我見日光之下、有一宗大禍患、就是財主積存貲財、反害自己．

Ecclesiastes 5:14 But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.
傳道書 5:14 因遭遇禍患、這些貲財就消滅．那人若生了兒子、手裏也一無所有。

Ecclesiastes 5:15 As he came forth of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
傳道書 5:15 他怎樣從母胎赤身而來、也必照樣赤身而去．他所勞碌得來的、手中分毫不能帶去。

Ecclesiastes 5:16 And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?
傳道書 5:16 他來的情形怎樣、他去的情形也怎樣．這也是一宗大禍患．他爲風勞碌有甚麼益處呢。

Ecclesiastes 5:17 All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.
傳道書 5:17 並且他終身在黑暗中喫喝、多有煩惱、又有病患嘔氣。

Ecclesiastes 5:18 Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.
傳道書 5:18 我所見爲善爲美的、就是人在 神賜他一生的日子喫喝、享受日光之下勞碌得來的好處．因爲這是他的分。

Ecclesiastes 5:19 Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.
傳道書 5:19 神賜人貲財豐富、使他能以喫用、能取自己的分、在他勞碌中喜樂．這乃是 神的恩賜。

Ecclesiastes 5:20 For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart.
傳道書 5:20 他不多思念自己一生的年日．因爲 神應他的心使他喜樂。

Ecclesiastes 6:1 There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:
傳道書 6:1 我見日光之下有一宗禍患、重壓在人身上．

Ecclesiastes 6:2 A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
傳道書 6:2 就是人蒙 神賜他貲財、豐富、尊榮、以致他心裏所願的一樣都不缺、只是 神使他不能喫用、反有外人來喫用．這是虛空、也是禍患。

Ecclesiastes 6:3 If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
傳道書 6:3 人若生一百個兒子、活許多歲數、以致他的年日甚多、心裏卻不得滿享福樂、又不得埋葬．據我說、那不到期而落的胎比他倒好．

Ecclesiastes 6:4 For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.
傳道書 6:4 因爲虛虛而來、暗暗而去、名字被黑暗遮蔽．

Ecclesiastes 6:5 Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.
傳道書 6:5 並且沒有見過天日、也毫無知覺．這胎、比那人倒享安息。

Ecclesiastes 6:6 Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
傳道書 6:6 那人雖然活千年、再活千年、卻不享福、衆人豈不都歸一個地方去麼。

Ecclesiastes 6:7 All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
傳道書 6:7 人的勞碌都爲口腹、心裏卻不知足。

Ecclesiastes 6:8 For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?
傳道書 6:8 這樣看來、智慧人比愚昧人有甚麼長處呢．窮人在衆人面前知道如何行、有甚麼長處呢。

Ecclesiastes 6:9 Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
傳道書 6:9 眼睛所看的、比心裏妄想的倒好．這也是虛空、也是捕風。

Ecclesiastes 6:10 That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
傳道書 6:10 先前所有的、早已起了名．並知道何爲人．他也不能與那比自己力大的相爭。

Ecclesiastes 6:11 Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?
傳道書 6:11 加增虛浮的事旣多、這與人有甚麼益處呢。

Ecclesiastes 6:12 For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
傳道書 6:12 人一生虛度的日子、就如影兒經過．誰知道甚麼與他有益呢．誰能告訴他身後在日光之下有甚麼事呢。

Ecclesiastes 7:1 A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.
傳道書 7:1 名譽強如美好的膏油．人死的日子、勝過人生的日子。

Ecclesiastes 7:2 It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.
傳道書 7:2 往遭喪的家去、強如往宴樂的家去、因爲死是衆人的結局．活人也必將這事放在心上。

Ecclesiastes 7:3 Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
傳道書 7:3 憂愁強如喜笑、因爲面帶愁容終必使心喜樂。

Ecclesiastes 7:4 The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
傳道書 7:4 智慧人的心、在遭喪之家．愚昧人的心、在快樂之家。

Ecclesiastes 7:5 It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
傳道書 7:5 聽智慧人的責備、強如聽愚昧人的歌唱。

Ecclesiastes 7:6 For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.
傳道書 7:6 愚昧人的笑聲、好像鍋下燒荊棘的爆聲、這也是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 7:7 Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
傳道書 7:7 勒索使智慧人變爲愚妄．賄賂能敗壞人的慧心。

Ecclesiastes 7:8 Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
傳道書 7:8 事情的終局、強如事情的起頭．存心忍耐的、勝過居心驕傲的。

Ecclesiastes 7:9 Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
傳道書 7:9 你不要心裏急躁惱怒、因爲惱怒存在愚昧人的懷中。

Ecclesiastes 7:10 Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.
傳道書 7:10 不要說、先前的日子強過如今的日子、是甚麼緣故呢．你這樣問、不是出於智慧。

Ecclesiastes 7:11 Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.
傳道書 7:11 智慧和產業並好．而且見天日的人、得智慧更爲有益。

Ecclesiastes 7:12 For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
傳道書 7:12 因爲智慧護庇人、好像銀錢護庇人一樣．惟獨智慧能保全智慧人的生命、這就是知識的益處。

Ecclesiastes 7:13 Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?
傳道書 7:13 你要察看 神的作爲、因 神使爲曲的、誰能變爲直呢。

Ecclesiastes 7:14 In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
傳道書 7:14 遇亨通的日子、你當喜樂．遭患難的日子、你當思想．因爲 神使這兩樣並列、爲的是叫人查不出身後有甚麼事。

Ecclesiastes 7:15 All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.
傳道書 7:15 有義人行義、反致滅亡．有惡人行惡、倒享長壽．這都是我在虛度之日中所見過的。

Ecclesiastes 7:16 Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?
傳道書 7:16 不要行義過分．也不要過於自逞智慧．何必自取敗亡呢。

Ecclesiastes 7:17 Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
傳道書 7:17 不要行惡過分．也不要爲人愚昧．何必不到期而死呢。

Ecclesiastes 7:18 It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.
傳道書 7:18 你持守這個爲美．那個也不要鬆手．因爲敬畏 神的人、必從這兩樣出來。

Ecclesiastes 7:19 Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
傳道書 7:19 智慧使有智慧的人、比城中十個官長更有能力。

Ecclesiastes 7:20 For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
傳道書 7:20 時常行善而不犯罪的義人、世上實在沒有。

Ecclesiastes 7:21 Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
傳道書 7:21 人所說的一切話、你不要放在心上、恐怕聽見你的僕人咒詛你。

Ecclesiastes 7:22 For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
傳道書 7:22 因爲你心裏知道、自己也曾屢次咒詛別人。

Ecclesiastes 7:23 All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
傳道書 7:23 我曾用智慧試驗這一切事．我說、要得智慧、智慧卻離我遠。

Ecclesiastes 7:24 That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?
傳道書 7:24 萬事之理、離我甚遠、而且最深、誰能測透呢。

Ecclesiastes 7:25 I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:
傳道書 7:25 我轉念、一心要知道、要考察、要尋求智慧、和萬事的理由．又要知道邪惡爲愚昧、愚昧爲狂妄。

Ecclesiastes 7:26 And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
傳道書 7:26 我得知有等婦人、比死還苦、他的心是網羅、手是鎖鍊．凡蒙 神喜悅的人、必能躱避他．有罪的人、卻被他纏住了。

Ecclesiastes 7:28 Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
傳道書 7:28 傳道者說、看哪、一千男子中、我找到一個正直人．但衆女子中、沒有找到一個．我將這事一一比較、要尋求其理、我心仍要尋找、卻未曾找到。

Ecclesiastes 7:29 Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
傳道書 7:29 我所找到的、只有一件、就是 神造人原是正直、但他們尋出許多巧計。

Ecclesiastes 8:1 Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.
傳道書 8:1 誰如智慧人呢．誰知道事情的解釋呢．人的智慧使他的臉發光、並使他臉上的暴氣改變。

Ecclesiastes 8:2 I counsel thee to keep the king's commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.
傳道書 8:2 我勸你遵守王的命令．旣指 神起誓、理當如此。

Ecclesiastes 8:3 Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
傳道書 8:3 不要急躁離開王的面前．不要固執行惡．因爲他凡事都隨自己的心意而行。

Ecclesiastes 8:4 Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
傳道書 8:4 王的話本有權力、誰敢問他說、你作甚麼呢。

Ecclesiastes 8:5 Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.
傳道書 8:5 凡遵守命令的、必不經歷禍患．智慧人的心、能辨明時候和定理。

Ecclesiastes 8:6 Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
傳道書 8:6 各樣事務成就、都有時候和定理．因爲人的苦難、重壓在他身上。

Ecclesiastes 8:7 For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
傳道書 8:7 他不知道將來的事、因爲將來如何、誰能告訴他呢。

Ecclesiastes 8:8 There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
傳道書 8:8 無人有權力掌管生命、將生命留住．也無人有權力掌管死期．這塲爭戰、無人能免．邪惡也不能救那好行邪惡的人。

Ecclesiastes 8:9 All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
傳道書 8:9 這一切我都見過．也專心查考日光之下所作的一切事．有時這人管轄那人、令人受害。

Ecclesiastes 8:10 And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.
傳道書 8:10 我見惡人埋葬、歸入墳墓．又見行正直事的、離開聖地、在城中被人忘記．這也是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 8:11 Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
傳道書 8:11 因爲斷定罪名、不立刻施刑、所以世人滿心作惡。

Ecclesiastes 8:12 Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
傳道書 8:12 罪人雖然作惡百次、倒享長久的年日．然而我準知道、敬畏 神的、就是在他面前敬畏的人、終久必得福樂。

Ecclesiastes 8:13 But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
傳道書 8:13 惡人卻不得福樂、也不得長久的年日．這年日好像影兒、因他不敬畏 神。

Ecclesiastes 8:14 There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
傳道書 8:14 世上有一件虛空的事、就是義人所遭遇的、反照惡人所行的．又有惡人所遭遇的、反照義人所行的．我說、這也是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 8:15 Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
傳道書 8:15 我就稱讚快樂、原來人在日光之下、莫強如喫喝快樂．因爲他在日光之下、 神賜他一生的年日、要從勞碌中、時常享受所得的。

Ecclesiastes 8:16 When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
傳道書 8:16 我專心求智慧、要看世上所作的事．（有晝夜不睡覺、不合眼的）

Ecclesiastes 8:17 Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea farther; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
傳道書 8:17 我就看明 神一切的作爲．知道人查不出日光之下所作的事．任憑他費多少力尋查、都查不出來．就是智慧人雖想知道、也是查不出來。

Ecclesiastes 9:1 For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.
傳道書 9:1 我將這一切事放在心上、詳細考究、就知道義人和智慧人、並他們的作爲、都在 神手中．或是愛、或是恨、都在他們的前面、人不能知道。

Ecclesiastes 9:2 All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.
傳道書 9:2 凡臨到衆人的事、都是一樣．義人和惡人、都遭遇一樣的事．好人、潔淨人和不潔淨人、獻祭的與不獻祭的、也是一樣．好人如何、罪人也如何．起誓的如何、怕起誓的也如何。

Ecclesiastes 9:3 This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
傳道書 9:3 在日光之下所行的一切事上、有一件禍患、就是衆人所遭遇的、都是一樣．並且世人的心、充滿了惡．活着的時候心裏狂妄、後來就歸死人那裏去了。

Ecclesiastes 9:4 For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
傳道書 9:4 與一切活人相連的、那人還有指望．因爲活着的狗、比死了的獅子更強。

Ecclesiastes 9:5 For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
傳道書 9:5 活着的人、知道必死．死了的人、毫無所知．也不再得賞賜、他們的名無人記念．

Ecclesiastes 9:6 Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
傳道書 9:6 他們的愛、他們的恨、他們的嫉妒、早都消滅了．在日光之下所行的一切事上、他們永不再有分了。

Ecclesiastes 9:7 Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
傳道書 9:7 你只管去歡歡喜喜喫你的飯．心中快樂喝你的酒．因爲 神已經悅納你的作爲。

Ecclesiastes 9:8 Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
傳道書 9:8 你的衣服當時常潔白．你頭上也不要缺少膏油。

Ecclesiastes 9:9 Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
傳道書 9:9 在你一生虛空的年日、就是 神賜你在日光之下虛空的年日、當同你所愛的妻、快活度日．因爲那是你生前、在日光之下勞碌的事上所得的分。

Ecclesiastes 9:10 Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
傳道書 9:10 凡你手所當作的事、要盡力去作．因爲在你所必去的陰間、沒有工作、沒有謀算、沒有知識、也沒有智慧。

Ecclesiastes 9:11 I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
傳道書 9:11 我又轉念、見日光之下、快跑的未必能贏、力戰的未必得勝、智慧的未必得糧食、明哲的未必得貲財、靈巧的未必得喜悅．所臨到衆人的、是在乎當時的機會。

Ecclesiastes 9:12 For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
傳道書 9:12 原來人也不知道自己的定期．魚被惡網圈住、鳥被網羅捉住、禍患忽然臨到的時候、世人陷在其中、也是如此。

Ecclesiastes 9:13 This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:
傳道書 9:13 我見日光之下有一樣智慧、據我看乃是廣大、

Ecclesiastes 9:14 There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
傳道書 9:14 就是有一小城、其中的人數稀少、有大君王來攻擊、修築營壘、將城圍困．

Ecclesiastes 9:15 Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
傳道書 9:15 城中有一個貧窮的智慧人、他用智慧救了那城、卻沒有人記念那窮人．

Ecclesiastes 9:16 Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
傳道書 9:16 我就說、智慧勝過勇力．然而那貧窮人的智慧、被人藐視、他的話也無人聽從。

Ecclesiastes 9:17 The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
傳道書 9:17 寧可在安靜之中聽智慧人的言語、不聽掌管愚昧人的喊聲。

Ecclesiastes 9:18 Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
傳道書 9:18 智慧勝過打仗的兵器．但一個罪人、能敗壞許多善事。

Ecclesiastes 10:1 Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
傳道書 10:1 死蒼蠅、使作香的膏油發出臭氣．這樣、一點愚昧、也能敗壞智慧和尊榮。

Ecclesiastes 10:2 A wise man's heart is at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.
傳道書 10:2 智慧人的心居右．愚昧人的心居左。

Ecclesiastes 10:3 Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
傳道書 10:3 並且愚昧人行路、顯出無知．對衆人說、他是愚昧人。

Ecclesiastes 10:4 If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
傳道書 10:4 掌權者的心、若向你發怒、不要離開你的本位、因爲柔和能免大過。

Ecclesiastes 10:5 There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler:
傳道書 10:5 我見日光之下、有一件禍患、似乎出於掌權的錯誤、

Ecclesiastes 10:6 Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.
傳道書 10:6 就是愚昧人立在高位．富足人坐在低位。

Ecclesiastes 10:7 I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.
傳道書 10:7 我見過僕人騎馬、王子像僕人在地上步行。

Ecclesiastes 10:8 He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.
傳道書 10:8 挖陷坑的、自己必掉在其中．拆牆垣的、必爲蛇所咬。

Ecclesiastes 10:9 Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.
傳道書 10:9 鑿開石頭的、必受損傷．劈開木頭的、必遭危險。

Ecclesiastes 10:10 If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.
傳道書 10:10 鐵器鈍了、若不將刃磨快、就必多費氣力．但得智慧指教、便有益處。

Ecclesiastes 10:11 Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.
傳道書 10:11 未行法術以先、蛇若咬人、後行法術也是無益。

Ecclesiastes 10:12 The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.
傳道書 10:12 智慧人的口、說出恩言．愚昧人的嘴、吞滅自己。

Ecclesiastes 10:13 The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
傳道書 10:13 他口中的言語、起頭是愚昧．他話的末尾、是奸惡的狂妄。

Ecclesiastes 10:14 A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?
傳道書 10:14 愚昧人多有言語、人卻不知將來有甚麼事．他身後的事、誰能告訴他呢。

Ecclesiastes 10:15 The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.
傳道書 10:15 凡愚昧人、他的勞碌使自己困乏．因爲連進城的路他也不知道。

Ecclesiastes 10:16 Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!
傳道書 10:16 邦國阿、你的王若是孩童、你的羣臣早晨宴樂、你就有禍了。

Ecclesiastes 10:17 Blessed art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
傳道書 10:17 邦國阿、你的王若是貴胄之子、你的羣臣按時喫喝、爲要補力、不爲酒醉、你就有福了。

Ecclesiastes 10:18 By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.
傳道書 10:18 因人懶惰、房頂塌下．因人手懶、房屋滴漏。

Ecclesiastes 10:19 A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.
傳道書 10:19 設擺筵席、是爲喜笑．酒能使人快活、錢能叫萬事應心。

Ecclesiastes 10:20 Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
傳道書 10:20 你不可咒詛君王、也不可心懷此念．在你臥房也不可咒詛富戶．因爲空中的鳥、必傳揚這聲音．有翅膀的、也必述說這事。

Ecclesiastes 11:1 Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
傳道書 11:1 當將你的糧食撒在水面、因爲日久必能得着。

Ecclesiastes 11:2 Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
傳道書 11:2 你要分給七人、或分給八人、因爲你不知道將來有甚麼災禍臨到地上。

Ecclesiastes 11:3 If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.
傳道書 11:3 雲若滿了雨、就必傾倒在地上．樹若向南倒、或向北倒、樹倒在何處、就存在何處。

Ecclesiastes 11:4 He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
傳道書 11:4 看風的必不撒種．望雲的必不收割。

Ecclesiastes 11:5 As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child: even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.
傳道書 11:5 風從何道來、骨頭在懷孕婦人的胎中如何長成、你尚且不得知道、這樣、行萬事之 神的作爲、你更不得知道。

Ecclesiastes 11:6 In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.
傳道書 11:6 早晨要撒你的種、晚上也不要歇你的手、因爲你不知道那一樣發旺、或是早撒的、或是晚撒的、或是兩樣都好。

Ecclesiastes 11:7 Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:
傳道書 11:7 光本是佳美的、眼見日光也是可悅的。

Ecclesiastes 11:8 But if a man live many years, and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.
傳道書 11:8 人活多年、就當快樂多年．然而也當想到黑暗的日子、因爲這日子必多、所要來的都是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 11:9 Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.
傳道書 11:9 少年人哪、你在幼年時當快樂．在幼年的日子、使你的心歡暢、行你心所願行的、看你眼所愛看的、卻要知道、爲這一切的事、 神必審問你。

Ecclesiastes 11:10 Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.
傳道書 11:10 所以你當從心中除掉愁煩．從肉體克去邪惡．因爲一生的開端、和幼年之時、都是虛空的。

Ecclesiastes 12:1 Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
傳道書 12:1 你趁着年幼、衰敗的日子尚未來到、就是你所說、我毫無喜樂的那些年日未曾臨近之先、當記念造你的主．

Ecclesiastes 12:2 While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:
傳道書 12:2 不要等到日頭、光明、月亮、星宿、變爲黑暗、雨後雲彩反回、

Ecclesiastes 12:3 In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
傳道書 12:3 看守房屋的發顫、有力的屈身、推磨的稀少就止息、從窗戶往外看的都昏暗、

Ecclesiastes 12:4 And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
傳道書 12:4 街門關閉、推磨的響聲微小、雀鳥一叫、人就起來、唱歌的女子、也都衰微、

Ecclesiastes 12:5 Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:
傳道書 12:5 人怕高處、路上有驚慌、杏樹開花、蚱蜢成爲重擔、人所願的也都廢掉、因爲人歸他永遠的家、弔喪的在街上往來、

Ecclesiastes 12:6 Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
傳道書 12:6 銀鍊折斷、金罐破裂、瓶子在泉旁損壞、水輪在井口破爛、

Ecclesiastes 12:7 Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
傳道書 12:7 塵土仍歸於地、靈仍歸於賜靈的 神。

Ecclesiastes 12:8 Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.
傳道書 12:8 傳道者說、虛空的虛空、凡事都是虛空。

Ecclesiastes 12:9 And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
傳道書 12:9 再者、傳道者因有智慧、仍將知識教訓衆人．又默想、又考查、又陳說許多箴言。

Ecclesiastes 12:10 The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.
傳道書 12:10 傳道者專心尋求可喜悅的言語、是憑正直寫的誠實話。

Ecclesiastes 12:11 The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
傳道書 12:11 智慧人的言語、好像刺棍．會中之師的言語、又像釘穩的釘子．都是一個牧者所賜的。

Ecclesiastes 12:12 And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
傳道書 12:12 我兒、還有一層、你當受勸戒．着書多、沒有窮盡．讀書多、身體疲倦。

Ecclesiastes 12:13 Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
傳道書 12:13 這些事都已聽見了．總意就是敬畏 神、謹守他的誡命、這是人所當盡的本分。

Ecclesiastes 12:14 For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
傳道書 12:14 因爲人所作的事、連一切隱藏的事、無論是善是惡、 神都必審問。 雅歌]] 1925

## Song of Solomon / 雅歌

Song of Solomon 1:1 The song of songs, which is Solomon's.
雅歌 1:1 所羅門的歌、是歌中的雅歌。

Song of Solomon 1:2 Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.
雅歌 1:2 願他用口與我親嘴．因你的愛情比酒更美。

Song of Solomon 1:3 Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
雅歌 1:3 你的膏油馨香．你的名如同倒出來的香膏．所以衆童女都愛你。

Song of Solomon 1:4 Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
雅歌 1:4 願你吸引我、我們就快跑跟隨你．王帶我進了內室．我們必因你歡喜快樂．我們要稱讚你的愛情、勝似稱讚美酒．他們愛你是理所當然的。

Song of Solomon 1:5 I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
雅歌 1:5 耶路撒冷的衆女子阿、我雖然黑、卻是秀美、如同基達的帳棚、好像所羅門的幔子。

Song of Solomon 1:6 Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.
雅歌 1:6 不要因日頭把我曬黑了、就輕看我。我同母的弟兄向我發怒．他們使我看守葡萄園、我自己的葡萄園、卻沒有看守。

Song of Solomon 1:7 Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?
雅歌 1:7 我心所愛的阿、求你告訴我你在何處牧羊、晌午在何處使羊歇臥．我何必在你同伴的羊羣旁邊、好像蒙着臉的人呢。

Song of Solomon 1:8 If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.
雅歌 1:8 你這女子中極美麗的、你若不知道、只管跟隨羊羣的脚蹤去、把你的山羊羔、牧放在牧人帳棚的旁邊。

Song of Solomon 1:9 I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots.
雅歌 1:9 我的佳偶、我將你比法老車上套的駿馬。

Song of Solomon 1:10 Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.
雅歌 1:10 你的兩顋、因髮辮而秀美、你的頸項、因珠串而華麗。

Song of Solomon 1:11 We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
雅歌 1:11 我們要爲你編上金辮、鑲上銀釘。

Song of Solomon 1:12 While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
雅歌 1:12 王正坐席的時候、我的哪噠香膏發出香味。

Song of Solomon 1:13 A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
雅歌 1:13 我以我的良人爲一袋沒藥、常在我懷中。

Song of Solomon 1:14 My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En-gedi.
雅歌 1:14 我以我的良人爲一棵鳳仙花、在隱基底葡萄園中。

Song of Solomon 1:15 Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes.
雅歌 1:15 我的佳偶、你甚美麗、你甚美麗．你的眼好像鴿子眼。

Song of Solomon 1:16 Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.
雅歌 1:16 我的良人哪、你甚美麗可愛、我們以青草爲牀榻、

Song of Solomon 1:17 The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.
雅歌 1:17 以香柏樹爲房屋的棟梁、以松樹爲椽子。

Song of Solomon 2:1 I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
雅歌 2:1 我是沙崙的玫瑰花、是谷中的百合花。

Song of Solomon 2:2 As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
雅歌 2:2 我的佳偶在女子中、好像百合花在荊棘內。

Song of Solomon 2:3 As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
雅歌 2:3 我的良人在男子中、如同㰋果樹在樹林中。我歡歡喜喜坐在他的蔭下、嘗他果子的滋味覺得甘甜。

Song of Solomon 2:4 He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
雅歌 2:4 他帶我入筵宴所、以愛爲旗在我以上。

Song of Solomon 2:5 Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.
雅歌 2:5 求你們給我葡萄乾增補我力、給我㰋果暢快我心．因我思愛成病。

Song of Solomon 2:6 His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.
雅歌 2:6 他的左手在我頭下、他的右手將我抱住。

Song of Solomon 2:7 I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
雅歌 2:7 耶路撒冷的衆女子阿、我指着羚羊、或田野的母鹿、囑咐你們、不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的、等他自己情願。

Song of Solomon 2:8 The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
雅歌 2:8 聽阿、是我良人的聲音．看哪、他躥山越嶺而來。

Song of Solomon 2:9 My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.
雅歌 2:9 我的良人好像羚羊、或像小鹿．他站在我們牆壁後、從窗戶往裏觀看、從窗櫺往裏窺探。

Song of Solomon 2:10 My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
雅歌 2:10 我良人對我說、我的佳偶、我的美人、起來、與我同去。

Song of Solomon 2:11 For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
雅歌 2:11 因爲冬天已往．雨水止住過去了。

Song of Solomon 2:12 The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
雅歌 2:12 地上百花開放．百鳥鳴叫的時候已經來到、斑鳩的聲音在我們境內也聽見了．

Song of Solomon 2:17 Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
雅歌 2:17 我的良人哪、求你等到天起涼風、日影飛去的時候、你要轉回、好像羚羊、或像小鹿在比特山上。

Song of Solomon 3:1 By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.

Song of Solomon 5:1 I am come into my garden, my sister, my spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.
雅歌 5:1 我妹子、我新婦、我進了我的園中、採了我的沒藥和香料、喫了我的蜜房和蜂蜜．喝了我的酒和奶．我的朋友們、請喫、我所親愛的、請喝、且多多的喝。

Song of Solomon 5:2 I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh, saying, Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, and my locks with the drops of the night.
雅歌 5:2 我身睡臥、我心卻醒．這是我良人的聲音．他敲門、說、我的妹子、我的佳偶、我的鴿子、我的完全人、求你給我開門、因我的頭滿了露水、我的頭髮被夜露滴濕。

Song of Solomon 5:3 I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?
雅歌 5:3 我回答說、我脫了衣裳、怎能再穿上呢．我洗了脚、怎能再玷汚呢。

Song of Solomon 5:4 My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved for him.
雅歌 5:4 我的良人從門孔裏伸進手來、我便因他動了心。

雅歌 5:5 我起來、要給我良人開門．我的兩手滴下沒藥、我的指頭有沒藥汁滴在門閂上。

Song of Solomon 5:8 I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I am sick of love.

雅歌 5:9 你這女子中極美麗的、你的良人、比別人的良人有何強處．你的良人、比別人的良人有何強處、你就這樣囑咐我們。

Song of Solomon 5:10 My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
雅歌 5:10 我的良人、白而且紅、超乎萬人之上。

Song of Solomon 8:1 O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.

Song of Solomon 8:2 I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.

Song of Solomon 8:3 His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.

Song of Solomon 8:4 I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.

Song of Solomon 8:5 Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
雅歌 8:5 那靠着良人從曠野上來的、是誰呢。我在㰋果樹下叫醒你．你母親在那裏爲你劬勞、生養你的在那裏爲你劬勞。

Song of Solomon 8:6 Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
雅歌 8:6 求你將我放在你心上如印記、帶在你臂上如戳記．因爲愛情如死之堅強．嫉恨如陰間之殘忍．所發的電光、是火燄的電光、是耶和華的烈燄。

Song of Solomon 8:7 Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
雅歌 8:7 愛情、衆水不能息滅、大水也不能淹沒．若有人拿家中所有的財寶要換愛情、就全被藐視。

Song of Solomon 8:8 We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
雅歌 8:8 我們有一小妹、他的兩乳尚未長成．人來提親的日子、我們當爲他怎樣辦理。

Song of Solomon 8:9 If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
雅歌 8:9 他若是牆、我們要在其上建造銀塔．他若是門、我們要用香柏木板圍護他。

Song of Solomon 8:10 I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
雅歌 8:10 我是牆、我兩乳像其上的樓．那時我在他眼中像得平安的人。

Song of Solomon 8:11 Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
雅歌 8:11 所羅門在巴力哈們有一葡萄園．他將這葡萄園交給看守的人、爲其中的果子必交一千舍客勒銀子。

Song of Solomon 8:12 My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
雅歌 8:12 我自己的葡萄園在我面前．所羅門哪、一千舍客勒歸你、二百舍客勒歸看守果子的人。

Song of Solomon 8:13 Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
雅歌 8:13 你這住在園中的、同伴都要聽你的聲音．求你使我也得聽見。

Song of Solomon 8:14 Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
雅歌 8:14 我的良人哪、求你快來、如羚羊或小鹿在香草山上。 以賽亞書]] 1925

## Isaiah / 以賽亞書

Isaiah 1:1 The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
以賽亞書 1:1 當烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家、作猶大王的時候、亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示、論到猶大、和耶路撒冷。

Isaiah 1:2 Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the L ORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
以賽亞書 1:2 天哪、要聽、地阿、側耳而聽．因爲耶和華說、我養育兒女、將他們養大、他們竟悖逆我。

Isaiah 1:3 The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
以賽亞書 1:3 牛認識主人、驢認識主人的槽．以色列卻不認識、我的民卻不留意。

Isaiah 1:4 Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the L ORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
以賽亞書 1:4 嗐、犯罪的國民、擔着罪孽的百姓、行惡的種類、敗壞的兒女．他們離棄耶和華、藐視以色列的聖者、與他生疏、往後退步。

Isaiah 1:5 Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
以賽亞書 1:5 你們爲甚麼屢次悖逆、還要受責打麼。你們已經滿頭疼痛、全心發昏。

Isaiah 1:6 From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
以賽亞書 1:6 從脚掌到頭頂、沒有一處完全的．盡是傷口、青腫、與新打的傷痕．都沒有收口、沒有纏裹、也沒有用膏滋潤。

Isaiah 1:7 Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
以賽亞書 1:7 你們的地土已經荒涼．你們的城邑被火焚燬．你們的田地、在你們眼前爲外邦人所侵吞、旣被外邦人傾覆、就成爲荒涼。

Isaiah 1:8 And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
以賽亞書 1:8 僅存錫安城、好像葡萄園的草棚、瓜田的茅屋、被圍困的城邑。

Isaiah 1:9 Except the L ORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
以賽亞書 1:9 若不是萬軍之耶和華給我們稍留餘種、我們早已像所多瑪、蛾摩拉的樣子了。

Isaiah 1:10 Hear the word of the L ORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
以賽亞書 1:10 你們這所多瑪的官長阿、要聽耶和華的話．你們這蛾摩拉的百姓阿、要側耳聽我們 神的訓誨。

Isaiah 1:11 To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the L ORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
以賽亞書 1:11 耶和華說、你們所獻的許多祭物、與我何益呢．公綿羊的燔祭、和肥畜的脂油、我已經彀了．公牛的血、羊羔的血、公山羊的血、我都不喜悅。

Isaiah 1:12 When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
以賽亞書 1:12 你們來朝見我、誰向你們討這些、使你們踐踏我的院宇呢。

Isaiah 1:13 Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
以賽亞書 1:13 你們不要再獻虛浮的供物．香品是我所憎惡的．月朔、和安息日、並宣召的大會、也是我所憎惡的．作罪孽、又守嚴肅會、我也不能容忍。

Isaiah 1:14 Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
以賽亞書 1:14 你們的月朔、和節期、我心裏恨惡、我都以爲麻煩．我擔當、便不耐煩。

Isaiah 1:15 And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
以賽亞書 1:15 你們舉手禱告、我必遮眼不看．就是你們多多的祈禱、我也不聽．你們的手都滿了殺人的血。

Isaiah 1:16 Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
以賽亞書 1:16 你們要洗濯、自潔．從我眼前除掉你們的惡行．要止住作惡、

Isaiah 1:17 Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
以賽亞書 1:17 學習行善．尋求公平、解救受欺壓的、給孤兒伸寃、爲寡婦辨屈。

Isaiah 1:18 Come now, and let us reason together, saith the L ORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
以賽亞書 1:18 耶和華說、你們來、我們彼此辯論．你們的罪雖像硃紅、必變成雪白．雖紅如丹顏、必白如羊毛。

Isaiah 1:19 If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
以賽亞書 1:19 你們若甘心聽從、必喫地上的美物．

Isaiah 1:20 But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the L ORD hath spoken it.
以賽亞書 1:20 若不聽從、反倒悖逆、必被刀劍吞滅．這是耶和華親口說的。

Isaiah 1:21 How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
以賽亞書 1:21 可歎忠信的城、變爲妓女．從前充滿了公平、公義居在其中、現今卻有凶手居住。

Isaiah 1:22 Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
以賽亞書 1:22 你的銀子、變爲渣滓、你的酒、用水攙對。

Isaiah 1:23 Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
以賽亞書 1:23 你的官長居心悖逆、與盜賊作伴．各都喜愛賄賂、追求贓私．他們不爲孤兒伸寃、寡婦的案件、也不得呈到他們面前。

Isaiah 1:24 Therefore saith the Lord, the L ORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
以賽亞書 1:24 因此、主萬軍之耶和華以色列的大能者說、哎、我要向我的對頭雪恨、向我的敵人報仇．

Isaiah 1:25 And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
以賽亞書 1:25 我必反手加在你身上、煉盡你的渣滓、除淨你的雜質．

Isaiah 1:26 And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellers as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
以賽亞書 1:26 我也必復還你的審判官、像起初一樣、復還你的謀士、像起先一般．然後、你必稱爲公義之城、忠信之邑。

Isaiah 1:27 Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
以賽亞書 1:27 錫安必因公平得蒙救贖、其中歸正的人、必因公義得蒙救贖。

Isaiah 1:28 And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the L ORD shall be consumed.
以賽亞書 1:28 但悖逆的、和犯罪的、必一同敗亡、離棄耶和華的、必致消滅。

Isaiah 1:29 For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
以賽亞書 1:29 那等人必因你們所喜愛的橡樹抱愧、你們必因所選擇的園子蒙羞。

Isaiah 1:30 For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
以賽亞書 1:30 因爲你們必如葉子枯乾的橡樹、好像無水澆灌的園子。

Isaiah 1:31 And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
以賽亞書 1:31 有權勢的必如麻瓤、他的工作、好像火星、都要一同焚燬、無人撲滅。

Isaiah 2:1 The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
以賽亞書 2:1 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示、論到猶大、和耶路撒冷。

Isaiah 2:2 And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
以賽亞書 2:2 末後的日子、耶和華殿的山必堅立、超乎諸山、高舉過於萬嶺．萬民都要流歸這山

Isaiah 2:3 And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
以賽亞書 2:3 必有許多國的民前往、說、來罷、我們登耶和華的山、奔雅各 神的殿．主必將他的道教訓我們、我們也要行他的路．因爲訓誨必出於錫安、耶和華的言語、必出於耶路撒冷。

Isaiah 2:4 And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
以賽亞書 2:4 他必在列國中施行審判、爲許多國民斷定是非．他們要將刀打成犂頭、把槍打成鐮刀．這國不舉刀攻擊那國、他們也不再學習戰事。

Isaiah 2:5 O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
以賽亞書 2:5 雅各家阿、來罷、我們在耶和華的光明中行走。

Isaiah 2:6 Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
以賽亞書 2:6 耶和華、你離棄了你百姓雅各家、是因他們充滿了東方的風俗、作觀兆的、像非利士人一樣、並與外邦人擊掌。

Isaiah 2:7 Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
以賽亞書 2:7 他們的國滿了金銀、財寶也無窮．他們的地滿了馬匹、車輛也無數。

Isaiah 2:8 Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
以賽亞書 2:8 他們的地滿了偶像．他們跪拜自己手所造的、就是自己指頭所作的。

Isaiah 2:9 And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
以賽亞書 2:9 卑賤人屈膝、尊貴人下跪．所以不可饒恕他們。

Isaiah 2:10 Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
以賽亞書 2:10 你當進入巖穴、藏在土中、躱避耶和華的驚嚇、和他威嚴的榮光。

Isaiah 2:11 The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
以賽亞書 2:11 到那日、眼目高傲的必降爲卑、性情狂傲的都必屈膝．惟獨耶和華被尊崇。

Isaiah 2:12 For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
以賽亞書 2:12 必有萬軍耶和華降罰的一個日子、要臨到驕傲狂妄的、一切自高的都必降爲卑．

Isaiah 2:13 And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
以賽亞書 2:13 又臨到利巴嫩高大的香柏樹、和巴珊的橡樹．

Isaiah 2:14 And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
以賽亞書 2:14 又臨到一切高山的峻嶺．

Isaiah 2:15 And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
以賽亞書 2:15 又臨到高臺、和堅固城牆．

Isaiah 2:16 And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
以賽亞書 2:16 又臨到他施的船隻、並一切可愛的美物．

Isaiah 2:17 And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
以賽亞書 2:17 驕傲的必屈膝、狂妄的必降卑．在那日、惟獨耶和華被尊崇。

Isaiah 2:18 And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
以賽亞書 2:18 偶像必全然廢棄。

Isaiah 2:19 And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
以賽亞書 2:19 耶和華興起使地大震動的時候、人就進入石洞、進入土穴、躱避耶和華的驚嚇、和他威嚴的榮光。

Isaiah 2:20 In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
以賽亞書 2:20 到那日、人必將爲拜而造的金偶像、銀偶像、拋給田鼠、和蝙蝠．

Isaiah 2:21 To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
以賽亞書 2:21 到耶和華興起使地大震動的時候、人好進入磐石洞中、和巖石穴裏、躱避耶和華的驚嚇、和他威嚴的榮光。

Isaiah 2:22 Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
以賽亞書 2:22 你們休要倚靠世人、他鼻孔裏不過有氣息．他在一切事上可算甚麼呢。

Isaiah 3:1 For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,
以賽亞書 3:1 主萬軍之耶和華從耶路撒冷和猶大、除掉衆人所倚靠的、所仗賴的、就是所倚靠的糧、所仗賴的水．

Isaiah 3:2 The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
以賽亞書 3:2 除掉勇士、和戰士、審判官、和先知、占卜的、和長老．

Isaiah 3:3 The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counseller, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
以賽亞書 3:3 五十夫長、和尊貴人．謀士、和有巧藝的、以及妙行法術的。

Isaiah 3:4 And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
以賽亞書 3:4 主說、我必使孩童作他們的首領、使嬰孩轄管他們。

Isaiah 3:5 And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
以賽亞書 3:5 百姓要彼此欺壓、各人受鄰舍的欺壓．少年人必侮慢老年人、卑賤人必侮慢尊貴人。

Isaiah 3:6 When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
以賽亞書 3:6 人在父家拉住弟兄、說、你有衣服、可以作我們的官長、這敗落的事歸在你手下罷．

Isaiah 3:7 In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
以賽亞書 3:7 那時他必揚聲說、我不作醫治你們的人．因我家中沒有糧食、也沒有衣服．你們不可立我作百姓的官長。

Isaiah 3:8 For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
以賽亞書 3:8 耶路撒冷敗落、猶大傾倒．因爲他們的舌頭、和行爲、與耶和華反對、惹了他榮光的眼目。

Isaiah 3:9 The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
以賽亞書 3:9 他們的面色證明自己的不正．他們述說自己的罪惡、並不隱瞞、好像所多瑪一樣。他們有禍了．因爲作惡自害。

Isaiah 3:10 Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
