Acts 26:20 But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.
使徒行傳 26:20 先在大馬色、後在耶路撒冷、和猶太全地、以及外邦、勸勉他們應當悔改歸向 神、行事與悔改的心相稱。

Acts 26:21 For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.
使徒行傳 26:21 因此、猶太人在殿裏拿住我、想要殺我。

Acts 26:22 Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:
使徒行傳 26:22 然而我蒙 神的幫助、直到今日還站得住、對着尊貴卑賤老幼作見證．所講的、並不外乎衆先知和摩西所說、將來必成的事．

Acts 26:23 That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.
使徒行傳 26:23 就是基督必須受害、並且因從死裏復活、要首先把光明的道、傳給百姓和外邦人。

Acts 26:24 And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.
使徒行傳 26:24 保羅這樣分訴、非斯都大聲說、保羅、你癲狂了罷．你的學問太大、反叫你癲狂了。

Acts 26:25 But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.
使徒行傳 26:25 保羅說、非斯都大人、我不是癲狂、我說的乃是眞實明白話。

Acts 26:26 For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.
使徒行傳 26:26 王也曉得這些事、所以我向王放膽直言、我深信這些事沒有一件向王隱藏的．因都不是在背地裏作的。

Acts 26:27 King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.
使徒行傳 26:27 亞基帕王阿、你信先知麼、我知道你是信的。

Acts 26:28 Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
使徒行傳 26:28 亞基帕對保羅說、你想少微一勸、便叫我作基督徒阿。

Acts 26:29 And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.
使徒行傳 26:29 保羅說、無論是少勸、是多勸、我向 神所求的、不但你一個人、就是今天一切聽我的、都要像我一樣、只是不要像我有這些鎖鍊。

Acts 26:30 And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:
使徒行傳 26:30 於是王、和巡撫、並百尼基、與同坐的人、都起來、

Acts 26:31 And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.
使徒行傳 26:31 退到裏面、彼此談論說、這人並沒有犯甚麼該死該綁的罪。

Acts 26:32 Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Cesar.
使徒行傳 26:32 亞基帕又對非斯都說、這人若沒有上告於該撒、就可以釋放了。

Acts 27:1 And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.
使徒行傳 27:1 非斯都旣然定規了、叫我們坐船往義大利去、便將保羅、和別的囚犯、交給御營裏的一個百夫長、名叫猶流。

Acts 27:2 And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
使徒行傳 27:2 有一隻亞大米田的船、要沿着亞西亞一帶地方的海邊走、我們就上了那船開行、有馬其頓的帖撒羅尼迦人、亞里達古、和我們同去。

Acts 27:3 And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
使徒行傳 27:3 第二天、到了西頓．猶流寬待保羅、准他往朋友那裏去、受他們的照應。

Acts 27:4 And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary. And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
使徒行傳 27:4 從那裏又開船、因爲風不順、就貼着居比路背風岸行去。

Acts 27:6 And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.
使徒行傳 27:6 在那裏百夫長遇見一隻亞力山太的船、要往義大利去、便叫我們上了那船。

Acts 27:7 And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;
使徒行傳 27:7 一連多日、船行得慢、僅僅來到革尼土的對面。因爲被風攔阻、就貼着革哩底背風岸、從撒摩尼對面行過．

Acts 27:8 And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.
使徒行傳 27:8 我們沿岸行走、僅僅來到一個地方、名叫佳澳．離那裏不遠、有拉西亞城。

Acts 27:9 Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,
使徒行傳 27:9 走的日子多了、已經過了禁食的節期、行船又危險、保羅就勸衆人說、

Acts 27:10 And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.
使徒行傳 27:10 衆位、我看這次行船、不但貨物和船要受傷損、大遭破壞、連我們的性命也難保。

Acts 27:11 Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.
使徒行傳 27:11 但百夫長信從掌船的和船主、不信從保羅所說的。

Acts 27:12 And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.
使徒行傳 27:12 且因在這海口過冬不便、船上的人、就多半說、不如開船離開這地方、或者能到非尼基過冬．非尼基是革哩底的一個海口、一面朝東北、一面朝東南。

Acts 27:13 And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.
使徒行傳 27:13 這時微微起了南風、他們以爲得意、就起了錨、貼近革哩底行去。

Acts 27:14 But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.
使徒行傳 27:14 不多幾時、狂風從島上撲下來、那風名叫友拉革羅。

Acts 27:15 And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.
使徒行傳 27:15 船被風抓住、敵不住風、我們就任風颳去。

Acts 27:16 And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:
使徒行傳 27:16 貼着一個小島的背風岸奔行、那島名叫高大、在那裏僅僅收住了小船．

Acts 27:17 Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.
使徒行傳 27:17 旣然把小船拉上來、就用纜索捆綁船底．又恐怕在賽耳底沙灘上擱了淺、就落下篷來、任船飄去。

Acts 27:18 And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;
使徒行傳 27:18 我們被風浪逼得甚急、第二天衆人就把貨物拋在海裏。

Acts 27:19 And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.
使徒行傳 27:19 到第三天、他們又親手把船上的器具拋棄了。

Acts 27:20 And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
使徒行傳 27:20 太陽和星辰多日不顯露、又有狂風大浪催逼、我們得救的指望就都絕了。

Acts 27:21 But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.
使徒行傳 27:21 衆人多日沒有喫甚麼、保羅就出來站在他們中間說、衆位、你們本該聽我的話、不離開革哩底、免得遭這樣的傷損破壞。

Acts 27:22 And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.
使徒行傳 27:22 現在我還勸你們放心．你們的性命、一個也不失喪、惟獨失喪這船。

Acts 27:23 For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,
使徒行傳 27:23 因我所屬所事奉的 神、他的使者昨夜站在我旁邊說、

Acts 27:24 Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Cesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
使徒行傳 27:24 保羅、不要害怕、你必定站在該撒面前．並且與你同船的人、 神都賜給你了。

Acts 27:25 Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
使徒行傳 27:25 所以衆位可以放心、我信 神他怎樣對我說、事情也要怎樣成就。

Acts 27:26 Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.
使徒行傳 27:26 只是我們必要撞在一個島上。

Acts 27:27 But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
使徒行傳 27:27 到了第十四天夜間、船在亞底亞海、飄來飄去、約到半夜、水手以爲漸近旱地、

Acts 27:28 And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.
使徒行傳 27:28 就探深淺、探得有十二丈．稍往前行、又探深淺、探得有九丈。

Acts 27:29 Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.
使徒行傳 27:29 恐怕撞在石頭上、就從船尾拋下四個錨、盼望天亮。

Acts 27:30 And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,
使徒行傳 27:30 水手想要逃出船去、把小船放在海裏、假作要從船頭拋錨的樣子．

Acts 27:31 Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
使徒行傳 27:31 保羅對百夫長和兵丁說、這些人若不等在船上、你們必不能得救。

Acts 27:32 Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.
使徒行傳 27:32 於是兵丁砍斷小船的繩子、由他飄去。

Acts 27:33 And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.
使徒行傳 27:33 天漸亮的時候、保羅勸衆人都喫飯、說、你們懸望忍餓不喫甚麼、已經十四天了。

Acts 27:34 Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.
使徒行傳 27:34 所以我勸你們喫飯、這是關乎你們救命的事．因爲你們各人連一根頭髮、也不至於損壞。

Acts 27:35 And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.
使徒行傳 27:35 保羅說了這話、就拿着餅、在衆人面前祝謝了 神、擘開喫。

Acts 27:36 Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.
使徒行傳 27:36 於是他們都放下心、也就喫了。

Acts 27:37 And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
使徒行傳 27:37 我們在船上的、共有二百七十六個人。

Acts 27:38 And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
使徒行傳 27:38 他們喫飽了、就把船上的麥子、拋在海裏、爲要叫船輕一點。

Acts 27:39 And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.
使徒行傳 27:39 到了天亮、他們不認識那地方、但見一個海灣、有岸可登、就商議能把船攏進去不能。

Acts 27:40 And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.
使徒行傳 27:40 於是砍斷纜索、棄錨在海裏、同時也鬆開舵繩、拉起頭篷、順着風向岸行去。

Acts 27:41 And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.
使徒行傳 27:41 但遇着兩水夾流的地方、就把船擱了淺．船頭膠住不動、船尾被浪的猛力衝壞。

Acts 27:42 And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.
使徒行傳 27:42 兵丁的意思、要把囚犯殺了、恐怕有洑水脫逃的。

Acts 27:43 But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:
使徒行傳 27:43 但百夫長要救保羅、不准他們任意而行、就吩咐會洑水的、跳下水去先上岸．

Acts 27:44 And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.
使徒行傳 27:44 其餘的人、可以用板子、或船上的零碎東西上岸．這樣、衆人都得了救上了岸。

Acts 28:1 And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
使徒行傳 28:1 我們旣已得救、纔知道那島名叫米利大。

Acts 28:2 And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
使徒行傳 28:2 土人看待我們、有非常的情分、因爲當時下雨、天氣又冷、就生火、接待我們衆人。

Acts 28:3 And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
使徒行傳 28:3 那時、保羅拾起一捆柴、放在火上、有一條毒蛇、因爲熱了出來、咬住他的手。

Acts 28:4 And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.
使徒行傳 28:4 土人看見那毒蛇、懸在他手上、就彼此說、這人必是個凶手、雖然從海裏救上來、天理還不容他活着。

Acts 28:5 And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.
使徒行傳 28:5 保羅竟把那毒蛇甩在火裏、並沒有受傷。

Acts 28:6 Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
使徒行傳 28:6 土人想他必要腫起來、或是忽然仆倒死了．看了多時、見他無害、就轉念說、他是個神。

Acts 28:7 In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.
使徒行傳 28:7 離那地方不遠、有田產是島長部百流的．他接納我們、盡情款待三日。

Acts 28:8 And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.
使徒行傳 28:8 當時、部百流的父親、患熱病和痢疾躺着．保羅進去、爲他禱告、按手在他身上、治好了他。

Acts 28:9 So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:
使徒行傳 28:9 從此、島上其餘的病人、也來得了醫治。

Acts 28:10 Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.
使徒行傳 28:10 他們又多方的尊敬我們．到了開船的時候、也把我們所需用的送到船上。

Acts 28:11 And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
使徒行傳 28:11 過了三個月、我們上了亞力山太的船、往前行．這船以丟斯雙子爲記、是在那海島過了冬的。

Acts 28:12 And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.
使徒行傳 28:12 到了叙拉古、我們停泊三日。

Acts 28:13 And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
使徒行傳 28:13 又從那裏繞行、來到利基翁．過了一天、起了南風、第二天就來到部丟利。

Acts 28:14 Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.
使徒行傳 28:14 在那裏遇見弟兄們、請我們與他們同住了七天．這樣、我們來到羅馬。

Acts 28:15 And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
使徒行傳 28:15 那裏的弟兄們、一聽見我們的信息、就出來到亞比烏市、和三館地方迎接我們．保羅見了他們、就感謝 神、放心壯膽。

Acts 28:16 And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
使徒行傳 28:16 進了羅馬城、保羅蒙准、和一個看守他的兵、另住在一處。

Acts 28:17 And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
使徒行傳 28:17 過了三天、保羅請猶太人的首領來．他們來了、就對他們說、弟兄們、我雖沒有作甚麼事干犯本國的百姓、和我們祖宗的規條、卻被鎖綁、從耶路撒冷解在羅馬人的手裏。

Acts 28:18 Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.
使徒行傳 28:18 他們審問了我、就願意釋放我．因爲在我身上、並沒有該死的罪。

Acts 28:19 But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Cesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.
使徒行傳 28:19 無奈猶太人不服、我不得已、只好上告於該撒．並非有甚麼事、要控告我本國的百姓。

Acts 28:20 For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
使徒行傳 28:20 因此、我請你們來見面說話．我原爲以色列人所指望的、被這鍊子捆鎖。

Acts 28:21 And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.
使徒行傳 28:21 他們說、我們並沒有接着從猶太來論你的信、也沒有弟兄到這裏來、報給我們說、你有甚麼不好處。

Acts 28:22 But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.
使徒行傳 28:22 但我們願意聽你的意見如何．因爲這教門、我們曉得是到處被毀謗的。

Acts 28:23 And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
使徒行傳 28:23 他們和保羅約定了日子、就有許多人到他的寓處來、保羅從早到晚、對他們講論這事、證明 神國的道、引摩西的律法和先知的書、以耶穌的事、勸勉他們。

Acts 28:24 And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.
使徒行傳 28:24 他所說的話、有信的、有不信的。

Acts 28:25 And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
使徒行傳 28:25 他們彼此不合、就散了．未散以先、保羅說了一句話、說、聖靈藉先知以賽亞、向你們祖宗所說的話、是不錯的。

Acts 28:26 Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:
使徒行傳 28:26 他說、『〡你去告訴這百姓說、你們聽是要聽見、卻不明白．看是要看見、卻不曉得．

Acts 28:27 For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
使徒行傳 28:27 因爲這百姓、油蒙了心、耳朶發沉、眼睛閉着．恐怕眼睛看見、耳朶聽見、心裏明白、回轉過來、我就醫治他們。』

Acts 28:28 Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
使徒行傳 28:28 所以你們當知道、 神這救恩、如今傳給外邦人、他們也必聽受。

Acts 28:30 And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,
使徒行傳 28:30 保羅在自己所租的房子裏、住了足足兩年。凡來見他的人、他全都接待、

Acts 28:31 Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
使徒行傳 28:31 放膽傳講 神國的道、將主耶穌基督的事教導人、並沒有人禁止。 :28a〡賽六 〩 〡十 羅馬書]] 1925

## Romans / 羅馬書

Romans 1:1 Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
羅馬書 1:1 耶穌基督的僕人保羅、奉召爲使徒、特派傳 神的福音．

Romans 1:2 (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
羅馬書 1:2 這福音是 神從前藉衆先知、在聖經上所應許的、

Romans 1:3 Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
羅馬書 1:3 論到他兒子我主耶穌基督．按肉體說、是從大衞後裔生的、

Romans 1:4 And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
羅馬書 1:4 按聖善的靈說、因從死裏復活、以大能顯明是 神的兒子。

Romans 1:5 By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
羅馬書 1:5 我們從他受了恩惠、並使徒的職分、在萬國之中叫人爲他的名信服眞道．

Romans 1:6 Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
羅馬書 1:6 其中也有你們這蒙召屬耶穌基督的人。

Romans 1:7 To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
羅馬書 1:7 我寫信給你們在羅馬爲 神所愛、奉召作聖徒的衆人。願恩惠平安、從我們的父 神、並主耶穌基督、歸與你們。

Romans 1:8 First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
羅馬書 1:8 第一、我靠着耶穌基督、爲你們衆人感謝我的 神．因你們的信德傳遍了天下。

Romans 1:9 For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
羅馬書 1:9 我在他兒子福音上、用心靈所事奉的 神、可以見證我怎樣不住的題到你們、

Romans 1:10 Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
羅馬書 1:10 在禱告之間、常常懇求、或者照 神的旨意、終能得平坦的道路往你們那裏去。

Romans 1:11 For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
羅馬書 1:11 因爲我切切的想見你們、要把些屬靈的恩賜分給你們、使你們可以堅固．

Romans 1:12 That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
羅馬書 1:12 這樣我在你們中間、因你與我彼此的信心、就可以同得安慰。

Romans 1:13 Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
羅馬書 1:13 弟兄們、我不願意你們不知道、我屢次定意往你們那裏去、要在你們中間得些果子、如同在其餘的外邦人中一樣．只是到如今仍有阻隔。

Romans 1:14 I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
羅馬書 1:14 無論是希利尼人、化外人、聰明人、愚拙人、我都欠他們的債。

Romans 1:15 So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
羅馬書 1:15 所以情願盡我的力量、將福音也傳給你們在羅馬的人。

Romans 1:16 For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
羅馬書 1:16 我不以福音爲恥．這福音本是 神的大能、要救一切相信的、先是猶太人、後是希利尼人。

Romans 1:17 For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
羅馬書 1:17 因爲 神的義、正在這福音上顯明出來．這義是本於信、以致於信．如經上所記、『〡義人必因信得生。』

Romans 1:18 For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
羅馬書 1:18 原來 神的忿怒、從天上顯明在一切不虔不義的人身上、就是那些行不義阻擋眞理的人。

Romans 1:19 Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
羅馬書 1:19 神的事情、人所能知道的、原顯明在人心裏．因爲 神已經給他們顯明。

Romans 1:20 For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
羅馬書 1:20 自從造天地以來、 神的永能和神性是明明可知的、雖是眼不能見、但藉着所造之物、就可以曉得、叫人無可推諉．

Romans 1:21 Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
羅馬書 1:21 因爲他們雖然知道 神、卻不當作 神榮耀他、也不感謝他．他們的思念變爲虛妄、無知的心就昏暗了．

Romans 1:22 Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
羅馬書 1:22 自稱爲聰明、反成了愚拙、

Romans 1:23 And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
羅馬書 1:23 將不能朽壞之 神的榮耀、變爲偶像、彷彿必朽壞的人、和飛禽走獸昆蟲的樣式。

Romans 1:24 Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
羅馬書 1:24 所以 神任憑他們、逞着心裏的情慾行汚穢的事、以致彼此玷辱自己的身體。

Romans 1:25 Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
羅馬書 1:25 他們將 神的眞實變爲虛謊、去敬拜事奉受造之物、不敬奉那造物的主．主乃是可稱頌的、直到永遠。阿們。

Romans 1:26 For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
羅馬書 1:26 因此 神任憑他們放縱可羞恥的情慾．他們的女人、把順性的用處、變爲逆性的用處．

Romans 1:27 And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
羅馬書 1:27 男人也是如此、棄了女人順性的用處、慾火攻心、彼此貪戀、男和男行可羞恥的事、就在自己身上受這妄爲當得的報應。

Romans 1:28 And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
羅馬書 1:28 他們旣然故意不認識 神、 神就任憑他們存邪僻的心、行那些不合理的事．

Romans 1:29 Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
羅馬書 1:29 裝滿了各樣不義、邪惡、貪婪、惡毒．滿心是嫉妒、凶殺、爭競、詭詐、毒恨．

Romans 1:30 Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
羅馬書 1:30 又是讒毀的、背後說人的、怨恨 神的、侮慢人的、狂傲的、自誇的、捏造惡事的、違背父母的、

Romans 1:31 Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
羅馬書 1:31 無知的、背約的、無親情的、不憐憫人的．

Romans 1:32 Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
羅馬書 1:32 他們雖知道 神判定、行這樣事的人是當死的、然而他們不但自己去行、還喜歡別人去行。 :1a〡哈二 〤

Romans 2:1 Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
羅馬書 2:1 你這論斷人的、無論你是誰、也無可推諉、你在甚麼事上論斷人、就在甚麼事上定自己的罪．因你這論斷人的、自己所行卻和別人一樣。

Romans 2:2 But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
羅馬書 2:2 我們知道這樣行的人、 神必照眞理審判他。

Romans 2:3 And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
羅馬書 2:3 你這人哪、你論斷行這樣事的人、自己所行的卻和別人一樣、你以爲能逃脫 神的審判麼。

Romans 2:4 Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
羅馬書 2:4 還是你藐視他豐富的恩慈、寬容、忍耐、不曉得他的恩慈是領你悔改呢．

Romans 2:5 But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
羅馬書 2:5 你竟任着你剛硬不悔改的心、爲自己積蓄忿怒、以致 神震怒、顯他公義審判的日子來到。

Romans 2:6 Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
羅馬書 2:6 他必照各人的行爲報應各人．

Romans 2:7 To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
羅馬書 2:7 凡恆心行善、尋求榮耀尊貴、和不能朽壞之福的、就以永生報應他們．

Romans 2:8 But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
羅馬書 2:8 惟有結黨不順從眞理、反順從不義的、就以忿怒惱恨報應他們．

Romans 2:9 Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
羅馬書 2:9 將患難、困苦、加給一切作惡的人、先是猶太人、後是希利尼人．

Romans 2:10 But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
羅馬書 2:10 卻將榮耀、尊貴、平安、加給一切行善的人、先是猶太人、後是希利尼人．

Romans 2:11 For there is no respect of persons with God.
羅馬書 2:11 因爲 神不偏待人。

Romans 2:12 For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
羅馬書 2:12 凡沒有律法犯了罪的、也必不按律法滅亡．凡在律法以下犯了罪的、也必按律法受審判、

Romans 2:13 (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
羅馬書 2:13 （原來在 神面前、不是聽律法的爲義、乃是行律法的稱義．

Romans 2:14 For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
羅馬書 2:14 沒有律法的外邦人、若順着本性行律法上的事、他們雖然沒有律法、自己就是自己的律法．

Romans 2:15 Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
羅馬書 2:15 這是顯出律法的功用刻在他們心裏、他們是非之心同作見證、並且他們的思念互相較量、或以爲是、或以爲非）

Romans 2:16 In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
羅馬書 2:16 就在 神藉耶穌基督審判人隱祕事的日子、照着我的福音所言。

Romans 2:17 Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
羅馬書 2:17 你稱爲猶太人、又倚靠律法、且指着 神誇口．

Romans 2:18 And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
羅馬書 2:18 旣從律法中受了教訓、就曉得 神的旨意、也能分別是非、

Romans 2:19 And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
羅馬書 2:19 又深信自己是給瞎子領路的、是黑暗中人的光、

Romans 2:20 An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
羅馬書 2:20 是蠢笨人的師傅、是小孩子的先生、在律法上有知識和眞理的模範。

Romans 2:21 Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
羅馬書 2:21 你旣是教導別人、還不教導自己麼．你講說人不可偷竊、自己還偷竊麼．

Romans 2:22 Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
羅馬書 2:22 你說人不可姦淫、自己還姦淫麼．你厭惡偶像、自己還偷竊廟中之物麼．

Romans 2:23 Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
羅馬書 2:23 你指着律法誇口、自己倒犯律法、玷辱 神麼。

Romans 2:24 For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
羅馬書 2:24 〡 神的名在外邦人中、因你們受了褻瀆、正如經上所記的。

Romans 2:25 For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
羅馬書 2:25 你若是行律法的、割禮固然於你有益．若是犯律法的、你的割禮就算不得割禮。

Romans 2:26 Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
羅馬書 2:26 所以那未受割禮的、若遵守律法的條例、他雖然未受割禮、豈不算是有割禮麼。

Romans 2:27 And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
羅馬書 2:27 而且那本來未受割禮的、若能全守律法、豈不是要審判你這有儀文和割禮竟犯律法的人麼。

Romans 2:28 For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
羅馬書 2:28 因爲外面作猶太人的、不是眞猶太人、外面肉身的割禮、也不是眞割禮．

Romans 2:29 But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
羅馬書 2:29 惟有裏面作的、纔是眞猶太人．眞割禮也是心裏的、在乎靈不在乎儀文．這人的稱讚、不是從人來的、乃是從 神來的。 :2a〡賽五十二 〥

Romans 3:1 What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
羅馬書 3:1 這樣說來、猶太人有甚麼長處、割禮有甚麼益處呢．

Romans 3:2 Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
羅馬書 3:2 凡事大有好處．第一是 神的聖言交託他們。

Romans 3:3 For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
羅馬書 3:3 卽便有不信的、這有何妨呢．難道他們的不信、就廢掉 神的信麼。

Romans 3:4 God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
羅馬書 3:4 斷乎不能．不如說、 神是眞實的、人都是虛謊的．如經上所記、『〡你責備人的時候、顯爲公義．被人議論的時候、可以得勝。』

Romans 3:5 But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
羅馬書 3:5 我且照着人的常話說、我們的不義、若顯出 神的義來、我們可以怎麼說呢． 神降怒、是他不義麼．

Romans 3:6 God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
羅馬書 3:6 斷乎不是．若是這樣、 神怎能審判世界呢。

Romans 3:7 For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
羅馬書 3:7 若 神的眞實、因我的虛謊、越發顯出他的榮耀、爲甚麼我還受審判、好像罪人呢。

Romans 3:8 And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
羅馬書 3:8 爲甚麼不說、我們可以作惡以成善呢、這是毀謗我們的人、說我們有這話．這等人定罪、是該當的。

Romans 3:9 What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
羅馬書 3:9 這卻怎麼樣呢．我們比他們強麼．決不是的．因我們已經證明、猶太人和希利尼人都在罪惡之下．

Romans 3:10 As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
羅馬書 3:10 就如經上所記、『〢沒有義人、連一個也沒有．

Romans 3:11 There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
羅馬書 3:11 沒有明白的、沒有尋求 神的．

Romans 3:12 They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
羅馬書 3:12 都是偏離正路、一同變爲無用．沒有行善的、連一個也沒有。

Romans 3:13 Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
羅馬書 3:13 〣他們的喉嚨是敞開的墳墓．他們用舌頭弄詭詐．〤嘴唇裏有虺蛇的毒氣．

Romans 3:14 Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
羅馬書 3:14 〥滿口是咒罵苦毒．

Romans 3:15 Their feet are swift to shed blood:
羅馬書 3:15 〦殺人流血他們的脚飛跑．

Romans 3:16 Destruction and misery are in their ways:
羅馬書 3:16 所經過的路、便行殘害暴虐的事．

Romans 3:17 And the way of peace have they not known:
羅馬書 3:17 平安的路、他們未曾知道．

Romans 3:18 There is no fear of God before their eyes.
羅馬書 3:18 〧他們眼中不怕 神。』

Romans 3:19 Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
羅馬書 3:19 我們曉得律法上的話、都是對律法以下之人說的、好塞住各人的口、叫普世的人都伏在 神審判之下．

Romans 3:20 Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
羅馬書 3:20 所以凡有血氣的沒有一個、因行律法、能在 神面前稱義．因爲律法本是叫人知罪。

Romans 3:21 But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
羅馬書 3:21 但如今 神的義在律法以外已經顯明出來、有律法和先知爲證．

Romans 3:22 Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
羅馬書 3:22 就是 神的義、因信耶穌基督、加給一切相信的人、並沒有分別．

Romans 3:23 For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
羅馬書 3:23 因爲世人都犯了罪、虧缺了 神的榮耀。

Romans 3:24 Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
羅馬書 3:24 如今卻蒙 神的恩典、因基督耶穌的救贖、就白白的稱義。

Romans 3:25 Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
羅馬書 3:25 神設立耶穌作挽回祭、是憑着耶穌的血、藉着人的信、要顯明 神的義．因爲他用忍耐的心、寬容人先時所犯的罪．

Romans 3:26 To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
羅馬書 3:26 好在今時顯明他的義、使人知道他自己爲義、也稱信耶穌的人爲義。

Romans 3:27 Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
羅馬書 3:27 旣是這樣、那裏能誇口呢．沒有可誇的了。用何法沒有的呢、是用立功之法麼．不是、乃用信主之法。

Romans 3:28 Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
羅馬書 3:28 所以我們看定了、人稱義是因着信、不在乎遵行律法。

Romans 3:29 Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
羅馬書 3:29 難道 神只作猶太人的 神麼．不也是作外邦人的 神麼．是的、也作外邦人的 神。

Romans 3:30 Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
羅馬書 3:30 神旣是一位、他就要因信稱那受割禮的爲義、也要因信稱那未受割禮的爲義。

Romans 3:31 Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
羅馬書 3:31 這樣、我們因信廢了律法麼．斷乎不是、更是堅固律法。 :3a〡詩五十一 〤 :3b〢詩十四 〡至〣 五十三 〡至〣 :3c〣詩五 〩 :3d〤詩百四十 〣 :3e〥詩十 〧 :3f〦賽五十九 〧 〨 :3g〧詩三十六 〡

Romans 4:1 What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
羅馬書 4:1 如此說來、我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕、憑着肉體得了甚麼呢。

Romans 4:2 For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
羅馬書 4:2 倘若亞伯拉罕是因行爲稱義、就有可誇的．只是在 神面前並無可誇。

Romans 4:3 For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
羅馬書 4:3 經上說甚麼呢．說、『〡亞伯拉罕信 神、這就算爲他的義。』

Romans 4:4 Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
羅馬書 4:4 作工的得工價、不算恩典、乃是該得的、

Romans 4:5 But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
羅馬書 4:5 惟有不作工的、只信稱罪人爲義的 神、他的信就算爲義。

Romans 4:6 Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
羅馬書 4:6 正如大衞稱那在行爲以外、蒙 神算爲義的人是有福的。

Romans 4:7 Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
羅馬書 4:7 他說、『〢得赦免其過、遮蓋其罪的、這人是有福的。

Romans 4:8 Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
羅馬書 4:8 主不算爲有罪的、這人是有福的。』

Romans 4:9 Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
羅馬書 4:9 如此看來、這福是單加給那受割禮的人麼．不也是加給那未受割禮的人麼．因我們所說、亞伯拉罕的信、就算爲他的義。

Romans 4:10 How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
羅馬書 4:10 是怎麼算的呢．是在他受割禮的時候呢．是在他未受割禮的時候呢．不是在受割禮的時候、乃是在未受割禮的時候。

Romans 4:11 And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
羅馬書 4:11 並且他受了割禮的記號、作他未受割禮的時候因信稱義的印證、叫他作一切未受割禮而信之人的父、使他們也算爲義．

Romans 4:12 And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
羅馬書 4:12 又作受割禮之人的父、就是那些不但受割禮、並且按我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕、未受割禮而信之蹤跡去行的人。

Romans 4:13 For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
羅馬書 4:13 因爲 神應許亞伯拉罕和他後裔、必得承受世界、不是因律法、乃是因信而得的義。

Romans 4:14 For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
羅馬書 4:14 若是屬乎律法的人、纔得爲後嗣、信就歸於虛空、應許也就廢棄了。

Romans 4:15 Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
羅馬書 4:15 因爲律法是惹動忿怒的．那裏沒有律法、那裏就沒有過犯。

Romans 4:16 Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
羅馬書 4:16 所以人得爲後嗣是本乎信．因此就屬乎恩．叫應許定然歸給一切後裔．不但歸給那屬乎律法的、也歸給那效法亞伯拉罕之信的。

Romans 4:17 (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
羅馬書 4:17 亞伯拉罕所信的、是那叫死人復活使無變爲有的 神、他在主面前作我們世人的父．如經上所記、『〣我已經立你作多國的父。』

Romans 4:18 Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
羅馬書 4:18 他在無可指望的時候、因信仍有指望、就得以作多國的父、正如先前所說、『〤你的後裔將要如此。』

Romans 4:19 And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah's womb:
羅馬書 4:19 他將近百歲的時候、雖然想到自己的身體如同已死、撒拉的生育已經斷絕、他的信心還是不輭弱．

Romans 4:20 He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
羅馬書 4:20 並且仰望 神的應許、總沒有因不信、心裏起疑惑．反倒因信、心裏得堅固、將榮耀歸給 神。

Romans 4:21 And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
羅馬書 4:21 且滿心相信、 神所應許的必能作成．

Romans 4:22 And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
羅馬書 4:22 所以這就算爲他的義。

Romans 4:23 Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
羅馬書 4:23 算爲他義的這句話、不是單爲他寫的、

Romans 4:24 But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
羅馬書 4:24 也是爲我們將來得算爲義之人寫的．就是我們這信 神使我們的主耶穌從死裏復活的人。

Romans 4:25 Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
羅馬書 4:25 耶穌被交給人、是爲我們的過犯、復活、是爲叫我們稱義。 :4a〡創十五 〦 :4b〢詩三十二 〡 〢 :4c〣創十七 〥 :4d〤創十五 〥

Romans 5:1 Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
羅馬書 5:1 我們旣因信稱義、就藉着我們的主耶穌基督、得與 神相和。

Romans 5:2 By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
羅馬書 5:2 我們又藉着他、因信得進入現在所站的這恩典中、並且歡歡喜喜盼望 神的榮耀。

Romans 5:3 And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
羅馬書 5:3 不但如此、就是在患難中、也是歡歡喜喜的．因爲知道患難生忍耐．

Romans 5:4 And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
羅馬書 5:4 忍耐生老練．老練生盼望．

Romans 5:5 And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
羅馬書 5:5 盼望不至於羞恥．因爲所賜給我們的聖靈、將 神的愛澆灌在我們心裏。

Romans 5:6 For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
羅馬書 5:6 因我們還輭弱的時候、基督就按所定的日期爲罪人死。

Romans 5:7 For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
羅馬書 5:7 爲義人死、是少有的、爲仁人死、或者有敢作的。

Romans 5:8 But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
羅馬書 5:8 惟有基督在我們還作罪人的時候爲我們死、 神的愛就在此向我們顯明了。

Romans 5:9 Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
羅馬書 5:9 現在我們旣靠着他的血稱義、就更要藉着他免去 神的忿怒。

Romans 5:10 For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
羅馬書 5:10 因爲我們作仇敵的時候、且藉着 神兒子的死、得與 神和好、旣已和好、就更要因他的生得救了。

Romans 5:11 And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
羅馬書 5:11 不但如此、我們旣藉着我主耶穌基督、得與 神和好、也就藉着他、以 神爲樂。

Romans 5:12 Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
羅馬書 5:12 這就如罪是從一人入了世界、死又是從罪來的、於是死就臨到衆人、因爲衆人都犯了罪。

Romans 5:13 (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
羅馬書 5:13 沒有律法之先、罪已經在世上．但沒有律法、罪也不算罪。

Romans 5:14 Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
羅馬書 5:14 然而從亞當到摩西死就作了王、連那些不與亞當犯一樣罪過的、也在他的權下．亞當乃是那以後要來之人的豫像。

Romans 5:15 But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
羅馬書 5:15 只是過犯不如恩賜．若因一人的過犯、衆人都死了、何况 神的恩典、與那因耶穌基督一人恩典中的賞賜、豈不更加倍的臨到衆人麼。

Romans 5:16 And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
羅馬書 5:16 因一人犯罪就定罪、也不如恩賜．原來審判是由一人而定罪、恩賜乃是由許多過犯而稱義。

Romans 5:17 For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
羅馬書 5:17 若因一人的過犯、死就因這一人作了王、何况那些受洪恩又蒙所賜之義的、豈不更要因耶穌基督一人在生命中作王麼。

Romans 5:18 Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
羅馬書 5:18 如此說來、因一次的過犯、衆人都被定罪、照樣、因一次的義行、衆人也就被稱義得生命了。

Romans 5:19 For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
羅馬書 5:19 因一人的悖逆、衆人成爲罪人、照樣、因一人的順從、衆人也成爲義了。

Romans 5:20 Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
羅馬書 5:20 律法本是外添的、叫過犯顯多．只是罪在那裏顯多、恩典就更顯多了。

Romans 5:21 That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
羅馬書 5:21 就如罪作王叫人死、照樣、恩典也藉着義作王、叫人因我們的主耶穌基督得永生。

Romans 6:1 What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
羅馬書 6:1 這樣、怎麼說呢．我們可以仍在罪中、叫恩典顯多麼。

Romans 6:2 God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
羅馬書 6:2 斷乎不可．我們在罪上死了的人、豈可仍在罪中活着呢。

Romans 6:3 Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
羅馬書 6:3 豈不知我們這受洗歸入基督耶穌的人、是受洗歸入他的死麼。

Romans 6:4 Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
羅馬書 6:4 所以我們藉着洗禮歸入死、和他一同埋葬．原是叫我們一舉一動有新生的樣式、像基督藉着父的榮耀、從死裏復活一樣。

Romans 6:5 For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
羅馬書 6:5 我們若在他死的形狀上與他聯合、也要在他復活的形狀上與他聯合．

Romans 6:6 Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
羅馬書 6:6 因爲知道我們的舊人、和他同釘十字架、使罪身滅絕、叫我們不再作罪的奴僕．

Romans 6:7 For he that is dead is freed from sin.
羅馬書 6:7 因爲已死的人、是脫離了罪。

Romans 6:8 Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
羅馬書 6:8 我們若是與基督同死、就信必與他同活．

Romans 6:9 Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
羅馬書 6:9 因爲知道基督旣從死裏復活、就不再死、死也不再作他的主了。

Romans 6:10 For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
羅馬書 6:10 他死是向罪死了、只有一次．他活是向 神活着。

Romans 6:11 Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
羅馬書 6:11 這樣、你們向罪也當看自己是死的．向 神在基督耶穌裏、卻當看自己是活的。

Romans 6:12 Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
羅馬書 6:12 所以不要容罪在你們必死的身上作王、使你們順從身子的私慾．

Romans 6:13 Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
羅馬書 6:13 也不要將你們的肢體獻給罪作不義的器具．倒要像從死裏復活的人、將自己獻給 神．並將肢體作義的器具獻給 神。

Romans 6:14 For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
羅馬書 6:14 罪必不能作你們的主．因你們不在律法之下、乃在恩典之下。

Romans 6:15 What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
羅馬書 6:15 這卻怎麼樣呢．我們在恩典之下、不在律法之下、就可以犯罪麼．斷乎不可。

Romans 6:16 Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
羅馬書 6:16 豈不曉得你們獻上自己作奴僕、順從誰、就作誰的奴僕麼．或作罪的奴僕、以至於死．或作順命的奴僕、以至成義。

Romans 6:17 But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
羅馬書 6:17 感謝 神、因爲你們從前雖然作罪的奴僕、現今卻從心裏順服了所傳給你們道理的模範。

Romans 6:18 Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
羅馬書 6:18 你們旣從罪裏得了釋放、就作了義的奴僕。

Romans 6:19 I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
羅馬書 6:19 我因你們肉體的輭弱、就照人的常話對你們說、你們從前怎樣將肢體獻給不潔不法作奴僕、以至於不法．現今也要照樣將肢體獻給義作奴僕、以至於成聖．

Romans 6:20 For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
羅馬書 6:20 因爲你們作罪之奴僕的時候、就不被義約束了。

Romans 6:21 What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
羅馬書 6:21 你們現今所看爲羞恥的事、當日有甚麼果子呢．那些事的結局就是死。

Romans 6:22 But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
羅馬書 6:22 但現今你們旣從罪裏得了釋放、作了 神的奴僕、就有成聖的果子、那結局就是永生。

Romans 6:23 For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
羅馬書 6:23 因爲罪的工價乃是死．惟有 神的恩賜、在我們的主基督耶穌裏、乃是永生。

Romans 7:1 Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
羅馬書 7:1 弟兄們、我現在對明白律法的人說、你們豈不曉得律法管人是在活着的時候麼。

Romans 7:2 For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
羅馬書 7:2 就如女人有了丈夫、丈夫還活着、就被律法約束．丈夫若死了、就脫離了丈夫的律法。

Romans 7:3 So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
羅馬書 7:3 所以丈夫活着、他若歸於別人、便叫淫婦．丈夫若死了、他就脫離了丈夫的律法、雖然歸於別人、也不是淫婦。

Romans 7:4 Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
羅馬書 7:4 我的弟兄們、這樣說來、你們藉着基督的身體、在律法上也是死了．叫你們歸於別人、就是歸於那從死裏復活的、叫我們結果子給 神。

Romans 7:5 For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
羅馬書 7:5 因爲我們屬肉體的時候、那因律法而生的惡慾、就在我們肢體中發動、以致結成死亡的果子．

Romans 7:6 But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
羅馬書 7:6 但我們旣然在捆我們的律法上死了、現今就脫離了律法．叫我們服事主、要按着心靈的新樣、不按着儀文的舊樣。

Romans 7:7 What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
羅馬書 7:7 這樣、我們可說甚麼呢．律法是罪麼．斷乎不是．只是非因律法、我就不知何爲罪．非律法說、『〡不可起貪心。』我就不知何爲貪心。

Romans 7:8 But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
羅馬書 7:8 然而罪趁着機會、就藉着誡命叫諸般的貪心在我裏頭發動．因爲沒有律法罪是死的。

Romans 7:9 For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
羅馬書 7:9 我以前沒有律法是活着的、但是誡命來到、罪又活了、我就死了。

Romans 7:10 And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
羅馬書 7:10 那本來叫人活的誡命、反倒叫我死．

Romans 7:11 For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
羅馬書 7:11 因爲罪趁着機會、就藉着誡命引誘我、並且殺了我。

Romans 7:12 Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
羅馬書 7:12 這樣看來、律法是聖潔的、誡命也是聖潔、公義、良善的。

Romans 7:13 Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
羅馬書 7:13 旣然如此、那良善的是叫我死麼．斷乎不是．叫我死的乃是罪。但罪藉着那良善的叫我死、就顯出眞是罪．叫罪因着誡命更顯出是惡極了。

Romans 7:14 For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
羅馬書 7:14 我們原曉得律法是屬乎靈的、但我是屬乎肉體的、是已經賣給罪了。

Romans 7:15 For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
羅馬書 7:15 因爲我所作的、我自己不明白．我所願意的、我並不作．我所恨惡的、我倒去作。

Romans 7:16 If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
羅馬書 7:16 若我所作的、是我所不願意的、我就應承律法是善的。

Romans 7:17 Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
羅馬書 7:17 旣是這樣、就不是我作的、乃是住在我裏頭的罪作的。

Romans 7:18 For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
羅馬書 7:18 我也知道、在我裏頭、就是我肉體之中、沒有良善．因爲立志爲善由得我、只是行出來由不得我。

Romans 7:19 For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
羅馬書 7:19 故此、我所願意的善、我反不作．我所不願意的惡、我倒去作。

Romans 7:20 Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
羅馬書 7:20 若我去作所不願意作的、就不是我作的、乃是住在我裏頭的罪作的。

Romans 7:21 I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
羅馬書 7:21 我覺得有個律、就是我願意爲善的時候、便有惡與我同在。

Romans 7:22 For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
羅馬書 7:22 因爲按着我裏面的意思。我是喜歡 神的律．

Romans 7:23 But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
羅馬書 7:23 但我覺得肢體中另有個律、和我心中的律交戰、把我擄去叫我附從那肢體中犯罪的律。

Romans 7:24 O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
羅馬書 7:24 我眞是苦阿、誰能救我脫離這取死的身體呢。

Romans 7:25 I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
羅馬書 7:25 感謝 神、靠着我們的主耶穌基督就能脫離了。這樣看來、我以內心順服 神的律．我肉體卻順服罪的律了。 :7a〡出二十 〡〧 申五 〢一

Romans 8:1 There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
羅馬書 8:1 如今那些在基督耶穌裏的、就不定罪了。

Romans 8:2 For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
羅馬書 8:2 因爲賜生命聖靈的律、在基督耶穌裏釋放了我、使我脫離罪和死的律了。

Romans 8:3 For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
羅馬書 8:3 律法旣因肉體輭弱、有所不能行的、 神就差遣自己的兒子、成爲罪身的形狀、作了〡贖罪祭、在肉體中定了罪案．

Romans 8:4 That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
羅馬書 8:4 使律法的義、成就在我們這不隨從肉體、只隨從聖靈的人身上。

Romans 8:5 For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
羅馬書 8:5 因爲隨從肉體的人、體貼肉體的事．隨從聖靈的人、體貼聖靈的事。

Romans 8:6 For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
羅馬書 8:6 體貼肉體的就是死．體貼聖靈的乃是生命平安．

Romans 8:7 Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
羅馬書 8:7 原來體貼肉體的、就是與 神爲仇．因爲不服 神的律法、也是不能服。

Romans 8:8 So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
羅馬書 8:8 而且屬肉體的人、不能得 神的喜歡。

Romans 8:9 But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
羅馬書 8:9 如果 神的靈住在你們心裏、你們就不屬肉體、乃屬聖靈了．人若沒有基督的靈、就不是屬基督的。

Romans 8:10 And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
羅馬書 8:10 基督若在你們心裏、身體就因罪而死、心靈卻因義而活．

Romans 8:11 But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
羅馬書 8:11 然而叫耶穌從死裏復活者的靈、若住在你們心裏、那叫基督耶穌從死裏復活的、也必藉着住在你們心裏的聖靈、使你們必死的身體又活過來。

Romans 8:12 Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
羅馬書 8:12 弟兄們、這樣看來、我們並不是欠肉體的債、去順從肉體活着。

Romans 8:13 For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
羅馬書 8:13 你們若順從肉體活着必要死．若靠着聖靈治死身體的惡行必要活着。

Romans 8:14 For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
羅馬書 8:14 因爲凡被 神的靈引導的、都是 神的兒子。

Romans 8:15 For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
羅馬書 8:15 你們所受的不是奴僕的心、仍舊害怕．所受的乃是兒子的心、因此我們呼叫阿爸、父。

Romans 8:16 The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
羅馬書 8:16 聖靈與我們的心同證我們是 神的兒女．

Romans 8:17 And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
羅馬書 8:17 旣是兒女、便是後嗣、就是 神的後嗣、和基督同作後嗣．如果我們和他一同受苦、也必和他一同得榮耀。

Romans 8:18 For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
羅馬書 8:18 我想現在的苦楚、若比起將來要顯於我們的榮耀、就不足介意了。

Romans 8:19 For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
羅馬書 8:19 受造之物、切望等候 神的衆子顯出來。

Romans 8:20 For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
羅馬書 8:20 因爲受造之物服在虛空之下、不是自己願意、乃是因那叫他如此的。

Romans 8:21 Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
羅馬書 8:21 但受造之物仍然指望脫離敗壞的轄制、得享 神兒女自由的榮耀。

Romans 8:22 For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
羅馬書 8:22 我們知道一切受造之物、一同歎息勞苦、直到如今。

Romans 8:23 And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
羅馬書 8:23 不但如此、就是我們這有聖靈初結果子的、也是自己心裏歎息、等候得着兒子的名分、乃是我們的身體得贖。

Romans 8:24 For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
羅馬書 8:24 我們得救是在乎盼望．只是所見的盼望不是盼望．誰還盼望他所見的呢。

Romans 8:25 But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
羅馬書 8:25 但我們若盼望那所不見的、就必忍耐等候。

Romans 8:26 Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
羅馬書 8:26 况且我們的輭弱有聖靈幫助、我們本不曉得當怎樣禱告、只是聖靈親自用說不出來的歎息、替我們禱告。

Romans 8:27 And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
羅馬書 8:27 鑒察人心的、曉得聖靈的意思．因爲聖靈照着 神的旨意替聖徒祈求。

Romans 8:28 And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
羅馬書 8:28 我們曉得萬事都互相効力、叫愛 神的人得益處、就是按他旨意被召的人。

Romans 8:29 For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
羅馬書 8:29 因爲他豫先所知道的人、就豫先定下效法他兒子的模樣使他兒子在許多弟兄中作長子．

Romans 8:30 Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
羅馬書 8:30 豫先所定下的人又召他們來．所召來的人、又稱他們爲義．所稱爲義的人、又叫他們得榮耀。

Romans 8:31 What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
羅馬書 8:31 旣是這樣、還有甚麼說的呢． 神若幫助我們、誰能敵擋我們呢。

Romans 8:32 He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
羅馬書 8:32 神旣不愛惜自己的兒子爲我們衆人捨了、豈不也把萬物和他一同白白的賜給我們麼。

Romans 8:33 Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
羅馬書 8:33 誰能控告 神所揀選的人呢．有 神稱他們爲義了。

Romans 8:34 Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
羅馬書 8:34 誰能定他們的罪呢．有基督耶穌已經死了、而且從死裏復活、現今在 神的右邊、也替我們祈求。

Romans 8:35 Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
羅馬書 8:35 誰能使我們與基督的愛隔絕呢．難道是患難麼、是困苦麼、是逼迫麼、是飢餓麼、是赤身露體麼、是危險麼、是刀劍麼。

Romans 8:36 As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
羅馬書 8:36 如經上所記、『〢我們爲你的緣故、終日被殺．人看我們如將宰的羊。』

Romans 8:37 Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
羅馬書 8:37 然而靠着愛我們的主、在這一切的事上、已經得勝有餘了。

Romans 8:38 For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
羅馬書 8:38 因爲我深信無論是死、是生、是天使、是掌權的、是有能的、是現在的事、是將來的事、

Romans 8:39 Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
羅馬書 8:39 是高處的、是低處的、是別的受造之物、都不能叫我們與 神的愛隔絕．這愛是在我們的主基督耶穌裏的。 :8a〡利七 〣〧 :8b〢詩四十四 〢二

Romans 9:1 I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
羅馬書 9:1 我在基督裏說眞話、並不謊言、有我良心被聖靈感動、給我作見證．

Romans 9:2 That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
羅馬書 9:2 我是大有憂愁、心裏時常傷痛。

Romans 9:3 For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
羅馬書 9:3 爲我弟兄、我骨肉之親、就是自己被咒詛、與基督分離、我也願意。

Romans 9:4 Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
羅馬書 9:4 他們是以色列人．那兒子的名分、榮耀、諸約、律法、禮儀、應許、都是他們的．

Romans 9:5 Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
羅馬書 9:5 列祖就是他們的祖宗、按肉體說、基督也是從他們出來的、他是在萬有之上、永遠可稱頌的 神。阿們。

Romans 9:6 Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
羅馬書 9:6 這不是說 神的話落了空．因爲從以色列生的、不都是以色列人．

Romans 9:7 Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
羅馬書 9:7 也不因爲是亞伯拉罕的後裔、就都作他的兒女．惟獨『〡從以撒生的、纔要稱爲你的後裔。』

Romans 9:8 That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
羅馬書 9:8 這就是說、肉身所生的兒女、不是 神的兒女．惟獨那應許的兒女、纔算是後裔。

Romans 9:9 For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
羅馬書 9:9 因爲所應許的話是這樣說、『〢到明年這時候我要來、撒拉必生一個兒子。』

Romans 9:10 And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
羅馬書 9:10 不但如此、還有利百加、旣從一個人、就是從我們的祖宗以撒懷了孕．

Romans 9:11 (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
羅馬書 9:11 （雙子還沒有生下來、善惡還沒有作出來、只因要顯明 神揀選人的旨意、不在乎人的行爲、乃在乎召人的主）

Romans 9:12 It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
羅馬書 9:12 神就對利百加說、『〣將來大的要服事小的。』

Romans 9:13 As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
羅馬書 9:13 正如經上所記、『〤雅各是我所愛的、以掃是我所惡的。』

Romans 9:14 What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
羅馬書 9:14 這樣、我們可說甚麼呢．難道 神有甚麼不公平麼．斷乎沒有。

Romans 9:15 For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
羅馬書 9:15 因他對摩西說、『〥我要憐憫誰、就憐憫誰、要恩待誰、就恩待誰。』

Romans 9:16 So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
羅馬書 9:16 據此看來、這不在乎那定意的、也不在乎那奔跑的、只在乎發憐憫的 神。

Romans 9:17 For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
羅馬書 9:17 因爲經上有話向法老說、『〦我將你興起來、特要在你身上彰顯我的權能、並要使我的名傳遍天下。』

Romans 9:18 Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
羅馬書 9:18 如此看來、 神要憐憫誰、就憐憫誰、要叫誰剛硬、就叫誰剛硬。

Romans 9:19 Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
羅馬書 9:19 這樣、你必對我說、他爲甚麼還指責人呢．有誰抗拒他的旨意呢。

Romans 9:20 Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
羅馬書 9:20 你這個人哪、你是誰、竟敢向 神強嘴呢．受造之物豈能對造他的說、你爲甚麼這樣造我呢。

Romans 9:21 Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
羅馬書 9:21 窰匠難道沒有權柄、從一團泥裏拿一塊作成貴重的器皿、又拿一塊作成卑賤的器皿麼。

Romans 9:22 What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
羅馬書 9:22 倘若 神要顯明他的忿怒、彰顯他的權能、就多多忍耐寬容那可怒豫備遭毀滅的器皿．

Romans 9:23 And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
羅馬書 9:23 又要將他豐盛的榮耀、彰顯在那蒙憐憫早豫備得榮耀的器皿上．

Romans 9:24 Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
羅馬書 9:24 這器皿就是我們被 神所召的、不但是從猶太人中、也是從外邦人中、這有甚麼不可呢。

Romans 9:25 As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
羅馬書 9:25 就像 神在何西阿書上說、『〧那本來不是我子民的、我要稱爲我的子民．本來不是蒙愛的、我要稱爲蒙愛的。

Romans 9:26 And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
羅馬書 9:26 〨從前在甚麼地方對他們說、你們不是我的子民、將來就在那裏稱他們爲永生 神的兒子。』

Romans 9:27 Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
羅馬書 9:27 以賽亞指着以色列人喊着說、『〩以色列人雖多如海沙、得救的不過是剩下的餘數．

Romans 9:28 For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
羅馬書 9:28 因爲主要在世上施行他的話、叫他的話都成全、速速的完結。』

Romans 9:29 And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
羅馬書 9:29 又如以賽亞先前說過、『〡十若不是萬軍之主給我們存留餘種、我們早已像所多瑪、蛾摩拉的樣子了。』

Romans 9:30 What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
羅馬書 9:30 這樣、我們可說甚麼呢．那本來不追求義的外邦人、反得了義、就是因信而得的義．

Romans 9:31 But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
羅馬書 9:31 但以色列人追求律法的義、反得不着律法的義。

Romans 9:32 Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
羅馬書 9:32 這是甚麼緣故呢．是因爲他們不憑着信心求、只憑着行爲求．他們正跌在那絆脚石上．

Romans 9:33 As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
羅馬書 9:33 就如經上所記、『〡一我在錫安放一塊絆脚的石頭、跌人的磐石．信靠他的人必不至於羞愧。』 :9a〡創廿一 〡二 :9b〢創十八 〡十 :9c〣創廿五 〢三 :9d〤瑪一 〢 〣 :9e〥出三十三 〡〩 :9f〦出九 〡〦 :9g〧何二 〢三 :9h〨何一 〡十 :9i〩賽十 〢二 〢三 :9j〡十賽一 〩 :9k〡一賽廿八 〡〦

Romans 10:1 Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
羅馬書 10:1 弟兄們、我心裏所願的、向 神所求的、是要以色列人得救。

Romans 10:2 For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
羅馬書 10:2 我可以證明他們向 神有熱心、但不是按着眞知識．

Romans 10:3 For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
羅馬書 10:3 因爲不知道 神的義、想要立自己的義、就不服 神的義了。

Romans 10:4 For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
羅馬書 10:4 律法的總結就是基督、使凡信他的都得着義。

Romans 10:5 For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
羅馬書 10:5 摩西寫着說、『〡人若行那出於律法的義、就必因此活着。』

Romans 10:6 But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
羅馬書 10:6 惟有出於信心的義如此說、『〢你不要心裏說、誰要升到天上去呢．就是要領下基督來．

Romans 10:7 Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
羅馬書 10:7 誰要下到陰間去呢．就是要領基督從死裏上來。』

Romans 10:8 But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
羅馬書 10:8 他到底怎麼說呢．他說、『〣這道離你不遠、正在你口裏、在你心裏。』就是我們所傳信主的道。

Romans 10:9 That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
羅馬書 10:9 你若口裏認耶穌爲主、心裏信 神叫他從死裏復活、就必得救．

Romans 10:10 For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
羅馬書 10:10 因爲人心裏相信、就可以稱義．口裏承認、就可以得救。

Romans 10:11 For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
羅馬書 10:11 經上說、『〤凡信他的人、必不至於羞愧。』

Romans 10:12 For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
羅馬書 10:12 猶太人和希利尼人、並沒有分別．因爲衆人同有一位主、他也厚待一切求告他的人．

Romans 10:13 For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
羅馬書 10:13 因爲『〥凡求告主名的、就必得救。』

Romans 10:14 How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
羅馬書 10:14 然而人未曾信他、怎能求他呢．未曾聽見他、怎能信他呢．沒有傳道的、怎能聽見呢。

Romans 10:15 And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
羅馬書 10:15 若沒有奉差遣、怎能傳道呢．如經上所記、『〦報福音傳喜信的人、他們的脚蹤何等佳美。』

Romans 10:16 But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
羅馬書 10:16 只是人沒有都聽從福音．因爲以賽亞說、『〧主阿、我們所傳的有誰信呢。』

Romans 10:17 So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
羅馬書 10:17 可見信道是從聽道來的、聽道是從基督的話來的。

Romans 10:18 But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
羅馬書 10:18 但我說、人沒有聽見麼．誠然聽見了．『〨他們的聲音傳遍天下、他們的言語傳到地極。』

Romans 10:19 But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
羅馬書 10:19 我再說、以色列人不知道麼．先有摩西說、『〩我要用那不成子民的、惹動你們的憤恨．我要用那無知的民、觸動你們的怒氣。』

Romans 10:20 But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
羅馬書 10:20 又有以賽亞放膽說、『〡十沒有尋找我的、我叫他們遇見．沒有訪問我的、我向他們顯現。』

Romans 10:21 But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
羅馬書 10:21 至於以色列人、他說、『〡一我整天伸手招呼那悖逆頂嘴的百姓。』 :10a〡利十八 〥 :10b〢申三十 〡二 :10c〣申三十 〡〤 :10d〤賽廿八 〡〦 :10e〥珥二 〣二 :10f〦賽五十二 〧 :10g〧賽五十三 〡 :10h〨詩十九 〤 :10i〩申三十二 〢一 :10j〡十賽六十五 〡 :10k〡一賽六十五 〢

Romans 11:1 I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
羅馬書 11:1 我且說、 神棄絕了他的百姓麼．斷乎沒有．因爲我也是以色列人、亞伯拉罕的後裔、屬便雅憫支派的。

Romans 11:2 God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel saying,
羅馬書 11:2 神並沒有棄絕他豫先所知道的百姓。你們豈不曉得經上論到以利亞是怎麼說的呢．他在 神面前怎樣控告以色列人、說、

Romans 11:3 Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
羅馬書 11:3 『〡主阿、他們殺了你的先知、拆了你的祭壇、只剩下我一個人、他們還要尋索我的命。』

Romans 11:4 But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
羅馬書 11:4 神的回話是怎麼說的呢．他說、『〢我爲自己留下七千人、是未曾向巴力屈膝的。』

Romans 11:5 Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
羅馬書 11:5 如今也是這樣、照着揀選的恩典還有所留的餘數。

Romans 11:6 And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
羅馬書 11:6 旣是出於恩典、就不在乎行爲．不然、恩典就不是恩典了。

Romans 11:7 What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
羅馬書 11:7 這是怎麼樣呢．以色列人所求的、他們沒有得着．惟有蒙揀選的人得着了、其餘的就成了頑梗不化的．

Romans 11:8 (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
羅馬書 11:8 如經上所記、『〣 神給他們昏迷的心、眼睛不能看見、耳朶不能聽見、直到今日。』

Romans 11:9 And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
羅馬書 11:9 大衞也說、『〤願他們的筵席變爲網羅、變爲機檻、變爲絆脚石、作他們的報應．

Romans 11:10 Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
羅馬書 11:10 願他們的眼睛昏矇、不得看見．願你時常彎下他們的腰。』

Romans 11:11 I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
羅馬書 11:11 我且說、他們失脚是要他們跌倒麼．斷乎不是．反倒因他們的過失、救恩便臨到外邦人、要激動他們發憤。

Romans 11:12 Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
羅馬書 11:12 若他們的過失、爲天下的富足、他們的缺乏、爲外邦人的富足．何况他們的豐滿呢。

Romans 11:13 For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
羅馬書 11:13 我對你們外邦人說這話．因我是外邦人的使徒、所以敬重我的職分．

Romans 11:14 If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
羅馬書 11:14 或者可以激動我骨肉之親發憤、好救他們一些人。

Romans 11:15 For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
羅馬書 11:15 若他們被丟棄、天下就得與 神和好、他們被收納、豈不是死而復生麼。

Romans 11:16 For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
羅馬書 11:16 所獻的新麵若是聖潔、全團也就聖潔了．樹根若是聖潔、樹枝也就聖潔了。

Romans 11:17 And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
羅馬書 11:17 若有幾根枝子被折下來、你這野橄欖得接在其中、一同得着橄欖根的肥汁．

Romans 11:18 Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
羅馬書 11:18 你就不可向舊枝子誇口、若是誇口、當知道不是你托着根、乃是根托着你。

Romans 11:19 Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
羅馬書 11:19 你若說、那枝子被折下來、是特爲叫我接上。

Romans 11:20 Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
羅馬書 11:20 不錯．他們因爲不信、所以被折下來．你因爲信、所以立得住．你不可自高、反要懼怕。

Romans 11:21 For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
羅馬書 11:21 神旣不愛惜原來的枝子、也必不愛惜你。

Romans 11:22 Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
羅馬書 11:22 可見 神的恩慈、和嚴厲．向那跌倒的人、是嚴厲的．向你是有恩慈的．只要你長久在他的恩慈裏．不然、你也要被砍下來。

Romans 11:23 And they also, if they abide not in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

Romans 11:24 For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
羅馬書 11:24 你是從那天生的野橄欖上砍下來的、尚且逆着性得接在好橄欖上、何况這本樹的枝子、要接在本樹上呢。

Romans 11:25 For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
羅馬書 11:25 弟兄們、我不願意你們不知道這奧祕、（恐怕你們自以爲聰明）就是以色列人有幾分是硬心的、等到外邦人的數目添滿了．

Romans 11:26 And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
羅馬書 11:26 於是以色列全家都要得救、如經上所記、『〥必有一位救主、從錫安出來、要消除雅各家的一切罪惡。』

Romans 11:27 For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
羅馬書 11:27 又說、『〦我除去他們罪的時候、這就是我與他們所立的約。』

Romans 11:28 As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the father's sakes.
羅馬書 11:28 就着福音說、他們爲你們的緣故是仇敵．就着揀選說、他們爲列祖的緣故是蒙愛的。

Romans 11:29 For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
羅馬書 11:29 因爲 神的恩賜和選召、是沒有後悔的。

Romans 11:30 For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
羅馬書 11:30 你們從前不順服 神、如今因他們的不順服、你們倒蒙了憐恤．

Romans 11:31 Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
羅馬書 11:31 這樣、他們也是不順服、叫他們因着施給你們的憐恤、現在也就蒙憐恤。

Romans 11:32 For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
羅馬書 11:32 因爲 神將衆人都圈在不順服之中、特意要憐恤衆人。

Romans 11:33 O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
羅馬書 11:33 深哉、 神豐富的智慧和知識。他的判斷、何其難測、他的蹤跡何其難尋、

Romans 11:34 For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counseller?
羅馬書 11:34 誰知道主的心、誰作過他的謀士呢、

Romans 11:35 Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
羅馬書 11:35 誰是先給了他、使他後來償還呢。

Romans 11:36 For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

Romans 12:1 I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
羅馬書 12:1 所以弟兄們、我以 神的慈悲勸你們、將身體獻上、當作活祭、是聖潔的、是 神所喜悅的．你們如此事奉、乃是理所當然的。

Romans 12:2 And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
羅馬書 12:2 不要效法這個世界．只要心意更新而變化、叫你們察驗何爲 神的善良、純全可喜悅的旨意。

Romans 12:3 For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
羅馬書 12:3 我憑着所賜我的恩、對你們各人說、不要看自己過於所當看的．要照着 神所分給各人信心的大小、看得合乎中道。

Romans 12:4 For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
羅馬書 12:4 正如我們一個身子上有好些肢體、肢體也不都是一樣的用處。

Romans 12:5 So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
羅馬書 12:5 我們這許多人、在基督裏成爲一身、互相聯絡作肢體、也是如此。

Romans 12:6 Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

Romans 12:7 Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

Romans 12:8 Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

Romans 12:9 Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
羅馬書 12:9 愛人不可虛假、惡要厭惡、善要親近。

Romans 12:10 Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

Romans 12:11 Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
羅馬書 12:11 殷勤不可懶惰．要心裏火熱．常常服事主。

Romans 12:12 Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
羅馬書 12:12 在指望中要喜樂．在患難中要忍耐。禱告要恆切．

Romans 12:13 Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
羅馬書 12:13 聖徒缺乏要幫補．客要一味的款待。

Romans 12:14 Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
羅馬書 12:14 逼迫你們的、要給他們祝福．只要祝福、不可咒詛。

Romans 12:15 Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
羅馬書 12:15 與喜樂的人要同樂．與哀哭的人要同哭。

Romans 12:16 Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
羅馬書 12:16 要彼此同心．不要志氣高大、倒要俯就卑微的人。不要自以爲聰明。

Romans 12:17 Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
羅馬書 12:17 不要以惡報惡、衆人以爲美的事、要留心去作。

Romans 12:18 If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

羅馬書 12:19 親愛的弟兄、不要自己伸寃、寧可讓步、聽憑主怒．因爲經上記着、『〡主說、伸寃在我．我必報應。』

Romans 12:21 Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

Romans 13:1 Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

Romans 13:2 Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
羅馬書 13:2 所以抗拒掌權的、就是抗拒 神的命．抗拒的必自取刑罰。

Romans 13:3 For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
羅馬書 13:3 作官的原不是叫行善的懼怕、乃是叫作惡的懼怕。你願意不懼怕掌權的麼．你只要行善、就可得他的稱讚．

Romans 13:4 For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
羅馬書 13:4 因爲他是 神的用人、是與你有益的。你若作惡、卻當懼怕．因爲他不是空空的佩劍．他是 神的用人、是伸寃的、刑罰那作惡的。

Romans 13:5 Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
羅馬書 13:5 所以你們必須順服、不但是因爲刑罰、也是因爲良心。

Romans 13:6 For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

Romans 13:7 Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
羅馬書 13:7 凡人所當得的、就給他．當得糧的、給他納糧．當得稅的、給他上稅．當懼怕的、懼怕他．當恭敬的、恭敬他。

Romans 13:8 Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
羅馬書 13:8 凡事都不可虧欠人、惟有彼此相愛、要常以爲虧欠．因爲愛人的就完全了律法。

Romans 13:9 For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
羅馬書 13:9 〡像那不可姦淫、不可殺人、不可偷盜、不可貪婪、或有別的誡命、都包在愛人如己這一句話之內了。

Romans 13:10 Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
羅馬書 13:10 愛是不加害與人的、所以愛就完全了律法。

Romans 13:11 And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
羅馬書 13:11 再者、你們曉得現今就是該趁早睡醒的時候、因爲我們得救、現今比初信的時候更近了。

Romans 13:12 The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
羅馬書 13:12 黑夜已深、白晝將近．我們就當脫去暗昧的行爲、帶上光明的兵器。

Romans 13:13 Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
羅馬書 13:13 行事爲人要端正、好像行在白晝．不可荒宴醉酒．不可好色邪蕩．不可爭競嫉妒。

Romans 13:14 But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

Romans 14:1 Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
