Romans 14:2 For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
羅馬書 14:2 有人信百物都可喫．但那輭弱的、只喫蔬菜。

Romans 14:3 Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
羅馬書 14:3 喫的人不可輕看不喫的人．不喫的人不可論斷喫的人．因爲 神已經收納他了。

Romans 14:4 Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
羅馬書 14:4 你是誰、竟論斷別人的僕人呢。他或站住、或跌倒、自有他的主人在．而且他也必要站住．因爲主能使他站住。

Romans 14:5 One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
羅馬書 14:5 有人看這日比那日強、有人看日日都是一樣．只是各人心裏要意見堅定。

Romans 14:6 He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
羅馬書 14:6 守日的人、是爲主守的．喫的人、是爲主喫的、因他感謝 神．不喫的人、是爲主不喫的、也感謝 神。

Romans 14:7 For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
羅馬書 14:7 我們沒有一個人爲自己活、也沒有一個人爲自己死。

Romans 14:8 For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
羅馬書 14:8 我們若活着、是爲主而活．若死了、是爲主而死．所以我們或活或死、總是主的人。

Romans 14:9 For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
羅馬書 14:9 因此基督死了、又活了、爲要作死人並活人的主。

Romans 14:10 But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
羅馬書 14:10 你這個人、爲甚麼論斷弟兄呢．又爲甚麼輕看弟兄呢．因我們都要站在 神的臺前。

Romans 14:11 For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
羅馬書 14:11 經上寫着、『〡主說、我憑着我的永生起誓、萬膝必向我跪拜、萬口必向我承認。』

Romans 14:12 So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
羅馬書 14:12 這樣看來、我們各人必要將自己的事、在 神面前說明。

Romans 14:13 Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
羅馬書 14:13 所以我們不可再彼此論斷．寧可定意誰也不給弟兄放下絆脚跌人之物。

Romans 14:14 I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
羅馬書 14:14 我憑着主耶穌確知深信、凡物本來沒有不潔淨的．惟獨人以爲不潔淨的、在他就不潔淨了。

Romans 14:15 But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
羅馬書 14:15 你若因食物叫弟兄憂愁、就不是按着愛人的道理行。基督已經替他死、你不可因你的食物叫他敗壞。

Romans 14:16 Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
羅馬書 14:16 不可叫你的善被人毀謗．

Romans 14:17 For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
羅馬書 14:17 因爲 神的國、不在乎喫喝、只在乎公義、和平、並聖靈中的喜樂。

Romans 14:18 For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
羅馬書 14:18 在這幾樣上服事基督的、就爲 神所喜悅、又爲人所稱許。

Romans 14:19 Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
羅馬書 14:19 所以我們務要追求和睦的事、與彼此建立德行的事。

Romans 14:20 For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
羅馬書 14:20 不可因食物毀壞 神的工程．凡物固然潔淨、但有人因食物叫人跌倒、就是他的罪了。

Romans 14:21 It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
羅馬書 14:21 無論是喫肉、是喝酒、是甚麼別的事、叫弟兄跌倒、一槪不作纔好。

Romans 14:22 Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
羅馬書 14:22 你有信心、就當在 神面前守着。人在自己以爲可行的事上、能不自責、就有福了。

Romans 14:23 And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
羅馬書 14:23 若有疑心而喫的、就必有罪．因爲他喫、不是出於信心．凡不出於信心的都是罪。 :14a〡賽四十五 〢三

Romans 15:1 We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
羅馬書 15:1 我們堅固的人、應該擔代不堅固人的輭弱、不求自己的喜悅。

Romans 15:2 Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
羅馬書 15:2 我們各人務要叫鄰舍喜悅、使他得益處、建立德行。

Romans 15:3 For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
羅馬書 15:3 因爲基督也不求自己的喜悅、如經上所記、『辱罵你人的辱罵、都落在我身上。』〡

Romans 15:4 For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
羅馬書 15:4 從前所寫的聖經、都是爲教訓我們寫的、叫我們因聖經所生的忍耐和安慰、可以得着盼望。

Romans 15:5 Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
羅馬書 15:5 但願賜忍耐安慰的 神、叫你們彼此同心、效法基督耶穌．

Romans 15:6 That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
羅馬書 15:6 一心一口、榮耀 神、我們主耶穌基督的父。

Romans 15:7 Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
羅馬書 15:7 所以你們要彼此接納、如同基督接納你們一樣、使榮耀歸與 神。

Romans 15:8 Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
羅馬書 15:8 我說、基督是爲 神眞理作了受割禮人的執事、要證實所應許列祖的話。

Romans 15:9 And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
羅馬書 15:9 並叫外邦人、因他的憐憫、榮耀 神．如經上所記、『〢因此我要在外邦中稱讚你、歌頌你的名。』

Romans 15:10 And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
羅馬書 15:10 又說、『〣你們外邦人、當與主的百姓一同歡樂。』

Romans 15:11 And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
羅馬書 15:11 又說、『〤外邦阿、你們當讚美主．萬民哪、你們都當頌讚他。』

Romans 15:12 And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
羅馬書 15:12 又有以賽亞說、『〥將來有耶西的根、就是那興起來要治理外邦的．外邦人要仰望他。』

Romans 15:13 Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
羅馬書 15:13 但願使人有盼望的 神、因信、將諸般的喜樂平安、充滿你們的心、使你們藉着聖靈的能力、大有盼望。

Romans 15:14 And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
羅馬書 15:14 弟兄們、我自己也深信你們是滿有良善、充足了諸般的知識、也能彼此勸戒。

Romans 15:15 Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
羅馬書 15:15 但我稍微放膽寫信給你們、是要題醒你們的記性、特因 神所給我的恩典、

Romans 15:16 That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
羅馬書 15:16 使我爲外邦人作基督耶穌的僕役、作 神福音的祭司、叫所獻上的外邦人、因着聖靈、成爲聖潔、可蒙悅納。

Romans 15:17 I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
羅馬書 15:17 所以論到 神的事我在基督耶穌裏有可誇的。

Romans 15:18 For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
羅馬書 15:18 除了基督藉我作的那些事、我甚麼都不敢題．只題他藉我言語作爲、用神蹟奇事的能力、並聖靈的能力、使外邦人順服．

Romans 15:19 Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
羅馬書 15:19 甚至我從耶路撒冷、直轉到以利哩古、到處傳了基督的福音。

Romans 15:20 Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
羅馬書 15:20 我立了志向、不在基督的名被稱過的地方傳福音、免得建造在別人的根基上．

Romans 15:21 But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
羅馬書 15:21 就如經上所記、『〦未曾聞知他信息的、將要看見．未曾聽過的、將要明白。』

Romans 15:22 For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
羅馬書 15:22 我因多次被攔阻、總不得到你們那裏去．

Romans 15:23 But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
羅馬書 15:23 但如今在這裏再沒有可傳的地方、而且這好幾年、我切心想望到士班雅去的時候、可以到你們那裏．

Romans 15:24 Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
羅馬書 15:24 盼望從你們那裏經過、得見你們、先與你們彼此交往、心裏稍微滿足、然後蒙你們送行。

Romans 15:25 But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
羅馬書 15:25 但現在我往耶路撒冷去、供給聖徒。

Romans 15:26 For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
羅馬書 15:26 因爲馬其頓、和亞該亞人樂意湊出捐項、給耶路撒冷聖徒中的窮人。

Romans 15:27 It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
羅馬書 15:27 這固然是他們樂意的．其實也算是所欠的債．因外邦人、旣然在他們屬靈的好處上有分、就當把養身之物供給他們。

Romans 15:28 When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
羅馬書 15:28 等我辦完了這事、把這善果向他們交付明白、我就要路過你們那裏、往士班雅去。

Romans 15:29 And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
羅馬書 15:29 我也曉得去的時候、必帶着基督豐盛的恩典而去。

Romans 15:30 Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
羅馬書 15:30 弟兄們、我藉着我們主耶穌基督、又藉着聖靈的愛、勸你們與我一同竭力、爲我祈求 神．

Romans 15:31 That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
羅馬書 15:31 叫我脫離在猶太不順從的人、也叫我爲耶路撒冷所辦的捐項、可蒙聖徒悅納．

Romans 15:32 That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
羅馬書 15:32 並叫我順着 神的旨意、歡歡喜喜的到你們那裏、與你們同得安息。

Romans 15:33 Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
羅馬書 15:33 願賜平安的 神、常和你們衆人同在。阿們。 :15a〡詩六十九 〩 :15b〢撒下廿二 〥十 詩十八 〤〩 :15c〣申三十二 〤〣 :15d〤詩百十七 〡 :15e〥賽十一 〡十 :15f〦賽五十二 〡〥

Romans 16:1 I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
羅馬書 16:1 我對你們舉薦我們的姊妹非比、他是堅革哩教會中的女執事．

Romans 16:2 That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
羅馬書 16:2 請你們爲主接待他、合乎聖徒的體統．他在何事上、要你們幫助、你們就幫助他．因他素來幫助許多人、也幫助了我。

Romans 16:3 Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
羅馬書 16:3 問百基拉和亞居拉安．他們在基督耶穌裏與我同工、

Romans 16:4 Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
羅馬書 16:4 也爲我的命、將自己的頸項、置之度外．不但我感謝他們、就是外邦的衆教會、也感謝他們．

Romans 16:5 Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
羅馬書 16:5 又問在他們家中的教會安。問我所親愛的以拜尼土安．他在亞西亞是歸基督初結的果子。

Romans 16:6 Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
羅馬書 16:6 又問馬利亞安．他爲你們多受勞苦。

Romans 16:7 Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
羅馬書 16:7 又問我親屬與我一同坐監的安多尼古和猶尼亞安．他們在使徒中是有名望的、也是比我先在基督裏。

Romans 16:8 Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
羅馬書 16:8 又問我在主裏面所親愛的暗伯利安。

Romans 16:9 Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
羅馬書 16:9 又問在基督裏與我們同工的耳巴奴、並我所親愛的士大古安。

Romans 16:10 Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.
羅馬書 16:10 又問在基督裏經過試驗的亞比利安。問亞利多布家裏的人安。

Romans 16:11 Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
羅馬書 16:11 又問我親屬希羅天安。問拿其數家在主裏的人安。

Romans 16:12 Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
羅馬書 16:12 又問爲主勞苦的土非拿氏和土富撒氏安。問可親愛爲主多受勞苦的彼息氏安。

Romans 16:13 Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
羅馬書 16:13 又問在主蒙揀選的魯孚和他母親安．他的母親就是我的母親。

Romans 16:14 Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
羅馬書 16:14 又問亞遜其土、弗勒干、黑米、八羅巴、黑馬、並與他們在一處的弟兄們安。

Romans 16:15 Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
羅馬書 16:15 又問非羅羅古、和猶利亞、尼利亞、和他姊妹、同阿林巴、並與他們在一處的衆聖徒安。

Romans 16:16 Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
羅馬書 16:16 你們親嘴問安、彼此務要聖潔。基督的衆教會都問你們安。

Romans 16:17 Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
羅馬書 16:17 弟兄們、那些離間你們、叫你們跌倒、背乎所學之道的人、我勸你們要留意躱避他們。

Romans 16:18 For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
羅馬書 16:18 因爲這樣的人不服事我們的主基督、只服事自己的肚腹．用花言巧語、誘惑那些老實人的心。

Romans 16:19 For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
羅馬書 16:19 你們的順服、已經傳於衆人、所以我爲你們歡喜．但我願意你們在善上聰明、在惡上愚拙。

Romans 16:20 And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
羅馬書 16:20 賜平安的 神、快要將撒但踐踏在你們脚下。願我主耶穌基督的恩、常和你們同在。

Romans 16:21 Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
羅馬書 16:21 與我同工的提摩太、和我的親屬路求、耶孫、所西巴德、問你們安。

Romans 16:22 I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
羅馬書 16:22 我這代筆寫信的德丟、在主裏面問你們安。

Romans 16:23 Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
羅馬書 16:23 那接待我、也接待全教會的該猶、問你們安。

Romans 16:24 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
羅馬書 16:24 城內管銀庫的以拉都、和兄弟括土、問你們安。

Romans 16:25 Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
羅馬書 16:25 惟有 神能照我所傳的福音、和所講的耶穌基督、並照永古隱藏不言的奧祕、堅固你們的心。

Romans 16:26 But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
羅馬書 16:26 這奧祕如今顯明出來、而且按着永生 神的命、藉衆先知的書指示萬國的民、使他們信服眞道。

Romans 16:27 To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
羅馬書 16:27 願榮耀因耶穌基督歸與獨一全智的 神、直到永遠。阿們。 哥林多前書]] 1925

## 1 Corinthians / 哥林多前書

1 Corinthians 1:1 Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
哥林多前書 1:1 奉 神旨意、蒙召作耶穌基督使徒的保羅、同兄弟所提尼、

1 Corinthians 1:2 Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both their's and our's:
哥林多前書 1:2 寫信給在哥林多 神的教會、就是在基督耶穌裏成聖、蒙召作聖徒的、以及所有在各處求告我主耶穌基督之名的人．基督是他們的主、也是我們的主．

1 Corinthians 1:3 Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
哥林多前書 1:3 願恩惠平安、從 神我們的父、並主耶穌基督、歸與你們。

1 Corinthians 1:4 I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
哥林多前書 1:4 我常爲你們感謝我的 神、因 神在基督耶穌裏所賜給你們的恩惠．

1 Corinthians 1:5 That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
哥林多前書 1:5 又因你們在他裏面凡事富足、口才知識都全備．

1 Corinthians 1:6 Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
哥林多前書 1:6 正如我爲基督作的見證、在你們心裏得以堅固．

1 Corinthians 1:7 So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
哥林多前書 1:7 以致你們在恩賜上沒有一樣不及人的．等候我們的主耶穌基督顯現．

1 Corinthians 1:8 Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
哥林多前書 1:8 他也必堅固你們到底、叫你們在我們主耶穌基督的日子、無可責備。

1 Corinthians 1:9 God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
哥林多前書 1:9 神是信實的、你們原是被他所召、好與他兒子、我們的主耶穌基督、一同得分。

1 Corinthians 1:10 Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
哥林多前書 1:10 弟兄們、我藉我們主耶穌基督的名、勸你們都說一樣的話．你們中間也不可分黨．只要一心一意彼此相合。

1 Corinthians 1:11 For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
哥林多前書 1:11 因爲革來氏家裏的人、曾對我題起弟兄們來、說你們中間有分爭。

1 Corinthians 1:12 Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.
哥林多前書 1:12 我的意思就是你們各人說、我是屬保羅的．我是屬亞波羅的．我是屬磯法的．我是屬基督的。

1 Corinthians 1:13 Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?
哥林多前書 1:13 基督是分開的麼．保羅爲你們釘了十字架麼．你們是奉保羅的名受了洗麼。

1 Corinthians 1:14 I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
哥林多前書 1:14 我感謝 神、除了基利司布並該猶以外、我沒有給你們一個人施洗．

1 Corinthians 1:15 Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.
哥林多前書 1:15 免得有人說、你們是奉我的名受洗。

1 Corinthians 1:16 And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
哥林多前書 1:16 我也給司提反家施過洗．此外給別人施洗沒有、我卻記不清。

1 Corinthians 1:17 For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
哥林多前書 1:17 基督差遣我、原不是爲施洗、乃是爲傳福音．並不用智慧的言語、免得基督的十字架落了空。

1 Corinthians 1:18 For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
哥林多前書 1:18 因爲十字架的道理、在那滅亡的人爲愚拙．在我們得救的人卻爲 神的大能。

1 Corinthians 1:19 For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
哥林多前書 1:19 就如經上所記、『〡我要滅絕智慧人的智慧、廢棄聰明人的聰明。』

1 Corinthians 1:20 Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
哥林多前書 1:20 智慧人在那裏．文士在那裏．這世上的辯士在那裏． 神豈不是叫這世上的智慧變成愚拙麼。

1 Corinthians 1:21 For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.
哥林多前書 1:21 世人憑自己的智慧、旣不認識 神、 神就樂意用人所當作愚拙的道理、拯救那些信的人．這就是 神的智慧了。

1 Corinthians 1:22 For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
哥林多前書 1:22 猶太人是要神蹟、希利尼人是求智慧．

1 Corinthians 1:23 But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;
哥林多前書 1:23 我們卻是傳釘十字架的基督、在猶太人爲絆脚石、在外邦人爲愚拙、

1 Corinthians 1:24 But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
哥林多前書 1:24 但在那蒙召的、無論是猶太人、希利尼人、基督總爲 神的能力、 神的智慧。

1 Corinthians 1:25 Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
哥林多前書 1:25 因 神的愚拙總比人智慧． 神的輭弱總比人強壯。

1 Corinthians 1:26 For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
哥林多前書 1:26 弟兄們哪、可見你們蒙召的、按着肉體有智慧的不多、有能力的不多、有尊貴的也不多．

1 Corinthians 1:27 But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
哥林多前書 1:27 神卻揀選了世上愚拙的、叫有智慧的羞愧．又揀選了世上輭弱的、叫那強壯的羞愧．

1 Corinthians 1:28 And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
哥林多前書 1:28 神也揀選了世上卑賤的、被人厭惡的、以及那無有的、爲要廢掉那有的．

1 Corinthians 1:29 That no flesh should glory in his presence.
哥林多前書 1:29 使一切有血氣的、在 神面前一個也不能自誇。

1 Corinthians 1:30 But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:

哥林多前書 6:7 你們彼此告狀、這已經是你們的大錯了．爲甚麼不情願受欺呢．爲甚麼不情願喫虧呢。

1 Corinthians 6:8 Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.

哥林多前書 6:11 你們中間也有人從前是這樣．但如今你們奉主耶穌基督的名、並藉着我們 神的靈、已經洗淨、成聖稱義了。

哥林多前書 6:13 食物是爲肚腹、肚腹是爲食物．但 神要叫這兩樣都廢壞。身子不是爲淫亂、乃是爲主．主也是爲身子．

1 Corinthians 6:14 And God hath both raised up the Lord, and will also raise up us by his own power.

哥林多前書 6:15 豈不知你們的身子是基督的肢體麼．我可以將基督的肢體作爲娼妓的肢體麼．斷乎不可。

1 Corinthians 6:16 What? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, saith he, shall be one flesh.

哥林多前書 6:17 但與主聯合的、便是與主成爲一靈。

哥林多前書 6:18 你們要逃避淫行。人所犯的、無論甚麼罪、都在身子以外．惟有行淫的、是得罪自己的身子。

哥林多前書 6:19 豈不知你們的身子就是聖靈的殿麼．這聖靈是從 神而來、住在你們裏頭的．並且你們不是自己的人．

1 Corinthians 6:20 For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
哥林多前書 6:20 因爲你們是重價買來的．所以要在你們的身子上榮耀 神。 :6a〡創二 〢〤

哥林多前書 7:1 論到你們信上所題的事、我說男不近女倒好。

哥林多前書 7:2 但要免淫亂的事、男子當各有自己的妻子、女子也當各有自己的丈夫。

哥林多前書 7:4 妻子沒有權柄主張自己的身子、乃在丈夫．丈夫也沒有權柄主張自己的身子、乃在妻子。

1 Corinthians 7:5 Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.
哥林多前書 7:5 夫妻不可彼此虧負、除非兩相情願、暫時分房、爲要專心禱告方可、以後仍要同房、免得撒但趁着你們情不自禁、引誘你們。

1 Corinthians 8:11 And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?
哥林多前書 8:11 因此、基督爲他死的那輭弱弟兄、也就因你的知識沉淪了。

哥林多前書 8:12 你們這樣得罪弟兄們、傷了他們輭弱的良心、就是得罪基督。

哥林多前書 8:13 所以食物若叫我弟兄跌倒、我就永遠不喫肉、免得叫我弟兄跌倒了。

1 Corinthians 9:1 Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?
哥林多前書 9:1 我不是自由的麼．我不是使徒麼．我不是見過我們的主耶穌麼．你們不是我在主裏面所作之工麼。

1 Corinthians 9:2 If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.
哥林多前書 9:2 假若在別人我不是使徒、在你們我總是使徒．因爲你們在主裏正是我作使徒的印證。

哥林多前書 9:3 我對那盤問我的人、就是這樣分訴。

哥林多前書 9:4 難道我們沒有權柄靠福音喫喝麼。

哥林多前書 9:5 難道我們沒有權柄娶信主的姊妹爲妻、帶着一同往來、彷彿其餘的使徒、和主的弟兄、並磯法一樣麼。

1 Corinthians 9:6 Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?
哥林多前書 9:6 獨有我與巴拿巴沒有權柄不作工麼。

哥林多前書 9:7 有誰當兵、自備糧餉呢．有誰栽葡萄園、不喫園裏的果子呢．有誰牧養牛羊、不喫牛羊的奶呢。

1 Corinthians 9:8 Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?
哥林多前書 9:8 我說這話、豈是照人的意見．律法不也是這樣說麼。

哥林多前書 9:9 就如摩西的律法記着說、『〡牛在塲上踹穀的時候、不可籠住他的嘴。』難道 神所掛念的是牛麼．

1 Corinthians 9:10 Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.

1 Corinthians 9:11 If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
哥林多前書 9:11 我們若把屬靈的種子撒在你們中間、就是從你們收割奉養肉身之物、這還算大事麼。

1 Corinthians 9:12 If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

1 Corinthians 9:13 Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?

哥林多前書 12:9 又有一人蒙這位聖靈賜他信心．還有一人蒙這位聖靈賜他醫病的恩賜．

哥林多前書 12:10 又叫一人能行異能．又叫一人能作先知．又叫一人能辨別諸靈．又叫一人能說方言．又叫一人能繙方言。

1 Corinthians 12:11 But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
哥林多前書 12:11 這一切都是這位聖靈所運行、隨己意分給各人的。

哥林多前書 12:13 我們不拘是猶太人、是希利尼人、是爲奴的、是自主的、都從一位聖靈受洗、成了一個身體．飲於一位聖靈。

1 Corinthians 12:14 For the body is not one member, but many.
哥林多前書 12:14 身子原不是一個肢體、乃是許多肢體。

哥林多前書 12:17 若全身是眼、從那裏聽聲呢．若全身是耳、從那裏聞味呢。

哥林多前書 12:18 但如今 神隨自己的意思、把肢體俱各安排在身上了。

1 Corinthians 12:19 And if they were all one member, where were the body?
哥林多前書 12:19 若都是一個肢體、身子在哪裏呢。

1 Corinthians 12:20 But now are they many members, yet but one body.

哥林多前書 12:21 眼不能對手說、我用不着你．頭也不能對脚說、我用不着你。

哥林多前書 12:22 不但如此、身上肢體人以爲輭弱的、更是不可少的．

哥林多前書 12:24 我們俊美的肢體、自然用不着裝飾．但 神配搭這身子、把加倍的體面給那有缺欠的肢體．

1 Corinthians 12:25 That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

哥林多前書 12:28 神在教會所設立的、第一是使徒．第二是先知．第三是教師．其次是行異能的．再次是得恩賜醫病的．幫助人的．治理事的．說方言的。

1 Corinthians 12:29 Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
哥林多前書 12:29 豈都是使徒麼．豈都是先知麼．豈都是教師麼．豈都是行異能的麼．

哥林多前書 12:30 豈都是得恩賜醫病的麼．豈都是說方言的麼．豈都是繙方言的麼。

哥林多前書 12:31 你們要切切的求那更大的恩賜、我現今把最妙的道指示你們。

1 Corinthians 13:4 Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
哥林多前書 13:4 愛是恆久忍耐、又有恩慈．愛是不嫉妒．愛是不自誇．不張狂．

1 Corinthians 13:5 Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
哥林多前書 13:5 不作害羞的事．不求自己的益處．不輕易發怒．不計算人的惡．

1 Corinthians 13:6 Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
哥林多前書 13:6 不喜歡不義．只喜歡眞理．

1 Corinthians 13:7 Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

哥林多前書 13:9 我們現在所知道的有限、先知所講的也有限．

哥林多前書 14:38 若有不知道的、就由他不知道罷。

哥林多前書 14:39 所以我弟兄們、你們要切慕作先知講道、也不要禁止說方言。

1 Corinthians 14:40 Let all things be done decently and in order.
哥林多前書 14:40 凡事都要規規矩矩的按着次序行。 :14a〡賽廿八 〡一 〡二 :14b〢創三 〡〦

1 Corinthians 15:1 Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;

1 Corinthians 15:2 By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.

1 Corinthians 15:3 For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
哥林多前書 15:3 我當日所領受又傳給你們的、第一、就是基督照聖經所說、爲我們的罪死了．

1 Corinthians 15:4 And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
哥林多前書 15:4 而且埋葬了．又照聖經所說、第三天復活了．

1 Corinthians 15:5 And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
哥林多前書 15:5 並且顯給磯法看．然後顯給十二使徒看．

1 Corinthians 15:6 After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
哥林多前書 15:6 後來一時顯給五百多弟兄看、其中一大半到如今還在、卻也有已經睡了的．

1 Corinthians 15:7 After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
哥林多前書 15:7 以後顯給雅各看．再顯給衆使徒看．

哥林多前書 15:8 末了也顯給我看．我如同未到產期而生的人一般。

1 Corinthians 15:9 For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
哥林多前書 15:9 我原是使徒中最小的、不配稱爲使徒、因爲我從前逼迫 神的教會。

1 Corinthians 15:10 But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
哥林多前書 15:10 然而我今日成了何等人、是蒙 神的恩纔成的．並且他所賜我的恩、不是徒然的．我比衆使徒格外勞苦．這原不是我、乃是 神的恩與我同在。

1 Corinthians 15:11 Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
哥林多前書 15:11 不拘是我是衆使徒、我們如此傳、你們也如此信了。

1 Corinthians 15:12 Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
哥林多前書 15:12 旣傳基督是從死裏復活了、怎麼在你們中間、有人說沒有死人復活的事呢。

1 Corinthians 15:13 But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
哥林多前書 15:13 若沒有死人復活的事、基督也就沒有復活了。

1 Corinthians 15:14 And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
哥林多前書 15:14 若基督沒有復活、我們所傳的便是枉然、你們所信的也是枉然。

1 Corinthians 15:15 Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
哥林多前書 15:15 並且明顯我們是爲 神妄作見證的．因我們見證 神是叫基督復活了．若死人眞不復活、 神也就沒有叫基督復活了。

1 Corinthians 15:16 For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
哥林多前書 15:16 因爲死人若不復活、基督也就沒有復活了。

1 Corinthians 15:17 And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
哥林多前書 15:17 基督若沒有復活、你們的信便是徒然．你們仍在罪裏。

1 Corinthians 15:18 Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
哥林多前書 15:18 就是在基督裏睡了的人也滅亡了。

1 Corinthians 15:19 If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
哥林多前書 15:19 我們若靠基督、只在今生有指望、就算比衆人更可憐。

1 Corinthians 15:20 But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
哥林多前書 15:20 但基督已經從死裏復活、成爲睡了之人初熟的果子。

1 Corinthians 15:21 For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
哥林多前書 15:21 死旣是因一人而來、死人復活也是因一人而來。

1 Corinthians 15:22 For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
哥林多前書 15:22 在亞當裏衆人都死了．照樣、在基督裏衆人也都要復活。

1 Corinthians 15:23 But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
哥林多前書 15:23 但各人是按着自己的次序復活。初熟的果子是基督．以後在他來的時候、是那些屬基督的。

1 Corinthians 15:24 Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
哥林多前書 15:24 再後末期到了、那時、基督旣將一切執政的、掌權的、有能的、都毀滅了、就把國交與父 神。

1 Corinthians 15:25 For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
哥林多前書 15:25 因爲基督必要作王、等 神把一切仇敵、都放在他的脚下。

1 Corinthians 15:26 The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
哥林多前書 15:26 儘末了所毀滅的仇敵、就是死。

1 Corinthians 15:27 For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
哥林多前書 15:27 因爲經上說、『〡 神叫萬物都服在他的脚下。』旣說萬物都服了他、明顯那叫萬物服他的不在其內了。

1 Corinthians 15:28 And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
哥林多前書 15:28 萬物旣服了他、那時、子也要自己服那叫萬物服他的、叫 神在萬物之上、爲萬物之主。

1 Corinthians 15:29 Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
哥林多前書 15:29 不然、那些爲死人受洗的、將來怎樣呢．若死人總不復活、因何爲他們受洗呢．

1 Corinthians 15:30 And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
哥林多前書 15:30 我們又因何時刻冒險呢。

1 Corinthians 15:31 I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
哥林多前書 15:31 弟兄們、我在我主基督耶穌裏、指着你們所誇的口、極力的說、我是天天冒死。

1 Corinthians 15:32 If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
哥林多前書 15:32 我若當日像尋常人、在以弗所同野獸戰鬬、那於我有甚麼益處呢．若死人不復活、我們就喫喫喝喝罷．因爲明天要死了。

1 Corinthians 15:33 Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
哥林多前書 15:33 你們不要自欺．濫交是敗壞善行。

1 Corinthians 15:34 Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
哥林多前書 15:34 你們要醒悟爲善、不要犯罪．因爲有人不認識 神．我說這話、是要叫你們羞愧。

1 Corinthians 15:35 But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
哥林多前書 15:35 或有人問、死人怎樣復活．帶着甚麼身體來呢。

1 Corinthians 15:36 Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
哥林多前書 15:36 無知的人哪、你所種的、若不死就不能生。

1 Corinthians 15:37 And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
哥林多前書 15:37 並且你所種的、不是那將來的形體、不過是子粒、卽如麥子、或是別樣的穀．

1 Corinthians 15:38 But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
哥林多前書 15:38 但 神隨自己的意思、給他一個形體、並叫各等子粒、各有自己的形體。

1 Corinthians 15:39 All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
哥林多前書 15:39 凡肉體各有不同．人是一樣、獸又是一樣、鳥又是一樣、魚又是一樣。

1 Corinthians 15:40 There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
哥林多前書 15:40 有天上的形體、也有地上的形體．但天上形體的榮光是一樣、地上形體的榮光又是一樣。

1 Corinthians 15:41 There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
哥林多前書 15:41 日有日的榮光、月有月的榮光、星有星的榮光．這星和那星的榮光、也有分別。

1 Corinthians 15:42 So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
哥林多前書 15:42 死人復活也是這樣．所種的是必朽壞的、復活的是不朽壞的．

1 Corinthians 15:43 It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
哥林多前書 15:43 所種的是羞辱的、復活的是榮耀的．所種的是輭弱的、復活的是強壯的．

1 Corinthians 15:44 It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
哥林多前書 15:44 所種的是血氣的身體、復活的是靈性的身體．若有血氣的身體、也必有靈性的身體。

1 Corinthians 15:45 And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
哥林多前書 15:45 經上也是這樣記着說、『〢首先的人亞當、成了有靈的活人。』末後的亞當、成了叫人活的靈。

1 Corinthians 15:46 Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
哥林多前書 15:46 但屬靈的不在先、屬血氣的在先．以後纔有屬靈的。

1 Corinthians 15:47 The first man is of the earth, earthy; the second man is the Lord from heaven.
哥林多前書 15:47 頭一個人是出於地、乃屬土．第二個人是出於天。

1 Corinthians 15:48 As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
哥林多前書 15:48 那屬土的怎樣、凡屬土的也就怎樣．屬天的怎樣、凡屬天的也就怎樣。

1 Corinthians 15:49 And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
哥林多前書 15:49 我們旣有屬土的形狀、將來也必有屬天的形狀。

1 Corinthians 15:50 Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
哥林多前書 15:50 弟兄們、我告訴你們說、血肉之體、不能承受 神的國．必朽壞的、不能承受不朽壞的。

1 Corinthians 15:51 Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
哥林多前書 15:51 我如今把一件奧祕的事告訴你們．我們不是都要睡覺、乃是都要改變、

1 Corinthians 15:52 In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
哥林多前書 15:52 就在一霎時、眨眼之間、號筒末次吹響的時候．因號筒要響、死人要復活成爲不朽壞的、我們也要改變。

1 Corinthians 15:53 For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
哥林多前書 15:53 這必朽壞的、總要變成不朽壞的．這必死的、總要變成不死的。

1 Corinthians 15:54 So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
哥林多前書 15:54 這必朽壞的、旣變成不朽壞的．這必死的、旣變成不死的．那時經上所記、〣死被得勝吞滅的話就應驗了。

1 Corinthians 15:55 O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
哥林多前書 15:55 〤死阿、你得勝的權勢在那裏．死阿、你的毒鈎在那裏．

1 Corinthians 15:56 The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
哥林多前書 15:56 死的毒鈎就是罪．罪的權勢就是律法。

1 Corinthians 15:57 But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
哥林多前書 15:57 感謝 神、使我們藉着我們的主耶穌基督得勝。

1 Corinthians 15:58 Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
哥林多前書 15:58 所以我親愛的弟兄們、你們務要堅固不可搖動、常常竭力多作主工、因爲知道你們的勞苦、在主裏面不是徒然的。 :15a〡詩八 〦 :15b〢創二 〧 :15c〣賽廿五 〨 :15d〤何十三 〡〤

1 Corinthians 16:1 Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
哥林多前書 16:1 論到爲聖徒捐錢、我從前怎樣吩咐加拉太的衆教會、你們也當怎樣行。

1 Corinthians 16:2 Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
哥林多前書 16:2 每逢七日的第一日、各人要照自己的進項抽出來留着．免得我來的時候現湊。

1 Corinthians 16:3 And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
哥林多前書 16:3 及至我來到了、你們寫信舉薦誰、我就打發他們、把你們的捐資送到耶路撒冷去．

1 Corinthians 16:4 And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
哥林多前書 16:4 若我也該去、他們可以和我同去。

1 Corinthians 16:5 Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
哥林多前書 16:5 我要從馬其頓經過．旣經過了、就要到你們那裏去．

1 Corinthians 16:6 And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
哥林多前書 16:6 或者和你們同住幾時、或者也過冬．無論我往那裏去、你們就可以給我送行。

1 Corinthians 16:7 For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
哥林多前書 16:7 我如今不願意路過見你們．主若許我、我就指望和你們同住幾時。

1 Corinthians 16:8 But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
哥林多前書 16:8 但我要仍舊住在以弗所、直等到五旬節．

1 Corinthians 16:9 For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
哥林多前書 16:9 因爲有寬大又有功效的門、爲我開了、並且反對的人也多。

1 Corinthians 16:10 Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
哥林多前書 16:10 若是提摩太來到、你們要留心、叫他在你們那裏無所懼怕．因爲他勞力作主的工、像我一樣．

1 Corinthians 16:11 Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
哥林多前書 16:11 所以無論誰、都不可藐視他．只要送他平安前行、叫他到我這裏來．因我指望他和弟兄們同來。

1 Corinthians 16:12 As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
哥林多前書 16:12 至於兄弟亞波羅、我再三的勸他、同弟兄們到你們那裏去．但這時他決不願意去．幾時有了機會他必去。

1 Corinthians 16:13 Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
哥林多前書 16:13 你們務要儆醒、在眞道上站立得穩、要作大丈夫、要剛強。

1 Corinthians 16:14 Let all your things be done with charity.
哥林多前書 16:14 凡你們所作的、都要憑愛心而作。

1 Corinthians 16:15 I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
哥林多前書 16:15 弟兄們、你們曉得司提反一家、是亞該亞初結的果子．並且他們專以服事聖徒爲念．

1 Corinthians 16:16 That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
哥林多前書 16:16 我勸你們順服這樣的人、並一切同工同勞的人。

1 Corinthians 16:17 I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
哥林多前書 16:17 司提反、和福徒拿都、並亞該古、到這裏來、我很喜歡．因爲你們待我有不及之處、他們補上了。

1 Corinthians 16:18 For they have refreshed my spirit and your's: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
哥林多前書 16:18 他們叫我和你們心裏都快活．這樣的人、你們務要敬重。

1 Corinthians 16:19 The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
哥林多前書 16:19 亞西亞的衆教會問你們安。亞居拉和百基拉、並在他們家裏的教會、因主多多的問你們安。

1 Corinthians 16:20 All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
哥林多前書 16:20 衆弟兄都問你們安。你們要親嘴問安、彼此務要聖潔。

1 Corinthians 16:21 The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
哥林多前書 16:21 我保羅親筆問安。

1 Corinthians 16:22 If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
哥林多前書 16:22 若有人不愛主、這人可詛可咒。主必要來。

1 Corinthians 16:23 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
哥林多前書 16:23 願主耶穌基督的恩、常與你們衆人同在。

1 Corinthians 16:24 My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
哥林多前書 16:24 我在基督耶穌裏的愛、與你們衆人同在。阿們。 哥林多後書]] 1925

## 2 Corinthians / 哥林多後書

2 Corinthians 1:1 Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
哥林多後書 1:1 奉 神旨意、作基督耶穌使徒的保羅、和兄弟提摩太、寫信給在哥林多 神的教會、並亞該亞徧處的衆聖徒．

2 Corinthians 1:2 Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
哥林多後書 1:2 願恩惠平安、從 神我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們。

2 Corinthians 1:3 Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
哥林多後書 1:3 願頌讚歸與我們的主耶穌基督的父 神、就是發慈悲的父、賜各樣安慰的 神．

2 Corinthians 1:4 Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
哥林多後書 1:4 我們在一切患難中、他就安慰我們、叫我們能用 神所賜的安慰、去安慰那遭各樣患難的人。

2 Corinthians 1:5 For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
哥林多後書 1:5 我們旣多受基督的苦楚、就靠基督多得安慰。

2 Corinthians 1:6 And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
哥林多後書 1:6 我們受患難呢、是爲叫你們得安慰得拯救．我們得安慰呢、也是爲叫你們得安慰．這安慰能叫你們忍受我們所受的那樣苦楚。

2 Corinthians 1:7 And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
哥林多後書 1:7 我們爲你們所存的盼望是確定的．因爲知道你們旣是同受苦楚、也必同得安慰。

2 Corinthians 1:8 For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
哥林多後書 1:8 弟兄們、我們不要你們不曉得、我們從前在亞西亞遭遇苦難、被壓太重、力不能勝、甚至連活命的指望都絕了．

2 Corinthians 1:9 But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
哥林多後書 1:9 自己心裏也斷定是必死的、叫我們不靠自己、只靠叫死人復活的 神．

2 Corinthians 1:10 Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
哥林多後書 1:10 他曾救我們脫離那極大的死亡、現在仍要救我們、並且我們指望他將來還要救我們。

2 Corinthians 1:11 Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
哥林多後書 1:11 你們以祈禱幫助我們、好叫許多人爲我們謝恩、就是爲我們因許多人所得的恩。

2 Corinthians 1:12 For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
哥林多後書 1:12 我們所誇的、是自己的良心、見證我們憑着 神的聖潔和誠實、在世爲人、不靠人的聰明、乃靠 神的恩惠、向你們更是這樣。

2 Corinthians 1:13 For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
哥林多後書 1:13 我們現在寫給你們的話、並不外乎你們所念的、所認識的、我也盼望你們到底還是要認識．

2 Corinthians 1:14 As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are our's in the day of the Lord Jesus.
哥林多後書 1:14 正如你們已經有幾分認識我們．以我們誇口、好像我們在我們主耶穌的日子、以你們誇口一樣。

2 Corinthians 1:15 And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
哥林多後書 1:15 我旣然這樣深信、就早有意到你們那裏去、叫你們再得益處．

2 Corinthians 1:16 And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
哥林多後書 1:16 也要從你們那裏經過、往馬其頓去、再從馬其頓回到你們那裏、叫你們給我送行往猶太去。

2 Corinthians 1:17 When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
哥林多後書 1:17 我有此意、豈是反復不定麼．我所起的意、豈是從情慾起的、叫我忽是忽非麼。

2 Corinthians 1:18 But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
哥林多後書 1:18 我指着信實的 神說、我們向你們所傳的道、並沒有是而又非的。

2 Corinthians 1:19 For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
哥林多後書 1:19 因爲我和西拉、並提摩太、在你們中間所傳 神的兒子耶穌基督、總沒有是而又非的、在他只有一是。

2 Corinthians 1:20 For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
哥林多後書 1:20 神的應許、不論有多少、在基督都是是的．所以藉着他也都是實在的、叫 神因我們得榮耀。

2 Corinthians 1:21 Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
哥林多後書 1:21 那在基督裏堅固我們和你們、並且膏我們的、就是 神．

2 Corinthians 1:22 Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
哥林多後書 1:22 他又用印印了我們、並賜聖靈在我們心裏作憑據。

2 Corinthians 1:23 Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
哥林多後書 1:23 我呼籲 神給我的心作見證、我沒有往哥林多去是爲要寬容你們。

2 Corinthians 1:24 Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
哥林多後書 1:24 我們並不是轄管你們的信心、乃是幫助你們的快樂．因爲你們憑信纔站立得住。

2 Corinthians 2:1 But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

哥林多後書 2:2 倘若我叫你們憂愁、除了我叫那憂愁的人以外、誰能叫我快樂呢。

2 Corinthians 2:3 And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
哥林多後書 2:3 我曾把這事寫給你們、恐怕我到的時候、應該叫我快樂的那些人、反倒叫我憂愁．我也深信、你們衆人都以我的快樂爲自己的快樂。

2 Corinthians 2:4 For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
哥林多後書 2:4 我先前心裏難過痛苦、多多的流淚、寫信給你們．不是叫你們憂愁、乃是叫你們知道我格外的疼愛你們。

2 Corinthians 2:5 But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
哥林多後書 2:5 若有叫人憂愁的、他不但叫我憂愁、也是叫你們衆人有幾分憂愁、我說幾分、恐怕說得太重。

2 Corinthians 2:6 Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
哥林多後書 2:6 這樣的人、受了衆人的責罰、也就彀了．

2 Corinthians 2:7 So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
哥林多後書 2:7 倒不如赦免他、安慰他、免得他憂愁太過、甚至沉淪了。

2 Corinthians 2:8 Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
哥林多後書 2:8 所以我勸你們、要向他顯出堅定不移的愛心來。

2 Corinthians 2:9 For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
哥林多後書 2:9 爲此我先前也寫信給你們、要試驗你們、看你們凡事順從不順從。

2 Corinthians 2:10 To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
哥林多後書 2:10 你們赦免誰、我也赦免誰、我若有所赦免的、是在基督面前爲你們赦免的．

2 Corinthians 2:11 Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
哥林多後書 2:11 免得撒但趁着機會勝過我們．因我們並非不曉得他的詭計。

2 Corinthians 2:12 Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
哥林多後書 2:12 我從前爲基督的福音到了特羅亞、主也給我開了門。

2 Corinthians 2:13 I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
哥林多後書 2:13 那時因爲沒有遇見兄弟提多、我心裏不安、便辭別那裏的人往馬其頓去了。

2 Corinthians 2:14 Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
哥林多後書 2:14 感謝 神、常帥領我們在基督裏誇勝、並藉着我們在各處顯揚那因認識基督而有的香氣。

2 Corinthians 2:15 For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
哥林多後書 2:15 因爲我們在 神面前、無論在得救的人身上、或滅亡的人身上、都有基督馨香之氣。

2 Corinthians 2:16 To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
哥林多後書 2:16 在這等人、就作了死的香氣叫他死．在那等人、就作了活的香氣叫他活．這事誰能當得起呢。

2 Corinthians 2:17 For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
哥林多後書 2:17 我們不像那許多人、爲利混亂 神的道．乃是由於誠實、由於 神、在 神面前憑着基督講道。

2 Corinthians 3:1 Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
哥林多後書 3:1 我們豈是又舉薦自己麼．豈像別人、用人的薦信給你們、或用你們的薦信給人麼。

2 Corinthians 3:2 Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
哥林多後書 3:2 你們就是我們的薦信、寫在我們的心裏、被衆人所知道所念誦的。

2 Corinthians 3:3 Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
哥林多後書 3:3 你們明顯是基督的信、藉着我們修成的．不是用墨寫的、乃是用永生 神的靈寫的．不是寫在石版上、乃是寫在心版上。

2 Corinthians 3:4 And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
哥林多後書 3:4 我們因基督所以在 神面前纔有這樣的信心．

2 Corinthians 3:5 Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
哥林多後書 3:5 並不是我們憑自己能承擔甚麼事、我們所能承擔的、乃是出於 神．

2 Corinthians 3:6 Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
哥林多後書 3:6 他叫我們能承當這新約的執事．不是憑着字句、乃是憑着精意．因爲那字句是叫人死、精意是叫人活。

2 Corinthians 3:7 But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

2 Corinthians 3:8 How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
哥林多後書 3:8 何况那屬靈的職事、豈不更有榮光麼。

2 Corinthians 3:9 For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
哥林多後書 3:9 若是定罪的職事有榮光、那稱義的職事、榮光就越發大了。

2 Corinthians 3:10 For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
哥林多後書 3:10 那從前有榮光的、因這極大的榮光、就算不得有榮光了．

2 Corinthians 3:11 For if that which was done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
哥林多後書 3:11 若那廢掉的有榮光、這長存的就更有榮光了。

2 Corinthians 3:12 Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
哥林多後書 3:12 我們旣有這樣的盼望、就大膽講說、

2 Corinthians 3:13 And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
哥林多後書 3:13 不像摩西將帕子蒙在臉上、叫以色列人不能定睛看到那將廢者的結局．

2 Corinthians 3:14 But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
哥林多後書 3:14 但他們的心地剛硬．直到今日誦讀舊約的時候、這帕子還沒有揭去．這帕子在基督裏已經廢去了。

2 Corinthians 3:15 But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
哥林多後書 3:15 然而直到今日、每逢誦讀摩西書的時候、帕子還在他們心上。

2 Corinthians 3:16 Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
哥林多後書 3:16 但他們的心幾時歸向主、帕子就幾時除去了。

2 Corinthians 3:17 Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
哥林多後書 3:17 主就是那靈、主的靈在那裏、那裏就得以自由。

2 Corinthians 3:18 But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
哥林多後書 3:18 我們衆人旣然敞着臉、得以看見主的榮光、好像從鏡子裏返照、就變成主的形狀、榮上加榮、如同從主的靈變成的。

2 Corinthians 4:1 Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

哥林多後書 4:2 乃將那些暗昧可恥的事棄絕了、不行詭詐、不謬講 神的道理．只將眞理表明出來、好在 神面前把自己薦與各人的良心。

2 Corinthians 4:3 But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

2 Corinthians 4:4 In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
哥林多後書 4:4 此等不信之人、被這世界的 神弄瞎了心眼、不叫基督榮耀福音的光照着他們．基督本是 神的像。

2 Corinthians 4:5 For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

2 Corinthians 4:7 But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

2 Corinthians 4:8 We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
哥林多後書 4:8 我們四面受敵、卻不被困住．心裏作難、卻不至失望．

2 Corinthians 4:9 Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
哥林多後書 4:9 遭逼迫、卻不被丟棄．打倒了、卻不至死亡．

2 Corinthians 4:10 Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
哥林多後書 4:10 身上常帶着耶穌的死、使耶穌的生、也顯明在我們身上。

2 Corinthians 4:11 For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
哥林多後書 4:11 因爲我們這活着的人、是常爲耶穌被交於死地、使耶穌的生、在我們這必死的身上顯明出來。

2 Corinthians 4:12 So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
哥林多後書 4:12 這樣看來、死是在我們身上發動、生卻在你們身上發動。

2 Corinthians 4:13 We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
哥林多後書 4:13 但我們旣有信心、正如經上記着說、『〢我因信、所以如此說話。』我們也信、所以也說話．

2 Corinthians 4:14 Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
哥林多後書 4:14 自己知道、那叫主耶穌復活的、也必叫我們與耶穌一同復活、並且叫我們與你們一同站在他面前。

2 Corinthians 4:15 For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
哥林多後書 4:15 凡事都是爲你們、好叫恩惠因人多越發加增、感謝格外顯多、以致榮耀歸與 神。

2 Corinthians 4:16 For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
哥林多後書 4:16 所以我們不喪膽．外體雖然毀壞、內心卻一天新似一天。

2 Corinthians 4:17 For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
哥林多後書 4:17 我們這至暫至輕的苦楚、要爲我們成就極重無比永遠的榮耀。

2 Corinthians 4:18 While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
哥林多後書 4:18 原來我們不是顧念所見的、乃是顧念所不見的．因爲所見的是暫時的、所不見的是永遠的。 :4a〡創一 〣 :4b〢詩百十六 〡十

2 Corinthians 5:1 For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
哥林多後書 5:1 我們原知道、我們這地上的帳棚若拆毀了、必得 神所造、不是人手所造、在天上永存的房屋。

2 Corinthians 5:2 For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
哥林多後書 5:2 我們在這帳棚裏歎息、深想得那從天上來的房屋、好像穿上衣服．

2 Corinthians 5:3 If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
哥林多後書 5:3 倘若穿上、被遇見的時候就不至於赤身了。

2 Corinthians 5:4 For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
哥林多後書 5:4 我們在這帳棚裏、歎息勞苦、並非願意脫下這個、乃是願意穿上那個、好叫這必死的被生命吞滅了。

2 Corinthians 5:5 Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
哥林多後書 5:5 爲此培植我們的就是 神、他又賜給我們聖靈作憑據。

2 Corinthians 5:6 Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
哥林多後書 5:6 所以我們時常坦然無懼、並且曉得我們住在身內便與主相離。

2 Corinthians 5:7 (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
哥林多後書 5:7 因我們行事爲人、是憑着信心、不是憑着眼見。

2 Corinthians 5:8 We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
哥林多後書 5:8 我們坦然無懼、是更願意離開身體與主同住。

2 Corinthians 5:9 Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
哥林多後書 5:9 所以無論是住在身內、離開身外、我們立了志向、要得主的喜悅。

2 Corinthians 5:10 For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
哥林多後書 5:10 因爲我們衆人、必要在基督臺前顯露出來、叫各人按着本身所行的、或善或惡受報。

2 Corinthians 5:11 Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
哥林多後書 5:11 我們旣知道主是可畏的、所以勸人、但我們在 神面前是顯明的、盼望在你們的良心裏也是顯明的。

2 Corinthians 5:12 For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
哥林多後書 5:12 我們不是向你們再舉薦自己、乃是叫你們因我們有可誇之處、好對那憑外貌不憑內心誇口的人、有言可答。

2 Corinthians 5:13 For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
哥林多後書 5:13 我們若果顚狂、是爲 神．若果謹守、是爲你們。

2 Corinthians 5:14 For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
哥林多後書 5:14 原來基督的愛激勵我們．因我們想一人旣替衆人死、衆人就都死了．

2 Corinthians 5:15 And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
哥林多後書 5:15 並且他替衆人死、是叫那些活着的人、不再爲自己活、乃爲替他們死而復活的主活。

2 Corinthians 5:16 Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
哥林多後書 5:16 所以我們從今以後、不憑着外貌認人了．雖然憑着外貌認過基督、如今卻不再這樣認他了。

2 Corinthians 5:17 Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
哥林多後書 5:17 若有人在基督裏、他就是新造的人．舊事已過、都變成新的了。

2 Corinthians 5:18 And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
哥林多後書 5:18 一切都是出於 神、他藉着基督使我們與他和好、又將勸人與他和好的職分賜給我們．

2 Corinthians 5:19 To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
哥林多後書 5:19 這就是 神在基督裏、叫世人與自己和好、不將他們的過犯歸到他們身上．並且將這和好的道理託付了我們。

2 Corinthians 5:20 Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
哥林多後書 5:20 所以我們作基督的使者、就好像 神藉我們勸你們一般．我們替基督求你們與 神和好。

2 Corinthians 5:21 For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
哥林多後書 5:21 神使那無罪的、替我們成爲罪．好叫我們在他裏面成爲 神的義。

2 Corinthians 6:1 We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
哥林多後書 6:1 我們與 神同工的、也勸你們、不可徒受他的恩典．

哥林多後書 7:7 不但藉着他來、也藉着他從你們所得的安慰、安慰了我們．因他把你們的想念、哀慟、和向我的熱心、都告訴了我、叫我更加歡喜。

In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

哥林多後書 7:16 我如今歡喜、能在凡事上爲你們放心。

哥林多後書 10:3 因爲我們雖然在血氣中行事、卻不憑着血氣爭戰．

2 Corinthians 10:4 (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
哥林多後書 10:4 我們爭戰的兵器、本不是屬血氣的、乃是在 神面前有能力、可以攻破堅固的營壘、

2 Corinthians 10:5 Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
哥林多後書 10:5 將各樣的計謀、各樣攔阻人認識 神的那些自高之事、一槪攻破了、又將人所有的心意奪回、使他都順服基督．

2 Corinthians 10:6 And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
哥林多後書 10:6 並且我已經豫備好了、等你們十分順服的時候、要責罰那一切不順服的人。

2 Corinthians 10:7 Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
哥林多後書 10:7 你們是看眼前的麼．倘若有人自信是屬基督的、他要再想想、他如何屬基督、我們也是如何屬基督的。

2 Corinthians 10:8 For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
哥林多後書 10:8 主賜給我們權柄、是要造就你們、並不是要敗壞你們、我就是爲這權柄稍微誇口、也不至於慚愧．

2 Corinthians 10:9 That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
哥林多後書 10:9 我說這話免得你們以爲我寫信是要威嚇你們。

2 Corinthians 10:10 For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
哥林多後書 10:10 因爲有人說、他的信、又沉重、又利害．及至見面、卻是氣貌不揚、言語粗俗的。

2 Corinthians 10:11 Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
哥林多後書 10:11 這等人當想、我們不在那裏的時候、信上的言語如何、見面的時候、行事也必如何。

2 Corinthians 10:12 For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
哥林多後書 10:12 因爲我們不敢將自己和那自薦的人同列相比．他們用自己度量自己、用自己比較自己、乃是不通達的。

2 Corinthians 10:13 But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
哥林多後書 10:13 我們不願意分外誇口、只要照 神所量給我們的界限、搆到你們那裏。

2 Corinthians 10:14 For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
哥林多後書 10:14 我們並非過了自己的界限、好像搆不到你們那裏．因爲我們早到你們那裏、傳了基督的福音。

2 Corinthians 10:15 Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
哥林多後書 10:15 我們不仗着別人所勞碌的、分外誇口．但指望你們信心增長的時候、所量給我們的界限、就可以因着你們更加開展、

2 Corinthians 10:16 To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
哥林多後書 10:16 得以將福音傳到你們以外的地方、並不是在別人界限之內、藉着他現成的事誇口。

2 Corinthians 10:17 But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
哥林多後書 10:17 〡但誇口的當指着主誇口。

2 Corinthians 10:18 For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
哥林多後書 10:18 因爲蒙悅納的、不是自己稱許的、乃是主所稱許的。 :10a〡耶九 〢三

2 Corinthians 11:1 Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
哥林多後書 11:1 但願你們寬容我這一點愚妄．其實你們原是寬容我的。

2 Corinthians 11:2 For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
哥林多後書 11:2 我爲你們起的憤恨、原是 神那樣的憤恨．因爲我曾把你們許配一個丈夫、要把你們如同貞潔的童女、獻給基督。

2 Corinthians 11:3 But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
哥林多後書 11:3 我只怕你們的心或偏於邪、失去那向基督所存純一清潔的心、就像蛇用詭詐誘惑了夏娃一樣。

2 Corinthians 11:4 For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
哥林多後書 11:4 假如有人來、另傳一個耶穌、不是我們所傳過的．或者你們另受一個靈、不是你們所受過的．或者另得一個福音、不是你們所得過的．你們容讓他也就罷了．

2 Corinthians 11:5 For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
哥林多後書 11:5 但我想、我一點不在那些最大的使徒以下。

2 Corinthians 11:6 But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
哥林多後書 11:6 我的言語雖然粗俗、我的知識卻不粗俗．這是我們在凡事上、向你們衆人顯明出來的。

2 Corinthians 11:7 Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
哥林多後書 11:7 我因爲白白傳 神的福音給你們、就自居卑微、叫你們高升、這算是我犯罪麼。

2 Corinthians 11:8 I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
哥林多後書 11:8 我虧負了別的教會、向他們取了工價來、給你們効力。

2 Corinthians 11:9 And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
哥林多後書 11:9 我在你們那裏缺乏的時候、並沒有累着你們一個人．因我所缺乏的、那從馬其頓來的弟兄們都補足了．我向來凡事謹守、後來也必謹守、總不至於累着你們。

2 Corinthians 11:10 As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
哥林多後書 11:10 旣有基督的誠實在我裏面、就無人能在亞該亞一帶地方阻擋我這自誇。

2 Corinthians 11:11 Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
哥林多後書 11:11 爲甚麼呢．是因我不愛你們麼．這有 神知道。

2 Corinthians 11:12 But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
哥林多後書 11:12 我現在所作的、後來還要作、爲要斷絕那些尋機會人的機會、使他們在所誇的事上、也不過與我們一樣。

2 Corinthians 11:13 For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
哥林多後書 11:13 那等人是假使徒、行事詭詐、裝作基督使徒的模樣。

2 Corinthians 11:14 And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
哥林多後書 11:14 這也不足爲怪．因爲連撒但也裝作光明的天使。

2 Corinthians 11:15 Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
哥林多後書 11:15 所以他的差役、若裝作仁義的差役、也不算希奇．他們的結局、必然照着他們的行爲。

2 Corinthians 11:16 I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
哥林多後書 11:16 我再說、人不可把我看作愚妄的．縱然如此、也要把我當作愚妄人接納、叫我可以畧畧自誇。

2 Corinthians 11:17 That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
哥林多後書 11:17 我說的話、不是奉主命說的、乃是像愚妄人放膽自誇．

2 Corinthians 11:18 Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
哥林多後書 11:18 旣有好些人憑着血氣自誇、我也要自誇了．

2 Corinthians 11:19 For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
哥林多後書 11:19 你們旣是精明人、就能甘心忍耐愚妄人。

2 Corinthians 11:20 For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
哥林多後書 11:20 假若有人強你們作奴僕、或侵吞你們、或擄掠你們、或悔慢你們、或打你們的臉、你們都能忍耐他。

2 Corinthians 11:21 I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
哥林多後書 11:21 我說這話、是羞辱自己．好像我們從前是輭弱的．然而人在何事上勇敢、（我說句愚妄話）我也勇敢。

2 Corinthians 11:22 Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
哥林多後書 11:22 他們是希伯來人麼．我也是。他們是以色列人麼．我也是。他們是亞伯拉罕的後裔麼．我也是。

2 Corinthians 11:23 Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
哥林多後書 11:23 他們是基督的僕人麼．（我說句狂話）我更是。我比他們多受勞苦、多下監牢、受鞭打是過重的、冒死是屢次有的．

2 Corinthians 11:24 Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
哥林多後書 11:24 被猶太人鞭打五次、每次四十、減去一下．

2 Corinthians 11:25 Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
哥林多後書 11:25 被棍打了三次、被石頭打了一次、遇着船壞三次、一晝一夜在深海裏。

2 Corinthians 11:26 In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
哥林多後書 11:26 又屢次行遠路、遭江河的危險、盜賊的危險、同族的危險、外邦人的危險、城裏的危險、曠野的危險、海中的危險、假弟兄的危險。

2 Corinthians 11:27 In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
哥林多後書 11:27 受勞碌、受困苦、多次不得睡、又饑又渴、多次不得食、受寒冷、赤身露體。

2 Corinthians 11:28 Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
哥林多後書 11:28 除了這外面的事、還有爲衆教會掛心的事、天天壓在我身上。

2 Corinthians 11:29 Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
哥林多後書 11:29 有誰輭弱、我不輭弱呢．有誰跌倒、我不焦急呢。

2 Corinthians 11:30 If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
哥林多後書 11:30 我若必須自誇、就誇那關乎我輭弱的事便了。

2 Corinthians 11:31 The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
哥林多後書 11:31 那永遠可稱頌之主耶穌的父 神、知道我不說謊。

2 Corinthians 11:32 In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
哥林多後書 11:32 在大馬色亞哩達王手下的提督、把守大馬色城要捉拿我．

2 Corinthians 11:33 And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
哥林多後書 11:33 我就從窗戶中、在筐子裏從城牆上被人縋下去、脫離了他的手。

2 Corinthians 12:1 It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
哥林多後書 12:1 我自誇固然無益、但我是不得已的．如今我要說到主的顯現和啟示。

2 Corinthians 12:2 I knew a man in Christ about fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
哥林多後書 12:2 我認得一個在基督裏的人、他前十四年被提到第三層天上去．或在身內、我不知道．或在身外、我也不知道．只有 神知道。

2 Corinthians 12:3 And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
哥林多後書 12:3 我認得這人、或在身內、或在身外、我都不知道．只有 神知道。

2 Corinthians 12:4 How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
哥林多後書 12:4 他被提到樂園裏、聽見隱祕的言語、是人不可說的。

2 Corinthians 12:5 Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
哥林多後書 12:5 爲這人、我要誇口．但是爲我自己、除了我的輭弱以外、我並不誇口。

2 Corinthians 12:6 For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
哥林多後書 12:6 我就是願意誇口、也不算狂．因爲我必說實話．只是我禁止不說、恐怕有人把我看高了、過於他在我身上所看見所聽見的。

2 Corinthians 12:7 And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
哥林多後書 12:7 又恐怕我因所得的啟示甚大、就過於自高、所以有一根刺加在我肉體上、就是撒但的差役、要攻擊我、免得我過於自高。

2 Corinthians 12:8 For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
哥林多後書 12:8 爲這事、我三次求過主、叫這刺離開我。

2 Corinthians 12:9 And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
哥林多後書 12:9 他對我說、我的恩典彀你用的．因爲我的能力、是在人的輭弱上顯得完全．所以我更喜歡誇自己的輭弱、好叫基督的能力覆庇我．

2 Corinthians 12:10 Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
哥林多後書 12:10 我爲基督的緣故、就以輭弱、凌辱、急難、逼迫、困苦、爲可喜樂的．因我甚麼時候輭弱、甚麼時候就剛強了。

2 Corinthians 12:11 I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
哥林多後書 12:11 我成了愚妄人、是被你們強逼的．我本該被你們稱許纔是．我雖算不了甚麼、卻沒有一件事在那些最大的使徒以下。

2 Corinthians 12:12 Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
哥林多後書 12:12 我在你們中間、用百般的忍耐、藉着神蹟奇事異能、顯出使徒的憑據來。

2 Corinthians 12:13 For what is it wherein you were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
哥林多後書 12:13 除了我不累着你們這一件事、你們還有甚麼事不及別的教會呢．這不公之處、求你們饒恕我罷。

2 Corinthians 12:14 Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not your's but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
哥林多後書 12:14 如今我打算第三次到你們那裏去、也必不累着你們．因我所求的是你們、不是你們的財物．兒女不該爲父母積財、父母該爲兒女積財。

2 Corinthians 12:15 And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
哥林多後書 12:15 我也甘心樂意爲你們的靈魂費財費力。難道我越發愛你們、就越發少得你們的愛麼。

2 Corinthians 12:16 But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
哥林多後書 12:16 罷了、我自己並沒有累着你們、你們卻有人說、我是詭詐、用心計牢籠你們。

2 Corinthians 12:17 Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
哥林多後書 12:17 我所差到你們那裏去的人、我藉着他們一個人佔過你們的便宜麼。

2 Corinthians 12:18 I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
哥林多後書 12:18 我勸了提多到你們那裏去、又差那位兄弟與他同去．提多佔過你們的便宜麼．我們行事、不同是一個心靈麼．不同是一個脚蹤麼。

2 Corinthians 12:19 Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
哥林多後書 12:19 你們到如今、還想我們是向你們分訴．我們本是在基督裏當 神面前說話。親愛的弟兄阿、一切的事、都是爲造就你們。

2 Corinthians 12:20 For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
哥林多後書 12:20 我怕我再來的時候、見你們不合我所想望的、你們見我也不合你們所想望的．又怕有分爭、嫉妒、惱怒、結黨、毀謗、讒言、狂傲、混亂的事．

2 Corinthians 12:21 And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
哥林多後書 12:21 且怕我來的時候、我的 神叫我在你們面前慚愧．又因許多人從前犯罪、行汚穢姦淫邪蕩的事、不肯悔改、我就憂愁。

2 Corinthians 13:1 This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
哥林多後書 13:1 這是我第三次要到你們那裏去。憑兩三個人的口作見證、句句都要定準。

2 Corinthians 13:2 I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
哥林多後書 13:2 我從前說過、如今不在你們那裏又說、正如我第二次見你們的時候所說的一樣、就是對那犯了罪的、和其餘的人說、我若再來必不寬容。

2 Corinthians 13:3 Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
哥林多後書 13:3 你們旣然尋求基督在我裏面說話的憑據、我必不寬容．因爲基督在你們身上、不是輭弱的．在你們裏面、是有大能的。

2 Corinthians 13:4 For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
哥林多後書 13:4 他因輭弱被釘在十字架上、卻因 神的大能、仍然活着．我們也是這樣同他輭弱、但因 神向你們所顯的大能、也必與他同活。

2 Corinthians 13:5 Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
哥林多後書 13:5 你們總要自己省察有信心沒有．也要自己試驗．豈不知你們若不是可棄絕的、就有耶穌基督在你們心裏麼。

2 Corinthians 13:6 But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
哥林多後書 13:6 我卻盼望你們曉得我們不是可棄絕的人。

2 Corinthians 13:7 Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
哥林多後書 13:7 我們求 神、叫你們一件惡事都不作．這不是要顯明我們是蒙悅納的、是要你們行事端正、任憑人看我們是被棄絕的罷。

2 Corinthians 13:8 For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
哥林多後書 13:8 我們凡事不能敵擋眞理、只能扶助眞理。

2 Corinthians 13:9 For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

2 Corinthians 13:12 Greet one another with an holy kiss.

哥林多後書 13:13 衆聖徒都問你們安。

2 Corinthians 13:14 The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

## Galatians / 加拉太書

Galatians 1:1 Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
加拉太書 1:1 作使徒的保羅、（不是由於人、也不是藉着人、乃是藉着耶穌基督、與叫他從死裏復活的父 神）

Galatians 1:2 And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
加拉太書 1:2 和一切與我同在的衆弟兄、寫信給加拉太的各教會。

Galatians 1:3 Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
加拉太書 1:3 願恩惠平安、從父 神與我們的主耶穌基督、歸與你們。

Galatians 1:4 Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
加拉太書 1:4 基督照我們父 神的旨意爲我們的罪捨己、要救我們脫離這罪惡的世代．

Galatians 1:5 To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
加拉太書 1:5 但願榮耀歸於 神直到永永遠遠。阿們。

加拉太書 1:6 我希奇你們這麼快離開那藉着基督之恩召你們的、去從別的福音．

Galatians 1:7 Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
加拉太書 1:7 那並不是福音、不過有些人攪擾你們、要把基督的福音更改了。

Galatians 1:8 But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
加拉太書 1:8 但無論是我們、是天上來的使者、若傳福音給你們、與我們所傳給你們的不同、他就應當被咒詛。

Galatians 1:9 As we said before, so say I now again, if any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
加拉太書 1:9 我們已經說了、現在又說、若有人傳福音給你們、與你們所領受的不同、他就應當被咒詛。

Galatians 1:10 For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
加拉太書 1:10 我現在是要得人的心呢、還是要得 神的心呢．我豈是討人的喜歡麼．若仍舊討人的喜歡、我就不是基督的僕人了。

Galatians 1:11 But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
加拉太書 1:11 弟兄們、我告訴你們、我素來所傳的福音、不是出於人的意思。

Galatians 1:12 For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
加拉太書 1:12 因爲我不是從人領受的、也不是人教導我的、乃是從耶穌基督啟示來的。

Galatians 1:13 For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
加拉太書 1:13 你們聽見我從前在猶太教中所行的事、怎樣極力逼迫殘害 神的教會。

Galatians 1:14 And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
加拉太書 1:14 我又在猶太教中、比我本國許多同歲的人更有長進、爲我祖宗的遺傳更加熱心。

Galatians 1:15 But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
加拉太書 1:15 然而那把我從母腹裏分別出來、又施恩召我的 神、

Galatians 1:16 To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
加拉太書 1:16 旣然樂意將他兒子啟示在我心裏、叫我把他傳在外邦人中、我就沒有與屬血氣的人商量、

加拉太書 1:17 也沒有上耶路撒冷去、見那些比我先作使徒的．惟獨往亞拉伯去．後又回到大馬色。

加拉太書 1:18 過了三年、纔上耶路撒冷去見磯法、和他同住了十五天。

加拉太書 1:19 至於別的使徒、除了主的兄弟雅各、我都沒有看見。

加拉太書 1:20 我寫給你們的、不是謊話、這是我在 神面前說的。

Galatians 1:21 Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
加拉太書 1:21 以後我到了叙利亞和基利家境內。

加拉太書 1:22 那時、猶太信基督的各教會都沒有見過我的面。

Galatians 1:23 But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
加拉太書 1:23 不過聽說、那從前逼迫我們的、現在傳揚他原先所殘害的眞道。

Galatians 1:24 And they glorified God in me.
加拉太書 1:24 他們就爲我的緣故、歸榮耀給 神。

Galatians 2:1 Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
加拉太書 2:1 過了十四年、我同巴拿巴又上耶路撒冷去、並帶着提多同去。

加拉太書 2:2 我是奉啟示上去的、把我在外邦人中所傳的福音、對弟兄們陳說．卻是背地裏對那有名望之人說的．惟恐我現在、或是從前、徒然奔跑。

Galatians 2:3 But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

加拉太書 2:4 因爲有偷着引進來的假弟兄、私下窺探我們在基督耶穌裏的自由、要叫我們作奴僕．

Galatians 2:5 To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
加拉太書 2:5 我們就是一刻的工夫、也沒有容讓順服他們、爲要叫福音的眞理仍存在你們中間。

Galatians 2:7 But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

Galatians 2:8 (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

加拉太書 2:9 又知道所賜給我的恩典、那稱爲教會柱石的雅各、磯法、約翰、就向我和巴拿巴用右手行相交之禮、叫我們往外邦人那裏去、他們往受割禮的人那裏去．

Galatians 2:10 Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

Galatians 3:14 That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

Galatians 3:22 But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

Galatians 3:25 But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

加拉太書 3:26 所以你們因信基督耶穌、都是 神的兒子。

Galatians 3:29 And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
