## Ephesians / 以弗所書

Ephesians 1:1 Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
以弗所書 1:1 奉 神旨意、作基督耶穌使徒的保羅、寫信給在以弗所的聖徒、就是在基督耶穌裏有忠心的人．

Ephesians 1:2 Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
以弗所書 1:2 願恩惠平安、從 神我們的父、和主耶穌基督、歸與你們。

Ephesians 1:3 Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
以弗所書 1:3 願頌讚歸與我們主耶穌基督的父 神、他在基督裏、曾賜給我們天上各樣屬靈的福氣．

Ephesians 1:4 According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
以弗所書 1:4 就如 神從創立世界以前、在基督裏揀選了我們、使我們在他面前成爲聖潔、無有瑕疵．

Ephesians 1:5 Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
以弗所書 1:5 又因愛我們、就按着自己意旨所喜悅的、豫定我們、藉着耶穌基督得兒子的名分、

Ephesians 1:6 To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
以弗所書 1:6 使他榮耀的恩典得着稱讚．這恩典是他在愛子裏所賜給我們的。

Ephesians 1:7 In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
以弗所書 1:7 我們藉這愛子的血、得蒙救贖、過犯得以赦免、乃是照他豐富的恩典．

Ephesians 1:8 Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
以弗所書 1:8 這恩典是 神用諸般智慧聰明、充充足足賞給我們的、

Ephesians 1:9 Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
以弗所書 1:9 都是照他自己所豫定的美意、叫我們知道他旨意的奧祕、

Ephesians 1:10 That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
以弗所書 1:10 要照所安排的、在日期滿足的時候、使天上地上一切所有的、都在基督裏面同歸於一。

Ephesians 1:11 In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
以弗所書 1:11 我們也在他裏面得了基業、這原是那位隨己意行作萬事的、照着他旨意所豫定的．

Ephesians 1:12 That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
以弗所書 1:12 叫他的榮耀、從我們這首先在基督裏有盼望的人、可以得着稱讚。

Ephesians 1:13 In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
以弗所書 1:13 你們旣聽見眞理的道、就是那叫你們得救的福音、也信了基督、旣然信他、就受了所應許的聖靈爲印記．

Ephesians 1:14 Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
以弗所書 1:14 這聖靈、是我們得基業的憑據、直等到 神之民被贖、使他的榮耀得着稱讚。

Ephesians 1:15 Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
以弗所書 1:15 因此、我旣聽見你們信從主耶穌、親愛衆聖徒、

Ephesians 1:16 Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
以弗所書 1:16 就爲你們不住的感謝 神、禱告的時候、常題到你們．

Ephesians 1:17 That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
以弗所書 1:17 求我們主耶穌基督的 神、榮耀的父、將那賜人智慧和啟示的靈、賞給你們、使你們眞知道他．

Ephesians 1:18 The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
以弗所書 1:18 並且照明你們心中的眼睛、使你們知道他的恩召有何等指望．他在聖徒中得的基業、有何等豐盛的榮耀．

Ephesians 1:19 And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
以弗所書 1:19 並知道他向我們這信的人所顯的能力、是何等浩大、

Ephesians 1:20 Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
以弗所書 1:20 就是照他在基督身上、所運行的大能大力、使他從死裏復活、叫他在天上坐在自己的右邊、

Ephesians 1:21 Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
以弗所書 1:21 遠超過一切執政的、掌權的、有能的、主治的、和一切有名的．不但是今世的、連來世的也都超過了．

Ephesians 1:22 And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
以弗所書 1:22 又將萬有服在他的脚下、使他爲教會作萬有之首．

Ephesians 1:23 Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
以弗所書 1:23 教會是他的身體、是那充滿萬有者所充滿的。

Ephesians 2:1 And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
以弗所書 2:1 你們死在過犯罪惡之中、他叫你們活過來．

Ephesians 2:2 Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
以弗所書 2:2 那時、你們在其中行事爲人隨從今世的風俗、順服空中掌權者的首領、就是現今在悖逆之子心中運行的邪靈．

Ephesians 2:3 Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
以弗所書 2:3 我們從前也都在他們中間、放縱肉體的私慾、隨着肉體和心中所喜好的去行、本爲可怒之子、和別人一樣．

Ephesians 2:4 But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
以弗所書 2:4 然而 神旣有豐富的憐憫．因他愛我們的大愛、

Ephesians 2:5 Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
以弗所書 2:5 當我們死在過犯中的時候、便叫我們與基督一同活過來．（你們得救是本乎恩）

Ephesians 2:6 And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
以弗所書 2:6 他又叫我們與基督耶穌一同復活、一同坐在天上、

Ephesians 2:7 That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
以弗所書 2:7 要將他極豐富的恩典、就是他在基督耶穌裏向我們所施的恩慈、顯明給後來的世代看．

Ephesians 2:8 For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
以弗所書 2:8 你們得救是本乎恩、也因着信、這並不是出於自己、乃是 神所賜的．

Ephesians 2:9 Not of works, lest any man should boast.
以弗所書 2:9 也不是出於行爲、免得有人自誇。

Ephesians 2:10 For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
以弗所書 2:10 我們原是他的工作、在基督耶穌裏造成的、爲要叫我們行善、就是 神所豫備叫我們行的。

Ephesians 2:11 Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
以弗所書 2:11 所以你們應當記念、你們從前按肉體是外邦人、是稱爲沒受割禮的這名原是那些憑人手在肉身上稱爲受割禮之人所起的．

Ephesians 2:12 That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
以弗所書 2:12 那時、你們與基督無關、在以色列國民以外、在所應許的諸約上是局外人．並且活在世上沒有指望、沒有 神。

Ephesians 2:13 But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
以弗所書 2:13 你們從前遠離 神的人、如今卻在基督耶穌裏、靠着他的血、已經得親近了。

Ephesians 2:14 For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
以弗所書 2:14 因他使我們和睦、將兩下合而爲一、拆毀了中間隔斷的牆．

Ephesians 2:15 Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
以弗所書 2:15 而且以自己的身體、廢掉寃仇、就是那記在律法上的規條．爲要將兩下、藉着自己造成一個新人、如此便成就了和睦．

Ephesians 2:16 And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
以弗所書 2:16 旣在十字架上滅了寃仇、便藉這十字架、使兩下歸爲一體、與 神和好了．

Ephesians 2:17 And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
以弗所書 2:17 並且來傳和平的福音給你們遠處的人、也給那近處的人。

Ephesians 2:18 For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
以弗所書 2:18 因爲我們兩下藉着他被一個聖靈所感、得以進到父面前。

Ephesians 2:19 Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
以弗所書 2:19 這樣、你們不再作外人、和客旅、是與聖徒同國、是 神家裏的人了．

Ephesians 2:20 And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
以弗所書 2:20 並且被建造在使徒和先知的根基上、有基督耶穌自己爲房角石．

Ephesians 2:21 In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
以弗所書 2:21 各房靠他聯絡得合式、漸漸成爲主的聖殿．

Ephesians 2:22 In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
以弗所書 2:22 你們也靠他同被建造成爲 神藉着聖靈居住的所在。

Ephesians 3:1 For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
以弗所書 3:1 因此、我保羅爲你們外邦人作了基督耶穌被囚的、替你們祈禱．

Ephesians 3:2 If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
以弗所書 3:2 諒必你們曾聽見 神賜恩給我、將關切你們的職分託付我、

Ephesians 3:3 How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
以弗所書 3:3 用啟示使我知道福音的奧祕、正如我以前畧畧寫過的．

Ephesians 3:4 Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
以弗所書 3:4 你們念了、就能曉得我深知基督的奧祕．

Ephesians 3:5 Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto the holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
以弗所書 3:5 這奧祕在以前的世代、沒有叫人知道、像如今藉着聖靈啟示他的聖使徒和先知一樣．

Ephesians 3:6 That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
以弗所書 3:6 這奧祕就是外邦人在基督耶穌裏、藉着福音、得以同爲後嗣、同爲一體、同蒙應許。

Ephesians 3:7 Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
以弗所書 3:7 我作了這福音的執事、是照 神的恩賜．這恩賜是照他運行的大能賜給我的．

Ephesians 3:8 Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
以弗所書 3:8 我本來比衆聖徒中最小的還小．然而他還賜我這恩典、叫我把基督那測不透的豐富、傳給外邦人．

Ephesians 3:9 And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
以弗所書 3:9 又使衆人都明白、這歷代以來隱藏在創造萬物之 神裏的奧祕、是如何安排的．

Ephesians 3:10 To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
以弗所書 3:10 爲要藉着教會、使天上執政的、掌權的、現在得知 神百般的智慧．

Ephesians 3:11 According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
以弗所書 3:11 這是照 神從萬世以前、在我們主基督耶穌裏所定的旨意。

Ephesians 3:12 In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
以弗所書 3:12 我們因信耶穌、就在他裏面放膽無懼、篤信不疑的來到 神面前。

Ephesians 3:13 Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
以弗所書 3:13 所以我求你們、不要因我爲你們所受的患難喪膽．這原是你們的榮耀。

Ephesians 3:14 For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
以弗所書 3:14 因此。我在父面前屈膝、

Ephesians 3:15 Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
以弗所書 3:15 （天上地上的各家、都是從他得名）

Ephesians 3:16 That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
以弗所書 3:16 求他按着他豐盛的榮耀、藉着他的靈、叫你們心裏的力量剛強起來、

Ephesians 3:17 That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
以弗所書 3:17 使基督因你們的信、住在你們心裏、叫你們的愛心、有根有基、

Ephesians 3:18 May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
以弗所書 3:18 能以和衆聖徒一同明白基督的愛、是何等長闊高深、

Ephesians 3:19 And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
以弗所書 3:19 並知道這愛是過於人所能測度的、便叫 神一切所充滿的、充滿了你們。

Ephesians 3:20 Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
以弗所書 3:20 神能照着運行在我們心裏的大力、充充足足的成就一切超過我們所求所想的．

Ephesians 3:21 Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
以弗所書 3:21 但願他在教會中、並在基督耶穌裏、得着榮耀、直到世世代代、永永遠遠。阿們。

Ephesians 4:1 I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
以弗所書 4:1 我爲主被囚的勸你們、旣然蒙召、行事爲人就當與蒙召的恩相稱．

Ephesians 4:2 With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
以弗所書 4:2 凡事謙虛、溫柔、忍耐、用愛心互相寬容、

Ephesians 4:3 Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
以弗所書 4:3 用和平彼此聯絡、竭力保守聖靈所賜合而爲一的心。

Ephesians 4:4 There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
以弗所書 4:4 身體只有一個、聖靈只有一個、正如你們蒙召、同有一個指望、

Ephesians 4:5 One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
以弗所書 4:5 一主、一信、一洗、

Ephesians 4:6 One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
以弗所書 4:6 一 神、就是衆人的父、超乎衆人之上、貫乎衆人之中、也住在衆人之內。

Ephesians 4:7 But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
以弗所書 4:7 我們各人蒙恩、都是照基督所量給各人的恩賜。

Ephesians 4:8 Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
以弗所書 4:8 所以經上說、『〡他升上高天的時候、擄掠了仇敵、將各樣的恩賜賞給人。』

Ephesians 4:9 (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
以弗所書 4:9 （旣說升上、豈不是先降在地下麼．

Ephesians 4:10 He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
以弗所書 4:10 那降下的、就是遠升諸天之上要充滿萬有的。）

Ephesians 4:11 And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
以弗所書 4:11 他所賜的有使徒、有先知．有傳福音的．有牧師和教師．

Ephesians 4:12 For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
以弗所書 4:12 爲要成全聖徒、各盡其職、建立基督的身體．

Ephesians 4:13 Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
以弗所書 4:13 直等到我們衆人在眞道上同歸於一、認識 神的兒子、得以長大成人、滿有基督長成的身量．

Ephesians 4:14 That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
以弗所書 4:14 使我們不再作小孩子、中了人的詭計、和欺騙的法術、被一切異教之風搖動、飄來飄去、就隨從各樣的異端．

Ephesians 4:15 But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
以弗所書 4:15 惟用愛心說誠實話、凡事長進、連於元首基督．

Ephesians 4:16 From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
以弗所書 4:16 全身都靠他聯絡得合式、百節各按各職、照着各體的功用、彼此相助、便叫身體漸漸增長、在愛中建立自己。

Ephesians 4:17 This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
以弗所書 4:17 所以我說、且在主裏確實的說、你們行事、不要再像外邦人存虛妄的心行事．

Ephesians 4:18 Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
以弗所書 4:18 他們心地昏昧、與 神所賜的生命隔絕了、都因自己無知、心裏剛硬．

Ephesians 4:19 Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
以弗所書 4:19 良心旣然喪盡、就放縱私慾、貪行種種的汚穢。

Ephesians 4:20 But ye have not so learned Christ;
以弗所書 4:20 你們學了基督、卻不是這樣．

Ephesians 4:21 If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
以弗所書 4:21 如果你們聽過他的道、領了他的教、學了他的眞理、

Ephesians 4:22 That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
以弗所書 4:22 就要脫去你們從前行爲上的舊人．這舊人是因私慾的迷惑、漸漸變壞的．

Ephesians 4:23 And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
以弗所書 4:23 又要將你們的心志改換一新．

Ephesians 4:24 And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
以弗所書 4:24 並且穿上新人．這新人是照着 神的形像造的、有眞理的仁義、和聖潔。

Ephesians 4:25 Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
以弗所書 4:25 〢所以你們要棄絕謊言、各人與鄰舍說實話．因爲我們是互相爲肢體。

Ephesians 4:26 Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
以弗所書 4:26 〣生氣卻不要犯罪．不可含怒到日落．

Ephesians 4:27 Neither give place to the devil.
以弗所書 4:27 也不可給魔鬼留地步。

Ephesians 4:28 Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
以弗所書 4:28 從前偷竊的、不要再偷．總要勞力、親手作正經事、就可有餘、分給那缺少的人。

Ephesians 4:29 Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
以弗所書 4:29 汚穢的言語、一句不可出口、只要隨事說造就人的好話、叫聽見的人得益處。

Ephesians 4:30 And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
以弗所書 4:30 不要叫 神的聖靈擔憂．你們原是受了他的印記、等候得贖的日子來到。

Ephesians 4:31 Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
以弗所書 4:31 一切苦毒、惱恨、忿怒、嚷鬧、毀謗、並一切的惡毒、都當從你們中間除掉．

Ephesians 4:32 And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
以弗所書 4:32 並要以恩慈相待、存憐憫的心、彼此饒恕、正如 神在基督裏饒恕了你們一樣。 :4a〡詩六十八 〡〨 :4b〢亞八 〡〦 :4c〣詩四 〤

Ephesians 5:1 Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
以弗所書 5:1 所以你們該效法 神、好像蒙慈愛的兒女一樣．

Ephesians 5:2 And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
以弗所書 5:2 也要憑愛心行事、正如基督愛我們、爲我們捨了自己、當作馨香的供物、和祭物、獻與 神。

Ephesians 5:3 But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
以弗所書 5:3 至於淫亂、並一切汚穢、或是貪婪、在你們中間連題都不可、方合聖徒的體統。

Ephesians 5:4 Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
以弗所書 5:4 淫詞、妄語、和戲笑的話、都不相宜、總要說感謝的話。

Ephesians 5:5 For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
以弗所書 5:5 因爲你們確實的知道、無論是淫亂的、是汚穢的、是有貪心的、在基督和 神的國裏、都是無分的．有貪心的、就與拜偶像的一樣。

Ephesians 5:6 Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
以弗所書 5:6 不要被人虛浮的話欺哄．因這些事、 神的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。

Ephesians 5:7 Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
以弗所書 5:7 所以你們不要與他們同夥。

Ephesians 5:8 For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
以弗所書 5:8 從前你們是暗昧的、但如今在主裏面是光明的、行事爲人就當像光明的子女．

Ephesians 5:9 (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
以弗所書 5:9 光明所結的果子、就是一切良善、公義、誠實．

Ephesians 5:10 Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
以弗所書 5:10 總要察驗何爲主所喜悅的事。

Ephesians 5:11 And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
以弗所書 5:11 那暗昧無益的事、不要與人同行、倒要責備行這事的人．

Ephesians 5:12 For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
以弗所書 5:12 因爲他們暗中所行的、就是題起來、也是可恥的。

Ephesians 5:13 But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
以弗所書 5:13 凡事受了責備、就被光顯明出來．因爲一切能顯明的、就是光。

Ephesians 5:14 Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
以弗所書 5:14 所以主說、你這睡着的人、當醒過來、從死裏復活、基督就要光照你了。

Ephesians 5:15 See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
以弗所書 5:15 你們要謹愼行事、不要像愚昧人、當像智慧人．

Ephesians 5:16 Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
以弗所書 5:16 要愛惜光陰、因爲現今的世代邪惡。

Ephesians 5:17 Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
以弗所書 5:17 不要作糊塗人、要明白主的旨意如何。

Ephesians 5:18 And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
以弗所書 5:18 不要醉酒、酒能使人放蕩、乃要被聖靈充滿。

Ephesians 5:19 Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
以弗所書 5:19 當用詩章、頌詞、靈歌、彼此對說、口唱心和的讚美主．

Ephesians 5:20 Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
以弗所書 5:20 凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名、常常感謝父 神。

Ephesians 5:21 Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
以弗所書 5:21 又當存敬畏基督的心、彼此順服。

Ephesians 5:22 Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
以弗所書 5:22 你們作妻子的、當順服自己的丈夫、如同順服主．

Ephesians 5:23 For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
以弗所書 5:23 因爲丈夫是妻子的頭、如同基督是教會的頭．他又是教會全體的救主。

Ephesians 5:24 Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
以弗所書 5:24 教會怎樣順服基督、妻子也要怎樣凡事順服丈夫。

Ephesians 5:25 Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
以弗所書 5:25 你們作丈夫的、要愛你們的妻子、正如基督愛教會、爲教會捨己．

Ephesians 5:26 That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
以弗所書 5:26 要用水藉着道、把教會洗淨、成爲聖潔、

Ephesians 5:27 That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
以弗所書 5:27 可以獻給自己、作個榮耀的教會、毫無玷汚皺紋等類的病、乃是聖潔沒有瑕疵的。

Ephesians 5:28 So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
以弗所書 5:28 丈夫也當照樣愛妻子、如同愛自己的身子．愛妻子、便是愛自己了。

Ephesians 5:29 For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
以弗所書 5:29 從來沒有人恨惡自己的身子、總是保養顧惜、正像基督待教會一樣．

Ephesians 5:30 For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
以弗所書 5:30 因我們是他身上的肢體。

Ephesians 5:31 For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
以弗所書 5:31 爲這個緣故、〡人要離開父母、與妻子連合、二人成爲一體。

Ephesians 5:32 This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
以弗所書 5:32 這是極大的奧祕、但我是指着基督和教會說的。

Ephesians 5:33 Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
以弗所書 5:33 然而你們各人都當愛妻子、如同愛自己一樣．妻子也當敬重他的丈夫。 :5a〡創二 〢〤

Ephesians 6:1 Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
以弗所書 6:1 你們作兒女的、要在主裏聽從父母、這是理所當然的。

Ephesians 6:3 That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
以弗所書 6:3 要孝敬父母、使你得福、在世長壽．〡這是第一條帶應許的誡命。

Ephesians 6:4 And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
以弗所書 6:4 你們作父親的、不要惹兒女的氣、只要照着主的教訓和警戒、養育他們。

Ephesians 6:5 Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
以弗所書 6:5 你們作僕人的、要懼怕戰兢、用誠實的心聽從你們肉身的主人、好像聽從基督一般。

Ephesians 6:6 Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
以弗所書 6:6 不要只在眼前事奉、像是討人喜歡的、要像基督的僕人、從心裏遵行 神的旨意．

Ephesians 6:7 With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
以弗所書 6:7 甘心事奉、好像服事主、不像服事人。

Ephesians 6:8 Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
以弗所書 6:8 因爲曉得各人所行的善事、不論是爲奴的、是自主的、都必按所行的得主的賞賜。

Ephesians 6:9 And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
以弗所書 6:9 你們作主人的待僕人、也是一理、不要威嚇他們．因爲知道他們和你們、同有一位主在天上、他並不偏待人。

Ephesians 6:10 Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
以弗所書 6:10 我還有末了的話、你們要靠着主、倚賴他的大能大力、作剛強的人。

Ephesians 6:11 Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
以弗所書 6:11 要穿戴 神所賜的全副軍裝、就能抵擋魔鬼的詭計。

Ephesians 6:12 For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
以弗所書 6:12 因我們並不是與屬血氣的爭戰、乃是與那些執政的、掌權的、管轄這幽暗世界的、以及天空屬靈氣的惡魔爭戰。

Ephesians 6:13 Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
以弗所書 6:13 所以要拿起 神所賜的全副軍裝、好在磨難的日子、抵擋仇敵、並且成就了一切、還能站立得住。

Ephesians 6:14 Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
以弗所書 6:14 所以要站穩了、用眞理當作帶子束腰、用公義當作護心鏡遮胸．

Ephesians 6:15 And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
以弗所書 6:15 又用平安的福音、當作豫備走路的鞋穿在脚上．

Ephesians 6:16 Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
以弗所書 6:16 此外又拿着信德當作籐牌、可以滅盡那惡者一切的火箭．

Ephesians 6:17 And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
以弗所書 6:17 並戴上救恩的頭盔、拿着聖靈的寶劍、就是 神的道．

Ephesians 6:18 Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
以弗所書 6:18 靠着聖靈、隨時多方禱告祈求、並要在此儆醒不倦、爲衆聖徒祈求、

Ephesians 6:19 And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
以弗所書 6:19 也爲我祈求、使我得着口才、能以放膽、開口講明福音的奧祕、

Ephesians 6:20 For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
以弗所書 6:20 （我爲這福音的奧祕、作了帶鎖鍊的使者）並使我照着當盡的本分、放膽講論。

Ephesians 6:21 But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
以弗所書 6:21 今有所親愛忠心事奉主的兄弟推基古、他要把我的事情並我的景况如何、全告訴你們叫你們知道。

Ephesians 6:22 Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
以弗所書 6:22 我特意打發他到你們那裏去、好叫你們知道我們的光景、又叫他安慰你們的心。

Ephesians 6:23 Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
以弗所書 6:23 願平安、仁愛、信心、從父 神和主耶穌基督、歸與弟兄們。

Ephesians 6:24 Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
以弗所書 6:24 並願所有誠心愛我們主耶穌基督的人、都蒙恩惠。 :6a〡出二十 〡二 申五 〡〦 腓立比書]] 1925

## Philippians / 腓立比書

Philippians 1:1 Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
腓立比書 1:1 基督耶穌的僕人保羅、和提摩太、寫信給凡住腓立比、在基督耶穌裏的衆聖徒、和諸位監督、諸位執事．

Philippians 1:2 Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
腓立比書 1:2 願恩惠平安、從 神我們的父、並主耶穌基督、歸與你們。

Philippians 1:3 I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
腓立比書 1:3 我每逢想念你們、就感謝我的 神．

Philippians 1:4 Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
腓立比書 1:4 （每逢爲你們衆人祈求的時候、常是歡歡喜喜的祈求）

Philippians 1:5 For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
腓立比書 1:5 因爲從頭一天直到如今、你們是同心合意的興旺福音。

Philippians 1:6 Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
腓立比書 1:6 我深信那在你們心裏動了善工的、必成全這工、直到耶穌基督的日子．

Philippians 1:7 Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
腓立比書 1:7 我爲你們衆人有這樣的意念、原是應當的．因你們常在我心裏、無論我是在捆鎖之中、是辯明證實福音的時候、你們都與我一同得恩。

Philippians 1:8 For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
腓立比書 1:8 我體會基督耶穌的心腸、切切的想念你們衆人．這是 神可以給我作見證的。

Philippians 1:9 And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
腓立比書 1:9 我所禱告的、就是要你們的愛心、在知識和各樣見識上、多而又多．

Philippians 1:10 That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ.
腓立比書 1:10 使你們能分別是非、作誠實無過的人、直到基督的日子．

Philippians 1:11 Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
腓立比書 1:11 並靠着耶穌基督結滿了仁義的果子、叫榮耀稱讚歸與 神。

Philippians 1:12 But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
腓立比書 1:12 弟兄們、我願意你們知道、我所遭遇的事、更是叫福音興旺．

Philippians 1:13 So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
腓立比書 1:13 以致我受的捆鎖、在御營全軍、和其餘的人中、已經顯明是爲基督的緣故。

Philippians 1:14 And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
腓立比書 1:14 並且那在主裏的弟兄、多半因我受的捆鎖、就篤信不疑、越發放膽傳 神的道、無所懼怕。

Philippians 1:15 Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
腓立比書 1:15 有的傳基督、是出於嫉妒分爭．也有的是出於好意．

Philippians 1:16 The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
腓立比書 1:16 這一等、是出於愛心、知道我是爲辯明福音設立的．

Philippians 1:17 But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
腓立比書 1:17 那一等傳基督、是出於結黨、並不誠實、意思要加增我捆鎖的苦楚。

Philippians 1:18 What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
腓立比書 1:18 這有何妨呢．或是假意、或是眞心、無論怎樣、基督究竟被傳開了．爲此我就歡喜、並且還要歡喜。

Philippians 1:19 For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
腓立比書 1:19 因爲我知道這事藉着你們的祈禱、和耶穌基督之靈的幫助、終必叫我得救．

Philippians 1:20 According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
腓立比書 1:20 照着我所切慕所盼望的、沒有一事叫我羞愧、只要凡事放膽．無論是生、是死、總叫基督在我身上照常顯大。

Philippians 1:21 For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
腓立比書 1:21 因我活着就是基督、我死了就有益處。

Philippians 1:22 But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
腓立比書 1:22 但我在肉身活着、若成就我工夫的果子、我就不知道該挑選甚麼。

Philippians 1:23 For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
腓立比書 1:23 我正在兩難之間、情願離世與基督同在．因爲這是好得無比的．

Philippians 1:24 Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
腓立比書 1:24 然而我在肉身活着、爲你們更是要緊的。

Philippians 1:25 And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
腓立比書 1:25 我旣然這樣深信、就知道仍要住在世間、且與你們衆人同住、使你們在所信的道上、又長進又喜樂．

Philippians 1:26 That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
腓立比書 1:26 叫你們在基督耶穌裏的歡樂、因我再到你們那裏去、就越發加增。

Philippians 1:27 Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
腓立比書 1:27 只要你們行事爲人與基督的福音相稱．叫我或來見你們、或不在你們那裏、可以聽見你們的景况、知道你們同有一個心志、站立得穩、爲所信的福音齊心努力．

Philippians 1:28 And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
腓立比書 1:28 凡事不怕敵人的驚嚇．這是證明他們沉淪、你們得救、都是出於 神。

Philippians 1:29 For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
腓立比書 1:29 因爲你們蒙恩、不但得以信服基督、並要爲他受苦。

Philippians 1:30 Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
腓立比書 1:30 你們的爭戰、就與你們在我身上從前所看見、現在所聽見的一樣。

Philippians 2:1 If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
腓立比書 2:1 所以在基督裏若有甚麼勸勉、愛心有甚麼安慰、聖靈有甚麼交通、心中有甚麼慈悲憐憫、

Philippians 2:2 Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
腓立比書 2:2 你們就要意念相同、愛心相同、有一樣的心思、有一樣的意念、使我的喜樂可以滿足。

Philippians 2:3 Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
腓立比書 2:3 凡事不可結黨、不可貪圖虛浮的榮耀．只要存心謙卑、各人看別人比自己強。

Philippians 2:4 Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
腓立比書 2:4 各人不要單顧自己的事、也要顧別人的事。

Philippians 2:5 Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
腓立比書 2:5 你們當以基督耶穌的心爲心。

Philippians 2:6 Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
腓立比書 2:6 他本有 神的形像、不以自己與 神同等爲強奪的．

Philippians 2:7 But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
腓立比書 2:7 反倒虛己、取了奴僕的形像、成爲人的樣式．

Philippians 2:8 And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
腓立比書 2:8 旣有人的樣子、就自己卑微、存心順服、以至於死、且死在十字架上。

Philippians 2:9 Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
腓立比書 2:9 所以 神將他升爲至高、又賜給他那超乎萬名之上的名、

Philippians 2:10 That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
腓立比書 2:10 叫一切在天上的、地上的、和地底下的、因耶穌的名、無不屈膝、

Philippians 2:11 And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
腓立比書 2:11 無不口稱耶穌基督爲主、使榮耀歸與父 神。

Philippians 2:12 Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
腓立比書 2:12 這樣看來、我親愛的弟兄、你們旣是常順服的、不但我在你們那裏、就是我如今不在你們那裏、更是順服的、就當恐懼戰兢、作成你們得救的工夫．

Philippians 2:13 For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
腓立比書 2:13 因爲你們立志行事、都是 神在你們心裏運行、爲要成就他的美意。

Philippians 2:14 Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
腓立比書 2:14 凡所行的、都不要發怨言、起爭論、

Philippians 2:15 That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
腓立比書 2:15 使你們無可指摘、誠實無僞、在這彎曲悖謬的世代、作 神無瑕疵的兒女．你們顯在這世代中、好像明光照耀、

Philippians 2:16 Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
腓立比書 2:16 將生命的道表明出來、叫我在基督的日子、好誇我沒有空跑、也沒有徒勞。

Philippians 2:17 Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
腓立比書 2:17 我以你們的信心爲供獻的祭物．我若被澆奠在其上、也是喜樂．並且與你們衆人一同喜樂．

Philippians 2:18 For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
腓立比書 2:18 你們也要照樣喜樂、並且與我一同喜樂。

Philippians 2:19 But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
腓立比書 2:19 我靠主耶穌指望快打發提摩太去見你們、叫我知道你們的事、心裏就得着安慰。

Philippians 2:20 For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
腓立比書 2:20 因爲我沒有別人與我同心、實在罣念你們的事。

Philippians 2:21 For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.
腓立比書 2:21 別人都求自己的事、並不求耶穌基督的事。

Philippians 2:22 But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
腓立比書 2:22 但你們知道提摩太的明證、他興旺福音與我同勞、待我像兒子待父親一樣。

Philippians 2:23 Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
腓立比書 2:23 所以我一看出我的事要怎樣了結、就盼望立刻打發他去．

Philippians 2:24 But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
腓立比書 2:24 但我靠着主自信我也必快去。

Philippians 2:25 Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
腓立比書 2:25 然而我想必須打發以巴弗提到你們那裏去．他是我的兄弟、與我一同作工、一同當兵、是你們所差遣的、也是供給我需用的。

Philippians 2:26 For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
腓立比書 2:26 他很想念你們衆人、並且極其難過、因爲你們聽見他病了．

Philippians 2:27 For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
腓立比書 2:27 他實在是病了、幾乎要死．然而 神憐恤他、不但憐恤他、也憐恤我、免得我憂上加憂。

Philippians 2:28 I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
腓立比書 2:28 所以我越發急速打發他去、叫你們再見他、就可以喜樂、我也可以少些憂愁。

Philippians 2:29 Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
腓立比書 2:29 故此你們要在主裏歡歡樂樂的接待他．而且要尊重這樣的人．

Philippians 2:30 Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
腓立比書 2:30 因他爲作基督的工夫、幾乎至死、不顧性命、要補足你們供給我的不及之處。

Philippians 3:1 Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
腓立比書 3:1 弟兄們、我還有話說、你們要靠主喜樂。我把這話再寫給你們、於我並不爲難、於你們卻是妥當。

Philippians 3:2 Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
腓立比書 3:2 應當防備犬類、防備作惡的、防備妄自行割的．

Philippians 3:3 For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
腓立比書 3:3 因爲眞受割禮的、乃是我們這以 神的靈敬拜、在基督耶穌裏誇口、不靠着肉體的．

Philippians 3:4 Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
腓立比書 3:4 其實我也可以靠肉體．若是別人想他可以靠肉體、我更可以靠着了。

Philippians 3:5 Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
腓立比書 3:5 我第八天受割禮、我是以色列族、便雅憫支派的人、是希伯來人所生的希伯來人．就律法說、我是法利賽人．

Philippians 3:6 Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
腓立比書 3:6 就熱心說、我是逼迫教會的．就律法上的義說、我是無可指摘的。

Philippians 3:7 But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
腓立比書 3:7 只是我先前以爲與我有益的、我現在因基督都當作有損的。

Philippians 3:8 Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
腓立比書 3:8 不但如此、我也將萬事當作有損的、因我以認識我主基督耶穌爲至寶。我爲他已經丟棄萬事、看作糞土、爲要得着基督．

Philippians 3:9 And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
腓立比書 3:9 並且得以在他裏面、不是有自己因律法而得的義、乃是有信基督的義、就是因信 神而來的義．

Philippians 3:10 That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
腓立比書 3:10 使我認識基督、曉得他復活的大能、並且曉得和他一同受苦、效法他的死．

Philippians 3:11 If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
腓立比書 3:11 或者我也得以從死裏復活。

Philippians 3:12 Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
腓立比書 3:12 這不是說、我已經得着了、已經完全了．我乃是竭力追求、或者可以得着基督耶穌所以得着我的。

Philippians 3:13 Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
腓立比書 3:13 弟兄們、我不是以爲自己已經得着了．我只有一件事、就是忘記背後努力面前的、

Philippians 3:14 I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
腓立比書 3:14 向着標竿直跑、要得 神在基督耶穌裏從上面召我來得的獎賞。

Philippians 3:15 Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
腓立比書 3:15 所以我們中間凡是完全人、總要存這樣的心．若在甚麼事上、存別樣的心、 神也必以此指示你們．

Philippians 3:16 Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
腓立比書 3:16 然而我們到了甚麼地步、就當照着甚麼地步行。

Philippians 3:17 Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
腓立比書 3:17 弟兄們、你們要一同效法我、也當留意看那些照我們榜樣行的人。

Philippians 3:18 (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
腓立比書 3:18 因爲有許多人行事、是基督十字架的仇敵．我屢次告訴你們、現在又流淚的告訴你們。

Philippians 3:19 Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
腓立比書 3:19 他們的結局就是沉淪、他們的 神就是自己的肚腹、他們以自己的羞辱爲榮耀、專以地上的事爲念。

Philippians 3:20 For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
腓立比書 3:20 我們卻是天上的國民．並且等候救主、就是主耶穌基督、從天上降臨。

Philippians 3:21 Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
腓立比書 3:21 他要按着那能叫萬有歸服自己的大能、將我們這卑賤的身體改變形狀、和他自己榮耀的身體相似。

Philippians 4:1 Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
腓立比書 4:1 我所親愛所想念的弟兄們、你們就是我的喜樂、我的冠冕．我親愛的弟兄、你們應當靠主站立得穩。

Philippians 4:2 I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
腓立比書 4:2 我勸友阿爹和循都基、要在主裏同心．

Philippians 4:3 And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
腓立比書 4:3 我也求你這眞實同負一軛的、幫助這兩個女人、因爲他們在福音上曾與我一同勞苦．還有革利免、並其餘和我一同作工的．他們的名字都在生命册上。

Philippians 4:4 Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
腓立比書 4:4 你們要靠主常常喜樂．我再說、你們要喜樂。

Philippians 4:5 Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
腓立比書 4:5 當叫衆人知道你們謙讓的心。主已經近了。

Philippians 4:6 Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
腓立比書 4:6 應當一無罣慮、只要凡事藉着禱告、祈求、和感謝、將你們所要的告訴 神。

Philippians 4:7 And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
腓立比書 4:7 神所賜出人意外的平安、必在基督耶穌裏、保守你們的心懷意念。

Philippians 4:8 Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
腓立比書 4:8 弟兄們、我還有未盡的話．凡是眞實的、可敬的、公義的、清潔的、可愛的、有美名的．若有甚麼德行、若有甚麼稱讚、這些事你們都要思念。

Philippians 4:9 Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
腓立比書 4:9 你們在我身上所學習的、所領受的、所聽見的、所看見的、這些事你們都要去行．賜平安的 神、就必與你們同在。

Philippians 4:10 But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
腓立比書 4:10 我靠主大大的喜樂、因爲你們思念我的心、如今又發生．你們向來就思念我、只是沒得機會。

Philippians 4:11 Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
腓立比書 4:11 我並不是因缺乏說這話、我無論在甚麼景况、都可以知足、這是我已經學會了．

Philippians 4:12 I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
腓立比書 4:12 我知道怎樣處卑賤、也知道怎樣處豐富、或飽足、或飢餓、或有餘、或缺乏、隨事隨在、我都得了祕訣。

Philippians 4:13 I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
腓立比書 4:13 我靠着那加給我力量的、凡事都能作。

Philippians 4:14 Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
腓立比書 4:14 然而你們和我同受患難、原是美事。

Philippians 4:15 Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
腓立比書 4:15 腓立比人哪、你們也知道我初傳福音、離了馬其頓的時候、論到授受的事、除了你們以外、並沒有別的教會供給我．

Philippians 4:16 For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
腓立比書 4:16 就是我在帖撒羅尼迦、你們也一次兩次的、打發人供給我的需用。

Philippians 4:17 Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
腓立比書 4:17 我並不求甚麼餽送、所求的就是你們的果子漸漸增多、歸在你們的帳上。

Philippians 4:18 But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
腓立比書 4:18 但我樣樣都有、並且有餘．我已經充足、因我從以巴弗提受了你們的餽送、當作極美的香氣、爲 神所收納所喜悅的祭物。

Philippians 4:19 But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
腓立比書 4:19 我的 神必照他榮耀的豐富、在基督耶穌裏、使你們一切所需用的都充足。

Philippians 4:20 Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
腓立比書 4:20 願榮耀歸給我們的父 神、直到永永遠遠。阿們。

Philippians 4:21 Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
腓立比書 4:21 請問在基督耶穌裏的各位聖徒安。在我這裏的衆弟兄都問你們安。

Philippians 4:22 All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
腓立比書 4:22 衆聖徒都問你們安。在該撒家裏的人特特的問你們安。

Philippians 4:23 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
腓立比書 4:23 願主耶穌基督的恩常在你們心裏。 歌羅西書]] 1925

## Colossians / 歌羅西書

Colossians 1:1 Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
歌羅西書 1:1 奉 神旨意、作基督耶穌使徒的保羅、和兄弟提摩太、

Colossians 1:2 To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
歌羅西書 1:2 寫信給歌羅西的聖徒、在基督裏有忠心的弟兄．願恩惠平安、從 神我們的父、歸與你們。

Colossians 1:3 We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
歌羅西書 1:3 我們感謝 神我們主耶穌基督的父、常常爲你們禱告．

Colossians 1:4 Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
歌羅西書 1:4 因聽見你們在基督耶穌裏的信心、並向衆聖徒的愛心．

Colossians 1:5 For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
歌羅西書 1:5 是爲那給你們存在天上的盼望．這盼望就是你們從前在福音眞理的道上所聽見的．

Colossians 1:6 Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
歌羅西書 1:6 這福音傳到你們那裏、也傳到普天之下、並且結果增長、如同在你們中間、自從你們聽見福音、眞知道 神恩惠的日子一樣．

Colossians 1:7 As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
歌羅西書 1:7 正如你們從我們所親愛、一同作僕人的以巴弗所學的．他爲我們作了基督忠心的執事．

Colossians 1:8 Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
歌羅西書 1:8 也把你們因聖靈所存的愛心告訴了我們。

Colossians 1:9 For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
歌羅西書 1:9 因此、我們自從聽見的日子、也就爲你們不住的禱告祈求、願你們在一切屬靈的智慧悟性上、滿心知道 神的旨意．

Colossians 1:10 That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
歌羅西書 1:10 好叫你們行事爲人對得起主、凡事蒙他喜悅、在一切善事上結果子、漸漸的多知道 神．

Colossians 1:11 Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
歌羅西書 1:11 照他榮耀的權能、得以在各樣的力上加力、好叫你們凡事歡歡喜喜的忍耐寬容．

Colossians 1:12 Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
歌羅西書 1:12 又感謝父、叫我們能與衆聖徒在光明中同得基業．

Colossians 1:13 Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
歌羅西書 1:13 他救了我們脫離黑暗的權勢、把我們遷到他愛子的國裏．

Colossians 1:14 In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
歌羅西書 1:14 我們在愛子裏得蒙救贖、罪過得以赦免。

Colossians 1:15 Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
歌羅西書 1:15 愛子是那不能看見之 神的像、是首生的、在一切被造的以先．

Colossians 1:16 For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
歌羅西書 1:16 因爲萬有都是靠他造的、無論是天上的、地上的、能看見的、不能看見的、或是有位的、主治的、執政的、掌權的、一槪都是藉着他造的、又是爲他造的．

Colossians 1:17 And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
歌羅西書 1:17 他在萬有之先．萬有也靠他而立。

Colossians 1:18 And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
歌羅西書 1:18 他也是教會全體之首．他是元始、是從死裏首先復生的、使他可以在凡事上居首位。

Colossians 1:19 For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
歌羅西書 1:19 因爲父喜歡叫一切的豐盛、在他裏面居住。

Colossians 1:20 And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
歌羅西書 1:20 旣然藉着他在十字架上所流的血、成就了和平、便藉着他叫萬有、無論是地上的、天上的、都與自己和好了。

Colossians 1:21 And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
歌羅西書 1:21 你們從前與 神隔絕、因着惡行、心裏與他爲敵．

Colossians 1:22 In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
歌羅西書 1:22 但如今他藉着基督的肉身受死、叫你們與自己和好、都成了聖潔、沒有瑕疵、無可責備、把你們引到自己面前。

Colossians 1:23 If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
歌羅西書 1:23 只要你們在所信的道上恆心、根基穩固、堅定不移、不至被引動失去福音的盼望．這福音就是你們所聽過的、也是傳與普天下萬人聽的．我保羅也作了這福音的執事。

Colossians 1:24 Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
歌羅西書 1:24 現在我爲你們受苦、倒覺歡樂、並且爲基督的身體、就是爲教會、要在我肉身上補滿基督患難的缺欠。

Colossians 1:25 Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
歌羅西書 1:25 我照 神爲你們所賜我的職分、作了教會的執事、要把 神的道理傳得全備．

Colossians 1:26 Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
歌羅西書 1:26 這道理就是歷世歷代所隱藏的奧祕、但如今向他的聖徒顯明了．

Colossians 1:27 To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
歌羅西書 1:27 神願意叫他們知道、這奧祕在外邦人中有何等豐盛的榮耀．就是基督在你們心裏成了有榮耀的盼望．

Colossians 1:28 Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
歌羅西書 1:28 我們傳揚他、是用諸般的智慧、勸戒各人、教導各人．要把各人在基督裏完完全全的引到 神面前．

Colossians 1:29 Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
歌羅西書 1:29 我也爲此勞苦、照着他在我裏面運用的大能、盡心竭力。

Colossians 2:1 For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
歌羅西書 2:1 我願意你們曉得我爲你們和老底嘉人、並一切沒有與我親自見面的人、是何等的盡心竭力．

Colossians 2:2 That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
歌羅西書 2:2 要叫他們的心得安慰、因愛心互相聯絡、以致豐豐足足在悟性中有充足的信心、使他們眞知 神的奧祕、就是基督．

Colossians 2:3 In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
歌羅西書 2:3 所積蓄的一切智慧知識、都在他裏面藏着。

Colossians 2:4 And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
歌羅西書 2:4 我說這話、免得有人用花言巧語迷惑你們。

Colossians 2:5 For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
歌羅西書 2:5 我身子雖與你們相離、心卻與你們同在、見你們循規蹈矩、信基督的心也堅固、我就歡喜了。

Colossians 2:6 As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
歌羅西書 2:6 你們旣然接受了主基督耶穌、就當遵他而行．

Colossians 2:7 Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
歌羅西書 2:7 在他裏面生根建造、信心堅固、正如你們所領的教訓、感謝的心也更增長了。

Colossians 2:8 Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
歌羅西書 2:8 你們要謹愼、恐怕有人用他的理學、和虛空的妄言、不照着基督、乃照人間的遺傳、和世上的小學、就把你們擄去．

Colossians 2:9 For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
歌羅西書 2:9 因爲 神本性一切的豐盛、都有形有體的居住在基督裏面．

Colossians 2:10 And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
歌羅西書 2:10 你們在他裏面也得了豐盛。他是各樣執政掌權者的元首．

Colossians 2:11 In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
歌羅西書 2:11 你們在他裏面、也受了不是人手所行的割禮、乃是基督使你們脫去肉體情慾的割禮．

Colossians 2:12 Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
歌羅西書 2:12 你們旣受洗與他一同埋葬、也就在此與他一同復活．都因信那叫他從死裏復活 神的功用。

Colossians 2:13 And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
歌羅西書 2:13 你們從前在過犯、和未受割禮的肉體中死了、 神赦免了你們一切過犯、便叫你們與基督一同活過來．

Colossians 2:14 Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
歌羅西書 2:14 又塗抹了在律例上所寫、攻擊我們有礙於我們的字據、把他撤去、釘在十字架上．

Colossians 2:15 And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
歌羅西書 2:15 旣將一切執政的掌權的擄來、明顯給衆人看、就仗着十字架誇勝。

Colossians 2:16 Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
歌羅西書 2:16 所以不拘在飲食上、或節期、月朔、安息日、都不可讓人論斷你們．

Colossians 2:17 Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
歌羅西書 2:17 這些原是後事的影兒．那形體卻是基督。

Colossians 2:18 Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
歌羅西書 2:18 不可讓人因着故意謙虛、和敬拜天使、就奪去你們的獎賞．這等人拘泥在所見過的、隨着自己的慾心、無故的自高自大、

Colossians 2:19 And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
歌羅西書 2:19 不持定元首、全身旣然靠着他筋節得以相助聯絡、就因 神大得長進。

Colossians 2:21 (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
歌羅西書 2:21 你們若是與基督同死、脫離了世上的小學、爲甚麼仍像在世俗中活着、服從那不可拿、不可嘗、不可摸、等類的規條呢。

Colossians 2:22 Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
歌羅西書 2:22 這都是照人所吩咐所教導的。說到這一切、正用的時候就都敗壞了。

Colossians 2:23 Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body: not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
歌羅西書 2:23 這些規條、使人徒有智慧之名、用私意崇拜、自表謙卑、苦待己身、其實在克制肉體的情慾上、是毫無功效。

Colossians 3:1 If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
歌羅西書 3:1 所以你們若眞與基督一同復活、就當求在上面的事．那裏有基督坐在 神的右邊。

Colossians 3:2 Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
歌羅西書 3:2 你們要思念上面的事、不要思念地上的事。

Colossians 3:3 For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
歌羅西書 3:3 因爲你們已經死了、你們的生命與基督一同藏在 神裏面。

Colossians 3:4 When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
歌羅西書 3:4 基督是我們的生命、他顯現的時候、你們也要與他一同顯現在榮耀裏。

Colossians 3:5 Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
歌羅西書 3:5 所以要治死你們在地上的肢體．就如淫亂、汚穢、邪情、惡慾、和貪婪、貪婪就與拜偶像一樣。

Colossians 3:6 For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
歌羅西書 3:6 因這些事、 神的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。

Colossians 3:7 In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
歌羅西書 3:7 當你們在這些事中活着的時候、也曾這樣行過。

Colossians 3:8 But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
歌羅西書 3:8 但現在你們要棄絕這一切的事、以及惱恨、忿怒、惡毒、毀謗、並口中汚穢的言語。

Colossians 3:9 Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
歌羅西書 3:9 不要彼此說謊．因你們已經脫去舊人、和舊人的行爲、

Colossians 3:10 And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
歌羅西書 3:10 穿上了新人．這新人在知識上漸漸更新、正如造他主的形像．

Colossians 3:11 Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
歌羅西書 3:11 在此並不分希利尼人、猶太人、受割禮的、未受割禮的、化外人、西古提人、爲奴的、自主的．惟有基督是包括一切、又住在各人之內。

Colossians 3:12 Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
歌羅西書 3:12 所以你們旣是 神的選民、聖潔蒙愛的人、就要存憐憫、恩慈、謙虛、溫柔、忍耐的心。

Colossians 3:13 Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
歌羅西書 3:13 倘若這人與那人有嫌隙、總要彼此包容、彼此饒恕．主怎樣饒恕了你們、你們也要怎樣饒恕人。

Colossians 3:14 And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
歌羅西書 3:14 在這一切之外、要存着愛心．愛心就是聯絡全德的。

Colossians 3:15 And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
歌羅西書 3:15 又要叫基督的平安在你們心裏作主．你們也爲此蒙召、歸爲一體．且要存感謝的心。

Colossians 3:16 Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
歌羅西書 3:16 當用各樣的智慧、把基督的道理、豐豐富富的存在心裏、用詩章、頌詞、靈歌、彼此教導、互相勸戒心被恩感歌頌 神。

Colossians 3:17 And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
歌羅西書 3:17 無論作甚麼、或說話、或行事、都要奉主耶穌的名、藉着他感謝父 神。

Colossians 3:18 Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
歌羅西書 3:18 你們作妻子的、當順服自己的丈夫、這在主裏面是相宜的。

Colossians 3:19 Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
歌羅西書 3:19 你們作丈夫的、要愛你們的妻子、不可苦待他們。

Colossians 3:20 Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
歌羅西書 3:20 你們作兒女的、要凡事聽從父母、因爲這是主所喜悅的。

Colossians 3:21 Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
歌羅西書 3:21 你們作父親的、不要惹兒女的氣、恐怕他們失了志氣。

Colossians 3:22 Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God;
歌羅西書 3:22 你們作僕人的、要凡事聽從你們肉身的主人、不要只在眼前事奉、像是討人喜歡的、總要存心誠實敬畏主．

Colossians 3:23 And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
歌羅西書 3:23 無論作甚麼、都要從心裏作、像是給主作的、不是給人作的。

Colossians 3:24 Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
歌羅西書 3:24 因你們知道從主那裏、必得着基業爲賞賜．你們所事奉的乃是主基督。

Colossians 3:25 But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
歌羅西書 3:25 那行不義的、必受不義的報應．主並不偏待人。

Colossians 4:1 Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
歌羅西書 4:1 你們作主人的、要公公平平的待僕人、因爲知道你們也有一位主在天上。

Colossians 4:2 Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
歌羅西書 4:2 你們要恆切禱告、在此儆醒感恩．

Colossians 4:3 Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
歌羅西書 4:3 也要爲我們禱告、求 神給我們開傳道的門、能以講基督的奧祕、（我爲此被捆鎖）

Colossians 4:4 That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
歌羅西書 4:4 叫我按着所該說的話、將這奧祕發明出來。

Colossians 4:5 Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
歌羅西書 4:5 你們要愛惜光陰、用智慧與外人交往。

Colossians 4:6 Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
歌羅西書 4:6 你們的言語要常常帶着和氣、好像用鹽調和、就可知道該怎樣回答各人。

Colossians 4:7 All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
歌羅西書 4:7 有我親愛的兄弟推基古要將我一切的事都告訴你們．他是忠心的執事、和我一同作主的僕人。

Colossians 4:8 Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
歌羅西書 4:8 我特意打發他到你們那裏去、好叫你們知道我們的光景、又叫他安慰你們的心。

Colossians 4:9 With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
歌羅西書 4:9 我又打發一位親愛忠心的兄弟阿尼西母同去．他也是你們那裏的人。他們要把這裏一切的事都告訴你們。

Colossians 4:10 Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
歌羅西書 4:10 與我一同坐監的亞里達古問你們安。巴拿巴的表弟馬可也問你們安。（說到這馬可、你們已經受了吩咐．他若到了你們那裏、你們就接待他。）

Colossians 4:11 And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
歌羅西書 4:11 耶數又稱爲猶士都、也問你們安．奉割禮的人中、只有這三個人、是爲 神的國與我一同作工的、也是叫我心裏得安慰的。

Colossians 4:12 Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
歌羅西書 4:12 有你們那裏的人、作基督耶穌僕人的以巴弗問你們安。他在禱告之間、常爲你們竭力的祈求、願你們在 神一切的旨意上、得以完全、信心充足、能站立得穩。

Colossians 4:13 For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
歌羅西書 4:13 他爲你們和老底嘉並希拉波立的弟兄、多多的勞苦．這是我可以給他作見證的。

Colossians 4:14 Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
歌羅西書 4:14 所親愛的醫生路加、和底馬問你們安。

Colossians 4:15 Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
歌羅西書 4:15 請問老底嘉的弟兄和寧法、並他家裏的教會安。

Colossians 4:16 And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
歌羅西書 4:16 你們念了這書信、便交給老底嘉的教會、叫他們也念．你們也要念從老底嘉來的書信。

Colossians 4:17 And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
歌羅西書 4:17 要對亞基布說、務要謹愼、盡你從主所受的職分。

Colossians 4:18 The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
歌羅西書 4:18 我保羅親筆問你們安。你們要記念我的捆鎖。願恩惠常與你們同在。 帖撒羅尼迦前書]] 1925

## 1 Thessalonians / 帖撒羅尼迦前書

1 Thessalonians 1:1 Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:1 保羅、西拉、提摩太、寫信給帖撒羅尼迦在父 神和主耶穌基督裏的教會．願恩惠平安歸與你們。

1 Thessalonians 1:2 We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:2 我們爲你們衆人常常感謝 神、禱告的時候題到你們．

1 Thessalonians 1:3 Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:3 在 神我們的父面前、不住的記念你們因信心所作的工夫、因愛心所受的勞苦、因盼望我們主耶穌基督所存的忍耐。

1 Thessalonians 1:4 Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:4 被 神所愛的弟兄阿、我知道你們是蒙揀選的．

1 Thessalonians 1:5 For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:5 因爲我們的福音傳到你們那裏、不獨在乎言語、也在乎權能、和聖靈、並充足的信心．正如你們知道我們在你們那裏、爲你們的緣故是怎樣爲人。

1 Thessalonians 1:6 And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost.
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:6 並且你們在大難之中、蒙了聖靈所賜的喜樂、領受眞道、就效法我們、也效法了主．

1 Thessalonians 1:7 So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:7 甚至你們作了馬其頓和亞該亞、所有信主之人的榜樣。

1 Thessalonians 1:8 For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:8 因爲主的道從你們那裏已經傳揚出來、你們向 神的信心不但在馬其頓和亞該亞、就是在各處、也都傳開了．所以不用我們說甚麼話。

1 Thessalonians 1:9 For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:9 因爲他們自己已經報明我們是怎樣進到你們那裏、你們是怎樣離棄偶像歸向 神、要服事那又眞又活的 神、

1 Thessalonians 1:10 And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
帖撒羅尼迦前書 1:10 等候他兒子從天降臨、就是他從死裏復活的、那位救我們脫離將來忿怒的耶穌。

1 Thessalonians 2:1 For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
帖撒羅尼迦前書 2:1 弟兄們、你們自己原曉得我們進到你們那裏、並不是徒然的。

1 Thessalonians 2:2 But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
帖撒羅尼迦前書 2:2 我們從前在腓立比被害受辱、這是你們知道的．然而還是靠我們的 神放開膽量、在大爭戰中把 神的福音傳給你們。

1 Thessalonians 2:3 For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
帖撒羅尼迦前書 2:3 我們的勸勉、不是出於錯誤、不是出於汚穢、也不是用詭詐．

1 Thessalonians 2:4 But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
帖撒羅尼迦前書 2:4 但 神旣然驗中了我們、把福音託付我們、我們就照樣講、不是要討人喜歡、乃是要討那察驗我們心的 神喜歡。

1 Thessalonians 2:5 For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
帖撒羅尼迦前書 2:5 因爲我們從來沒有用過諂媚的話、這是你們知道的．也沒有藏着貪心、這是 神可以作見證的。

1 Thessalonians 2:6 Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
