## 2 Thessalonians / 帖撒羅尼迦後書

2 Thessalonians 1:1 Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:1 保羅、西拉、提摩太、寫信給帖撒羅尼迦在 神我們的父與主耶穌基督裏的教會．

2 Thessalonians 1:2 Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:2 願恩惠平安、從父 神和主耶穌基督、歸與你們。

2 Thessalonians 1:3 We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:3 弟兄們、我們該爲你們常常感謝 神、這本是合宜的．因你們的信心格外增長、並且你們衆人彼此相愛的心也都充足．

2 Thessalonians 1:4 So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:4 甚至我們在 神的各教會裏爲你們誇口、都因你們在所受的一切逼迫患難中、仍舊存忍耐和信心．

2 Thessalonians 1:5 Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:5 這正是 神公義判斷的明證．叫你們可算配得 神的國、你們就是爲這國受苦。

2 Thessalonians 1:6 Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:6 神旣是公義的、就必將患難報應那加患難給你們的人．

2 Thessalonians 1:7 And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:7 也必使你們這受患難的人、與我們同得平安．那時、主耶穌同他有能力的天使、從天上在火燄中顯現、

2 Thessalonians 1:8 In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:8 要報應那不認識 神、和那不聽從我主耶穌福音的人。

2 Thessalonians 1:9 Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:9 他們要受刑罰、就是永遠沉淪、離開主的面和他權能的榮光．

2 Thessalonians 1:10 When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:10 這正是主降臨要在他聖徒的身上得榮耀、又在一切信的人身上顯爲希奇的那日子．（我們對你們作的見證、你們也信了。）

2 Thessalonians 1:11 Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:11 因此、我們常爲你們禱告、願我們的 神看你們配得過所蒙的召．又用大能成就你們一切所羨慕的良善、和一切因信心所作的工夫．

2 Thessalonians 1:12 That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 1:12 叫我們主耶穌的名、在你們身上得榮耀、你們也在他身上得榮耀、都照着我們的 神並主耶穌基督的恩。

2 Thessalonians 2:1 Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:1 弟兄們、論到我們主耶穌基督降臨、和我們到他那裏聚集、

2 Thessalonians 2:2 That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:2 我勸你們、無論有靈、有言語、有冒我名的書信、說主的日子現在到了、不要輕易動心、也不要驚慌。

2 Thessalonians 2:3 Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:3 人不拘用甚麼法子、你們總不要被他誘惑．因爲那日子以前、必有離道反教的事．並有那大罪人、就是沉淪之子、顯露出來．

2 Thessalonians 2:4 Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:4 他是抵擋主、高抬自己、超過一切稱爲 神的、和一切受人敬拜的．甚至坐在 神的殿裏、自稱是 神。

2 Thessalonians 2:5 Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:5 我還在你們那裏的時候、曾把這些事告訴你們、你們不記得麼。

2 Thessalonians 2:6 And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:6 現在你們也知道那攔阻他的是甚麼、是叫他到了的時候、纔可以顯露．

2 Thessalonians 2:7 For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:7 因爲那不法的隱意已經發動．只是現在有一個攔阻的、等到那攔阻的被除去．

2 Thessalonians 2:8 And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:8 那時這不法的人、必顯露出來．主耶穌要用口中的氣滅絕他、用降臨的榮光廢掉他。

2 Thessalonians 2:9 Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:9 這不法的人來、是照撒但的運動、行各樣的異能神蹟、和一切虛假的奇事、

2 Thessalonians 2:10 And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:10 並且在那沉淪的人身上、行各樣出於不義的詭詐．因他們不領受愛眞理的心、使他們得救。

2 Thessalonians 2:11 And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:11 故此、 神就給他們一個生發錯誤的心、叫他們信從虛謊．

2 Thessalonians 2:12 That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:12 使一切不信眞理、倒喜愛不義的人、都被定罪。

2 Thessalonians 2:13 But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:13 主所愛的弟兄們哪、我們本該常爲你們感謝 神．因爲他從起初揀選了你們、叫你們因信眞道、又被聖靈感動成爲聖潔、能以得救。

2 Thessalonians 2:14 Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:14 神藉我們所傳的福音、召你們到這地步、好得着我們主耶穌基督的榮光。

2 Thessalonians 2:15 Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:15 所以弟兄們、你們要站立得穩、凡所領受的教訓、不拘是我們口傳的、是信上寫的、都要堅守。

2 Thessalonians 2:16 Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:16 但願我們主耶穌基督、和那愛我們、開恩將永遠的安慰、並美好的盼望、賜給我們的父 神、

2 Thessalonians 2:17 Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 2:17 安慰你們的心、並且在一切善行善言上、堅固你們。

2 Thessalonians 3:1 Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:1 弟兄們、我還有話說．請你們爲我們禱告、好叫主的道理快快行開、得着榮耀、正如在你們中間一樣．

2 Thessalonians 3:2 And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:2 也叫我們脫離無理之惡人的手．因爲人不都是有信心。

2 Thessalonians 3:3 But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:3 但主是信實的、要堅固你們、保護你們脫離那惡者。

2 Thessalonians 3:4 And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:4 我們靠主深信你們現在是遵行我們所吩咐的、後來也必要遵行。

2 Thessalonians 3:5 And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:5 願主引導你們的心、叫你們愛 神並學基督的忍耐。

2 Thessalonians 3:6 Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:6 弟兄們、我們奉主耶穌基督的名吩咐你們、凡有弟兄不按規矩而行、不遵守從我們所受的教訓、就當遠離他。

2 Thessalonians 3:7 For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:7 你們自己原知道應當怎樣效法我們．因爲我們在你們中間、未嘗不按規矩而行．

2 Thessalonians 3:8 Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:8 也未嘗白喫人的飯．倒是辛苦勞碌、晝夜作工、免得叫你們一人受累。

2 Thessalonians 3:9 Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:9 這並不是因我們沒有權柄、乃是要給你們作榜樣、叫你們效法我們。

2 Thessalonians 3:10 For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:10 我們在你們那裏的時候、曾吩咐你們說、若有人不肯作工、就不可喫飯。

2 Thessalonians 3:11 For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:11 因我們聽說、在你們中間有人不按規矩而行、甚麼工都不作、反倒專管閒事。

2 Thessalonians 3:12 Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:12 我們靠主耶穌基督、吩咐勸戒這樣的人、要安靜作工、喫自己的飯。

2 Thessalonians 3:13 But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:13 弟兄們、你們行善不可喪志。

2 Thessalonians 3:14 And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:14 若有人不聽從我們這信上的話、要記下他、不和他交往、叫他自覺羞愧。

2 Thessalonians 3:15 Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:15 但不要以他爲仇人、要勸他如弟兄。

2 Thessalonians 3:16 Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:16 願賜平安的主、隨時隨事親自給你們平安．願主常與你們衆人同在。

2 Thessalonians 3:17 The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:17 我保羅親筆問你們安．凡我的信都以此爲記．我的筆跡就是這樣。

2 Thessalonians 3:18 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
帖撒羅尼迦後書 3:18 願我們主耶穌基督的恩、常與你們衆人同在。 提摩太前書]] 1925

## 1 Timothy / 提摩太前書

1 Timothy 1:1 Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
提摩太前書 1:1 奉我們救主 神、和我們的盼望基督耶穌之命、作基督耶穌使徒的保羅、

1 Timothy 1:2 Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
提摩太前書 1:2 寫信給那因信主作我眞兒子的提摩太．願恩惠憐憫平安、從父 神和我們主基督耶穌、歸與你。

1 Timothy 1:3 As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
提摩太前書 1:3 我往馬其頓去的時候、曾勸你仍住在以弗所、好囑咐那幾個人、不可傳異教、

1 Timothy 1:4 Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
提摩太前書 1:4 也不可聽從荒渺無憑的話語、和無窮的家譜．這等事只生辯論、並不發明 神在信上所立的章程。

1 Timothy 1:5 Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
提摩太前書 1:5 但命令的總歸就是愛．這愛是從清潔的心、和無虧的良心、無僞的信心、生出來的。

1 Timothy 1:6 From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
提摩太前書 1:6 有人偏離這些、反去講虛浮的話．

1 Timothy 1:7 Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
提摩太前書 1:7 想要作教法師、卻不明白自己所講說的、所論定的。

1 Timothy 1:8 But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
提摩太前書 1:8 我們知道律法原是好的、只要人用得合宜．

1 Timothy 1:9 Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
提摩太前書 1:9 因爲律法不是爲義人設立的、乃是爲不法和不服的、不虔誠和犯罪的、不聖潔和戀世俗的、弒父母和殺人的、

1 Timothy 1:10 For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
提摩太前書 1:10 行淫和親男色的、搶人口和說謊話的、並起假誓的、或是爲別樣敵正道的事設立的。

1 Timothy 1:11 According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
提摩太前書 1:11 這是照着可稱頌之 神交託我榮耀福音說的。

1 Timothy 1:12 And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
提摩太前書 1:12 我感謝那給我力量的、我們主基督耶穌、因他以我有忠心、派我服事他。

1 Timothy 1:13 Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
提摩太前書 1:13 我從前是褻瀆 神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的．然而我還蒙了憐憫、因我是不信不明白的時候而作的。

1 Timothy 1:14 And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
提摩太前書 1:14 並且我主的恩是格外豐盛、使我在基督耶穌裏有信心和愛心。

1 Timothy 1:15 This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
提摩太前書 1:15 基督耶穌降世、爲要拯救罪人．這話是可信的、是十分可佩服的．在罪人中我是個罪魁。

1 Timothy 1:16 Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
提摩太前書 1:16 然而我蒙了憐憫、是因耶穌基督要在我這罪魁身上、顯明他一切的忍耐、給後來信他得永生的人作榜樣。

1 Timothy 1:17 Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
提摩太前書 1:17 但願尊貴榮耀歸與那不能朽壞不能看見永世的君王、獨一的 神、直到永永遠遠。阿們。

1 Timothy 1:18 This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
提摩太前書 1:18 我兒提摩太阿、我照從前指着你的豫言、將這命令交託你、叫你因此可以打那美好的仗．

1 Timothy 1:19 Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
提摩太前書 1:19 常存信心、和無虧的良心．有人丟棄良心、就在眞道上如同船破壞了一般。

1 Timothy 1:20 Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
提摩太前書 1:20 其中有許米乃和亞力山大．我已經把他們交給撒但、使他們受責罰、就不再謗瀆了。

1 Timothy 2:1 I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
提摩太前書 2:1 我勸你第一要爲萬人懇求、禱告、代求、祝謝．

1 Timothy 2:2 For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
提摩太前書 2:2 爲君王和一切在位的也該如此．使我們可以敬虔端正、平安無事的度日。

1 Timothy 2:3 For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
提摩太前書 2:3 這是好的、在 神我們救主面前可蒙悅納。

1 Timothy 2:4 Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
提摩太前書 2:4 他願意萬人得救、明白眞道．

1 Timothy 2:5 For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
提摩太前書 2:5 因爲只有一位 神、在 神和人中間、只有一位中保、乃是降世爲人的基督耶穌。

1 Timothy 2:6 Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
提摩太前書 2:6 他捨自己作萬人的贖價．到了時候、這事必證明出來。

1 Timothy 2:7 Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
提摩太前書 2:7 我爲此奉派、作傳道的、作使徒、作外邦人的師傅、教導他們相信、學習眞道。我說的是眞話、並不是謊言。

1 Timothy 2:8 I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
提摩太前書 2:8 我願男人無忿怒、無爭論、舉起聖潔的手、隨處禱告。

1 Timothy 2:9 In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broidered hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
提摩太前書 2:9 又願女人廉恥、自守、以正派衣裳爲妝飾、不以編髮、黃金、珍珠、和貴價的衣裳爲妝飾．

1 Timothy 2:10 But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
提摩太前書 2:10 只要有善行．這纔與自稱是敬 神的女人相宜。

1 Timothy 2:11 Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
提摩太前書 2:11 女人要沉靜學道、一味的順服。

1 Timothy 2:12 But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
提摩太前書 2:12 我不許女人講道、也不許他轄管男人、只要沉靜。

1 Timothy 2:13 For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
提摩太前書 2:13 因爲先造的是亞當、後造的是夏娃。

1 Timothy 2:14 And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
提摩太前書 2:14 且不是亞當被引誘、乃是女人被引誘、陷在罪裏。

1 Timothy 2:15 Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
提摩太前書 2:15 然而女人若常存信心愛心、又聖潔自守、就必在生產上得救。

1 Timothy 3:1 This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
提摩太前書 3:1 人若想要得監督的職分、就是羨慕善工．這話是可信的．

1 Timothy 3:2 A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
提摩太前書 3:2 作監督的、必須無可指責、只作一個婦人的丈夫、有節制、自守、端正、樂意接待遠人、善於教導．

1 Timothy 3:3 Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
提摩太前書 3:3 不因酒滋事、不打人、只要溫和、不爭競、不貪財．

1 Timothy 3:4 One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
提摩太前書 3:4 好好管理自己的家、使兒女凡事端莊順服。

1 Timothy 3:5 (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
提摩太前書 3:5 人若不知道管理自己的家、焉能照管 神的教會呢。

1 Timothy 3:6 Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
提摩太前書 3:6 初入教的不可作監督、恐怕他自高自大、就落在魔鬼所受的刑罰裏。

1 Timothy 3:7 Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
提摩太前書 3:7 監督也必須在教外有好名聲、恐怕被人毀謗、落在魔鬼的網羅裏。

1 Timothy 3:8 Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
提摩太前書 3:8 作執事的也是如此、必須端莊、不一口兩舌、不好喝酒、不貪不義之財．

1 Timothy 3:9 Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
提摩太前書 3:9 要存清潔的良心、固守眞道的奧祕。

1 Timothy 3:10 And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
提摩太前書 3:10 這等人也要先受試驗．若沒有可責之處、然後叫他們作執事。

1 Timothy 3:11 Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
提摩太前書 3:11 女執事也是如此、必須端莊、不說讒言、有節制、凡事忠心。

1 Timothy 3:12 Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
提摩太前書 3:12 執事只要作一個婦人的丈夫、好好管理兒女和自己的家。

1 Timothy 3:13 For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
提摩太前書 3:13 因爲善作執事的、自己就得到美好的地步、並且在基督耶穌裏的眞道上大有膽量。

1 Timothy 3:14 These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
提摩太前書 3:14 我指望快到你那裏去、所以先將這些事寫給你．

1 Timothy 3:15 But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
提摩太前書 3:15 倘若我躭延日久、你也可以知道在 神的家中當怎樣行．這家就是永生 神的教會、眞理的柱石和根基。

1 Timothy 3:16 And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
提摩太前書 3:16 大哉、敬虔的奧祕、無人不以爲然．就是 神在肉身顯現、被聖靈稱義、被天使看見、被傳於外邦、被世人信服、被接在榮耀裏。

1 Timothy 4:1 Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
提摩太前書 4:1 聖靈明說、在後來的時候、必有人離棄眞道、聽從那引誘人的邪靈、和鬼魔的道理。

1 Timothy 4:2 Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
提摩太前書 4:2 這是因爲說謊之人的假冒．這等人的良心、如同被熱鐵烙慣了一般。

1 Timothy 4:3 Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
提摩太前書 4:3 他們禁止嫁娶、又禁戒食物、就是 神所造叫那信而明白眞道的人、感謝着領受的。

1 Timothy 4:4 For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
提摩太前書 4:4 凡 神所造的物、都是好的．若感謝着領受、就沒有一樣可棄的．

1 Timothy 4:5 For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
提摩太前書 4:5 都因 神的道和人的祈求、成爲聖潔了。

1 Timothy 4:6 If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
提摩太前書 4:6 你若將這些事題醒弟兄們、便是基督耶穌的好執事、在眞道的話語、和你向來所服從的善道上、得了教育。

1 Timothy 4:7 But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
提摩太前書 4:7 只是要棄絕那世俗的言語、和老婦荒渺的話、在敬虔上操練自己。

1 Timothy 4:8 For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
提摩太前書 4:8 操練身體、益處還少．惟獨敬虔、凡事都有益處．因有今生和來生的應許．

1 Timothy 4:9 This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
提摩太前書 4:9 這話是可信的、是十分可佩服的。

1 Timothy 4:10 For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
提摩太前書 4:10 我們勞苦努力、正是爲此．因我們的指望在乎永生的 神．他是萬人的救主、更是信徒的救主。

1 Timothy 4:11 These things command and teach.
提摩太前書 4:11 這些事你要吩咐人、也要教導人。

1 Timothy 4:12 Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
提摩太前書 4:12 不可叫人小看你年輕．總要在言語、行爲、愛心、信心、清潔上．都作信徒的榜樣。

1 Timothy 4:13 Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
提摩太前書 4:13 你要以宣讀、勸勉、教導爲念、直等到我來。

1 Timothy 4:14 Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
提摩太前書 4:14 你不要輕忽所得的恩賜、就是從前藉着豫言、在衆長老按手的時候、賜給你的。

1 Timothy 4:15 Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
提摩太前書 4:15 這些事你要殷勤去作、並要在此專心、使衆人看出你的長進來。

1 Timothy 4:16 Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
提摩太前書 4:16 你要謹愼自己和自己的教訓、要在這些事上恆心．因爲這樣行、又能救自己、又能救聽你的人。

1 Timothy 5:1 Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
提摩太前書 5:1 不可嚴責老年人、只要勸他如同父親．勸少年人如同弟兄．

1 Timothy 5:2 The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
提摩太前書 5:2 勸老年婦女如同母親．勸少年婦女如同姐妹．總要清清潔潔的。

1 Timothy 5:3 Honour widows that are widows indeed.
提摩太前書 5:3 要尊敬那眞爲寡婦的。

1 Timothy 5:4 But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
提摩太前書 5:4 若寡婦有兒女、或有孫子孫女、便叫他們先在自己家中學着行孝、報答親恩．因爲這在 神面前是可悅納的。

1 Timothy 5:5 Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
提摩太前書 5:5 那獨居無靠眞爲寡婦的、是仰賴 神、晝夜不住的祈求禱告。

1 Timothy 5:6 But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
提摩太前書 5:6 但那好宴樂的寡婦、正活着的時候、也是死的。

1 Timothy 5:7 And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
提摩太前書 5:7 這些事你要囑咐他們、叫他們無可指責。

1 Timothy 5:8 But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
提摩太前書 5:8 人若不看顧親屬、就是背了眞道、比不信的人還不好．不看顧自己家裏的人、更是如此。

1 Timothy 5:9 Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man.
提摩太前書 5:9 寡婦記在册子上、必須年紀到六十歲、從來只作一個丈夫的妻子、

1 Timothy 5:10 Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
提摩太前書 5:10 又有行善的名聲、就如養育兒女、接待遠人、洗聖徒的脚、救濟遭難的人、竭力行各樣善事。

1 Timothy 5:11 But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
提摩太前書 5:11 至於年輕的寡婦、就可以辭他．因爲他們的情慾發動、違背基督的時候、就想要嫁人。

1 Timothy 5:12 Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
提摩太前書 5:12 他們被定罪、是因廢棄了當初所許的願．

1 Timothy 5:13 And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
提摩太前書 5:13 並且他們又習慣懶惰、挨家閒遊．不但是懶惰、又說長道短、好管閒事、說些不當說的話。

1 Timothy 5:14 I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

1 Timothy 5:15 For some are already turned aside after Satan.
提摩太前書 5:15 因爲已經有轉去隨從撒但的。

1 Timothy 5:16 If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
提摩太前書 5:16 信主的婦女、若家中有寡婦、自己就當救濟他們、不可累着教會、好使教會能救濟那眞無倚靠的寡婦。

1 Timothy 5:17 Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
提摩太前書 5:17 那善於管理教會的長老、當以爲配受加倍的敬奉．那勞苦傳道教導人的、更當如此。

1 Timothy 5:18 For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
提摩太前書 5:18 因爲經上說、『〡牛在塲上踹穀的時候、不可籠住他的嘴。』又說、『〢工人得工價是應當的。』

1 Timothy 5:19 Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
提摩太前書 5:19 控告長老的呈子、非有兩三個見證就不要收。

1 Timothy 5:20 Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
提摩太前書 5:20 犯罪的人、當在衆人面前責備他、叫其餘的人也可以懼怕。

1 Timothy 5:21 I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
提摩太前書 5:21 我在 神和基督耶穌並蒙揀選的天使面前囑咐你、要遵守這些話、不可存成見、行事也不可有偏心。

1 Timothy 5:22 Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
提摩太前書 5:22 給人行按手的禮、不可急促．不要在別人的罪上有分．要保守自己清潔。

1 Timothy 5:23 Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
提摩太前書 5:23 因你胃口不清、屢次患病、再不要照常喝水、可以稍微用點酒。

1 Timothy 5:24 Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
提摩太前書 5:24 有些人的罪是明顯的、如同先到審判案前．有些人的罪是隨後跟了去的。

1 Timothy 5:25 Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
提摩太前書 5:25 這樣、善行也有明顯的．那不明顯的、也不能隱藏。 :5a〡申廿五 〤 :5b〢利十九 〡三

1 Timothy 6:1 Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
提摩太前書 6:1 凡在軛下作僕人的、當以自己主人配受十分的恭敬、免得 神的名和道理、被人褻瀆。

1 Timothy 6:2 And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
提摩太前書 6:2 僕人有信道的主人、不可因爲與他是弟兄就輕看他．更要加意服事他．因爲得服事之益處的、是信道蒙愛的。你要以此教訓人、勸勉人。

1 Timothy 6:3 If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
提摩太前書 6:3 若有人傳異教、不服從我們主耶穌基督純正的話、與那合乎敬虔的道理．

1 Timothy 6:4 He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
提摩太前書 6:4 他是自高自大、一無所知、專好問難、爭辯言詞、從此就生出嫉妒、分爭、毀謗、妄疑、

1 Timothy 6:5 Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
提摩太前書 6:5 並那壞了心術、失喪眞理之人的爭競。他們以敬虔爲得利的門路．

1 Timothy 6:6 But godliness with contentment is great gain.
提摩太前書 6:6 然而敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了．

1 Timothy 6:7 For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
提摩太前書 6:7 因爲我們沒有帶甚麼到世上來、也不能帶甚麼去．

1 Timothy 6:8 And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
提摩太前書 6:8 只要有衣有食、就當知足。

1 Timothy 6:9 But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
提摩太前書 6:9 但那些想要發財的人、就陷在迷惑、落在網羅、和許多無知有害的私慾裏、叫人沉在敗壞和滅亡中。

1 Timothy 6:10 For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
提摩太前書 6:10 貪財是萬惡之根．有人貪戀錢財、就被引誘離了眞道、用許多愁苦把自己刺透了。

1 Timothy 6:11 But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
提摩太前書 6:11 但你這屬 神的人、要逃避這些事、追求公義、敬虔、信心、愛心、忍耐、溫柔。

1 Timothy 6:12 Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
提摩太前書 6:12 你要爲眞道打那美好的仗、持定永生．你爲此被召．也在許多見證人面前、已經作了那美好的見證。

1 Timothy 6:13 I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
提摩太前書 6:13 我在叫萬物生活的 神面前、並在向本丟彼拉多作過那美好見證的基督耶穌面前囑咐你、

1 Timothy 6:14 That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
提摩太前書 6:14 要守這命令、毫不玷汚、無可指責、直到我們的主耶穌基督顯現．

1 Timothy 6:15 Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
提摩太前書 6:15 到了日期、那可稱頌獨有權能的、萬王之王、萬主之主、

1 Timothy 6:16 Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
提摩太前書 6:16 就是那獨一不死、住在人不能靠近的光裏、是人未曾看見、也是不能看見的、要將他顯明出來。但願尊貴和永遠的權能、都歸給他。阿們。

1 Timothy 6:17 Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
提摩太前書 6:17 你要囑咐那些今世富足的人、不要自高、也不要倚靠無定的錢財．只要倚靠那厚賜百物給我們享受的 神。

1 Timothy 6:18 That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
提摩太前書 6:18 又要囑咐他們行善、在好事上富足、甘心施捨、樂意供給人、

1 Timothy 6:19 Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
提摩太前書 6:19 爲自己積成美好的根基、豫備將來、叫他們持定那眞正的生命。

1 Timothy 6:20 O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
提摩太前書 6:20 提摩太阿、你要保守所託付你的、躱避世俗的虛談、和那敵眞道似是而非的學問。

1 Timothy 6:21 Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
提摩太前書 6:21 已經有人自稱有這學問、就偏離了眞道。願恩惠常與你們同在。 提摩太後書]] 1925

## 2 Timothy / 提摩太後書

2 Timothy 1:1 Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
提摩太後書 1:1 奉 神旨意、照着在基督耶穌裏生命的應許、作基督耶穌使徒的保羅、

2 Timothy 1:2 To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
提摩太後書 1:2 寫信給我親愛的兒子提摩太．願恩惠憐憫平安、從父 神和我們主基督耶穌、歸與你。

2 Timothy 1:3 I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
提摩太後書 1:3 我感謝 神、就是我接續祖先、用清潔的良心所事奉的 神、祈禱的時候、不住的想念你、

2 Timothy 1:4 Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
提摩太後書 1:4 記念你的眼淚、晝夜切切的想要見你、好叫我滿心快樂．

2 Timothy 1:5 When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
提摩太後書 1:5 想到你心裏無僞之信．這信是先在你外祖母羅以、和你母親友尼基心裏的．我深信也在你的心裏。

2 Timothy 1:6 Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
提摩太後書 1:6 爲此我題醒你、使你將 神藉我按手所給你的恩賜、再如火挑旺起來。

2 Timothy 1:7 For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
提摩太後書 1:7 因爲 神賜給我們、不是膽怯的心、乃是剛強、仁愛、謹守的心。

2 Timothy 1:8 Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
提摩太後書 1:8 你不要以給我們的主作見證爲恥、也不要以我這爲主被囚的爲恥．總要按 神的能力、與我爲福音同受苦難．

2 Timothy 1:9 Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
提摩太後書 1:9 神救了我們、以聖召召我們、不是按我們的行爲、乃是按他的旨意、和恩典．這恩典是萬古之先、在基督耶穌裏賜給我們的．

2 Timothy 1:10 But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
提摩太後書 1:10 但如今藉着我們救主基督耶穌的顯現、纔表明出來了。他已經把死廢去、藉着福音、將不能壞的生命彰顯出來。

2 Timothy 1:11 Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
提摩太後書 1:11 我爲這福音奉派作傳道的、作使徒、作師傅。

2 Timothy 1:12 For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
提摩太後書 1:12 爲這緣故、我也受這些苦難．然而我不以爲恥．因爲知道我所信的是誰、也深信他能保全我所交付他的、直到那日。

2 Timothy 1:13 Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

## Titus / 提多書

Titus 1:1 Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
提多書 1:1 神的僕人、耶穌基督的使徒保羅、憑着 神選民的信心、與敬虔眞理的知識、

Titus 1:2 In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
提多書 1:2 盼望那無謊言的 神、在萬古之先所應許的永生、

Titus 1:3 But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
提多書 1:3 到了日期、藉着傳揚的工夫、把他的道顯明了．這傳揚的責任、是按着 神我們救主的命令交託了我。

Titus 1:4 To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

提多書 1:5 我從前留你在革哩底、是要你將那沒有辦完的事都辦整齊了、又照我所吩咐你的、在各城設立長老．

提多書 1:6 若有無可指責的人、只作一個婦人的丈夫、兒女也是信主的、沒有人告他們是放蕩不服約束的、就可以設立。

提多書 1:7 監督旣是 神的管家、必須無可指責、不任性、不暴躁、不因酒滋事、不打人、不貪無義之財、

Titus 1:8 But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
提多書 1:8 樂意接待遠人、好善、莊重、公平、聖潔、自持．

提多書 1:9 堅守所教眞實的道理、就能將純正的教訓勸化人．又能把爭辯的人駁倒了。

Titus 1:11 Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
提多書 1:11 這些人的口總要堵住．他們因貪不義之財、將不該教導的教導人、敗壞人的全家。

Titus 1:12 One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
提多書 1:12 有革哩底人中的一個本地先知說、『革哩底人常說謊話、乃是惡獸、又饞又懶．』

Titus 1:13 This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

Titus 1:14 Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

## Philemon / 腓利門書

希伯來書 3:1 同蒙天召的聖潔弟兄阿、你們應當思想我們所認爲使者、爲大祭司的耶穌．
