希伯來書 3:2 他爲那設立他的盡忠、如同摩西在 神的全家盡忠一樣。

Hebrews 3:3 For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
希伯來書 3:3 他比摩西算是更配多得榮耀、好像建造房屋的比房屋更尊榮。

Hebrews 3:4 For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
希伯來書 3:4 因爲房屋都必有人建造．但建造萬物的就是 神。

Hebrews 3:5 And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
希伯來書 3:5 摩西爲僕人、在 神的全家誠然盡忠、爲要證明將來必傳說的事．

Hebrews 3:6 But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
希伯來書 3:6 但基督爲兒子、治理 神的家．我們若將可誇的盼望和膽量、堅持到底、便是他的家了。

Hebrews 3:7 Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
希伯來書 3:7 聖靈有話說、『〡你們今日若聽他的話、

Hebrews 3:8 Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
希伯來書 3:8 就不可硬着心、像在曠野惹他發怒、試探他的時候一樣．

Hebrews 3:9 When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
希伯來書 3:9 在那裏、你們的祖宗試我探我、並且觀看我的作爲、有四十年之久。

Hebrews 3:10 Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
希伯來書 3:10 所以我厭煩那世代的人、說、他們心裏常常迷糊、竟不曉得我的作爲．

Hebrews 3:11 So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
希伯來書 3:11 我就在怒中起誓說、他們斷不可進入我的安息。』

Hebrews 3:12 Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
希伯來書 3:12 弟兄們、你們要謹愼、免得你們中間、或有人存着不信的惡心、把永生 神離棄了．

Hebrews 3:13 But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
希伯來書 3:13 總要趁着還有今日、天天彼此相勸、免得你們中間、有人被罪迷惑、心裏就剛硬了。

Hebrews 3:14 For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
希伯來書 3:14 我們若將起初確實的信心、堅持到底、就在基督裏有分了。

Hebrews 3:15 While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
希伯來書 3:15 經上說、『〢你們今日若聽他的話、就不可硬着心、像惹他發怒的日子一樣。』

Hebrews 3:16 For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
希伯來書 3:16 那時聽見他話惹他發怒的是誰呢．豈不是跟着摩西從埃及出來的衆人麼。

Hebrews 3:17 But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
希伯來書 3:17 神四十年之久、又厭煩誰呢．豈不是那些犯罪屍首倒在曠野的人麼。

Hebrews 3:18 And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
希伯來書 3:18 又向誰起誓、不容他們進入他的安息呢．豈不是向那些不信從的人麼。

Hebrews 3:19 So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
希伯來書 3:19 這樣看來、他們不能進入安息、是因爲不信的緣故了。 :3a〡詩九十五 〧至〡一 :3b〢詩九十五 〨

Hebrews 4:1 Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
希伯來書 4:1 我們旣蒙留下有進入他安息的應許、就當畏懼、免得我們中間、或有人似乎是趕不上了。

Hebrews 4:2 For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
希伯來書 4:2 因爲有福音傳給我們、像傳給他們一樣．只是所聽見的道與他們無益、因爲他們沒有信心與所聽見的道調和。

Hebrews 4:3 For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
希伯來書 4:3 但我們已經相信的人、得以進入那安息、正如 神所說、『〡我在怒中起誓說、他們斷不可進入我的安息。』其實造物之工、從創世以來已經成全了。

Hebrews 4:4 For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
希伯來書 4:4 論到第七日、有一處說、『〢到第七日 神就歇了他一切的工。』

Hebrews 4:5 And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
希伯來書 4:5 又有一處說、『他們斷不可進入我的安息。』

Hebrews 4:6 Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
希伯來書 4:6 旣有必進安息的人、那先前聽見福音的、因爲不信從、不得進去．

Hebrews 4:7 Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
希伯來書 4:7 所以過了多年、就在大衞的書上、又限定一日、如以上所引的說、『〣你們今日若聽他的話、就不可硬着心。』

Hebrews 4:8 For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
希伯來書 4:8 若是約書亞已叫他們享了安息、後來 神就不再題別的日子了。

Hebrews 4:9 There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
希伯來書 4:9 這樣看來、必另有一安息日的安息、爲 神的子民存留。

Hebrews 4:10 For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
希伯來書 4:10 因爲那進入安息的、乃是歇了自己的工、正如 神歇了他的工一樣。

Hebrews 4:11 Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
希伯來書 4:11 所以我們務必竭力進入那安息、免得有人學那不信從的樣子跌倒了。

Hebrews 4:12 For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
希伯來書 4:12 神的道是活潑的、是有功效的、比一切兩刃的劍更快、甚至魂與靈、骨節與骨髓、都能刺入剖開、連心中的思念和主意、都能辨明。

Hebrews 4:13 Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
希伯來書 4:13 並且被造的、沒有一樣在他面前不顯然的．原來萬物、在那與我們有關係的主眼前、都是赤露敞開的。

Hebrews 4:14 Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
希伯來書 4:14 我們旣然有一位已經升入高天尊榮的大祭司、就是 神的兒子耶穌、便當持定所承認的道。

Hebrews 4:15 For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
希伯來書 4:15 因我們的大祭司、並非不能體恤我們的輭弱．他也曾凡事受過試探、與我們一樣．只是他沒有犯罪。

Hebrews 4:16 Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
希伯來書 4:16 所以我們只管坦然無懼的、來到施恩的寶座前、爲要得憐恤、蒙恩惠作隨時的幫助。 :4a〡詩九十五 〡一 :4b〢創二 〢 :4c〣詩九十五 〨

Hebrews 5:1 For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
希伯來書 5:1 凡從人間挑選的大祭司、是奉派替人辦理屬 神的事、爲要獻上禮物、和贖罪祭．

Hebrews 5:2 Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
希伯來書 5:2 他能體諒那愚蒙的、和失迷的人、因爲他自己也是被輭弱所困．

Hebrews 5:3 And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
希伯來書 5:3 故此他理當爲百姓和自己獻祭贖罪。

Hebrews 5:4 And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
希伯來書 5:4 這大祭司的尊榮、沒有人自取、惟要蒙 神所召、像亞倫一樣。

Hebrews 5:5 So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
希伯來書 5:5 如此、基督也不是自取榮耀作大祭司、乃是在乎向他說『〡你是我的兒子、我今日生你。』的那一位．

Hebrews 5:6 As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
希伯來書 5:6 就如經上又有一處說、『〢你是照着麥基洗德的等次永遠爲祭司。』

Hebrews 5:7 Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
希伯來書 5:7 基督在肉體的時候、旣大聲哀哭、流淚禱告懇求那能救他免死的主、就因他的虔誠、蒙了應允。

Hebrews 5:8 Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
希伯來書 5:8 他雖然爲兒子、還是因所受的苦難學了順從．

Hebrews 5:9 And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
希伯來書 5:9 他旣得以完全、就爲凡順從他的人、成了永遠得救的根源．

Hebrews 5:10 Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
希伯來書 5:10 並蒙 神照着麥基洗德的等次稱他爲大祭司。

Hebrews 5:11 Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
希伯來書 5:11 論到麥基洗德、我們有好些話、並且難以解明、因爲你們聽不進去。

Hebrews 5:12 For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
希伯來書 5:12 看你們學習的工夫、本該作師傅、誰知還得有人將 神聖言小學的開端、另教導你們．並且成了那必須喫奶、不能喫乾糧的人。

Hebrews 5:13 For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
希伯來書 5:13 凡只能喫奶的、都不熟練仁義的道理．因爲他是嬰孩。

Hebrews 5:14 But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
希伯來書 5:14 惟獨長大成人的、纔能喫乾糧、他們的心竅、習練得通達、就能分辨好歹了。 :5a〡詩二 〧 :5b〢詩百十 〤

Hebrews 6:1 Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
希伯來書 6:1 所以我們應當離開基督道理的開端、竭力進到完全的地步．不必再立根基、就如那懊悔死行、信靠 神、

Hebrews 6:2 Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
希伯來書 6:2 各樣洗禮、按手之禮、死人復活、以及永遠審判、各等教訓。

Hebrews 6:3 And this will we do, if God permit.
希伯來書 6:3 神若許我們、我們必如此行。

Hebrews 6:4 For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
希伯來書 6:4 論到那些已經蒙了光照、嘗過天恩的滋味、又於聖靈有分、

Hebrews 6:5 And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
希伯來書 6:5 並嘗過 神善道的滋味、覺悟來世權能的人、

Hebrews 6:6 If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
希伯來書 6:6 若是離棄道理、就不能叫他們從新懊悔了．因爲他們把 神的兒子重釘十字架、明明的羞辱他。

Hebrews 6:7 For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
希伯來書 6:7 就如一塊田地、喫過屢次下的雨水、生長菜蔬合乎耕種的人用、就從 神得福．

Hebrews 6:8 But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
希伯來書 6:8 若長荊棘和蒺藜、必被廢棄、近於咒詛、結局就是焚燒。

Hebrews 6:9 But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
希伯來書 6:9 親愛的弟兄們、我們雖是這樣說、卻深信你們的行爲強過這些、而且近乎得救。

Hebrews 6:10 For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
希伯來書 6:10 因爲 神並非不公義、竟忘記你們所作的工、和你們爲他名所顯的愛心、就是先前伺候聖徒、如今還是伺候。

Hebrews 6:11 And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
希伯來書 6:11 我們願你們各人都顯出這樣的殷勤、使你們有滿足的指望、一直到底。

Hebrews 6:12 That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
希伯來書 6:12 並且不懈怠．總要效法那些憑信心和忍耐承受應許的人。

Hebrews 6:13 For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
希伯來書 6:13 當初 神應許亞伯拉罕的時候、因爲沒有比自己更大可以指着起誓的、就指着自己起誓、說、

Hebrews 6:14 Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
希伯來書 6:14 『〡論福、我必賜大福給你．論子孫、我必叫你的子孫多起來。』

Hebrews 6:15 And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
希伯來書 6:15 這樣、亞伯拉罕旣恆久忍耐、就得了所應許的。

Hebrews 6:16 For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
希伯來書 6:16 人都是指着比自己大的起誓．並且以起誓爲實據、了結各樣的爭論。

Hebrews 6:17 Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
希伯來書 6:17 照樣、 神願意爲那承受應許的人、格外顯明他的旨意是不更改的、就起誓爲證．

Hebrews 6:18 That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
希伯來書 6:18 藉這兩件不更改的事、 神決不能說謊、好叫我們這逃往避難所、持定擺在我們前頭指望的人、可以大得勉勵．

Hebrews 6:19 Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
希伯來書 6:19 我們有這指望如同靈魂的錨、又堅固又牢靠、且通入幔內。

Hebrews 6:20 Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
希伯來書 6:20 作先鋒的耶穌、旣照着麥基洗德的等次、成了永遠的大祭司、就爲我們進入幔內。 :6a〡創廿二 〡〦 〡〧

Hebrews 7:1 For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
希伯來書 7:1 這麥基洗德、就是撒冷王、又是至高 神的祭司、本是長遠爲祭司的．他當亞伯拉罕殺敗諸王回來的時候、就迎接他、給他祝福。

Hebrews 7:2 To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
希伯來書 7:2 亞伯拉罕也將自己所得來的、取十分之一給他．他頭一個名繙出來、就是仁義王、他又名撒冷王、就是平安王的意思．

Hebrews 7:3 Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
希伯來書 7:3 他無父、無母、無族譜、無生之始、無命之終、乃是與 神的兒子相似。

Hebrews 7:4 Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
希伯來書 7:4 你們想一想、先祖亞伯拉罕、將自己所擄來上等之物取十分之一給他、這人是何等尊貴呢。

Hebrews 7:5 And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
希伯來書 7:5 那得祭司職任的利未子孫、領命照例向百姓取十分之一、這百姓是自己的弟兄、雖是從亞伯拉罕身中生的、還是照例取十分之一．

Hebrews 7:6 But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
希伯來書 7:6 獨有麥基洗德、不與他們同譜、倒收納亞伯拉罕的十分之一、爲那蒙應許的亞伯拉罕祝福。

Hebrews 7:7 And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
希伯來書 7:7 從來位分大的給位分小的祝福、這是駁不倒的理。

Hebrews 7:8 And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
希伯來書 7:8 在這裏收十分之一的都是必死的人．但在那裏收十分之一的、有爲他作見證的說、他是活的。

Hebrews 7:9 And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
希伯來書 7:9 並且可說、那受十分之一的利未、也是藉着亞伯拉罕納了十分之一．

Hebrews 7:10 For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
希伯來書 7:10 因爲麥基洗德迎接亞伯拉罕的時候、利未已經在他先祖的身中。

Hebrews 7:11 If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
希伯來書 7:11 從前百姓在利未人祭司職任以下受律法、倘若藉這職任能得完全、又何用另外興起一位祭司、照麥基洗德的等次、不照亞倫的等次呢。

Hebrews 7:12 For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
希伯來書 7:12 祭司的職任旣已更改、律法也必須更改。

Hebrews 7:13 For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
希伯來書 7:13 因爲這話所指的人、本屬別的支派、那支派裏從來沒有一人伺候祭壇。

Hebrews 7:14 For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
希伯來書 7:14 我們的主分明是從猶大出來的．但這支派、摩西並沒有題到祭司。

Hebrews 7:15 And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
希伯來書 7:15 倘若照麥基洗德的樣式、另外興起一位祭司來、我的話更是顯而易見的了．

Hebrews 7:16 Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
希伯來書 7:16 他成爲祭司、並不是照屬肉體的條例、乃是照無窮之生命的大能．

Hebrews 7:17 For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
希伯來書 7:17 因爲有給他作見證的說、『你是照着麥基洗德的等次永遠爲祭司。』〡

Hebrews 7:18 For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
希伯來書 7:18 先前的條例、因輭弱無益、所以廢掉了．

Hebrews 7:19 For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
希伯來書 7:19 （律法原來一無所成）就引進了更美的指望、靠這指望我們便可以進到 神面前。

Hebrews 7:20 And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
希伯來書 7:20 再者、耶穌爲祭司、並不是不起誓立的。

Hebrews 7:21 (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
希伯來書 7:21 至於那些祭司、原不是起誓立的、只有耶穌是起誓立的．因爲那立他的對他說、『〢主起了誓決不後悔、你是永遠爲祭司。』

Hebrews 7:22 By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
希伯來書 7:22 旣是起誓立的、耶穌就作了更美之約的中保。

Hebrews 7:23 And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
希伯來書 7:23 那些成爲祭司的、數目本來多、是因爲有死阻隔不能長久．

Hebrews 7:24 But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
希伯來書 7:24 這位旣是永遠常存的、他祭司的職任、就長久不更換。

Hebrews 7:25 Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
希伯來書 7:25 凡靠着他進到 神面前的人、他都能拯救到底．因爲他是長遠活着、替他們祈求。

Hebrews 7:26 For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
希伯來書 7:26 像這樣聖潔、無邪惡、無玷汚、遠離罪人、高過諸天的大祭司、原是與我們合宜的。

Hebrews 7:27 Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
希伯來書 7:27 他不像那些大祭司、每日必須先爲自己的罪、後爲百姓的罪獻祭、因爲他只一次將自己獻上、就把這事成全了。

Hebrews 7:28 For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
希伯來書 7:28 律法本是立輭弱的人爲大祭司．但在律法以後起誓的話、是立兒子爲大祭司、乃是成全到永遠的。 :7a〡詩百十 〤 :7b〢詩百十 〤

Hebrews 8:1 Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
希伯來書 8:1 我們所講的事、其中第一要緊的、就是我們有這樣的大祭司、已經坐在天上至大者寶座的右邊、

Hebrews 8:2 A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
希伯來書 8:2 在聖所、就是眞帳幕裏、作執事．這帳幕是主所支的、不是人所支的。

Hebrews 8:3 For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
希伯來書 8:3 凡大祭司都是爲獻禮物和祭物設立的．所以這位大祭司也必須有所獻的。

Hebrews 8:4 For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
希伯來書 8:4 他若在地上、必不得爲祭司、因爲已經有照律法獻禮物的祭司。

Hebrews 8:5 Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
希伯來書 8:5 他們供奉的事、本是天上事的形狀和影像、正如摩西將要造帳幕的時候、蒙 神警戒他、說、『〡你要謹愼、作各樣的物件、都要照着在山上指示你的樣式。』

Hebrews 8:6 But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
希伯來書 8:6 如今耶穌所得的職任是更美的、正如他作更美之約的中保．這約原是憑更美之應許立的。

Hebrews 8:7 For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
希伯來書 8:7 那前約若沒有瑕疵、就無處尋求後約了。

Hebrews 8:8 For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
希伯來書 8:8 所以主指責他的百姓說、『〢日子將到、我要與以色列家、和猶大家、另立新約．

Hebrews 8:9 Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
希伯來書 8:9 不像我拉着他們祖宗的手、領他們出埃及的時候、與他們所立的約．因爲他們不恆心守我的約、我也不理他們．這是主說的。』

Hebrews 8:10 For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
希伯來書 8:10 主又說、『〣那些日子以後、我與以色列家所立的約乃是這樣．我要將我的律法放在他們裏面、寫在他們心上、我要作他們的 神、他們要作我的子民．

Hebrews 8:11 And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
希伯來書 8:11 他們不用各人教導自己的鄉鄰、和自己的弟兄、說、你該認識主．因爲他們從最小的到至大的、都必認識我。

Hebrews 8:12 For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
希伯來書 8:12 我要寬恕他們的不義、不再記念他們的罪愆。』

Hebrews 8:13 In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
希伯來書 8:13 旣說新約。就以前約爲舊了。但那漸舊漸衰的、就必快歸無有了。 :8a〡出廿五 〤十 :8b〢耶三十一 〣一 :8c〣耶三十一 〣三 〣〤

Hebrews 9:1 Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
希伯來書 9:1 原來前約有禮拜的條例、和屬世界的聖幕。

Hebrews 9:2 For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
希伯來書 9:2 因爲有豫備的帳幕、頭一層叫作聖所．裏面有燈臺、桌子、和陳設餅。

Hebrews 9:3 And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
希伯來書 9:3 第二幔子後、又有一層帳幕、叫作至聖所．

Hebrews 9:4 Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
希伯來書 9:4 〡有金香爐、有包金的約櫃、櫃裏有盛嗎哪的金罐、和亞倫發過芽的杖、並兩塊約版．

Hebrews 9:5 And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
希伯來書 9:5 櫃上面有榮耀基路伯的影罩着施恩座．這幾件我現在不能一一細說。

Hebrews 9:6 Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
希伯來書 9:6 這些物件旣如此豫備齊了、衆祭司就常進頭一層帳幕、行拜 神的禮．

Hebrews 9:7 But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
希伯來書 9:7 至於第二層帳幕、惟有大祭司一年一次獨自進去、沒有不帶着血、爲自己和百姓的過錯獻上．

Hebrews 9:8 The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
希伯來書 9:8 聖靈用此指明、頭一層帳幕仍存的時候、進入至聖所的路還未顯明．

Hebrews 9:9 Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
希伯來書 9:9 那頭一層帳幕作現今的一個表樣、所獻的禮物和祭物、就着良心說、都不能叫禮拜的人得以完全．

Hebrews 9:10 Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
希伯來書 9:10 這些事連那飲食和諸般洗濯的規矩、都不過是屬肉體的條例、命定到振興的時候爲止。

Hebrews 9:11 But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
希伯來書 9:11 但現在基督已經來到、作了將來美事的大祭司、經過那更大更全備的帳幕、不是人手所造也不是屬乎這世界的．

Hebrews 9:12 Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
希伯來書 9:12 並且不用山羊和牛犢的血、乃用自己的血、只一次進入聖所、成了永遠贖罪的事。

Hebrews 9:13 For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
希伯來書 9:13 若山羊和公牛的血、並母牛犢的灰、灑在不潔的人身上、尚且叫人成聖、身體潔淨．

Hebrews 9:14 How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
希伯來書 9:14 何况基督藉着永遠的靈、將自己無瑕無疵獻給 神、他的血豈不更能洗淨你們的心除去你們的死行、使你們事奉那永生 神麼。

Hebrews 9:15 And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
希伯來書 9:15 爲此他作了新約的中保．旣然受死贖了人在前約之時所犯的罪過、便叫蒙召之人得着所應許永遠的產業。

Hebrews 9:16 For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
希伯來書 9:16 凡有遺命、必須等到留遺命的人死了．

Hebrews 9:17 For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
希伯來書 9:17 因爲人死了、遺命纔有効力、若留遺命的尚在、那遺命還有用處麼。

Hebrews 9:18 Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
希伯來書 9:18 所以前約也不是不用血立的。

Hebrews 9:19 For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
希伯來書 9:19 因爲摩西當日照着律法、將各樣誡命傳給衆百姓、就拿朱紅色絨和牛膝草、把牛犢山羊的血和水、灑在書上、又灑在衆百姓身上、說、

Hebrews 9:20 Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
希伯來書 9:20 『〢這血就是 神與你們立約的憑據。』

Hebrews 9:21 Moreover he sprinkled likewise with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
希伯來書 9:21 他又照樣把血灑在帳幕、和各樣器皿上。

Hebrews 9:22 And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
希伯來書 9:22 按着律法、凡物差不多都是用血潔淨的、若不流血、罪就不得赦免了。

Hebrews 9:23 It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
希伯來書 9:23 照着天上樣式作的物件、必須用這些祭物去潔淨．但那天上的本物、自然當用更美的祭物去潔淨。

Hebrews 9:24 For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
希伯來書 9:24 因爲基督並不是進了人手所造的聖所、（這不過是眞聖所的影像）乃是進了天堂、如今爲我們顯在 神面前．

Hebrews 9:25 Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
希伯來書 9:25 也不是多次將自己獻上、像那大祭司每年帶着牛羊的血進入聖所．

Hebrews 9:26 For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
希伯來書 9:26 如果這樣、他從創世以來、就必多次受苦了．但如今在這末世顯現一次、把自己獻爲祭、好除掉罪。

Hebrews 9:27 And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
希伯來書 9:27 按着定命、人人都有一死、死後且有審判．

Hebrews 9:28 So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
希伯來書 9:28 像這樣、基督旣然一次被獻、擔當了多人的罪、將來要向那等候他的人第二次顯現、並與罪無關、乃是爲拯救他們。 :9a〡代下廿六 〡〩 結八 〡一 :9b〢出廿四 〨

Hebrews 10:1 For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
希伯來書 10:1 律法旣是將來美事的影兒、不是本物的眞像、總不能藉着每年常獻一樣的祭物、叫那近前來的人得以完全。

Hebrews 10:2 For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
希伯來書 10:2 若不然、獻祭的事豈不早已止住了麼．因爲禮拜的人、良心旣被潔淨、就不再覺得有罪了。

Hebrews 10:3 But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
希伯來書 10:3 但這些祭物是叫人每年想起罪來。

Hebrews 10:4 For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
希伯來書 10:4 因爲公牛和山羊的血、斷不能除罪。

Hebrews 10:5 Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
希伯來書 10:5 所以基督到世上來的時候、就說、『〡 神阿、祭物和禮物是你不願意的、你曾給我豫備了身體．

Hebrews 10:6 In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
希伯來書 10:6 燔祭和贖罪祭是你不喜歡的．

Hebrews 10:7 Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
希伯來書 10:7 那時我說、 神阿、我來了爲要照你的旨意行．我的事在經卷上已經記載了。』

Hebrews 10:8 Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
希伯來書 10:8 以上說、祭物和禮物、燔祭和贖罪祭、是你不願意的、也是你不喜歡的、（這都是按着律法獻的）

Hebrews 10:9 Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
希伯來書 10:9 後又說、我來了爲要照你的旨意行．可見他是除去在先的、爲要立定在後的。

Hebrews 10:10 By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
希伯來書 10:10 我們憑這旨意、靠耶穌基督只一次獻上他的身體、就得以成聖。

Hebrews 10:11 And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
希伯來書 10:11 凡祭司天天站着事奉 神、屢次獻上一樣的祭物．這祭物永不能除罪。

Hebrews 10:12 But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
希伯來書 10:12 但基督獻了一次永遠的贖罪祭、就在 神的右邊坐下了．

Hebrews 10:13 From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
希伯來書 10:13 從此等候他仇敵成了他的脚凳。

Hebrews 10:14 For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
希伯來書 10:14 因爲他一次獻祭、便叫那得以成聖的人永遠完全。

Hebrews 10:15 Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
希伯來書 10:15 聖靈也對我們作見證．因爲他旣已說過、

Hebrews 10:16 This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
希伯來書 10:16 『〢主說、那些日子以後、我與他們所立的約乃是這樣．我要將我的律法寫在他們心上、又要放在他們的裏面。』

Hebrews 10:17 And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
希伯來書 10:17 以後就說、『我不再記念他們的罪愆、和他們的過犯。』

Hebrews 10:18 Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
希伯來書 10:18 這些罪過旣已赦免、就不用再爲罪獻祭了。

Hebrews 10:19 Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
希伯來書 10:19 弟兄們、我們旣因耶穌的血、得以坦然進入至聖所、

Hebrews 10:20 By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
希伯來書 10:20 是藉着他給我們開了一條又新又活的路從幔子經過、這幔子就是他的身體．

Hebrews 10:21 And having an high priest over the house of God;
希伯來書 10:21 又有一位大祭司治理 神的家．

Hebrews 10:22 Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
希伯來書 10:22 並我們心中天良的虧欠已經灑去、身體用清水洗淨了、就當存着誠心、和充足的信心、來到 神面前．

Hebrews 10:23 Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
希伯來書 10:23 也要堅守我們所承認的指望、不至搖動．因爲那應許我們的是信實的．

Hebrews 10:24 And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
希伯來書 10:24 又要彼此相顧、激發愛心、勉勵行善。

Hebrews 10:25 Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
希伯來書 10:25 你們不可停止聚會、好像那些停止慣了的人、倒要彼此勸勉．旣知道那日子臨近、就更當如此。

Hebrews 10:26 For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
希伯來書 10:26 因爲我們得知眞道以後、若故意犯罪、贖罪的祭就再沒有了．

Hebrews 10:27 But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
希伯來書 10:27 惟有戰懼等候審判和那燒滅衆敵人的烈火。

Hebrews 10:28 He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
希伯來書 10:28 人干犯摩西的律法、憑兩三個見證人、尚且不得憐恤而死．

Hebrews 10:29 Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
希伯來書 10:29 何况人踐踏 神的兒子、將那使他成聖之約的血當作平常、又褻慢施恩的聖靈、你們想、他要受的刑罰該怎樣加重呢。

Hebrews 10:30 For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
希伯來書 10:30 因爲我們知道誰說、『〣伸寃在我、我必報應。』又說、『〤主要審判他的百姓。』

Hebrews 10:31 It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
希伯來書 10:31 落在永生 神的手裏、眞是可怕的。

Hebrews 10:32 But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
希伯來書 10:32 你們要追念往日、蒙了光照以後、所忍受大爭戰的各樣苦難．

Hebrews 10:33 Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
希伯來書 10:33 一面被毀謗、遭患難、成了戲景、叫衆人觀看．一面陪伴那些受這樣苦難的人。

Hebrews 10:34 For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
希伯來書 10:34 因爲你們體恤了那些被捆鎖的人、並且你們的家業被人搶去、也甘心忍受、知道自己有更美長存的家業。

Hebrews 10:35 Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
希伯來書 10:35 所以你們不可丟棄勇敢的心．存這樣的心必得大賞賜。

Hebrews 10:36 For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
希伯來書 10:36 你們必須忍耐、使你們行完了 神的旨意、就可以得着所應許的。

Hebrews 10:37 For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
希伯來書 10:37 『〥因爲還有一點點時候、那要來的就來、並不遲延。

Hebrews 10:38 Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
希伯來書 10:38 只是義人必因信得生、他若退後、我心裏就不喜歡他。』

Hebrews 10:39 But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
希伯來書 10:39 我們卻不是退後入沉淪的那等人、乃是有信心以致靈魂得救的人。 :10a〡詩四十 〦至〨 :10b〢耶三十一 〣三 〣〤 :10c〣申三十二 〣〥 :10d〤申三十二 〣〦 :10e〥哈二 〣 〤

Hebrews 11:1 Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
希伯來書 11:1 信就是所望之事的實底、是未見之事的確據。

Hebrews 11:2 For by it the elders obtained a good report.
希伯來書 11:2 古人在這信上得了美好的證據。

Hebrews 11:3 Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
希伯來書 11:3 我們因着信、就知道諸世界是藉 神話造成的．這樣、所看見的、並不是從顯然之物造出來的。

Hebrews 11:4 By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
希伯來書 11:4 亞伯因着信獻祭與 神、比該隱所獻的更美、因此便得了稱義的見證、就是 神指他禮物作的見證．他雖然死了、卻因這信仍舊說話。

Hebrews 11:5 By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
希伯來書 11:5 以諾因着信被接去、不至於見死．人也找不着他、因爲 神已經把他接去了．只是他被接去以先、已經得了 神喜悅他的明證。

Hebrews 11:6 But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
希伯來書 11:6 人非有信、就不能得 神的喜悅．因爲到 神面前來的人、必須信有神，且信他賞賜那尋求他的人。

Hebrews 11:7 By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
希伯來書 11:7 挪亞因着信、旣蒙 神指示他未見的事、動了敬畏的心、豫備了一隻方舟、使他全家得救．因此就定了那世代的罪、自己也承受了那從信而來的義。

Hebrews 11:8 By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
希伯來書 11:8 亞伯拉罕因着信、蒙召的時候、就遵命出去、往將來要得爲業的地方去．出去的時候、還不知往那裏去。

Hebrews 11:9 By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
希伯來書 11:9 他因着信、就在所應許之地作客、好像在異地居住帳棚、與那同蒙一個應許的以撒、雅各一樣。

Hebrews 11:10 For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
希伯來書 11:10 因爲他等候那座有根基的城、就是 神所經營所建造的。

Hebrews 11:11 Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
希伯來書 11:11 因着信、連撒拉自己、雖然過了生育的歲數、還能懷孕．因他以爲那應許他的是可信的．

Hebrews 11:12 Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
希伯來書 11:12 所以從一個彷彿已死的人就生出子孫、如同天上的星那樣衆多、海邊的沙那樣無數。

Hebrews 11:13 These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
希伯來書 11:13 這些人都是存着信心死的、並沒有得着所應許的、卻從遠處望見、且歡喜迎接、又承認自己在世上是客旅、是寄居的。

Hebrews 11:14 For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
希伯來書 11:14 說這樣話的人、是表明自己要找一個家鄉。

Hebrews 11:15 And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
希伯來書 11:15 他們若想念所離開的家鄉、還有可以回去的機會。

Hebrews 11:16 But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
希伯來書 11:16 他們卻羨慕一個更美的家鄉、就是在天上的．所以 神被稱爲他們的 神、並不以爲恥．因爲他已經給他們豫備了一座城。

Hebrews 11:17 By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
希伯來書 11:17 亞伯拉罕因着信、被試驗的時候、就把以撒獻上．這便是那歡喜領受應許的、將自己獨生的兒子獻上。

Hebrews 11:18 Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
希伯來書 11:18 論到這兒子曾有話說、『〡從以撒生的纔要稱爲你的後裔．』

Hebrews 11:19 Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
希伯來書 11:19 他以爲 神還能叫人從死裏復活．他也彷彿從死中得回他的兒子來。

Hebrews 11:20 By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
希伯來書 11:20 以撒因着信、就指着將來的事、給雅各以掃祝福。

Hebrews 11:21 By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
希伯來書 11:21 雅各因着信、臨死的時候、給約瑟的兩個兒子各自祝福、扶着杖頭敬拜 神。

Hebrews 11:22 By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
希伯來書 11:22 約瑟因着信、臨終的時候、題到以色列族將來要出埃及、並爲自己的骸骨留下遺命。

Hebrews 11:23 By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
希伯來書 11:23 摩西生下來、他的父母見他是個俊美的孩子、就因着信把他藏了三個月、並不怕王命。

Hebrews 11:24 By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
希伯來書 11:24 摩西因着信、長大了就不肯稱爲法老女兒之子．

Hebrews 11:25 Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
希伯來書 11:25 他寧可和 神的百姓同受苦害、也不願暫時享受罪中之樂．

Hebrews 11:26 Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
希伯來書 11:26 他看爲基督受的凌辱、比埃及的財物更寶貴．因他想望所要得的賞賜。

Hebrews 11:27 By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
希伯來書 11:27 他因着信、就離開埃及、不怕王怒．因爲他恆心忍耐、如同看見那不能看見的主。

Hebrews 11:28 Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
希伯來書 11:28 他因着信、就守逾越節、行灑血的禮、免得那滅長子的臨近以色列人。

Hebrews 11:29 By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
希伯來書 11:29 他們因着信、過紅海如行乾地．埃及人試着要過去、就被吞滅了。

Hebrews 11:30 By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
希伯來書 11:30 以色列人因着信、圍繞耶利哥城七日、城牆就倒塌了。

Hebrews 11:31 By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
希伯來書 11:31 妓女喇合因着信、曾和和平平的接待探子、就不與那些不順從的人一同滅亡。

Hebrews 11:32 And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
希伯來書 11:32 我又何必再說呢．若要一一細說、基甸、巴拉、參孫、耶弗他、大衞、撒母耳、和衆先知的事、時候就不彀了。

Hebrews 11:33 Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions.
希伯來書 11:33 他們因着信、制伏了敵國、行了公義、得了應許、堵了獅子的口。

Hebrews 11:34 Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
希伯來書 11:34 滅了烈火的猛勢、脫了刀劍的鋒刃、輭弱變爲剛強、爭戰顯出勇敢、打退外邦的全軍。

Hebrews 11:35 Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
希伯來書 11:35 有婦人得自己的死人復活、又有人忍受嚴刑、不肯苟且得釋放、爲要得着更美的復活．

Hebrews 11:36 And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
希伯來書 11:36 又有人忍受戲弄、鞭打、捆鎖、監禁、各等的磨煉、

Hebrews 11:37 They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
希伯來書 11:37 被石頭打死、被鋸鋸死、受試探、被刀殺．披着綿羊山羊的皮各處奔跑、受窮乏、患難、苦害、

Hebrews 11:38 (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
希伯來書 11:38 在曠野、山嶺、山洞、地穴、飄流無定．本是世界不配有的人。

Hebrews 11:39 And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
希伯來書 11:39 這些人都是因信得了美好的證據、卻仍未得着所應許的．

Hebrews 11:40 God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
希伯來書 11:40 因爲 神給我們豫備了更美的事、叫他們若不與我們同得、就不能完全。 :11a〡創廿一 〡二

Hebrews 12:1 Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
希伯來書 12:1 我們旣有這許多的見證人、如同雲彩圍着我們、就當放下各樣的重擔、脫去容易纏累我們的罪、存心忍耐、奔那擺在我們前頭的路程、

Hebrews 12:2 Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
希伯來書 12:2 仰望爲我們信心創始成終的耶穌．他因那擺在前面的喜樂、就輕看羞辱、忍受了十字架的苦難、便坐在 神寶座的右邊。

Hebrews 12:3 For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
希伯來書 12:3 那忍受罪人這樣頂撞的、你們要思想、免得疲倦灰心。

Hebrews 12:4 Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
希伯來書 12:4 你們與罪惡相爭、還沒有抵擋到流血的地步。

Hebrews 12:5 And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
希伯來書 12:5 你們又忘了那勸你們如同勸兒子的話、說、『〡我兒、你不可輕看主的管教、被他責備的時候、也不可灰心．

Hebrews 12:6 For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
希伯來書 12:6 因爲主所愛的他必管教、又鞭打凡所收納的兒子。』

Hebrews 12:7 If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
希伯來書 12:7 你們所忍受的、是 神管教你們、待你們如同待兒子．焉有兒子不被父親管教的呢。

Hebrews 12:8 But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
希伯來書 12:8 管教原是衆子所共受的、你們若不受管教、就是私子、不是兒子了。

Hebrews 12:9 Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
希伯來書 12:9 再者、我們曾有生身的父管教我們、我們尚且敬重他、何况萬靈的父、我們豈不更當順服他得生麼。

Hebrews 12:10 For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
希伯來書 12:10 生身的父都是暫隨己意管教我們．惟有萬靈的父管教我們、是要我們得益處、使我們在他的聖潔上有分。

Hebrews 12:11 Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
希伯來書 12:11 凡管教的事、當時不覺得快樂、反覺得愁苦．後來卻爲那經練過的人、結出平安的果子、就是義．

Hebrews 12:12 Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
希伯來書 12:12 所以你們要把下垂的手、發酸的腿、挺起來．

Hebrews 12:13 And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
希伯來書 12:13 也要爲自己的脚把道路修直了、使瘸子不至歪脚、反得痊愈。

Hebrews 12:14 Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
希伯來書 12:14 你們要追求與衆人和睦、並要追求聖潔．非聖潔沒有人能見主．

Hebrews 12:15 Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
希伯來書 12:15 又要謹愼、恐怕有人失了 神的恩．恐怕有毒根生出來擾亂你們、因此叫衆人沾染汚穢．

Hebrews 12:16 Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
希伯來書 12:16 恐怕有淫亂的、有貪戀世俗如以掃的．他因一點食物把自己長子的名分賣了。

Hebrews 12:17 For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
希伯來書 12:17 後來想要承受父所祝的福、竟被棄絕、雖然號哭切求、卻得不着門路、使他父親的心意回轉、這是你們知道的。

Hebrews 12:18 For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
希伯來書 12:18 你們原不是來到那能摸的山、此山有火燄、密雲、黑暗、暴風、

Hebrews 12:19 And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
希伯來書 12:19 角聲與說話的聲音．那些聽見這聲音的、都求不要再向他們說話．

Hebrews 12:20 (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
希伯來書 12:20 因爲他們當不起所命他們的話、說、『〢靠近這山的、卽便是走獸、也要用石頭打死。』

Hebrews 12:21 And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
希伯來書 12:21 所見的極其可怕、甚至摩西說、『〣我甚是恐懼戰兢。』

Hebrews 12:22 But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
希伯來書 12:22 你們乃是來到錫安山、永生 神的城邑、就是天上的耶路撒冷．那裏有千萬的天使、

Hebrews 12:23 To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
希伯來書 12:23 有名錄在天上諸長子之會所共聚的總會、有審判衆人的 神、和被成全之義人的靈魂、

Hebrews 12:24 And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
希伯來書 12:24 並新約的中保耶穌、以及所灑的血．這血所說的比亞伯的血所說的更美。

Hebrews 12:25 See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
希伯來書 12:25 你們總要謹愼、不可棄絕那向你們說話的．因爲那些棄絕在地上警戒他們的、尚且不能逃罪、何况我們違背那從天上警戒我們的呢。

Hebrews 12:26 Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
希伯來書 12:26 當時他的聲音震動了地．但如今他應許說、『〤再一次我不單要震動地、還要震動天。』

Hebrews 12:27 And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
希伯來書 12:27 這再一次的話、是指明被震動的、就是受造之物、都要挪去、使那不被震動的常存。

Hebrews 12:28 Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
希伯來書 12:28 所以我們旣得了不能震動的國、就當感恩、照 神所喜悅的、用虔誠敬畏的心事奉 神。

Hebrews 12:29 For our God is a consuming fire.
希伯來書 12:29 因爲我們的 神乃是烈火。 :12a〡箴三 〡一 〡二 :12b〢出十九 〡二 〡三 :12c〣申九 〡〩 :12d〤該二 〦

Hebrews 13:1 Let brotherly love continue.
希伯來書 13:1 你們務要常存弟兄相愛的心。

Hebrews 13:2 Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
希伯來書 13:2 不可忘記用愛心接待客旅．因爲曾有接待客旅的、不知不覺就接待了天使。

Hebrews 13:3 Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
希伯來書 13:3 你們要記念被捆綁的人、好像與他們同受捆綁、也要記念遭苦害的人、想到自己也在肉身之內。

Hebrews 13:4 Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
希伯來書 13:4 婚姻、人人都當尊重、牀也不可汚穢．因爲苟合行淫的人 神必要審判。

Hebrews 13:5 Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
希伯來書 13:5 你們存心不可貪愛錢財．要以自己所有的爲足．因爲主曾說、『〡我總不撇下你、也不丟棄你。』

Hebrews 13:6 So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
希伯來書 13:6 所以我們可以放膽說、『〢主是幫助我的、我必不懼怕．人能把我怎麼樣呢。』

Hebrews 13:7 Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
希伯來書 13:7 從前引導你們、傳 神之道給你們的人、你們要想念他們、效法他們的信心、留心看他們爲人的結局。

Hebrews 13:8 Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
希伯來書 13:8 耶穌基督、昨日今日一直到永遠是一樣的。

Hebrews 13:9 Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
希伯來書 13:9 你們不要被那諸般怪異的教訓勾引了去．因爲人心靠恩得堅固纔是好的．並不是靠飲食．那在飲食上專心的、從來沒有得着益處。

Hebrews 13:10 We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
希伯來書 13:10 我們有一祭壇、上面的祭物是那些在帳幕中供職的人不可同喫的。

Hebrews 13:11 For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
希伯來書 13:11 原來牲畜的血、被大祭司帶入聖所作贖罪祭、牲畜的身子、被燒在營外。

Hebrews 13:12 Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
希伯來書 13:12 所以耶穌、要用自己的血叫百姓成聖、也就在城門外受苦。

Hebrews 13:13 Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
希伯來書 13:13 這樣、我們也當出到營外就了他去、忍受他所受的凌辱。

Hebrews 13:14 For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
希伯來書 13:14 我們在這裏本沒有常存的城、乃是尋求那將來的城。

Hebrews 13:15 By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
希伯來書 13:15 我們應當靠着耶穌、常常以頌讚爲祭、獻給 神、這就是那承認主名之人嘴唇的果子。

Hebrews 13:16 But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
希伯來書 13:16 只是不可忘記行善、和捐輸的事．因爲這樣的祭、是 神所喜悅的。

Hebrews 13:17 Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
希伯來書 13:17 你們要依從那些引導你們的、且要順服．因他們爲你們的靈魂時刻儆醒、好像那將來交帳的人．你們要使他們交的時候有快樂、不至憂愁．若憂愁就與你們無益了。

Hebrews 13:18 Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
希伯來書 13:18 請你們爲我們禱告．因我們自覺良心無虧、願意凡事按正道而行。

Hebrews 13:19 But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
希伯來書 13:19 我更求你們爲我禱告、使我快些回到你們那裏去。

Hebrews 13:20 Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
希伯來書 13:20 但願賜平安的 神、就是那憑永約之血使羣羊的大牧人我主耶穌、從死裏復活的 神、

Hebrews 13:21 Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
希伯來書 13:21 在各樣善事上、成全你們、叫你們遵行他的旨意、又藉着耶穌基督在你們心裏行他所喜悅的事．願榮耀歸給他、直到永永遠遠。阿們。

Hebrews 13:22 And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
希伯來書 13:22 弟兄們、我畧畧寫信給你們、望你們聽我勸勉的話。

Hebrews 13:23 Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
希伯來書 13:23 你們該知道我們的兄弟提摩太已經釋放了．他若快來、我必同他去見你們。

Hebrews 13:24 Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
希伯來書 13:24 請你們問引導你們的諸位和衆聖徒安。從義大利來的人也問你們安。

Hebrews 13:25 Grace be with you all. Amen.
希伯來書 13:25 願恩惠常與你們衆人同在。阿們。 :13a〡申三十一 〦 書一 〥 :13b〢詩百十八 〦 雅各書]] 1925

## James / 雅各書

James 1:1 James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
雅各書 1:1 作 神和主耶穌基督僕人的雅各、請散住十二個支派之人的安。

James 1:2 My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
雅各書 1:2 我的弟兄們、你們落在百般試煉中、都要以爲大喜樂．

James 1:3 Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
雅各書 1:3 因爲知道你們的信心經過試驗、就生忍耐。

James 1:4 But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
雅各書 1:4 但忍耐也當成功、使你們成全完備、毫無缺欠。

James 1:5 If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
雅各書 1:5 你們中間若有缺少智慧的、應當求那厚賜與衆人、也不斥責人的 神、主就必賜給他。

James 1:6 But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
雅各書 1:6 只要憑着信心求、一點不疑惑．因爲那疑惑的人、就像海中的波浪、被風吹動翻騰。

James 1:7 For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
雅各書 1:7 這樣的人、不要想從主那裏得甚麼．

James 1:8 A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
雅各書 1:8 心懷二意的人、在他一切所行的路上、都沒有定見。

James 1:9 Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
雅各書 1:9 卑微的弟兄升高、就該喜樂．

James 1:10 But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
雅各書 1:10 富足的降卑、也該如此．因爲他必要過去、如同草上的花一樣．

James 1:11 For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
雅各書 1:11 太陽出來、熱風颳起、草就枯乾、花也凋謝、美容就消沒了．那富足的人、在他所行的事上、也要這樣衰殘。

James 1:12 Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
雅各書 1:12 忍受試探的人是有福的．因爲他經過試驗以後、必得生命的冠冕、這是主應許給那些愛他之人的。

James 1:13 Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
雅各書 1:13 人被試探、不可說、我是被 神試探．因爲 神不能被惡試探、他也不試探人．

James 1:14 But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
雅各書 1:14 但各人被試探、乃是被自己的私慾牽引誘惑的。

James 1:15 Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
雅各書 1:15 私慾旣懷了胎、就生出罪來．罪旣長成、就生出死來。

James 1:16 Do not err, my beloved brethren.
雅各書 1:16 我親愛的弟兄們、不要看錯了。

James 1:17 Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
雅各書 1:17 各樣美善的恩賜、和各樣全備的賞賜、都是從上頭來的．從衆光之父那裏降下來的．在他並沒有改變、也沒有轉動的影兒。

James 1:18 Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
雅各書 1:18 他按自己的旨意、用眞道生了我們、叫我們在他所造的萬物中、好像初熟的果子。

James 1:19 Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
雅各書 1:19 我親愛的弟兄們、這是你們所知道的．但你們各人要快快的聽、慢慢的說、慢慢的動怒．

James 1:20 For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
雅各書 1:20 因爲人的怒氣、並不成就 神的義。

James 1:21 Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
雅各書 1:21 所以你們要脫去一切的汚穢、和盈餘的邪惡、存溫柔的心領受那所栽種的道、就是能救你們靈魂的道。

James 1:22 But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
雅各書 1:22 只是你們要行道、不要單單聽道、自己欺哄自己．

James 1:23 For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
雅各書 1:23 因爲聽道而不行道的、就像人對着鏡子看自己本來的面目．

James 1:24 For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
雅各書 1:24 看見、走後、隨卽忘了他的相貌如何。

James 1:25 But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
雅各書 1:25 惟有詳細察看那全備使人自由之律法的、並且時常如此、這人旣不是聽了就忘、乃是實在行出來、就在他所行的事上必然得福。

James 1:26 If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
雅各書 1:26 若有人自以爲虔誠、卻不勒住他的舌頭、反欺哄自己的心、這人的虔誠是虛的。

James 1:27 Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
雅各書 1:27 在 神我們的父面前、那清潔沒有玷汚的虔誠、就是看顧在患難中的孤兒寡婦、並且保守自己不沾染世俗。

James 2:1 My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
雅各書 2:1 我的弟兄們、你們信奉我們榮耀的主耶穌基督、便不可按着外貌待人。

James 2:2 For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
雅各書 2:2 若有一個人帶着金戒指、穿着華美衣服、進你們的會堂去．又有一個窮人、穿着骯髒衣服也進去．

James 2:3 And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
雅各書 2:3 你們就重看那穿華美衣服的人、說、請坐在這好位上．又對那窮人說、你站在那裏、或坐在我脚凳下邊．

James 2:4 Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
雅各書 2:4 這豈不是你們偏心待人、用惡意斷定人麼。

James 2:5 Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
雅各書 2:5 我親愛的弟兄們請聽、 神豈不是揀選了世上的貧窮人、叫他們在信上富足、並承受他所應許給那些愛他之人的國麼。

James 2:6 But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
雅各書 2:6 你們反倒羞辱貧窮人。那富足人豈不是欺壓你們、拉你們到公堂去麼。

James 2:7 Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
雅各書 2:7 他們不是褻瀆你們所敬奉的尊名麼。

James 2:8 If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
雅各書 2:8 經上記着說、『〡要愛人如己。』你們若全守這至尊的律法纔是好的．

James 2:9 But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
雅各書 2:9 但你們若按外貌待人、便是犯罪、被律法定爲犯法的。

James 2:10 For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
雅各書 2:10 因爲凡遵守全律法的、只在一條上跌倒、他就是犯了衆條。

James 2:11 For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
雅各書 2:11 〢原來那說不可姦淫的、也說不可殺人．你就是不姦淫、卻殺人、仍是成了犯律法的。

James 2:12 So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
雅各書 2:12 你們旣然要按使人自由的律法受審判、就該照這律法說話行事。

James 2:13 For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
雅各書 2:13 因爲那不憐憫人的、也要受無憐憫的審判．憐憫原是向審判誇勝。

James 2:14 What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
雅各書 2:14 我的弟兄們、若有人說、自己有信心、卻沒有行爲、有甚麼益處呢．這信心能救他麼。

James 2:15 If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
雅各書 2:15 若是弟兄、或是姐妹、赤身露體、又缺了日用的飲食、

James 2:16 And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
雅各書 2:16 你們中間有人對他們說、平平安安的去罷、願你們穿得煖喫得飽．卻不給他們身體所需用的、這有甚麼益處呢。

James 2:17 Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
雅各書 2:17 這樣、信心若沒有行爲就是死的。

James 2:18 Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
雅各書 2:18 必有人說、你有信心、我有行爲．你將你沒有行爲的信心指給我看、我便藉着我的行爲、將我的信心指給你看。

James 2:19 Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
雅各書 2:19 你信 神只有一位、你信的不錯．鬼魔也信、卻是戰驚。

James 2:20 But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
雅各書 2:20 虛浮的人哪、你願意知道沒有行爲的信心是死的麼。

James 2:21 Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
雅各書 2:21 我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕、把他兒子以撒獻在壇上、豈不是因行爲稱義麼。

James 2:22 Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
雅各書 2:22 可見信心是與他的行爲並行、而且信心因着行爲纔得成全．

James 2:23 And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
雅各書 2:23 這就應驗經上所說、『〣亞伯拉罕信 神、這就算爲他的義。』〤他又得稱爲 神的朋友。

James 2:24 Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
雅各書 2:24 這樣看來、人稱義是因着行爲、不是單因着信。

James 2:25 Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
雅各書 2:25 妓女喇合接待使者、又放他們從別的路上出去、不也是一樣因行爲稱義麼。

James 2:26 For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
雅各書 2:26 身體沒有靈魂是死的、信心沒有行爲也是死的。 :2a〡利十九 〡〨 :2b〢出二十 〡三 申五 〡〧 :2c〣創十五 〦 :2d〤代下二十 〧 賽四十一 〨

James 3:1 My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
雅各書 3:1 我的弟兄們、不要多人作師傅、因爲曉得我們要受更重的判斷。

James 3:2 For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
雅各書 3:2 原來我們在許多事上都有過失．若有人在話語上沒有過失、他就是完全人、也能勒住自己的全身。

James 3:3 Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
雅各書 3:3 我們若把嚼環放在馬嘴裏、叫他順服、就能調動他的全身。

James 3:4 Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
雅各書 3:4 看哪、船隻雖然甚大、又被大風催逼、只用小小的舵、就隨着掌舵的意思轉動。

James 3:5 Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
雅各書 3:5 這樣、舌頭在百體裏也是最小的、卻能說大話。看哪、最小的火、能點着最大的樹林．

James 3:6 And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
雅各書 3:6 舌頭就是火、在我們百體中、舌頭是個罪惡的世界、能汚穢全身、也能把生命的輪子點起來．並且是從地獄裏點着的。

James 3:7 For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
雅各書 3:7 各類的走獸、飛禽、昆蟲、水族、本來都可以制伏、也已經被人制伏了．

James 3:8 But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
雅各書 3:8 惟獨舌頭沒有人能制伏、是不止息的惡物．滿了害死人的毒氣。

James 3:9 Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
雅各書 3:9 我們用舌頭頌讚那爲主爲父的、又用舌頭咒詛那照着 神形像被造的人．

James 3:10 Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
雅各書 3:10 頌讚和咒詛從一個口裏出來、我的弟兄們、這是不應當的。

James 3:11 Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
雅各書 3:11 泉源從一個眼裏能發出甜苦兩樣的水麼。

James 3:12 Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
雅各書 3:12 我的弟兄們、無花果樹能生橄欖麼、葡萄樹能結無花果麼．鹹水裏也不能發出甜水來。

James 3:13 Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
雅各書 3:13 你們中間誰是有智慧有見識的呢．他就當在智慧的溫柔上、顯出他的善行來。

James 3:14 But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
雅各書 3:14 你們心裏若懷着苦毒的嫉妒和分爭、就不可自誇、也不可說謊話抵擋眞道。

James 3:15 This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
雅各書 3:15 這樣的智慧、不是從上頭來的、乃是屬地的、屬情慾的、屬鬼魔的。

James 3:16 For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
雅各書 3:16 在何處有嫉妒分爭、就在何處有擾亂、和各樣的壞事。

James 3:17 But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
雅各書 3:17 惟獨從上頭來的智慧、先是清潔、後是和平、溫良柔順、滿有憐憫、多結善果、沒有偏見、沒有假冒。

James 3:18 And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
雅各書 3:18 並且使人和平的、是用和平所栽種的義果。

James 4:1 From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
雅各書 4:1 你們中間的爭戰鬬毆、是從那裏來的呢．不是從你們百體中戰鬬之私慾來的麼。

James 4:2 Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
雅各書 4:2 你們貪戀、還是得不着．你們殺害嫉妒、又鬬毆爭戰、也不能得．你們得不着、是因爲你們不求。

James 4:3 Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
雅各書 4:3 你們求也得不着、是因爲你們妄求、要浪費在你們的宴樂中。

James 4:4 Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
雅各書 4:4 你們這些淫亂的人哪、豈不知與世俗爲友、就是與 神爲敵麼．所以凡想要與世俗爲友的、就是與 神爲敵了。

James 4:5 Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
雅各書 4:5 你們想經上所說是徒然的麼． 神所賜住在我們裏面的靈、是戀愛至於嫉妒麼。

James 4:6 But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
雅各書 4:6 但他賜更多的恩典．所以經上說、『〡 神阻擋驕傲的人、賜恩給謙卑的人。』

James 4:7 Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
雅各書 4:7 故此你們要順服 神．務要抵擋魔鬼、魔鬼就必離開你們逃跑了。

James 4:8 Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
雅各書 4:8 你們親近 神、 神就必親近你們。有罪的人哪、要潔淨你們的手。心懷二意的人哪、要清潔你們的心。

James 4:9 Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
雅各書 4:9 你們要愁苦、悲哀、哭泣．將喜笑變作悲哀、歡樂變作愁悶。

James 4:10 Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
雅各書 4:10 務要在主面前自卑、主就必叫你們升高。

James 4:11 Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
雅各書 4:11 弟兄們、你們不可彼此批評．人若批評弟兄、論斷弟兄、就是批評律法、論斷律法．你若論斷律法、就不是遵行律法、乃是判斷人的。

James 4:12 There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
雅各書 4:12 設立律法和判斷人的、只有一位、就是那能救人也能滅人的．你是誰、竟敢論斷別人呢。

James 4:13 Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
雅各書 4:13 嗐、你們有話說、今天明天我們要往某城裏去、在那裏住一年、作買賣得利．

James 4:14 Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
雅各書 4:14 其實明天如何、你們還不知道。你們的生命是甚麼呢．你們原來是一片雲霧、出現少時就不見了。

James 4:15 For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
雅各書 4:15 你們只當說、主若願意、我們就可以活着、也可以作這事、或作那事。

James 4:16 But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
雅各書 4:16 現今你們竟以張狂誇口．凡這樣誇口都是惡的。

James 4:17 Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
雅各書 4:17 人若知道行善、卻不去行、這就是他的罪了。 :4a〡箴三 〣〤

James 5:1 Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
雅各書 5:1 嗐、你們這些富足人哪、應當哭泣、號咷、因爲將有苦難臨到你們身上。

James 5:2 Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
雅各書 5:2 你們的財物壞了、衣服也被蟲子咬了。

James 5:3 Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
雅各書 5:3 你們的金銀都長了銹．那銹要證明你們的不是、又要喫你們的肉、如同火燒。你們在這末世、只知積儹錢財。

James 5:4 Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
雅各書 5:4 工人給你們收割莊稼、你們虧欠他們的工錢．這工錢有聲音呼叫．並且那收割之人的寃聲、已經入了萬軍之主的耳了。

James 5:5 Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
雅各書 5:5 你們在世上享美福、好宴樂、當宰殺的日子竟嬌養你們的心。

James 5:6 Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
雅各書 5:6 你們定了義人的罪、把他殺害、他也不抵擋你們。

James 5:7 Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
雅各書 5:7 弟兄們哪、你們要忍耐、直到主來。看哪、農夫忍耐等候地裏寶貴的出產、直到得了秋雨春雨。

James 5:8 Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
雅各書 5:8 你們也當忍耐、堅固你們的心．因爲主來的日子近了。

James 5:9 Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
雅各書 5:9 弟兄們、你們不要彼此埋怨、免得受審判．看哪、審判的主站在門前了。

James 5:10 Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
雅各書 5:10 弟兄們、你們要把那先前奉主名說話的衆先知、當作能受苦能忍耐的榜樣。

James 5:11 Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
雅各書 5:11 那先前忍耐的人、我們稱他們是有福的．你們聽見過約伯的忍耐、也知道主給他的結局、明顯主是滿心憐憫、大有慈悲。

James 5:12 But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
雅各書 5:12 我的弟兄們、最要緊的是不可起誓．不可指着天起誓、也不可指着地起誓、無論何誓都不可起．你們說話、是就說是、不是就說不是、免得你們落在審判之下。

James 5:13 Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
雅各書 5:13 你們中間有受苦的呢、他就該禱告。有喜樂的呢、他就該歌頌。

James 5:14 Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
雅各書 5:14 你們中間有病了的呢、他就該請教會的長老來．他們可以奉主的名用油抹他、爲他禱告．

James 5:15 And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
雅各書 5:15 出於信心的祈禱、要救那病人、主必叫他起來．他若犯了罪、也必蒙赦免。

James 5:16 Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
雅各書 5:16 所以你們要彼此認罪、互相代求、使你們可以得醫治。義人祈禱所發的力量、是大有功效的。

James 5:17 Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
雅各書 5:17 以利亞與我們是一樣性情的人、他懇切禱告、求不要下雨、雨就三年零六個月不下在地上。

James 5:18 And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
雅各書 5:18 他又禱告、天就降下雨來、地也生出土產。

James 5:19 Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
雅各書 5:19 我的弟兄們、你們中間若有失迷眞道的、有人使他回轉．

James 5:20 Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
雅各書 5:20 這人該知道叫一個罪人從迷路上轉回、便是救一個靈魂不死、並且遮蓋許多的罪。 彼得前書]] 1925

## 1 Peter / 彼得前書

1 Peter 1:1 Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
彼得前書 1:1 耶穌基督的使徒彼得、寫信給那分散在本都、加拉太、加帕多家、亞西亞、庇推尼寄居的．

1 Peter 1:2 Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
彼得前書 1:2 就是照父 神的先見被揀選、藉着聖靈得成聖潔、以致順服耶穌基督、又蒙他血所灑的人．願恩惠平安、多多的加給你們。

1 Peter 1:3 Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
彼得前書 1:3 願頌讚歸與我們主耶穌基督的父 神、他曾照自己的大憐憫、藉耶穌基督從死裏復活、重生了我們、叫我們有活潑的盼望、

1 Peter 1:4 To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
彼得前書 1:4 可以得着不能朽壞、不能玷汚、不能衰殘、爲你們存留在天上的基業。

1 Peter 1:5 Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
彼得前書 1:5 你們這因信蒙 神能力保守的人、必能得着所豫備、到末世要顯現的救恩。

1 Peter 1:6 Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
彼得前書 1:6 因此、你們是大有喜樂、但如今、在百般的試煉中暫時憂愁．

1 Peter 1:7 That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
彼得前書 1:7 叫你們的信心旣被試驗、就比那被火試驗、仍然能壞的金子、更顯寶貴．可以在耶穌基督顯現的時候、得着稱讚、榮耀、尊貴。

1 Peter 1:8 Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
彼得前書 1:8 你們雖然沒有見過他、卻是愛他．如今雖不得看見、卻因信他就有說不出來、滿有榮光的大喜樂．

1 Peter 1:9 Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
彼得前書 1:9 並且得着你們信心的果效、就是靈魂的救恩。

1 Peter 1:10 Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
彼得前書 1:10 論到這救恩、那豫先說你們要得恩典的衆先知、早已詳細的尋求考察．

1 Peter 1:11 Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
彼得前書 1:11 就是考察在他們心裏基督的靈、豫先證明基督受苦難、後來得榮耀、是指着甚麼時候、並怎樣的時候。

1 Peter 1:12 Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
彼得前書 1:12 他們得了啟示、知道他們所傳講的一切事、不是爲自己、乃是爲你們．那靠着從天上差來的聖靈、〡傳福音給你們的人、現在將這些事報給你們．天使也願意詳細察看這些事。

1 Peter 1:13 Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
彼得前書 1:13 所以要約束你們的心、謹愼自守、專心盼望耶穌基督顯現的時候所帶來給你們的恩。

1 Peter 1:14 As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
彼得前書 1:14 你們旣作順命的兒女、就不要效法從前蒙昧無知的時候、那放縱私慾的樣子。

1 Peter 1:15 But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
彼得前書 1:15 那召你們的旣是聖潔、你們在一切所行的事上也要聖潔．

1 Peter 1:16 Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
彼得前書 1:16 因爲經上記着說、『〢你們要聖潔、因爲我是聖潔的。』

1 Peter 1:17 And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
彼得前書 1:17 你們旣稱那不偏待人、按各人行爲審判人的主爲父、就當存敬畏的心、度你們在世寄居的日子．

1 Peter 1:18 Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
彼得前書 1:18 知道你們得贖、脫去你們祖宗所傳流虛妄的行爲、不是憑着能壞的金銀等物．

1 Peter 1:19 But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
彼得前書 1:19 乃是憑着基督的寶血、如同無瑕疵無玷汚的羔羊之血．

1 Peter 1:20 Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
彼得前書 1:20 基督在創世以前、是豫先被 神知道的、卻在這末世、纔爲你們顯現．

1 Peter 1:21 Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
彼得前書 1:21 你們也因着他、信那叫他從死裏復活、又給他榮耀的 神、叫你們的信心、和盼望、都在於 神。

1 Peter 1:22 Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
彼得前書 1:22 你們旣因順從眞理、潔淨了自己的心、以致愛弟兄沒有虛假、就當從心裏彼此切實相愛．

1 Peter 1:23 Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
彼得前書 1:23 你們蒙了重生、不是由於能壞的種子、乃是由於不能壞的種子、是藉着 神活潑常存的道。

1 Peter 1:24 For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
彼得前書 1:24 因爲『〣凡有血氣的、盡都如草、他的美榮、都像草上的花．草必枯乾、花必凋謝．

1 Peter 1:25 But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
彼得前書 1:25 惟有主的道是永存的。』所傳給你們的福音就是這道。 :1a〡比太十一 〥 :1b〢利十一 〤〤 〤〥 十九 〢 二十 〧 :1c〣賽四十 〦至〨

1 Peter 2:1 Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
彼得前書 2:1 所以你們旣除去一切的惡毒、詭詐、並假善、嫉妒、和一切毀謗的話、

1 Peter 2:2 As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
彼得前書 2:2 就要愛慕那純淨的靈奶、像纔生的嬰孩愛慕奶一樣、叫你們因此漸長、以致得救．

1 Peter 2:3 If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
彼得前書 2:3 你們若嘗過主恩的滋味、就必如此。

1 Peter 2:4 To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
彼得前書 2:4 主乃活石．固然是被人所棄的、卻是被 神所揀選所寶貴的．

1 Peter 2:5 Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
彼得前書 2:5 你們來到主面前、也就像活石、被建造成爲靈宮、作聖潔的祭司、藉着耶穌基督奉獻 神所悅納的靈祭。

1 Peter 2:6 Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
彼得前書 2:6 因爲經上說、『〡看哪、我把所揀選所寶貴的房角石、安放在錫安．信靠他的人、必不至於羞愧。』

1 Peter 2:7 Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
彼得前書 2:7 所以他在你們信的人就爲寶貴、在那不信的人有話說、『〢匠人所棄的石頭、已作了房角的頭塊石頭。』

1 Peter 2:8 And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

1 Peter 5:6 Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

彼得前書 5:8 務要謹守、儆醒．因爲你們的仇敵魔鬼、如同吼叫的獅子、徧地遊行、尋找可吞喫的人．

1 Peter 5:11 To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

1 Peter 5:13 The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
